text: Jackpot tiers (Mini/Minor/Major/Mega) are colour-coded blue/green/purple/red but each also carries its own text label on the plaque and reel ribbon, so colour is not the only cue.
The four low symbols (Heart/Spade/Clover/Diamond) are distinguished primarily by shape, not only by their red/purple/green/cyan colour.
The Push-Up active state is shown by a colour change (purple spin-button ring) plus a text/icon 'UP' badge and a change in the printed Total Bet text (two numbers instead of one).
Bison, Jackpot Bison and Collector symbols all use similar fire-wreathed bison-head or gold-coin art, but each carries a distinct printed value or letter/ribbon (C, MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, MEGA).
No gameplay-critical information is conveyed by sound alone; all wins, triggers and jackpot hits are also shown as on-screen text and numbers.
Settings expose independent mute toggles for All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music, so audio can be fully disabled.
Core controls (spin, bet select, autoplay, Push-Up toggle, menu, mute) are large, clearly separated buttons along the right edge and bottom bars in every game state.
Autoplay supports fixed round counts from 10 to 1000, reducing the need for repeated manual spin presses.
A Quick Play option lets the player tap anywhere to skip animations, cutting the number of precise interactions required per round.
All numeric information (bet, balance, win, jackpot values, free-spins counter, RTP, max win) is rendered as on-screen text at fixed HUD positions, favouring OCR-based screen-reading overlays.
Most symbols carry no text label on the reels (only Wild's 'W' and Collector's 'C' are lettered) and must be identified by shape/animal alt-text instead.

The four jackpot tier plaques above the reels are colour-coded (MINI blue, MINOR green, MAJOR magenta, MEGA red) but each also carries its own text label and numeric value, so colour is never the only cue.
The royal letters A (red), K (purple/magenta), Q (green) and J (blue) are colour-differentiated but always shown as the actual letter glyph, so identification does not depend on colour.

The turquoise beaded dreamcatcher charm (mid-value symbol) and the purple WILD Dreamcatcher Symbol are visually related but distinguished by the WILD's white 'W' letter and higher pay tier, not by hue alone.

All UI buttons are white line-art icons on dark circular buttons distinguished by icon shape (menu, speaker, star, autoplay, Push-Up, spin), not by sound; mute state (All Sounds / Sound Effects / Music) is shown by an icon change (speaker vs speaker-with-cross), not audio.
Feature outcomes (Free Spins award count, Instant Prize and Jackpot wins) are always shown as on-screen banners with numeric text, so no information is conveyed by sound alone.
Both the vertical Instant Prize ladder and the horizontal jackpot tier plaques print explicit numeric currency values next to their bison-count/tier labels, not relying on colour or icon size alone.
Push-Up can only be deactivated at the end of a game round; if Autoplay is running it must be switched off first before Push-Up can be deactivated.
Jackpot ticker bands are colour-coded (MINI cyan, MINOR green, MAJOR purple/magenta, MEGA red/pink) but each also prints its own name and value.
Locked Row meter's collection dots turn from grey to green, but each band also prints a '+N FS' value, so state does not rely on colour alone.
Push-Up tiles signal the active state via outline/fill plus a change in size and printed multiplier/grid-size text, not colour alone.

No information is conveyed by sound alone; the Settings panel exposes independent mute toggles for All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music, and all wins/counters/feature states are also shown as on-screen text.
Free Spins state is signalled by a full scene change (bright desert day vs. warm dusk temple interior) plus an explicit 'Free Spins: N / M' text counter, not a single colour swap.

Large circular touch targets for Spin and the toolbar icons; Autoplay presets (10-1000) remove the need for repeated clicking; the SPACE bar duplicates Spin and the Quick Play animation-skip, giving a keyboard-only path through a round.

Controls keep stable positions across states: toolbar (Bonus Buy/Autoplay/Bet Select/Spin) always bottom-right, hamburger and mute always top-right; paytable/rules/settings/info panels share one bottom nav and one linear scrolling layout.
Jackpot ladder plaques (MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/MEGA) are colour-coded but always paired with a printed name and value, so they read correctly without colour vision.
The left-side win-value ladder (tiers 4 to 10) and every paytable payout tier use printed numerals, not colour, to indicate value.
Letter symbols A/K/Q/J share the same candy-shaped card and are distinguished by the printed letter itself, not only by their red/pink/green/icy-blue stripe colour.
Jackpot Reindeer Symbol variants are colour-coded (red/purple/green/blue) but each carries its own printed MEGA/MAJOR/MINOR/MINI name-plate.
The pre-game sound prompt buttons are distinguished only by their YES/NO text label, not by colour.
Each panel of the branded splash screen (Jackpots, Instant Prizes, Free Spins) is explained in plain English caption text below its icon, not by colour alone.

All wins, triggers and instant-prize awards are communicated through on-screen text and numerals; Sound Effects, Music and All Sounds can each be muted independently without losing any game information.
Free Spins award counts and win totals are shown as large embossed gold numerals with a red-brown outline for high contrast against the card background.
Rules and paytable panels use white body text on a near-black background with gold section headers, giving high contrast throughout.
Eagle Wild is identifiable by its shape and gold 'W' letter on a blue shield tile, not colour alone.
Sword instant-prize ladder tier reached is confirmed by a highlighted/glowing rung plus the printed WIN amount and tier number, not colour alone.
Low Symbol conversion progress is shown via letter icons (A/K/Q/J) with numeric pip counts, not colour alone.
Push Bet toggle is described in the rules as green when active and grey when inactive, with no shape or text redundancy found for its on/off state on captured frames -- a colour-only cue.

Feature outcomes (Free Spins award, Low Symbol conversion, Sword instant win, round-end total) are all shown as on-screen text/numbers such as '+4 FREE SPINS' and 'WIN: 5.00 fun', so audio is not the sole channel for any observed state.

Free Spins switches the background from a daytime blue-sky courtyard to a dusk purple-violet palette with lit torches, reinforced by an on-screen 'Free Spins: N / M' text counter rather than colour alone.
The keyboard space bar is an explicit alternate control for both Spin and for skipping (quick-play) animations, reducing reliance on precise mouse/touch targeting.

Monetary values, RTP figures, feature-trigger rules and the Sword ladder are printed as legible text within the paytable/rules panels, not baked purely into images. The reel grid and win-ladder widget are graphical/canvas-only with no confirmed text-equivalent.

Green (+1%) and gold/amber (+25%) bonus gems are the color pair most likely to be confused, but each is also stamped with its own text label ('+1%' vs '+25%') the instant it is revealed, so the bonus amount is never color-only information.
Bomb tiles are a round black bomb with a lit fuse spark, a shape clearly different from the faceted diamond/gem tiles — a busted round is not conveyed by tile color alone.

Studio loading splash uses a red circle with a white diagonal cross plus a white 'Turbo Games' wordmark on black; identity is carried by the wordmark text and the cross shape, not by the red color alone.

Rules booklet is pure black background with bold white headings and light-grey body copy, plus a left-hand list of text-labeled section-jump buttons (How to Play?, Game Details, RTP, Continue Play, Settings, Disconnection Policy, Version) rather than color swatches, giving strong contrast and no color-coded navigation.

Most affordances use non-color cues alongside color: info-booklet nav arrows are differentiated by triangle/cross shape, not color alone; settings toggle switches show handle position (left=off, right=on) plus track color; the bonus-buy confirm dialog uses a red square with a white X (cancel) vs a green square with a white checkmark (confirm); the three Free Spins variant cards (red Random Wilds, purple/orange Expanding Wilds, green/teal Surrounding Wilds) are also distinguished by unique title text and a unique free-spin count, not color alone. Residual risk: the royal letters (A/K/Q/J, each a different honey-drip color - red/orange, orange/amber, green, blue) and the special-wild plaques rely partly on color, but every one is also uniquely identified by its printed letter or word, so identity is never color-only.

No audio-only information was observed. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative on/off toggles in the settings panel. All game state - win amounts, free spins remaining, chosen feature variant - is conveyed entirely through on-screen text and imagery, not sound.

The bet-menu +/- steppers signal a disabled (limit-reached) state only through a dimmer grey fill versus the bright green fill of an active button - a brightness/contrast cue rather than a hue change, which may be subtle for low-vision users. Elsewhere the game favors high contrast: the loading screen uses white and orange text on solid black, and win totals are shown as large gold 3D digits on dark wood, both legible without fine color discrimination.

All primary targets (SPIN, the three Free Spins variant CHOOSE buttons, bonus-buy confirm/cancel) are large. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop the spin (keyboard-operable), and holding SPACE triggers turbo spin. Autoplay, with an optional SKIP SCREENS checkbox, reduces the number of clicks needed for repeated play and for skipping feature intro/end screens.

Control layout is stable across all base-game and free-spins frames: hamburger menu, sound and info ('i') buttons grouped bottom-left; CREDIT/BET balance labels center-left; bet -/+ steppers flanking the central round SPIN button; AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. The info booklet is a strict linear 7-page sequence with a 'Page n/7' counter printed on every page, navigated by left/right green triangle arrows and closed with a green X or a top-right X.
Bonus-buy confirm/cancel buttons differentiated by both color (green/red) AND glyph shape (checkmark vs X)
Settings toggle switches use both color (gray=off/green=on) AND handle position (left=off/right=on)

The three feature-modifier monkey mascots are labelled with explicit text banners (WAYS - 5x5 REELS / WILDS - MORE WILDS / WINS - MULTIPLIER WILDS) in addition to banner color; active state is a brightness/glow effect, not a hue change
Wild medallion, letter symbols and GEM symbols each have a distinct shape (Fu-character medallion vs lettering vs gem-cut) in addition to color
Paytable navigation icons (previous/close/next) are differentiated by shape (left triangle / cross / right triangle), not color alone
Winning symbol cells on a base-game win are marked by an animated gold-and-pink glow/border (shape+motion), not color alone

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are decorative toggles; all game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, active modifiers, multiplier values, buy price) is conveyed via on-screen text and iconography
CREDIT, BET, win amounts and multiplier badges are shown in high-contrast gold/white text against dark or sky-blue backgrounds

Base game background is a bright cornflower-blue sky with white clouds; Free Spins switches to a deep indigo-purple night sky with pink-mauve clouds and gold stars — a large scene-wide palette change signals the feature state
All primary controls are large round or pill-shaped touch targets; SPIN is the largest target on screen
SPACE and ENTER start/stop the spin via keyboard; holding SPACE activates Turbo Spin, reducing the need for repeated precise clicks
Autoplay offers a settable spin count and a Skip Screens option, reducing required interactions

Control positions are stable across base-game screens: menu+sound bottom-left, info 'i' button next to them, CREDIT/BET center-left, SPIN centered-right with bet +/- flanking it, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN
The info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence navigable with previous/next arrows and closable with a consistent X control
Royal letters A/K/Q/J are colour-coded (red/green/pink/cyan) but each also has a distinct letter glyph, so identity does not depend on colour perception.
WILD (blue-skinned genie) and SCATTER (golden lamp on a red medallion) are distinguished by shape/artwork and printed 'WILD'/'SCATTER' text, not colour alone.

No audio-only information observed; ambient music and sound effects are decorative and independently toggleable in Settings. All game state (wins, spins left, prize amounts, feature names) is shown as on-screen text.

Feature state uses both a background palette shift (orange sunset in the base game to blue/purple starlit sky in Free Spins) and on-screen text banners ('FREE SPINS LEFT N', header labels), not colour alone.
Large round click targets. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop the spin (keyboard-operable); holding SPACE performs a turbo spin. Autoplay up to 100 spins via a slider reduces required clicks.

Stable control layout: hamburger menu and sound button far-left, info 'i' button beside them, bet +/- around the central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY pill below SPIN. The rules/paytable booklet is a linear 8-page sequence with a persistent 'Page N/8' indicator.

Toggle state, free-spins variant and most UI cues are duplicated by shape/text; residual risk: the three general portraits (blue robe, green robe, orange-red robe) are primarily distinguished by robe color and similar facial features, with no name labels, so color-blind players may struggle to tell them apart despite distinct icon background colors (light blue/green/peach) and portrait counts (1/2/3) on the free-spins choice screen.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, spins left, progressive points, multiplier reveals) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

Spoils of War's 8 red envelopes are differentiated only by subtle gold foil ornament motifs (diamond lattice, plain, knot, dragon, cloud scroll, blessing character, tassel-knot, twin-fish) on identical red backgrounds, which may be hard to distinguish for very low-vision users without additional labelling.

Large circular touch targets; SPIN is the largest and most central. SPACE/ENTER are keyboard alternatives to clicking SPIN. Autoplay with adjustable spin count and SKIP SCREENS reduces the number of interactions needed for extended play.

Stable control layout: menu/sound/info icons stacked bottom-left, bet +/- flank the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY sits directly below SPIN; the info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with an explicit 'Page n/7' position readout.

Green/red/blue egg colors are always paired with a text label at their nest (COLLECT/JACKPOT/MULTIPLIER) and, once a tile lands, with an explicit word/number (dollar amount, MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/GRAND, or x2/x3/x5) -- color reinforced by text every time.
Toggle switches (ante bet, settings) use both handle position (left=off, right=on) and green/grey fill, not color alone.

No audio-only information observed; music/SFX are decorative and independently toggleable (AMBIENT MUSIC, SOUND FX). All game state (bet, credit, win, respins left, jackpot progress, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

Jackpot-meter progress is small colored pips without numeric 'N of M' labels -- a minor gap for very-low-vision users, partly mitigated by the large printed tier name and dollar value next to the pips.

All primary controls are large circular/oval touch targets, SPIN largest. SPACE/ENTER also spin; holding SPACE = turbo. Autoplay (up to 100) and the four one-click Buy-Respins tiers reduce actions needed to reach the feature.

Stable control layout: hamburger menu + sound icon far left, info 'i' button next, bet +/- flanking SPIN, AUTOPLAY below SPIN. The 8-page info booklet is strictly linear with consistent prev/next/close positions.

The three Magic Pot mascots and the four jackpot ladder tiers are each labelled with their own printed name (Magic Reels/Enchanted Collector/Cash Frenzy; Mega/Major/Minor/Mini) in addition to colour, plus a distinct icon shape, so feature/tier identity is never colour-only.
The four Royal letters (A/K/Q/J) share identical payouts and are distinguished from each other by letter glyph, not by their outline colour alone (orange-red/orange-red/green/blue).

All game state (wins, free-spins counters, jackpot values, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text; Settings exposes only All Sounds/Sound Effects/Music mute toggles, sound is decorative.
Spin is a large circular target and the space bar also starts a spin; Autoplay presets run up to 1000 rounds, and clicking anywhere skips mid-round animations, both reducing repeated clicking.

Control positions are stable: mute/menu icons top-right, ways-counter/autoplay/bet-select/spin stacked down the right edge, jackpot ladder fixed left, Balance/Total Bet fixed to the bottom corners. Info panels share one bottom navigation row (paytable/rules/settings/KNOW THE GAME), each a single continuous scroll.

Symbol frames use distinct colors AND object shapes: Leprechaun=dark teal frame, Green Hat=emerald green, Beer Mug=dark red/crimson, Mushroom=deep purple/violet, Pipe=warm gold/amber. Royals differ by letter glyph. Shape alone is sufficient.

Cancel=red X circle, Confirm=green checkmark circle — shape is redundant cue. FS mode: full background shifts from daytime blue sky to aurora-borealis night scene. FS picker cards show spin count and multiplier range as text labels.

No audio-only game-state indicators. FS trigger, completion, win amounts, and mode transitions all communicated via visual text overlays and full background scene change. Ambient music and sound FX can be toggled independently in Settings.

Keyboard shortcuts: SPACE (hold for turbo spin), ENTER (start/stop spin). All controls in a single bottom bar. Autoplay up to 100 spins. Large spin button centrally placed. Bet +/- buttons are small circles.

Credit, bet, win amount, RTP, payout values, MEGAWAYS count, FREE SPINS LEFT counter all render as visible text. Win screens use large text. Spin button has no text label. Symbol names are not labeled on paytable icons.

High symbols each have a distinct animal subject: Dragon (serpentine scales), Phoenix (spread wings), Golden Money Toad (frog with ingot), Koi Fish (fish shape), Turtle (shell). Royals identified by letter character. WILD is a unique guardian lion face; Scatter is a unique circular yin-yang shape. FS picker options identified by spin count text and left-to-right position, not color alone. Toggle states use arm position (left=off, right=on) in addition to color.

All game information conveyed visually. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggled independently in Settings. BATTERY SAVER reduces animations. Game functions fully without audio; win amounts and outcomes communicated via on-screen text and win screen.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop the spin. Large click targets: spin button is a large circular element, AUTOPLAY is a prominent pill button, FS picker columns are wide vertical strips. Autoplay with configurable spin count slider. SKIP SCREENS option auto-dismisses feature intro and end screens, reducing required interactions.

Ways count shown numerically on both side panels (243 in base / 576 in free spins). Info panel shows Page N/8 indicator. Current WILD multiplier displayed as numeral+X in top-right orb during free spins. Win amounts shown as dollar values in bottom bar WIN field and as dedicated congratulations screen after free spins complete.

Five lion heads share the same frontal silhouette shape. Color is the primary differentiator; secondary cues: Gold Lion has polished metallic surface (vs. fur on others); White and Red Lions have dense fluffy fur; Yellow and Green Lions have smooth surface. Red Lion crown is gold-pointed; Green Lion crown has teal gem balls.

Protanopes/deuteranopes (red-green confusion): Red Lion and Green Lion hues may appear similar. Use texture (Red = dense fluffy fur, Green = smooth) and crown style to distinguish. SCATTER drum has 'SCATTER' text on tile; LION REEL badge has 'LION REEL' text — both identifiable without color.

Tritanopes (blue-yellow confusion): Yellow Lion may appear more greenish; K (blue/cobalt royal) may be confused with Q (pink/magenta royal). All royal symbols carry letter labels (A/K/Q/J/10) readable independent of color. Achromatopsia: rely on letter shape for royals; lion surface texture (metallic vs. fur vs. smooth) for high symbols.

AMBIENT (background music) and SOUND FX (game effects) can be independently toggled off via SETTINGS menu. All game information is conveyed visually: paytable values, win overlay text, credit counter. No audio-only information observed in captured screens.

Keyboard shortcuts: SPACE or ENTER start/stop spin. Info panel navigation via clickable left/right arrow buttons and X to close. AUTOPLAY (up to 100 spins) with SKIP SCREENS option (enabled by default) reduces per-spin interaction to zero once started.

All paytable and rules text is standard readable text rendered in the info panel. Payout values shown as 'N - $X.XX' per symbol. SCATTER symbol has 'SCATTER' text label on the symbol tile. LION REEL symbol has 'LION REEL' text on its badge tile. CREDIT and BET values are numeric displays in the bottom bar.
WILD is a golden lion head with bright green eyes, identified by its distinct silhouette/shape, not color alone

High-value symbols each have a distinct creature silhouette in addition to a colored card-frame accent: red-gold dragon head, golden phoenix (pink frame), green jade pixiu toad (green frame), blue-gold koi carp (blue frame), purple-shelled turtle (purple frame)
Jackpot tiers are always paired with text labels (GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR) in addition to plaque color (red/purple/green)
Volatility is shown as a count of filled vs unfilled lightning-bolt icons (shape/fill), not hue alone
Toggle switches (settings menu) show state via thumb position (left=off/right=on) in addition to green fill when on
Checkboxes (autoplay options) show a white checkmark glyph for the checked state, not color alone
No audio-only information; Ambient Music and Sound FX are purely decorative toggles, all game state is conveyed through on-screen text and imagery
Large round click targets throughout; SPACE/ENTER keys also start/stop spins, holding SPACE triggers Turbo Spin; Autoplay with adjustable spin count and Skip Screens reduces required clicks

Every paying symbol has a unique picture/glyph, never color-only: dragon head, phoenix, jade toad, koi fish, turtle, lion-mask WILD, yin-yang SCATTER, coin, plus letter/number glyphs for royals A/K/Q/J/10/9.

High-value symbol card border colors: Dragon red, Phoenix dark-red/pink, Money toad green, Koi fish blue, Turtle magenta/purple. Royals: A red/crimson, K orange/amber, Q gold/yellow, J blue, 10 purple/magenta, 9 green.
Free Spins option tiles are differentiated by BOTH a color-tinted lion statue AND a printed spin-count number AND a printed multiplier list -- redundant non-color cues.

The green-vs-red background shift between regular and Super/Mystery Free Spins rounds is a secondary cue only; the 'WILD MULTIPLIERS' side-panel values and the 'SUPER' word on the scatter icon carry the same information in text.
Toggle switches (settings/autoplay) show state via switch-handle left/right position and check-mark glyphs, not color alone.

No audio-only information observed on any captured frame; Ambient Music and Sound FX are decorative toggles in Settings. All game state (win amounts, spins left, multiplier sets, ways count, bet/credit) is conveyed as on-screen text/numbers.
Primary controls are white glyphs on dark semi-transparent circles (shape-coded, high contrast). CREDIT and BET labels are gold/yellow text on a dark bottom bar, high contrast against the background.

Large circular touch targets; the central SPIN button is the largest single control. SPACE/ENTER keys also start/stop a spin, reducing the need for precise pointer clicks. Autoplay (slider-selectable spin count, up to 100 observed) reduces repeated interaction.

Control positions are stable across all base-game frames: menu + sound stacked far-left, a separate info 'i' button just to their right, bet -/+ flanking the central spin button, autoplay below spin. The rules/paytable is a strictly linear 9-page sequence navigated with left/right arrows and closed with an X, each page numbered 'Page N/9'.

Golden dragon (red frame), phoenix (pink/magenta frame), money frog/toad (green frame), koi fish (blue frame) and tortoise (purple/magenta frame) are each differentiated by distinct animal artwork AND frame color, not color alone; royal letters A(red)/K(orange-gold)/Q(yellow-gold)/J(blue)/10(purple-magenta) are differentiated by letter shape as well as color.
WILD (golden lion medallion) and BONUS (yin-yang medallion) carry no colored card frame of their own and are identified by distinct shape/artwork, not color.

Free spins feature is signaled by a background hue-shift from cool blue to warm red/maroon PLUS an explicit 'FREE SPINS LEFT' text/counter, not color alone; the 7 free-spins options are each labelled with an explicit spin-count number or 'MYSTERY CHOICE' text in addition to a distinct statue color.
Settings and autoplay on/off toggle switches indicate state by physical left/right position in addition to green-vs-grey fill; checkboxes use a checkmark glyph, not fill color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, ways-to-win count, free-spins counter, active multiplier) is shown as on-screen text/numerals.

The MEGAWAYS ways-to-win indicator (top-right plaque) shows the current spin's exact ways count in large bold gold numerals (observed 144/1944/192/10584/3200); win amounts and free-spins totals are shown as large high-contrast gold text on dark backgrounds.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop the spin as a keyboard-only alternative to pointer clicks; SPIN, bet +/- and AUTOPLAY are large round click targets; Autoplay with configurable spin count and SKIP SCREENS reduces the number of required interactions.

Control layout is stable across all game states (menu+sound stacked far-left, info 'i' button next to them, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, SPIN centered with bet +/- flanking it, AUTOPLAY below SPIN); the rules/paytable booklet is a fixed 8-page linear sequence and always shows 'Page N/8'.

The three scatter tiers (Scatter/Golden Scatter/Super Scatter) share one yin-yang icon shape but are distinguished by explicit printed text labels, not color alone. Free Spins (red theme) vs Super Free Spins (gold theme) are also distinguished by on-screen text ('FREE SPINS LEFT' vs 'SUPER FREE SPINS LEFT'), not color alone. One residual color-only cue: the paytable's ways-to-win diagram uses a green checkmark vs a red X, though the check/cross shapes themselves are also distinguishable.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; sound and music are decorative and independently toggleable (Sound FX, Ambient Music). All game state - wins, spins remaining, current multiplier, bet/credit, feature triggers - is shown as on-screen text and numerals.

Large circular click targets for spin, menu, sound and info; bet adjustment via round +/- buttons or an optional bet menu; Autoplay with adjustable spin count and a Skip Screens option; two one-click Buy Feature shortcuts (Buy Free Spins / Buy Super Free Spins) reduce the manual actions needed to reach the bonus features.

Control positions are stable across the base game and all overlay dialogs: menu/sound icons stacked bottom-left, a separate info icon beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central spin button, autoplay directly below spin, CREDIT/BET labels left-of-center. The paytable/rules is a strictly linear 8-page booklet with an explicit 'Page N/8' indicator.

WILD MULTIPLIER bomb shows its multiplier value as printed cyan-blue numerals, not by color alone. The 6 Joker Reel plaques use distinct card colors (purple/magenta, green, orange, blue, olive, red/pink) as decorative per-reel identity only; the functional marked/unmarked state is shown by presence of a jester face versus a plain closed red curtain (shape/content cue), not color. Toggle switches show state via thumb position (left=off/right=on) plus track color.

No audio-only information observed; Sound FX and Ambient Music are decorative toggles only. Game state (win amounts, bet, Ante Bet tier, Joker Reel marking progress, Wild Multiplier value) is conveyed visually/textually throughout.

High-contrast text throughout: CREDIT/BET labels in yellow-gold on dark backgrounds. Volatility is shown as a 5-icon lightning-bolt count (not a single hue), staying legible without fine color/contrast discrimination. Preview tagline and payout numerals are large bold text.

Large round click targets; the central SPIN button is the largest single target. SPACE/ENTER also spin (keyboard-operable), holding SPACE engages turbo spin. Autoplay (adjustable spin count plus a Skip Screens option) reduces the number of required manual actions.

Stable control layout: menu+sound far-left of the bottom bar, 'i' info button just right of them, bet -/+ flank the central spin button, autoplay just below/right of spin. Rules/paytable booklet is a strict linear 6-page sequence with explicit 'Page N/6' text and left-triangle/right-triangle/X (previous/next/close) navigation.
GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR jackpots use color (crimson/teal/purple) plus explicit text label on each badge — identifiable without color discrimination. Safe for all colorblind types.

Free Spins mode: reel background shifts from dark navy blue to vivid bright green/lime as the primary signal — risk for deuteranopes/protanopes. Redundancy: gold 'FREE SPINS X OF Y' text counter in the bottom-left panel is color-independent.

Settings ON/OFF toggles use bright green (ON) vs white/gray (OFF) with no shape change — risk for red-green colorblind users. Each toggle carries a text label (BATTERY SAVER, AMBIENT MUSIC, SOUND FX, INTRO SCREEN) as redundancy.

Autoplay checkboxes combine color (green fill) with shape (checkmark) — accessible without color. Buy Free Spins cancel/confirm buttons combine color (red/green) with shape (X/checkmark) — accessible without color.

Royal symbols distinguished by letter/numeral (A/K/Q/J/10/9) not by color. Premium symbols differ by subject (leprechaun portrait, horseshoe, beer barrel, red mushrooms) — each has unique shape. WILD is labeled with letter W text. WIN amounts and 'YOU SMASHED IT' overlay are large high-contrast bold text readable without color.

Sound FX and Ambient Music can each be independently toggled off in Settings. All critical game information — wins, feature triggers, round completion — communicated via text overlays ('CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON', 'YOU SMASHED IT', WIN amounts), not audio only.
BATTERY SAVER option in Settings reduces animations, which may help users who find flashing animations distracting or disorienting.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop the spin — accessible for users who cannot easily click. Autoplay supports up to 100 spins; SKIP SCREENS option auto-dismisses feature intro/outro screens. Overlays respond to 'press anywhere' with no timed interactions identified.

Game is a single HTML5 canvas — standard screen readers cannot access game elements. Key on-screen texts: CREDIT, BET, WIN amount, FREE SPINS X OF Y counter, RESPINS counter, jackpot bar values (GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR with dollar amounts), 'HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN' hint. The 7-page info/paytable booklet contains all rules as text.

The five paying pigs are distinguishable by shape, not just color: hard hat (top symbol), crown with long hair (queen pig), horns with visible fangs (vampire pig), tall pompadour hair with sunglasses (orange pig), and a pacifier (baby pig).
WILD (gold crowned pig) is additionally marked by its crown and by an on-screen 'IS WILD AND STACKED' text banner when it stacks during Free Spins, not by color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles in SYSTEM SETTINGS, and all game state (win amount, credit, bet) is always shown as on-screen text.

Six always-visible bottom-bar sections (COIN VALUE, SPINS, BET, LINES, TOTAL BET, GOOD LUCK/PLAY-AUTOPLAY) sit at fixed positions; the paytable and payline diagram are permanently on-canvas text (payline numbers, payout amounts, 'BAR'/'ANY' labels) rather than hidden behind a button. Orange Triangle Gem (warm orange) is close in hue to the golden Aztec frame — distinguished by the gem body inside the frame rather than color contrast alone. Red-green colorblind users: Red Shield (rose-red shield shape) vs Dark Red Square (crimson square) differ by SHAPE, not just hue.
Teal Diamond Gem (teal/cyan) vs Blue Pentagon Gem (royal blue) differ by shape (diamond rhombus vs pentagon) and saturation — shape is the primary distinguishing cue.

Win Multiplier values displayed as numerals with 'x' suffix (e.g. '15x', '100x') — fully text-readable, no color dependency. Active multiplier coin glows green-yellow, but value is always shown as number.
Win overlay shows amount as text ('NICE!' label and dollar amount e.g. '$36.69'). Green glow on win overlay is decorative and carries no information.
AMBIENT and SOUND FX can be toggled independently via Settings menu. All gameplay information (wins, multipliers, bet, credit) is displayed visually as text — no audio-only cues.

Win amount and 'NICE!' label displayed as large bold text in win overlay. CREDIT/BET in bottom control bar use orange label text on dark background. Megaways counter in purple badge with white/yellow text top-left.
Keyboard shortcuts: SPACE = start/stop spin or hold for turbo spin; ENTER = start/stop spin. Autoplay available for up to 100 spins with TURBO SPIN, QUICK SPIN, and SKIP SCREENS options.

Game rules across 5 info pages are plain text, navigable via arrow buttons. CREDIT and BET values are numeric labels in the bottom bar. Megaways counter is numeric with 'MEGAWAYS' label, updates every spin.

Chance x2 active state adds a shape change (white star added to the Spin button icon), not just a color/banner change; 'BONUS ACTIVE'/'CHANCE x2 ACTIVE' and win-tier banners (BIG WIN/MEGA WIN/TOTAL WIN) are spelled out in text, not conveyed by color alone; the 4 high-value symbols and Scatter/Multiplier each use a distinct pictorial icon (chief face, woman face, serpent, mask, sun-medallion, numeric x100) in addition to background card colors (purple, red, blue, grey, gold), so identification does not depend on color alone.

No information appears to be conveyed by audio only; Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable and are decorative/reinforcing - win amounts, feature counters and states are always also shown as on-screen text/graphics.

Bet adjustment, Buy Bonus purchase and Chance x2 activation are all single large click targets; Autoplay reduces the number of manual spin clicks required; Spacebar is an alternative input to clicking the Spin button (toggle in Settings, on by default).

Stable control layout across screens: info(i) and settings(gear) buttons bottom-left beside the Balance text; Total bet with up/down arrows centered; Autoplay(A) and Spin buttons bottom-right; Buy Bonus/Chance x2 stacked in a fixed left side-panel; the info panel is a linear, scrollable/paged multi-page sequence (Paytable 11 pages, Rules 13 pages).

The -/+ bet-adjustment buttons show their disabled state as a brightness dimming of the white glyph inside a still-green pill (measured: enabled '+' RGB(216,237,216) vs disabled '+' RGB(107,118,107)) rather than a hue change - a moderate risk for colorblind users to notice.

The Gamble round's Black/Red suit-color choice is backed by text labels ('Black'/'Red') and by suit icons (spade/club vs diamond/heart shapes), not by color swatches alone, so it remains completable without color perception.

No information is conveyed by sound alone - wins, free-spin counters, gamble prompts and bet values are all shown as on-screen text/numbers. Background music and sound effects are independently toggleable sliders in Settings.

Same -/+ disabled-state cue as above is low-contrast (a subtle glyph-brightness dim rather than a full grey-out of the button), which may be hard to notice for low-vision users at normal viewing size.

All primary controls are large rounded targets (SPIN is a full circle). Bet adjustment requires repeated small -/+ clicks (no drag/slider for bet). Auto Spins with a preset round count (10-1000) reduces clicks needed for extended play. A 'Spacebar to spin' setting exists in Settings but its keyboard behaviour was not independently verified in a captured frame.

Bottom-bar controls keep stable relative left-to-right positions across all game states (BALANCE, LINE COUNT, MAX BET, SPIN, AUTO SPINS, BET VALUE, TOTAL BET, with the BGAMING wordmark bottom-left). The info panel is a stable 4-item vertical tab list (Settings/Paytable/Rules & Lines/History); Paytable is a single page and Rules & Lines is a single long-scroll document with no page-number navigation to track.

Payouts, multiplier values, bet/win amounts and spins-remaining are printed as explicit numerals, not conveyed by color alone. The light-blue vs. green tiki masks and the sky-blue vs. green Reward Multiplier shields rely partly on hue, but each is also distinguished by its crown gem color (masks) or its printed multiplier number (shields).
Toggle switches (Autoplay stop conditions, Game Settings) use knob position (right = on, left = off) in addition to color, so on/off state is not color-only.

No audio-only information was observed. Sound and Music are independently toggleable in Game Settings, and all game state (win amounts, spins remaining, multiplier total, purchase cost) is shown as on-screen text/numerals.

The SPIN button is the largest interactive target on screen, centrally placed in the right-hand column. Autoplay with configurable stop conditions and a one-tap Buy Bonus purchase reduce the number of individual actions needed to reach the Free Spins feature.

Control positions are stable across screens: the five round action buttons always sit in the same vertical column on the right edge; BALANCE/WIN/BET always sit in the same three-column footer. Multi-page content (paytable+rules, bet selector, autoplay) is one continuous vertical scroll with a visible scrollbar thumb, not paginated tabs.

All 5 high gems use distinct shapes: Red Ruby=teardrop, Blue Sapphire=pentagon, Golden Amber=elongated oval, Green Emerald=rotated square (diamond), Purple Amethyst=triangle. Shape encodes identity independent of color.

Royals A/K/Q/J: same octagonal gem shape, each has unique letter glyph. SCATTER has 'SCATTER' text label on tile. MULTIPLIER shows its numeric value. Confirm/cancel: checkmark vs X shape (not color alone). Toggle ON/OFF: right vs left position.
Volatility communicated by both the word 'VOLATILITY' and 5 filled lightning-bolt icons (shape and count). Autoplay checkbox state shown by checkmark presence, not only fill color.
Ambient music, sound effects, and intro screen each have independent ON/OFF toggles in the settings menu. All game information (wins, FS count, multiplier) is communicated visually in text.

Win amounts in large text in the POWERNUDGE WIN frame and bottom-bar WIN label. FS remaining count in large bold text in the Aztec urn. Accumulated multiplier in large bold text in the right-panel Multiplier Meter.
SPACE and ENTER keys trigger spin. AUTOPLAY supports up to 100 automated spins via slider. SKIP SCREENS bypasses feature intro/end overlays. TURBO SPIN reduces animation wait time between spins.

Win amounts shown in two locations: POWERNUDGE WIN frame top-left during cascades, and WIN label at bottom-center. Free Spins remaining count shown in Aztec urn display (left panel) and bottom-bar text.

Bonus Claw Game cube colours (crimson/red, teal/cyan blue, olive-gold yellow) are the only way to tell which Side Quest a freshly grabbed cube belongs to before its value is compared to a threshold; no shape or pattern differentiates the three colours beyond hue.
Bonus Bet / Wild Bet ON state is shown by colour brightening AND the slider's physical position AND the printed word 'ON'/'OFF', not colour alone.
A winning line is marked by a green outline glow AND a printed 'Line N pays' text AND a floating currency amount overlay, not colour alone.
When Bonus Bet or Wild Bet is active, the round Spin icon gains a white outlined star badge, a shape cue independent of the panel colour.
All game-state information (wins, bet, balance, Claw Grab counter, threshold values) is presented as on-screen text/numerals; no audio-only information was identified in the captured frames.
The Bonus Claw Game threshold table (FREE SPINS/MULTIPLIER/JACKPOT columns) is regularly clipped by the top edge of the 800px-tall viewport, at least the top row when two rows are shown.
Bet stepper uses small triangle up/down arrows that may be harder to hit precisely; the arrow dims/disables at the bet floor and ceiling as a non-destructive guard against invalid input.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across all base-game states: info/settings icons far-left, Total bet stepper centre-left, Balance bottom-left, Autoplay and Spin far-right; the two extra-bet toggle panels and Buy Bonus button occupy a fixed column on the far left.

All 7 symbols have unique shapes: Idol (square elaborate totem), Red Totem (cylinder), Pink Totem (wide face with feathered ruff), Ruby (square gem), Sapphire (4-point diamond gem), Emerald (hexagon gem), Amber (triangle gem). Shape alone is sufficient for identification.
Winning cluster indication uses a glowing border outline — luminance contrast based, not hue-only. Win amount is displayed as text.
Settings toggles: ON state is green with bar-texture icon; OFF state is grey/white. The bar-texture icon on the ON state provides shape cue in addition to color.

All game states have on-screen text overlays (CONGRATULATIONS, WIN amounts, FREE SPINS LEFT). No audio-exclusive information detected. Sound FX and Ambient Music can be toggled independently in Settings.
SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spin — one-key operation possible. Autoplay supports up to 100 auto-spins with TURBO SPIN, QUICK SPIN, SKIP SCREENS options.

WIN amount displayed as text at bottom center during wins. Free Spins trigger shows full-screen text: CONGRATULATIONS / YOU HAVE WON / [N] FREE SPINS / PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE. FREE SPINS LEFT counter shown as text numeral.
Smash Multiplier value shown as text numeral with x suffix on left panel. No color dependency for reading the multiplier value.

Every symbol is distinguishable by shape/silhouette in addition to color: the three tiki masks show three different creature faces (jaguar, eagle, serpent) and the four gems show four different cut shapes (round, pentagon, square, triangle) on an identical tile background; no symbol relies on hue alone.

Cell-multiplier tiles print their value as literal text ('X2', 'X4', ...), not as a color-coded scale; the standard vs. Super Bonus Game distinction is reinforced by explicit on-screen text labels in addition to the green/red ambient color shift.

No audio-only information was identified; Sound and Music are independent toggles in Settings, and all game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, multiplier values, purchase prices) is conveyed as on-screen text/numbers.

Toggle switches in Settings/Autoplay show state via BOTH handle position (right=on) and fill color (yellow=on); BALANCE/WIN/BET labels and values are consistently yellow-on-dark, and all multiplier/price/win numbers are large gold/white digits on a dark stone banner.

Large round/hexagonal touch targets throughout (SPIN button, purchase buttons, dialog BUY button); bet amount and autoplay round-count use large stepper '-'/'+' buttons rather than fine drag controls; autoplay reduces the number of required interactions for repeated spins.

A persistent control cluster (turbo, autoplay/loop, SPIN, bet+, menu) stays in a fixed stacked position on the right edge across the base game and both bonus rounds; the BONUS GAME / SUPER BONUS GAME purchase buttons sit just above it whenever a bonus round is not already active. Rules/Paytable/Autoplay content is a single continuous vertical scroll per panel rather than a fixed page sequence.

Royal symbols A/K/Q/J/10 use distinct letter/numeral shapes providing full shape redundancy independent of color (red, cobalt-blue, hot-pink, teal, cyan). Premium symbols are identified by shape: face plaque, male warrior portrait, female warrior portrait, axe, dagger. WILD is uniquely circular vs rectangular premiums. MONEY coin is circular with a centered numeric dollar value — instantly distinguishable from all other symbols regardless of color.

Base game vs Free Spins mode change: background shifts from bright daylight (high luminance, blue-green palette) to dark fiery temple interior (low luminance, amber-red palette). Sufficient luminance contrast for mode detection beyond hue alone. Win amount always displayed numerically on screen, not by color only.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles are independent. All essential game state displayed as on-screen text: win amount, free spins remaining counter (large orange numeral top-left), feature trigger congratulations screen, and max win cap stated in rules. CONGRATULATIONS overlay provides full visual confirmation of Free Spins win with dollar total.

SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts start and stop the spin. TURBO SPIN and QUICK SPIN options reduce wait time between spins. SKIP SCREENS toggle auto-dismisses feature introduction and win end screens. AUTOPLAY supports up to 100 auto-spins configurable in the autoplay menu.

Every symbol category is distinguishable by shape and printed text, not color alone: Wild carries a printed 'W', Scatter and the two bonus-spin symbols carry printed captions ('SCATTER', '+1 SPIN', '+2 SPIN') baked into the art.

The four Low Win pendant charms differ in outline shape in addition to gem color: spade frame (orange-red gems), heart frame (red gems), and two diamond frames (green gems vs blue-white gems) - shape and paytable position remain independent cues if hue is not distinguishable.

The in-game Help panel is printed on a solid black background with light-grey body text and section headers on dark-grey bars; key terms and numbers are additionally highlighted in orange for higher contrast.
Multiplier values ('X2'..'X500'), win amounts, free-spin counters ('N/15') and bet deltas ('+0.25 FUN') are always shown as printed text/numerals, never by color alone.

Chance x2 active/inactive state is shown by label text ('CHANCE X2' vs 'CHANCE X2 ACTIVE'), a bar-fill/arrow indicator, AND the spin-button icon shape changing from a circular double-arrow loop to a five-point star - not by color alone.
Checkbox state (Settings, Autoplay) is shown by a filled checkmark glyph inside the box, not by color alone; the audio Volume slider communicates its level by handle position on the track.

Base game background is a bright daytime blue-sky backyard (pale blue sky, mauve-purple roof, red brick chimney, green lawn, red/white/blue pennant bunting); Free Spins switches to a dusk purple-violet sky with pink-orange fireworks glow - mode is also confirmed by printed text ('Free spins: N/15').

Residual risk: the info-panel left-rail active-section indicator (Payments/History/Help icons) relies mainly on white-vs-grey icon fill, low contrast for some color-vision-deficient users, though icon position is fixed (top=Payments, middle=History, bottom=Help).

No information is conveyed by audio only; Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative/ambient. All outcomes (wins, free-spin counts, multiplier values, bonus purchase confirmations) are shown as on-screen text/graphics.

Payout figures are printed as light-cyan text on a near-black panel background next to the symbol icon and its tier number (6+/5/4 or 12+/10-11/8-9), readable without color discrimination; win/value text uses gold-yellow or white with a dark outline for contrast.
Free Spins award ('15') and Total Win amounts are shown as large high-contrast numerals (gold-yellow/white on dark backgrounds with dark outlines).

Bet size is set via a discrete dropdown list (tap a value, 0.20-50.00 FUN ladder) or +/- steppers, avoiding fine drag gestures; Spacebar can trigger a spin as an alternative to clicking the spin button; Autoplay with configurable stop conditions reduces required interactions for extended play.

Stable control positions across all base-game screens: 'i' info and gear settings bottom-left, Balance/Total-bet readout center-left of the bottom bar, autoplay 'A' and spin button bottom-right; Payments/Help are linear scrolling documents (no paginated 'Page N/M'), reached via a 3-icon left rail (money-bag=Payments, clock=History, question-mark=Help).

Jackpot tiers labeled MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/MEGA/GRAND in text AND distinct colors (blue/green/orange/purple/red), dual-coded. BADGE has SHERIFF text on face. COIN MONEY values as text on coin. WILD (horse) vs SCATTER (WANTED poster): shape and text differ.
AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles in System Settings dialog. All feature events communicated via on-screen text overlays and dollar-labeled win amounts.
Autoplay up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option. Turbo Spin reduces spin duration. BUY RESPINS single-click button always visible on left panel. Large circular spin button centered in bottom bar.

Info panel: 7 pages via arrow buttons, Page N/7 indicator. Feature triggers show full-screen text overlays (e.g. '5 FREE GAMES WON!'). Win amounts displayed as dollar text labels (BIG WIN $70.50 etc.), not conveyed by sound alone.

The four jackpot tiers are distinguished by both colour (blue, green, red, gold) and a printed tier label (MINI/MINOR/MEGA/GRAND) on every plaque and coin, so colour-blind players are not dependent on hue alone. The nine paying symbols are also distinguishable by shape and subject matter (mechanical fishing gear versus a sea creature versus various shell silhouettes) in addition to colour, which helps tell apart even the two shells that share a similar palette. The Bonus Game's Multiplier and Addition tiles are dual-coded: colour (magenta versus blue) plus a distinct printed glyph prefix ('x' versus plus sign), so their function does not rely on colour perception alone.

No information observed in the captured frames is conveyed by audio alone: jackpot ladder values, Enhancer tile values, the Bonus Game spin-remaining indicator, and win totals are all shown as on-screen text or graphics. The Settings panel exposes All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music toggles, letting deaf or hard-of-hearing players mute freely without losing gameplay information.

Balance, bet and win figures are rendered as bold cream-white or gold bevelled numerals with dark outlines against a comparatively dark background, giving strong contrast. However, at the captured viewport the numerals in the bottom control bar and the 3-slot Bonus Game spin counter at the extreme right edge of the play area are relatively small, which may be a readability concern without browser zoom.

Spin can be triggered either by clicking the spin button or by pressing the keyboard space bar, giving an alternative input path for players with limited pointing-device precision. Bet changes are made by scrolling a single list from 0.10 to 100.00 fun rather than repeated plus/minus taps, and an Autoplay mode with fixed round counts from 10 to 1000 reduces the number of individual actions needed for extended sessions.

Control layout is stable across screens: sound-mute and hamburger-menu icons top-right, spin button and turbo dial on the right of the reel housing, Balance bottom-left and Total Bet bottom-right in the control bar. The jackpot ladder is always docked to the same position on the left edge, and the Collector symbol always lands in the same reel-2 column, which aids players who rely on spatial memory rather than re-scanning the whole screen each spin. This documents visual layout consistency only; no ARIA labelling or literal screen-reader software support was observed or tested.

Symbols are told apart by picture and shape, not colour alone: the poker tiles carry printed letters and number, the other five symbols are distinct illustrations. Frames are red-orange (dancer), magenta-purple (surfer), blue (temple gate), teal (straw hat), olive-green (coconut) and dark charcoal with no coloured frame (poker tiles).
Winning symbols are marked by a bright gold glowing outline, and the win ribbon prints the amount as text; a small dark-blue badge with cyan border shows the winning symbol picture with its count.
Wins, free spins entry, last free spin and totals are all shown as large text banners (BIG WIN, FREE SPINS WON, LAST FREE SPIN, TOTAL WIN), so no event depends on sound.
Balance, bet and win plates are white text on dark; Paytable numbers and headings are golden yellow on dark slate grey; win amounts are large gold numerals; rules text is light grey on dark slate.

Controls are single taps with no drag required; Bet Options wheels scroll by drag but Max Bet and the plus and minus buttons give tap alternatives. Space starts a spin on keyboard and skips the animation during spinning. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins.

Paytable ladder pip indicators use three greyscale/shape states (solid light-grey filled / near-black empty / grey ring with dark center) rather than colour, so match groupings are readable without colour perception.

A win is marked by a bright mint-green glow ring around the winning tiles AND by highlighting the matching paytable ladder row with its printed multiplier text -- redundant with colour, not colour-only.
Sound-volume slider position (handle offset) is the primary cue for its level, not only the green fill colour of the track.

Swap of START (crimson-pink button with a white flame icon, text START and small text PRESS AND HOLD) to CASHOUT (orange-yellow button with dark brown text CASHOUT) is signalled by the printed word and the icon, not only by crimson versus orange; the live win amount and multiplier are also printed in large white text on the balloon.

In the history strip all chips have the same dark navy background; only the text colour differs (orange-yellow for x1.03, red for x2.68 and higher). The colour does not carry meaning for understanding: the multiplier number is printed in every chip, and colour does not mean win or loss.

The win banner is a dark green panel with a yellow pill label with the words YOU WIN!, the amount in white and the multiplier in bright green; the result is carried by words and numbers, not by green alone.

Menu toggles show state by knob position (right is on, left is off) as well as green (on) or grey (off); the selected autoplay preset is marked by a green outline and a bold number, and the running state by the remaining-rounds number and the X icon.

The bottom bar is near-black grey with light grey labels and white numbers; the on-balloon amount and multiplier are large bold white text over an orange and yellow envelope. The sky shifts from soft lavender-pink to saturated royal blue during flight.

The WIN field shows the bet, not the outcome, on a lost round and in flight (WIN 10 at bet 10). A player relying on this field alone can misread a lost round; the real result is in My bet history, where a lost round is x0 with a dash.

The core mechanic requires pressing and HOLDING the large round START button; releasing cashes out. This is demanding for players who cannot hold a button. The only no-hold alternative is autoplay with a Target coefficient (automatic cash-out).
The menu toggle '<Space> to spin & go' (ON by default) lets the space bar act as the start control, so the hold can be done with the keyboard instead of the mouse.
Bet is changed only with up and down arrow buttons on the BET field (no presets, no typing); the arrows are locked during a flight and during autoplay.

The pump button's three states are colour-coded (light grass-green when idle and ready, darker forest-green while held, flat medium-grey when disabled right after a pop) but each state also changes shape and finish (raised vs pressed-in vs flattened), so the state stays legible without colour vision.
A won and a lost round end on the identical resting screen with no audio win or loss cue; the outcome is communicated only by the top-left balance number changing.

No visual win banner or animation distinguishes a won round from a lost one -- both settle on the same lying-dog resting frame; the outcome is legible only from the small balance figure changing by the stake amount.

The scrollable Rules booklet fades the first and last visible line of each scroll position to low contrast at the panel's top and bottom edges, which can make boundary text hard to read for low-vision users.

The only interactive action is a press-and-hold of one large circular button; the release timing determines the outcome. No alternative input exists for this control scheme -- no autoplay, no click-to-start/click-to-stop, no auto-cashout option.

The four low-value card suits (clubs/hearts/spades/diamonds) are told apart mainly by shape; hearts, spades and diamonds also carry a distinct printed Chinese character (water/earth/wind) as a non-color cue, while clubs relies on shape alone. The mid-tier trio (scroll/gourd/brush) differs by icon shape as well as tile color (red/purple/green), so shape alone is enough to tell them apart.

During Free Spins, low symbols removed by the round's scatter-count ladder are marked with a red/grey crossed-out circle icon replacing the coloured suit icon, not by color alone. The loading-screen volatility indicator uses one solid-filled bar among four hollow outline bars — the fill-versus-outline contrast, not the red hue, is the distinguishing cue.

Payout tiers, RTP, bet limits, bonus-buy prices and version numbers are printed as plain white/gold text on contrasting dark or light panel backgrounds throughout the paytable/rules/info panels. Win amounts are shown as large stylised gold outlined lettering with an animated glow and a counting-up effect before settling on a static final value.

The game is fully mouse/click driven with no keyboard-only interaction observed; Buy Feature, Autoplay, Bet-select, Settings, and Rules/Paytable/Info are each a single, clearly separated on-screen button in a fixed position. Autoplay round counts are chosen from a fixed list (10/20/50/100/250/500/1000) rather than typed numeric entry.

The game is canvas-rendered inside a cross-domain iframe with no native DOM buttons or labels for in-game controls; balance, total bet, free-spins counter, paytable and rules text exist only as rendered pixels, not as accessible DOM text nodes.

State info is duplicated as text/numerals, not color alone: MULTIPLIER tiles print their numeric value; Free Spins Left and Total Multiplier are printed numerals on labelled wooden signs; settings toggles show on/off via physical left/right switch position plus grey-vs-green color; dialog actions use X/checkmark glyphs rather than red/green color; the ways-to-win diagram pairs its check/X marks with distinct shapes. The two Buy-Feature signboards differ mainly by warm-gold vs cool-blue glow, but full price/label text on each is independently readable.

No information is conveyed through audio alone; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are decorative and independently toggleable in System Settings. All wins, spin counts, multipliers and feature triggers are represented visually with text (amounts, counters, banner text), so the game remains fully playable with audio off.

All primary controls are large circular/pill touch targets; the central SPIN button is the largest element in the bottom bar. SPACE and ENTER keys can also start/stop a spin as a keyboard alternative to mouse clicks. Autoplay (configurable spin count, plus a Skip Screens option that auto-skips feature intro/end screens) substantially reduces the number of required interactions for extended play.

Control positions are stable across the session: menu (hamburger) and sound stacked bottom-far-left, 'i' info button just to their right, bet +/- flanking the large central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY pill directly beneath SPIN. The rules booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence navigated with prev/next arrows and closed with a dedicated X. During Free Spins, three left-side hanging signs (Total Multiplier / Free Spins Left / win ledger) occupy a fixed screen region as a stable landmark for state polling.

Card suits (Spade, Heart, Club, Diamond) use standard internationally recognized shapes as primary differentiator independent of color: spade, heart, club, diamond shapes. Blue/pink/purple/green color is secondary confirmation.
High symbols (Strawberry, Orange, Mushroom, Corn, Eggplant) differ by silhouette shape alone: round berry vs sphere vs domed-cap vs elongated-vertical vs elongated-teardrop. Color is secondary.
Sound FX and Ambient Music independently toggleable in SYSTEM SETTINGS without affecting gameplay. All win amounts, feature state, and respin counts are displayed as visible on-screen text.

Special respin symbol persistent variants (Persistent ADD, Persistent MULTIPLY, Persistent COLLECT) are distinguished from one-shot variants primarily by gem/jewel ornamentation rather than shape — users with reduced visual detail perception may find these harder to differentiate.
SPACE or ENTER keys start/stop spin; HOLD SPACE activates turbo. Autoplay supports up to 100 auto-spins with SKIP SCREENS option to bypass transition animations. Autoplay can be stopped at any time.

All game state displayed as on-screen numeric text: respins remaining badge, TOTAL WIN multiplier counter, numeric value label on each MONEY symbol, win amount on win screen. No game-critical information conveyed by color alone.

Bet/win/balance/jackpot values and feature-state text ('Free Spins Remaining' count, 'RESPINS' banner, 'YOU HAVE WON' banner) are always printed as legible numerals/words, not conveyed by color alone. Winning cells are marked with a bright yellow outline in addition to a numeric pop-up. Settings toggles use knob position as well as color (grey=off, orange=on). The 25 decorative payline-number side tags cycle through many colors, but the printed number, not the color, carries the information, and all 25 lines are always active.

No information observed is conveyed by sound alone; all game state (bet, win, balance, jackpot amount, feature counters and names) is shown as on-screen text/graphics. Settings expose separate Ambient and Effects sound toggles (both default on) and a Quick Spin toggle (default off), plus a footer mute icon.

Text is white/light-grey on a near-black translucent panel in the paytable and Help screens, a high-contrast combination. Winning cells add a bright yellow outline on top of the numeric win pop-up. The decorative payline-number side tags are small; a low-vision player relying on them (rather than the always-on 25-line rule) may find the printed numbers hard to read without zooming.

All primary controls are large circular/oval targets; the central Spin button is the largest target on screen. The space bar duplicates spin/stop, reducing the need for precise pointer clicks. Autoplay with configurable stop conditions reduces the total number of required interactions.

Control layout is stable: info (i) far left, bet display/level stepper, bet-max, spin (center), autoplay, coin stepper, balance, in that left-to-right order, with a second footer row below (settings/balance/bet/win/clock/turbo/fullscreen/sound). The paytable and Help screen are both single continuous vertical scrolling documents (not paginated), so content is encountered in a fixed linear order.

Toggle switches show handle position, not only color; checkboxes use an explicit checkmark glyph; the paytable win-path diagram pairs a green check with a red cross but restates the rule in text below it; the rose-pink farm-woman card and the magenta pig card are told apart by the picture, not the card tint; Free Spins mode is signalled by a full background palette shift plus explicit text counters, not hue alone.

No game information is conveyed by sound alone - wins, free spins remaining, multipliers, bet/credit and RTP/volatility/bet-limit disclosures are all shown as on-screen text/graphics; ambient music and sound effects are independently toggleable and purely decorative.

All primary controls are large circular touch targets, the spin button being the largest on screen; SPACE and ENTER both trigger spin (holding SPACE also gives turbo); Autoplay with a configurable spin count and a 'SKIP SCREENS' option reduces the number of discrete clicks/taps needed for extended play.

Control layout is stable across every screen (menu/info icons bottom-left, CREDIT/BET left-of-center, spin center-right with bet +/-, autoplay below spin); the 7-page rules booklet is strictly linear with an explicit 'Page n/7' label on each page, a good anchor for programmatic page announcements.
Symbols differ by silhouette and picture (portraits, gun, crate, medical bag, plane), not by colour alone. WILD and SCATTER tiles carry the printed words WILD and SCATTER.
Rank letters A K Q J 10 9 are tinted orange, gold, olive green, steel blue, grey-green and bronze, but the glyph shape is the reliable cue.

Win highlight is a bright yellow-orange glow plus bullet-hole marks plus the WIN banner text; BIG WIN (blue panel) and MEGA WIN (green panel) also carry printed titles. The multiplier is a printed number x1 to x10 on an olive plate under the reels.
Sound toggle is in the menu strip; the rules contain no audio-dependent information.

Dark charcoal panels with beige-gold headings; light cyan numbers on the dark olive balance bar in base game, white numbers in free spins. Balance, bet, win, multiplier, remaining free spins and total win are all printed as text.
