MONEY symbols have numeric dollar value in speech-bubble label. Buy FS dialog cancel/confirm buttons differ by shape (X vs checkmark) not only red/green color. Pick-a-box gifts vary in size and position.

Fisherman Backpack: red, green, gold. Puffin: black, white, orange. Fishing Rod: red, green, dark handle. Red Tackle Box: red body, green lid. Royals: A=purple/violet, K=light blue/cyan, Q=coral/red-pink, J=lime-green, 10=golden-yellow with orange gradient — all with gold glittery outlines.

All game state changes communicated via full on-screen text banners (feature trigger, win, FS completion, pick-a-box). MONEY collect events shown by text value in cell and WIN counter. Settings allow toggling Ambient Music and Sound FX independently.

FISHERMAN WILD framed in glowing candy-cane bordered cell during Free Spins. MONEY symbol cells are pink/rose with fish icon and value label — distinguishable from standard symbols by both background color and numeric content. Progression bar uses portrait images not just colors for collection level.

SPACE and ENTER keyboard controls for spin start/stop. Autoplay up to 100 auto-spins with Normal/Quick/Turbo speed modes. SKIP SCREENS reduces interaction during feature intro/outro. Buy Free Spins bypasses organic trigger loop.

Key values displayed as text: CREDIT, BET, WIN, FREE SPINS LEFT (updates each spin), BUY FREE SPINS (with cost). Feature states labeled: FEATURE ACTIVE, FREE SPINS COMPLETED, CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON. Pick-a-box modifier labels text (MORE FREE SPINS, CATCHES). Progression bar milestones: +10 FREE SPINS x2 through x50.

Jackpot tiers (MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/MEGA/GRAND) are named in text as well as colour-coded; card suits are distinguished by pip shape (spade/heart/diamond/club) in addition to colour; Push Bet toggle position (left=off/right=on) backs up its green/grey colour change.
Base game vs Free Spins state is reinforced by an explicit 'Free Spins: N/10' text counter in addition to the cool-to-warm background palette shift.

No information conveyed by audio alone; wins, spins-remaining, multipliers and jackpot values are all on-screen text/numerals. Settings exposes independent All Sounds/Sound Effects/Music mute toggles.

Large circular click targets for Spin, Bonus Buy and Autoplay. Spacebar is a keyboard alternative to clicking Spin. Autoplay (up to 1000 spins) and Bonus Buy reduce the number of interactions needed to reach feature content.

Right-hand control column keeps a stable order (Bonus Buy star, Autoplay play-icon, Bet coin-stack icon, Spin) across base game and free spins. Info/paytable/rules/settings panels share one bottom navigation bar (grid/question-mark/gear/shield icons).

The four card-suit low symbols (Spade/Heart/Diamond/Club) are told apart primarily by shape, with red/purple/green/blue tint only a secondary cue; the mid-tier trio (Compass/Potion Bottle/Boot) and the upper-mid pair (Walrus/Penguin Sailor) are distinguished by object silhouette, not color.
The five jackpot tiers (Mini blue, Minor green, Major purple, Mega pink/magenta, Grand gold) each print their tier name (MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/MEGA/GRAND) as text in addition to color coding.
The Push Bet toggle state is conveyed by pill color (green on / grey off) and by the switch's left/right position, so it remains distinguishable without color perception.

All wins, multipliers and feature awards are shown as on-screen text/numbers (WIN totals, Orca multiplier badges, jackpot ladder values); the game remains fully playable with sound off, and the Settings panel offers independent All Sounds/Sound Effects/Music mute toggles.

Spin can be triggered by the on-screen Spin button or the keyboard space bar; pressing anywhere on screen or the space bar also activates Quick Play to skip animations, reducing the precise clicks needed during fast cascading rounds.

The five scallop-shell symbols share the same shape and differ only by color (purple, red, blue, orange, green); purple/red pay one tier, blue/orange/green pay a lower tier. Purple vs red and blue vs green are close in saturation for deuteranope/protanope viewers; recognition currently relies on shape+position rather than a per-shell text label, so screen-reader/alt-text support should name each shell's color explicitly.

Chance x2 on/off state is conveyed by BOTH the slider-knob position (left=off, right=on) AND a pink/magenta glow, not color alone; the neighbouring Buy Bonus button also visibly dims/desaturates its text when disabled by Chance x2.

No audio-only information observed; all game state (wins, free-spins-remaining, multipliers, retrigger progress) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals. Sound (music/SFX) is purely decorative and independently toggleable in Settings.

A small yellow rounded-square badge with a bold black 'B' is fixed at the top-left corner of every screen (base game, paytable, free spins, win screens, dialogs) at a stable position; this is BGaming's own in-game brand badge drawn by the engine, not a screenshot artifact.

Win-tier banners (BIG WIN / MEGA WIN / SUPER MEGA WIN) and free-spin/win amounts use large high-contrast text (gold-on-green banner, cyan-on-dark numerals); payline diagrams in the paytable use filled cyan squares against grey/dark squares plus a text label 'Line N', not color alone.

Spacebar can substitute for clicking the Spin button (on by default). Large round targets for Spin/Autoplay/Info/Settings. Autoplay supports configurable stop conditions (on any win, if bonus won, if single win exceeds, if balance rises/falls by an amount), reducing required manual actions.

The 20-payline diagrams (paytable pages 12-14) mark active cells as solid red fill vs grey with no secondary shape/pattern cue, but each diagram is also labelled 'Line N' in text so the line can be identified without seeing the red/grey distinction.
WIN (green banner text), BIG WIN (light-blue banner text) and EPIC WIN (red banner text) win-tier posters are each identified by a large distinct text label, not by color alone.

The 'BUY BONUS' / 'BONUS ACTIVE' wooden sign changes both its text and visual state, not only color; Settings checkboxes show state via a black checkmark on a white square versus an empty dark square, not color.

No information is conveyed by audio alone — wins, spins remaining, prices, RTP and max win are all shown as on-screen text/numbers. Music and Sound FX are independently togglable and appear purely decorative.
Bottom-bar controls are white glyph icons on a dark translucent bar (high-contrast, shape-based); paytable payout numbers are printed in bright yellow on dark charcoal grey for high contrast.

Primary actions (Spin, Buy Bonus, Autoplay) are large circular/rectangular targets. A 'Spacebar to spin' toggle exists in Settings (default ON) for keyboard-only spinning; autoplay has five configurable stop-conditions to reduce required clicks.

Control positions are stable across all base-game/menu screens: info(i) and settings(gear) bottom-left, balance text beneath them, bet stepper centre, autoplay(A) and spin far right, volume/session-clock top-right. Paytable and rules are two separately-scrollable sections of one booklet, reached via two icon buttons (wallet icon for paytable, '?' icon for rules).
Ante Bet ON/OFF is distinguished not just by green/red toggle color but by the text label switching between 'OFF' and 'ON' with a check mark and by the toggle knob moving position
SCATTER, HOT DOG, EXPAND ('UP') and POP symbols are each uniquely shaped cartoon icons with a printed text label baked into the graphic, distinguishable by shape/text regardless of color perception
Card-rank symbols (9/10/J/Q/K/A) are distinguished by their printed glyph, not color — all share the same pink/white stripe pattern
Win-tier banners (SUPER WIN / MEGA WIN) rely on large printed text labels, not color coding, to convey tier
The HOT-DOGS payout ladder on the left uses numbered rungs (3 through 10) plus dollar amounts in plain text, not color-only cues
Ambient music and sound FX are togglable independently in Settings; no in-game captioning/subtitle system was observed for sound effects
Letter symbols differ by letter shape and drawing (A yellow, K red, Q green, J blue, 10 purple), so colour is not the only cue.
Cash fish are told apart by the printed price tag number, not only by colour.
The reached step of the fisherman trail is shown by position and a pink highlight against grey unreached steps; upgrade tiles carry text labels.
The selected stake in the stake dialog is shown by inverted fill (white with black text).
All feature announcements are written panels (ADDITIONAL GAMES AWARDED, COLLECT CASH MULTIPLE TIMES, CONGRATULATIONS); nothing observed depends on sound alone.
Win banners BIG WIN and MEGA WIN print the amount as a large number on a red ribbon; coins fall behind BIG WIN and coloured gems behind MEGA WIN.
Menu and dialogs use white text and outlines on a dark panel with yellow headings; stake, credit and spin counter are numeric.

Autoplay offers 10, 25, 50, 75 or 100 spins and a fast-forward button exists; PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE advances the feature intro; spacebar may start a spin depending on operator configuration (not tested).
Wins are announced in text (PAID, LINE n PAYS); feature messages such as MORE FISH ADDED are written panels. The fast-forward and sound buttons carry no text label.

Jackpot tiers each identified by unique name and dollar amount text (SUPER $50,000 / GRAND $10,000 / MAJOR $1,000 / MINOR $120 / MINI $24); color label is not the sole differentiator. WHEEL BONUS (blue) and GOLDEN WHEEL BONUS (gold) share the same windmill shape; gold version appears on reel 5 only, so reel position functionally distinguishes them for colorblind users. All 11 paying symbols have unique animal species or object shapes (rooster vs hen vs chick vs corn vs wheelbarrow are distinct by species and form). SCATTER golden egg shape is unique among all 15 symbol types. FOX WILD fox face character is unique. Wheel sectors each display both a distinct color and a text label; color is not required to read the sector name.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX can be independently toggled on or off in settings. All game state information conveyed via on-screen text; game is fully informational without audio. Feature mode changes are distinguished visually by background scene change (sunny open farm in base game vs red-orange barn exterior in standard FS vs peachy-golden sunset farm in bigger bonus FS) and by reel frame border style change (crimson in base game vs straw-texture in standard FS vs mixed straw and metallic brackets in bigger bonus FS).

Large circular spin button (estimated 70-80px diameter) positioned in lower-right of game canvas. AUTOPLAY available for up to 100 spins, configurable via AUTOPLAY SETTINGS panel. SKIP SCREENS option auto-advances feature intro and win screens after a short period, minimizing required interactions during bonus features (pre-checked in captured autoplay state). TURBO SPIN and QUICK SPIN modes available in autoplay settings. Keyboard shortcut: hold SPACE for turbo spin (shown in bottom bar). Free Spins round auto-plays without mandatory per-spin player input.

All critical values (CREDIT, BET, WIN amounts) displayed as dollar text in the bottom bar. Paytable has 9 paginated pages with a visible Page X/9 indicator for orientation. Free spins count shown redundantly in two locations: bottom bar text (FREE SPINS LEFT X) and left hanging counter sign. Feature announcements use large text overlays: FREE SPINS AWARDED, MEGA EGG FEATURE, BIGGER, CONGRATULATIONS! YOU WON $X.XX, SPIN TO WIN. Retrigger event shown as on-screen text (+1 SPIN AWARDED). All three bonus buy dialogs display feature name, cost, and current total bet as text. Jackpot panel shows dollar amounts as text for each tier.

Toggle switches (Ante Bet, System Settings) move position and print 'ON'/'OFF' text rather than relying on colour alone; WILD and SCATTER are also identified by a printed text banner or a distinct photo shape, not colour.

MONEY symbol values are always printed as text on the fish tile; retrigger-meter progress is shown by a numeric 'FREE SPINS LEFT' counter and explicit '+10 FREE SPINS xN' text labels, not colour alone.

Residual risk: the disabled state of the BUY FREE SPINS button during Ante Bet is communicated mainly through reduced opacity/washed-out colour, with no explicit on-screen 'disabled' text on the base-game screen itself.
Royal-letter symbols are colour-coded (A purple/violet, K blue, Q red/orange, J green, 10 orange/gold) but each also carries its own letter/number glyph as a non-colour cue.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles in System Settings. All game state (win amounts, spins left, multipliers, bet, retrigger progress) is shown as on-screen text/graphics.
The Free Spins win-screen amount ('YOU HAVE WON $X.XX') is shown in large, high-contrast light-blue-on-dark-navy text, and CREDIT/BET values use bold yellow-on-dark high-contrast text.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, menu, sound, info and bet +/-. SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop a spin. Autoplay offers a configurable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option to reduce the number of manual actions needed.

Bottom-bar controls are position-stable: hamburger menu + sound icon stacked bottom-left, a separate 'i' info button beside them, labelled CREDIT/BET text centre-left, bet -/+ and SPIN centred-right, AUTOPLAY just below SPIN. The rules/paytable booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with a 'Page N/7' indicator on every page.

WILD-collection tracker uses full-color vs greyscale fisherman-headshot icons (shape/desaturation, not color alone) plus explicit '+10 FREE SPINS x2/x3/x10' milestone text; settings toggles use knob position (left=off/right=on) in addition to track color; royal letters (A/K/Q/J/10) are distinguished primarily by glyph shape, secondarily by color (purple/blue/red/green/gold)

No audio-only information observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC toggles are purely decorative — all game state (wins, free spins remaining, WILD-collection progress, retrigger milestones, feature triggers) is conveyed via on-screen text and iconography

Win amounts, spin counts and CREDIT/BET values are large high-contrast text (white or yellow on dark or light-blue backgrounds); 'EPIC WIN!' and 'CONGRATULATIONS!' headlines use bold outlined lettering with drop shadows

Large round click targets for SPIN, bet +/-, menu/sound/info; SPACE/ENTER keys start/stop a spin (holding SPACE = turbo); AUTOPLAY with adjustable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option reduce the interactions needed for extended play

Stable control layout: hamburger menu + sound button far left, separate info 'i' button beside them, CREDIT/BET readout left-of-center, bet +/- flank the central SPIN button; the paytable/rules booklet is a linear 6-page sequence with a 'Page N/6' indicator and prev/close/next controls

All 10 paying symbols are distinguished by shape and character art independent of color: speedboat by silhouette, rod by bent arc and reel spool, lure by teardrop-with-hook, tackle box by open clamshell shape, money fish by fish-school cluster. SCATTER has word SCATTER printed on it. WILD is a fisherman character portrait. Royal symbols are labeled by letter (A/K/Q/J/10).

UI controls: ANTE BET toggle shows 'OFF'/'ON' text label and positional cue (right=on). Settings toggles have text descriptions. WIN amounts shown as large numeric text. Confirm/cancel buttons use both color (green/red) and distinct shapes (checkmark/X). BUY FREE SPINS vs BUY SUPER FREE SPINS distinguished by text, not color alone.

All mechanics, payouts, feature triggers, and win announcements communicated via text overlays and animated elements. No audio-only information detected. SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC independently toggleable in System Settings. BATTERY SAVER mode reduces animation speed.

Symbol colors: Speedboat is red/hot-pink. Rod is silver/grey with pink reel. Lure is neon-green with pink/yellow accents. Tackle Box is hot-pink exterior with white hinges. Money Fish are orange, red, and green cluster. A=purple with lime-green outline. K=blue-purple with lime-green outline. Q=pink ring with teal center. J=lime-green with teal outline. 10=golden-yellow with orange outline.

During Free Spins, money values are displayed as cash overlays (e.g. $4.00, $10.00, $20.00) directly on each fish symbol in large text. Win amounts shown in lime-green large bold text in CONGRATULATIONS overlay. Top-bar WILD counter uses portrait icons with retrigger markers labeled '+10 FREE SPINS'.

SPACE and ENTER buttons start/stop spins. Hold SPACE for TURBO SPIN (high-speed mode, fewer inputs). Full autoplay available up to 100 auto-spins with SKIP SCREENS option to bypass intro and end overlays automatically.

All symbols have describable artwork. SCATTER is text-labeled on symbol body. BET and CREDIT shown as text in bottom bar at all times. During FS: bottom bar shows WIN amount and FREE SPINS LEFT count. Win feedback: large text 'YOU HAVE WON $X.XX' in CONGRATULATIONS overlay. All settings panels use text-labeled buttons and headings.

The three wild women are also identified by their fixed reel position (2, 3 or 4) and by the multiplier text in the promo banner ('DOUBLES/TRIPLES/QUADRUPLES THE PRIZE'), not by hair or bikini color alone.

Payline diagrams in the paytable booklet use a single accent color (orange) for lit cells against dark gray for unlit cells — relies on brightness/contrast rather than hue discrimination, which is colorblind-safe.
Settings toggles (Sound Ambient, Sound Effects, Quick Spin) show on/off via both fill color (orange vs grey) and the physical left/right position of the round handle, not color alone.
Sound Ambient and Sound Effects are independent toggles in Settings, each shown via orange (on) vs grey (off) fill plus handle position; no game state is conveyed by sound alone.
SPIN (green circle, white arrow icon) becomes STOP (red circle, white square icon) during free spins — distinguished by icon shape as well as color.

Free-spins state is signalled by both a full background palette change (rainbow gradient replacing the beach photo) and explicit text ('FREE SPINS REMAINING' with a numeric countdown), not by color alone.

Bet and coin values are changed with discrete round +/- stepper buttons rather than a drag slider; a BET MAX shortcut exists but only raises BET LEVEL to its maximum, not COIN (must be raised separately).
BET LEVEL is a fixed non-arithmetic set of five values {1, 2, 5, 7, 10}, not a 1-10 range — should be read out as this explicit list.

The five Stacked Wild portraits differ by frame colour (blue, green, pink, red, orange) and also by hair, pose and outfit, and each is tied to a fixed reel; the reel multiplier x1 to x5 is printed as text on the arch above the reel.
An active multiplier is shown by a lit arch and its printed number, not by colour alone; dimmed arches stay readable.
Winning lines are identified by the line number on green leaf-shaped tabs at the reel edges and by a glowing orange-gold square frame around winning symbols, not by line colour.
Royal letters A (purple), K (coral-salmon), Q (golden-yellow), J (green) and 10 (periwinkle-blue) are told apart by shape; Scatter is identified by the word Scatter and a shield shape.
Free Spins are signalled by the words REMAINING FREE SPIN and LAST FREE SPIN in addition to the change from a bright blue daytime beach to an orange-red sunset sky.
A Sound toggle sits in the menu bar; no captions for audio events were seen on any frame.
Interface text is white or grey on dark charcoal panels with yellow numerals and yellow call-to-action buttons; balance and bet are plain numerals in dark translucent pills under the reels.

One large central orange-and-white life-ring Spin button; Space bar spins on PC (hold to continue); Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000; Max Bet sets the largest stake in one tap; Turbo Spin toggle exists.
The game field is a canvas; the Paytable and Rules panels are real DOM text, while banners and reels are canvas drawings.

Royal symbols are distinct colored bingo balls: A (red), K (purple), Q (green), J (blue). High symbols: BINGO Card (red card), Safe (teal), Money Bags (green bundles), Slot Machine (gold), Red 7 (red). WILD is gold chip stack, SCATTER is blue diamond, MYSTERY is purple square. BINGO trigger ball is golden-orange with fire glow.

TURBO SPIN available by holding SPACE. Autoplay supports 10 to 1000+ spins with configurable stop conditions (win limit, balance change). Quick Spin toggle and Space Bar/Enter to Spin options in settings panel.

Game: Bingo Mania. 5 reels, 3 rows, 30 paylines left to right. Left panel: BUY FREE SPINS button ($160 at $2 bet), BUY BINGO BONUS button ($160), ANTE BET toggle ($3). State is doubly encoded throughout: toggle switches show handle position (left=off, right=on) as well as color; the paytable page indicator uses a filled dot as well as a color change; Free Spins state is shown by an on-screen 'N Free Spins Remaining' counter and a background palette swap (warm desert versus stormy night), not by color alone; every numeric readout (bet, balance, win, RTP, jackpot breakdown) is plain legible text rather than color-coded.

No information observed to be audio-only: wins and feature triggers are always paired with an on-screen visual cue (banners, counters, background palette change). Settings expose separate 'Sound - Ambient' and 'Sound - Effects' toggles.

Help screen uses a plain black background with white body text; key numeric values (coin denominations, bet levels, RTP percentages, currency amounts) are highlighted in orange for emphasis, and the surrounding sentence always spells the same value out in words as well.

All primary actions (SPIN, BET LEVEL +/-, COIN +/-, BET MAX) are large, well-separated round buttons; the space bar also spins the reels; Autoplay offers a 'stop if FREE GAMES feature is triggered' toggle to cut down on repeated manual actions.

Bottom control bar keeps a stable left-to-right order across the whole session: info button, bet/level/max controls, SPIN centred, autoplay, coin/balance; the paytable booklet and Help screen are both linear, one-page-at-a-time documents with a consistent forward/back affordance.

Modes are not told apart by color alone: the MODE plate always prints the mode name and the MAX NNNNX badge as text. Guard costume color also changes (Easy blue, Medium green, Hard purple, Hardcore red) but is redundant with the text.
The four small bars on the MODE plate (blue, orange, yellow, red) also show difficulty by the count of filled bars.

Cash-out availability is shown by a blue CASH OUT tile appearing next to the yellow button (shape, position and text). A green flag with a check mark marks a safe step; a smoke puff and a falling bird mark a loss, by shape and not by color.
Results are visible on screen (smoke puff, falling bird, YOU WIN banner); no audio-only cues were observed. Sound and Music toggles exist in Game Settings.

Sky blue fills the panels and the promo splash. Bright yellow is the PLAY and GO! button and the numbers. Green is the plus and minus buttons, the bird counter and the success flag. Orange and red are the birds and the rising bars of the MODE plate.

Background is a sky-blue to pale-lavender mountain landscape with white clouds, beige cliffs and green foliage, with two wooden scaffold towers framing the cloud. Menu panels are flat dark navy blue with white headings and greyed-blue body text; control circles are medium blue with yellow icons.

Spacebar to spin is a toggle in Game Settings (on by default). Autoplay has stop on loss and stop on profit. PLAY and GO! are large buttons. Bet is changed by plus and minus buttons only; no typed input was seen.

The bottom strip BALANCE, WIN and TOTAL BET is machine-readable DOM text. Balance, win, total bet, cash-out amount, mode name and stage multiplier are printed as text. Birds alive are shown as a green digit above the flock.

Bison Coin tiles print their value as a plain number regardless of the tile's gold/green/purple frame colour.
Ice Block (blank) tiles are told apart from Bison Coin tiles by the presence or absence of a printed number, not by colour.
The currently selected row in bet-amount and autoplay lists is shown as a solid white block with black text, not a colour highlight.

All state changes (win amounts, free-spin counters, feature triggers) are shown as on-screen text/numbers; no audio-only information. Settings expose three independent mute toggles (All Sounds / Sound Effects / Music).
Spin can be triggered by the large circular Spin button or the space bar; Quick Play (skip animations) can be triggered by clicking anywhere on screen or the space bar.

Base game has exactly four persistent controls stacked on the right edge (Bonus Buy / Autoplay / Bet Select / Spin), plus mute and menu icons top-right and Balance/Total Bet readouts fixed at bottom-left/bottom-right - a stable four-corner-plus-column layout.

Reel symbols are distinguishable by frame shape/artwork in addition to border color: wolf head in a blue oval, eagle head in a green oval, ram head in a purple oval, iguana in a teal/cyan oval, bull in a fire-glow square with no oval

No audio-only information is conveyed; ambient music and sound FX are purely decorative and toggle-controlled, while all game state (wins, spins remaining, progressive value, MONEY-collection meter, bonus purchase confirmation) is shown as on-screen text and numbers
System Settings toggle switches (Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX) show on/off state via handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to a green fill when on

Large round click targets with SPIN as the largest; SPACE/ENTER keys provide keyboard-only spin control, holding SPACE engages turbo spin, and Autoplay (adjustable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option) reduces the number of discrete clicks needed for extended play

Control positions are stable across all screens: menu (hamburger) and sound icons stacked bottom-left, info 'i' button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN; the 6-page info booklet is a linear sequence navigated with left/right triangle icons and closed with a center X on every page
Low-value A/K/Q/J/10 symbols differ by letter shape only, not hue — A is the only one in red, the rest are grey/silver.
SCATTER is a unique flame-skull icon with a green 'SCATTER' text label — identifiable without color discrimination.
MULTIPLIER symbols are distinguished by explicit '+1x'/'x2' printed labels and by fixed, mutually exclusive reel position (reel 1 vs reel 5); rose color (pink vs red) is only a tertiary cue.
System Settings toggles show state via the physical left/right position of the switch handle, not just grey-vs-green fill color.
Autoplay checkboxes show the checked state via an explicit white checkmark glyph, not color fill alone.
Free Spins mode is signalled by both a red/crimson palette shift and explicit 'FREE SPINS LEFT'/'MULTIPLIER' text counters, never by color alone.
No audio-only information observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles. All game state (win amount, spins remaining, multiplier value, bet/credit) is conveyed as on-screen text.
Win amounts, spin counts, multiplier values and balance are shown as large, high-contrast white/gold/yellow text on dark backgrounds throughout the paytable, Free Spins and win screens.

All primary controls are large circular/oval hit targets (SPIN is the largest); SPACE/ENTER also start/stop a spin (keyboard-operable, no mouse precision required); Autoplay with adjustable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option reduces required interactions.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across all game states: menu+sound far-left, info 'i' button next to them, CREDIT/BET left-of-center, SPIN centered-right with bet +/- flanking it, AUTOPLAY just below SPIN, provider name bottom-left.

Jackpot tiers are labelled with their tier name (MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/MEGA/MAX) as text in addition to color (MINI blue/silver, MINOR green, MAJOR purple/magenta, MEGA orange, MAX red) - tier identity does not rely on color alone

Control layout is stable across all base-game screens: info/settings icons bottom-left, balance/bet readout bottom-center-left, autoplay+spin bottom-right; Buy Feature and Respin Ante are two fixed vertically-stacked plaques on the left edge. Primary UI text (CREDIT, BET, WIN amounts) displayed in white or gold against a near-black background providing high contrast. Paytable lists all payout values as text alongside each symbol icon.

WIN amount is displayed as dollar text in the control bar. MEGAWAYS count is a live-updating badge above the reels (screen reader announcement not confirmed from captures). BUY FREE SPINS panel shows price as text. Paytable payout values are presented as text.

The five royal symbols (A/K/Q/J/10) are differentiated only by outline color (blue, pink/magenta, green, gold/orange, purple/violet respectively) — the printed letter or number glyph, not the color, is the reliable way to tell them apart.
Free Spins vs base game is signalled by both a background hue shift (purple in base game, red/orange in Free Spins) and by on-screen text ('FREE SPIN(S) LEFT n'), not color alone.
System-settings toggle switches (Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen) show state via handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to green fill.
Paytable/rules navigation uses three distinct shapes (left triangle, X, right triangle), not color, to mean previous/close/next.
Winning reel cells are marked with a bright white/blue glowing outline (shape/brightness), not color alone; the win amount and contributing line are also printed as text.
The five prize-ladder tiers (BLITZ/MEGA/MAJOR/MINOR/MINI) use different badge colors, but each tier's name and current dollar value are always printed as text on the badge.
In the Buy Free Spins dialog, Cancel/Confirm are distinguished by an X glyph vs a checkmark glyph in addition to red/green button color.

No audio-only information was observed. Sound FX and Ambient Music are purely decorative toggles; all game state (wins, spins remaining, prize tiers, feature results) is conveyed through on-screen text and iconography.

Key numeric outcomes (win amount, free spins left, prize-ladder values, RTP/bet-limit text in the rules booklet) are rendered as large, high-contrast text (gold/white on dark backgrounds) rather than small print.

All primary targets are large circular buttons; the centre SPIN button is the largest single target. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin, and holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin. Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count and a 'skip screens' option that reduces the number of manual actions needed across many rounds or repeated feature-result screens.

Persistent control layout: menu and sound icons stacked bottom-far-left, a separate 'i' Information button just to their right, CREDIT/BET labels centre-left, bet -/+ flanking the large centre SPIN button, AUTOPLAY just below-right of SPIN. The 6-page rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence at a consistent position across all pages, navigated with left/right triangle arrows and closed with a centre X.
Royal letters/numbers are identified by their printed character (A/K/Q/J/10) plus a distinct outline color as a secondary cue, not color alone.
SCATTER and WILD both carry their name as printed text on the symbol itself, in addition to their distinctive shapes.
GOLD SYMBOL state is conveyed by a distinctly shaped ornate carved tile border, not just an amber hue.
The tumble/free-spins multiplier is always paired with a printed 'X{n}' number, never color-coded alone.

Gamble Wheel WIN/LOSE zones are labelled with printed 'WIN'/'LOSE' text signs in addition to green/red coloring, though the wheel's own zones still rely primarily on green vs red hue as the visual split (partial residual risk, mitigated by the text signs alongside the wheel).

No information is conveyed through audio alone; spin results, feature triggers, gamble win/lose and round totals are always accompanied by on-screen text/numbers. Ambient Music and Sound FX are purely decorative, togglable in Settings.
Multiplier badge renders a large bold yellow 'X{n}' number inside a high-contrast dark red/black fanged badge, legible at a glance.

The overall palette is heavily red/blood-toned in both base game and Free Spins (deep saturated blood-red feature background vs. softer pink/orange base-game sky) -- a strong overall color-value shift signals the feature state, but the uniformly dark/red palette may reduce contrast between some UI elements and the background for low-vision users.
Win totals ('CONGRATULATIONS ... YOU HAVE WON') render as large high-contrast yellow text on a dark wood plaque, legible without fine color discrimination.
GOLD SYMBOL state is marked by a distinctly shaped glowing amber tile with an ornate carved rune border -- a structural/shape cue, not reliant on subtle color alone.

All primary actions use large circular touch targets, with SPIN the largest. SPACE/ENTER give full keyboard operability for spinning. Autoplay (adjustable spin count + SKIP SCREENS option) minimizes repeated clicks. Buy Feature and Gamble Wheel each require only a single confirm click per decision.

Control positions are stable across all base-game frames (menu+sound far-left, info button, bet/spin/autoplay center-right). All monetary and count values (CREDIT, BET, WIN, FREE SPINS LEFT, MULTIPLIER Xn, buy-feature prices) render as on-screen text, extractable by a screen reader/OCR pipeline, not solely as graphics.

Alien/ammo/booster/special-item identity is conveyed primarily by distinct SHAPES and printed numeric stats (Health/Reward/Shots), not colour alone. The two boss aliens are distinguished by size, shape and the literal text 'FREE SPINS' printed on them, not just their shared teal colouring.
Toggle switches (Settings, Autoplay Advanced) use both track colour (yellow=on/grey=off) AND thumb position (right=on/left=off) redundantly.
The Kill-o-Meter tier ladder (X1/X10/X25/X50/X75) uses both a printed text label per tier AND a fill-colour/brightness cue, so the reached tier is readable regardless of colour perception.

No spoken narration/voice-over on any captured frame; all game-state information (win amounts, Free Spins award, coin/kill counts, RTP/bet limits) is conveyed as on-screen text, so the game is usable with sound off. Sound and Music are independent toggle rows in Settings.

Balance/Win/Bet readouts sit in a fixed full-width footer bar with bold yellow numeric values beside grey capitalised labels, high contrast against the dark background; Health/Reward/RTP/bet-limit figures in the rules booklet are highlighted bold yellow-gold.

All primary actions (Spin, Autoplay start, Turbo, Bet selector, Menu) are large (~70-90px) circular targets in a single fixed vertical column, reachable without precise aiming. 'Spacebar to spin' (default ON) offers a keyboard alternative to clicking Spin. Autoplay round-count selection is a large button grid (10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000), not a fine slider.

Team affiliation (Blue vs Pink bakery) is signalled mainly by blue vs pink/magenta color; team screens also carry text labels ('Blue bakery'/'Pink bakery', 'BLUE BAKERY WIN'/'PINK BAKERY WIN'), but the in-round scatter/tile color cue has no accompanying shape difference — rely on the persistent 'Change team' character indicator rather than judging color mid-spin.
Most paying symbols are distinguishable by shape alone regardless of color (mixer vs crossed utensils vs donut vs letter-cookie), which helps colorblind play.

All win feedback (round-win banners, Dish Opening reveal, Free Spins trigger, payline wins) is shown with on-screen text/numeric readouts and does not rely on sound alone; a Sound/Music mute toggle exists in Settings.

The two cherry-and-blueberry cupcake symbols are visually near-identical in shape and color even under zoom/pixel-diff comparison; they can only be told apart by their printed payout values (10000/900/300/200/dish300 FUN vs 5000/600/200/100/dish200 FUN at bet 1000 FUN).

All interactive controls (spin, bet selection, autoplay, settings, team switch) are large touch-friendly circular buttons; a 'Spacebar to spin' keyboard toggle exists as an alternative to clicking; bet and autoplay round counts use pill-button grids rather than fine sliders or drag gestures.

Canvas-rendered game with no ARIA/live-region evidence in this build; a screen-reader adaptation would need external instrumentation to announce current team, bet, spin result, round-win/Dish-Opening state and Free Spins progress.

Chance x2 toggle uses green fill in the base game ('available') vs purple/violet fill during Free Spins ('active-but-locked') for two functionally different states; the reliable non-colour cue is the accompanying text label ('CHANCE x2' vs 'CHANCE x2 ACTIVE'), not colour alone.

High-value ornaments are distinguished by shape as well as colour: green pine-tree shape, blue round ball, gold five-pointed star, red heart. Low-value fruits by shape too: green-and-red watermelon slice, dark-blue round berry, yellow oval lemon, round orange, red cherry pair.
No information is conveyed by audio alone; Volume/Music/Sound FX are togglable and all state (wins, spin counters, feature status) is duplicated in on-screen text/numerals.

The bold rounded display font renders the letter V with a curved lower vertex that can read as U at a glance (e.g. "YOU'VE" resembles "YOU'UE", "ACTIVE" resembles "ACTIUE") on win/trigger banners; this is a font-rendering trait, not a misspelling, but users relying on shape-reading rather than a screen reader should be aware.

Primary actions (Spin, Buy Bonus, dialog Buy/Cancel) are large rounded buttons; Spacebar is a keyboard alternative to clicking Spin. Autoplay offers configurable auto-stop conditions (on any win / bonus won / single win exceeds X / balance changes by X) to reduce the number of manual actions needed.

Control layout is stable across screens: info (i) and settings (gear) icons are grouped bottom-left, balance/bet fields centered, autoplay/spin controls bottom-right. The info booklet's third section icon (clock) is non-functional in this demo and should be announced as unavailable rather than left silent.

Free Spins / Super Free Spins state is signalled by BOTH a palette shift (purple vs green) AND text ('Free spins: n/N', 'BONUS ACTIVE [price]'); the Chance x2 ante state adds a white star-shaped badge onto the Spin button in addition to its red/gold pill and text label — not color alone.

Premium symbols are differentiated primarily by shape (faceted gem vs star vs heart vs fruit outline), which is colorblind-safe, but the blue sapphire gem and the blue plum fruit share a similar blue hue — rely on the distinct shapes (faceted gem vs round fruit with stem), not the shared blue color, to tell them apart.

No audio-only information was observed — all wins, spin counts, and multiplier values are conveyed as on-screen text/numerals in addition to sound cues; Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable in Settings and default on.

Win amounts and spin counters are large high-contrast numerals (white/gold text on a solid pink pill, or light grey/white on a dark charcoal info panel); Multiplier bomb values (e.g. 'x20', 'x100', 'x1000') are printed in bold white text with a purple outline directly on the bomb icon.

Spacebar can substitute for clicking the Spin button (toggle in Settings, on by default). Autoplay offers 10 to 1000 rounds or infinite, and Quick Spin (license-dependent, off by default) both reduce the number of required interactions.

The Free-Spins-won award screen ('YOU HAVE WON [N] FREE SPINS' on a green-leaf background) is pixel-identical whether the player bought the plain Free Spins product (100.00 FUN) or the Super Free Spins product (500.00 FUN), including showing the same spin count — a screen-reader/low-vision user cannot tell which variant was purchased from this screen alone. The only distinguishing signal is the purchase price on the preceding 'BONUS ACTIVE' pill (100.00 vs 500.00 FUN) once gameplay resumes, or the observed multiplier floor (2x vs 20x) during play.

Bet direction uses up/down triangle glyphs; disabled buttons are shown by dimmed brightness, not a distinct hue; the free-spins expanding-symbol count is a printed number next to the icon; base-game vs free-spins state is shown by BOTH a warm-gold/cool-teal background shift AND explicit text. Residual risk: royal symbols Q/J/10 are differentiated mainly by color (green/purple/blue) plus distinct glyph shapes, which remain distinguishable by shape alone.

No audio-only information observed; all game state (wins, spin counters, feature status, dialog prompts) is conveyed through on-screen text and graphics. Music and Sound FX are togglable and decorative per Settings.

Win amounts, MAX WIN, free-spins totals and dialog prices are all rendered as large, high-contrast text (white/gold/orange on dark backgrounds) redundant with graphics; winning symbols are also outlined by a glowing border, not color alone.

Primary controls (Spin, Autoplay, bet +/-, Buy bonus) are large, isolated circular/rounded targets. Spacebar can substitute for clicking Spin (toggle in Settings). Autospin round-count presets (10 up to 1000, or infinite) reduce the number of manual actions needed for extended play.

Control positions are stable: info (i) and settings (gear) at far left of the bottom bar with Balance beneath them; bet +/- just right with Total bet value beneath; autoplay ('A' icon) and Spin (double-arrow icon, no text) at far right. Paytable/history/rules overlay reached via 3 stacked round icons on its left edge, closed via a top-right 'X'; paytable and rules are long scrollable booklets (9 pages each), not paginated with next/prev arrows.

Royal symbols A/K/Q/J/10 are distinguished primarily by their printed glyph (letter/number shape), legible regardless of color perception; the red/orange/green/purple/blue color-coding is a secondary, non-essential cue.
Free Spins active state is signalled by a background lighting shift (warm daytime desert to dark navy night sky) AND explicit text ('BONUS ACTIVE', 'Free spins: n/12'), not by color alone.
Chance x2 ante state is shown by three redundant non-color cues: toggle handle position, the total-bet field value changing, and the Spin-button icon changing to a star.
Settings and Autoplay checkboxes use a checkmark glyph, not color, to indicate on/off state; the bet stepper uses shape-based up/down triangle arrows rather than color-coded controls.
The two Buy Bonus dialog purchase buttons are identical teal 'BUY' pills, distinguished only by column position and printed price/label text, not by color.

No information is conveyed by audio only; Music and Sound FX are independently togglable and decorative. All round outcomes (win amounts, free-spin counts, multipliers) are shown as on-screen text/numerals.
Win amounts, free-spin counters and MAX WIN/WAYS splash callouts are rendered as large, high-contrast white/gold text on a dark bar or backdrop.

Total bet is adjusted with small paired up/down stepper arrows rather than a drag slider; Autoplay offers preset round-count buttons (10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/unlimited) instead of manual entry; Spacebar can substitute for clicking the Spin button.

Control positions are stable across the base game: Info/Settings bottom-left, Buy Bonus/Chance-x2 rail far-left, Autoplay/Spin bottom-right. The Payments and Help booklets are fixed-length top-to-bottom scrolls (8 and 7 screen-heights) reached from the Info button's 3-icon left rail (money-bag = Payments, clock = round history, question-mark = Help).

The four premium symbols differ by drawing as well as colour - a jackal head, a cat head, a falcon head and a human heroine - so they stay distinct without colour. The royals differ by glyph (A, K, Q, J, 10) and by their own emblems: eye, scarab, crook and flail, lotus, ankh.

Sound and music are separate switches in Game Settings and the game is fully playable muted: every award, the remaining free-spins count and the total win are stated in on-screen text, and the message ribbon under the reels repeats prompts in writing.

Panel text is white or bright yellow on very dark navy in a large sans serif, and a fullscreen switch is offered in Game Settings. The only small text is the grey build stamp at the bottom of the rules panel; the greyed-out 'Advanced Settings' heading is low contrast until a round count is chosen, after which it turns white.

All controls are round targets of about 75x75 pixels in one vertical rail on the right edge. Autoplay offers eight preset round counts (10 to 1000) and five stop conditions, and the spacebar spins while the 'Spacebar to spin' switch in Game Settings is on.

The control rail and the bottom balance/win/bet strip are real DOM elements rather than canvas drawings, so their labels and the current bet are machine readable; the reels themselves are a single canvas and carry no text alternative.

Low symbols are each a distinct shape: heart (Heart of Ra), hexagon (Blue Hex Scarab), rhombus/diamond (Purple Ankh), triangle/shield (Gold Triangle Lotus), circle (Green Spiral Coin). High symbols are character portraits (pharaoh, cobra, Cleopatra etc.) — distinguishable by character shape, not color alone.
WILD is a gold deity idol labeled 'WILD' in text. SCATTER (book) has unique book shape with scarab cover. Confirm/cancel buttons in Buy dialog use checkmark and X symbols — not color only.

Settings toggles show ON/OFF via both color (green vs grey) and position of the triple-line symbol (lines on right = ON, left = OFF). Start Autoplay button is green but also has 'START AUTOPLAY' text label.

All audio information duplicated visually: win amounts shown as text, feature triggers shown as text overlays, CONGRATULATIONS screen with win total shown after Free Spins. No critical information is audio-only.

High-contrast white/gold text on dark backgrounds throughout. Win amounts in large fonts inside bordered boxes. Credit and bet values in yellow on dark background. Free Spins LEFT counter displayed as a red-circle badge with white number top-left. Win level labels (NICE!, SUPERB!) in large 3D gold text.

SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts available to start and stop spin. Autoplay supports up to 100 spins with configurable speed (normal, quick spin, turbo spin). SKIP SCREENS option auto-advances feature intro/end screens. All interactive elements are large click/touch targets.

All key information shown as readable text strings: game title, CREDIT, BET, WIN, FREE SPINS LEFT, button labels (SPIN, AUTOPLAY, BUY FREE SPINS, START AUTOPLAY). Feature events shown as text overlays: SELECTING SPECIAL EXPANDING SYMBOL, YOU HAVE WON 10 FREE SPINS WITH SPECIAL EXPANDING SYMBOL, CONGRATULATIONS. No information is conveyed solely through animation.
Royal-letter symbols (A red, K blue, Q purple/magenta, J orange, 10 green) are color-coded but also uniquely lettered and shaped, so identity does not depend on color alone.
Feature state (base game vs Free Spins vs Super Free Spins) is signalled by a full night-vs-day background palette change plus explicit on-screen text/counters, not by color alone.
The Super Free Spins progressive multiplier is shown as printed white/gold '×N' digits on a red badge, not as a color scale.
Bet-stepper arrows at the min/max bet limits are distinguished by brightness (dim vs bright), not by a color change.
Preview-slide indicator dots differ mainly by fill color, but their position (left dot vs right dot) also identifies which slide is active.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; Sound FX and Music are separately adjustable/mutable in Settings, and all wins, spin counts, multipliers and bonus states are shown as on-screen text/numbers in addition to any sound cues.
Settings toggle 'on' state (e.g. Spacebar to spin) is shown by both a yellow fill AND a black checkmark glyph, not fill color alone; audio sliders show state by handle/track position.
Win amounts are rendered as large high-contrast gold/white digits on a dark brown status bar or orange-to-red gradient ribbon.

Large circular touch targets for Spin/Autoplay; bet adjustment via a simple +/- stepper; Spacebar-to-spin is available as a keyboard alternative to clicking (on by default); Autoplay offers many stop-condition presets to reduce the number of manual actions needed.

Bottom bar layout is stable: Information + Settings icons at far left, bet stepper and status text centered, Autoplay + Spin at far right. Paytable/rules is a linear paged sequence (21 / 14 pages) navigated by scroll/chevron with an explicit close 'X'; the info-modal left-rail icon order (money-bag / clock / question-mark) is fixed.
Letter symbols A/K/Q/J/10 are each rendered in a distinct color (orange/red, green, amber/gold-orange, pink/magenta, pale lavender) but are distinguished primarily by glyph shape, not color alone.

Free Spins state is signalled redundantly: background shifts from cool blue/indigo to warm reddish-purple with a lava river at the bottom edge, plus explicit 'BONUS ACTIVE' and 'Free spins: N/10' text, plus a cyan box outline around the active Expanding symbol(s) in a strip above the reels.

The Expanding symbol for a Free Spins round is chosen before the round starts and shown boxed in cyan in the symbol strip above the reels; the round's Buy Bonus tier (1-9) directly sets how many symbols are boxed there.

Chance x2 side-bet on/off state is shown mainly via the teal progress-bar fill level (empty vs solid) plus the Spin button icon changing shape from circular arrows to a five-point star; the icon-shape change is the reliable non-color cue. The toggle's 'CHANCE x2' label names the odds-boost effect, not its price - the price is a 1.6x total-bet multiplier shown separately as a FUN surcharge.
No information is conveyed by audio only; Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable, and all feature and win outcomes are shown as on-screen text and numbers.

Win amounts and 'MEGA WIN'/'BIG WIN' banners use large warm gold/cream 3-D lettering with a brown drop-shadow over an animated gold-coin shower, high-contrast against the dark charcoal reel background.

Bet is adjusted only via two small up/down arrow buttons (no numeric-entry field observed); reaching min or max bet needs multiple presses. Autoplay offers 9 preset round counts (10 to 1000) plus unlimited, reducing manual Spin presses. Spacebar can trigger Spin by default, giving a keyboard alternative to clicking.

Bottom HUD control positions are stable across all screens: info and settings icons far left, bet field with arrow buttons centre-left, Autoplay button (replaced by the Free-spins N/10 counter during the feature) and Spin button far right.
Winning cell highlight is a green glow (color-only), but WIN amount and LINE PAYS text are always displayed simultaneously — no loss of information for colorblind users.
Jackpot bar uses color to distinguish tiers (cyan for MAJOR, gold for MEGA, pink for MINOR), but each tile also shows its text label (MAJOR/MEGA/MINOR) — fully readable without color.

Money Respin grid: filled positions (teal-green background with silver coin graphic) vs empty positions (plain teal-green rectangle). Shape cue available: circular coin disc vs empty rectangle — distinguishable without relying on color alone.
Royal symbols differ in both color and letter (red A, purple K, teal Q, pink J, gold 10) — letterform alone is sufficient to identify each symbol.

Character symbols distinguished by shape and appearance: Explorer (young man, light shirt, no hat), Sultan (turban, dark beard, red jacket), Woman (light hair, snake), Monkey (animal shape, red fez hat), 5th character (darker skin tones). No two share the same silhouette.
Settings toggles use green (ON) vs dark grey (OFF), but toggle circle position (right=ON, left=OFF) provides a shape cue independent of color.

Money Symbol coins: jackpot coins turn gold with text label (MINOR/MAJOR/MEGA in contrasting text); cash-value coins remain silver with dollar amount text overlay. Text fully identifies coin type without relying on gold vs silver color.

All game information — payouts, feature awards, win amounts, jackpot values — conveyed visually in text form. Feature triggers, Free Spins win, and BIG WIN all show explicit text overlays. No audio-only information identified; deaf users lose no game-critical information.

CREDIT and BET labels can be clicked to toggle between coins view and cash view, aiding legibility. Jackpot bar spans full width at top with large text values. Win amounts displayed in large gold text below reels. Seven-page info overlay provides full game rules in readable text format.

Keyboard support: SPACE and ENTER trigger spin. HOLD SPACE activates Turbo Spin. All primary controls are large circular buttons. Autoplay available for up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option to bypass feature intro and end screens. No mandatory rapid-click sequences identified.

All win amounts, bet values, jackpot values (MAJOR/MEGA/MINOR with multipliers), and feature announcements are displayed as on-screen text. Paytable is a text-based grid. Feature triggers show large explicit text banners (e.g. '5 FREESPINS WON!', 'SPECIAL EXPANDING SYMBOL CHOSEN!', 'PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE').
Symbol identities in the canvas-rendered paytable require visual description — no native ARIA labels in canvas implementation. This documentation provides textual descriptions of all 12 symbols.

Green 'Choose Tile'/'Start Game' and teal 'Cash Out' buttons differ in printed text as well as colour. The near-black Anubis hazard icon and the teal-blue scarab safe icon differ strongly in shape and silhouette, not only hue. The highlighted ladder rung is marked with an outline box and a pointer icon in addition to its background colour.

No sound-only cues were observed to carry unique information: outcomes are always paired with a visible balance change and a field-reset animation. Independent Sound and Music sliders in Settings both default to near-maximum.

Bet amount, mine count and field size are all adjusted with discrete +/- or chevron-arrow buttons rather than drag sliders. The main action button (Choose Tile / Start Game / Cash Out) is a single large target in a consistent bottom-right position across all captured states.

Every game-critical number (Balance, Bet Amount, ladder multipliers, Cash Out amount, mine count, field size) is rendered as plain text and is machine-readable via the game's own DOM. The safe (scarab) and hazard (Anubis) tile types are communicated purely through image content with no text label before a tile is opened -- consistent with a chance-based game, but any post-hoc 'this tile was safe/a mine' announcement must come from surrounding UI text, not the tile graphic.

All 3 monsters have unique silhouettes beyond color: Red Monster is one-eyed round blob with spiky hair; Green Monster has two horns and two symmetrical eyes; Purple Monster is the smallest blob with no horns and one fang. Shape alone distinguishes them.

Royal card symbols each carry a distinct letter (A, K, Q, J) AND a distinct suit icon: spade (pointed top, two lobes), heart (symmetric curved top, point bottom), clubs (trefoil three-lobe), diamond (rotated square). Neither letter nor shape alone requires color.
BONUS symbol is the only symbol bearing printed text 'BONUS' on its face — identifiable without color. Shape is unique: open book with eye, unlike all other symbols.
FAT symbol tracker panel uses text labels exclusively: size shown as '2X2', '6X6', etc. Collect counter shown as 'COLLECT N MORE TO LEVEL UP' in text. No color-only encoding.
Settings toggles indicate state by knob position AND color (green=on, grey=off). Autoplay checkboxes use checkmark shape (filled square with white checkmark = checked). No color-only toggle state.

Ambient music and sound effects are independently toggleable in System Settings. Battery Saver mode reduces animation speed. All game events and win notifications are conveyed via on-screen text and visual animations — no audio-only events confirmed.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop spins. Holding SPACE activates Turbo Spin. Autoplay available with SKIP SCREENS option (auto-skips feature intro/end screens). Bet adjusted via oval +/- buttons. No timed-response gameplay elements identified.

All game values visible as on-screen text: bet, credit, win amount, cluster size (e.g. '7X PAYS $2.50'), free spins remaining, FAT symbol size, collect threshold. No audio-only game events identified.

Symbols are distinguished by shape/imagery as well as card-background color: cowboy explorer (human portrait, brown hat/jacket) on blue; Pharaoh bust (gold-and-blue striped headdress) on green; Anubis (grey/black jackal head, glowing orange eyes) on red/orange; Ankh (gold cross-with-loop shape) on purple. Card letters differ by shape (A/K/Q/J/10) in addition to color (A=red, K=teal/cyan, Q=magenta/pink, J=green, 10=blue), each with a gold trim and small gold Eye-of-Horus flourish.

The Book icon is the ONLY symbol that is both WILD and SCATTER, and it uses the exact same golden-book/Eye-of-Horus artwork in both roles regardless of color; its function (substituting vs triggering Free Spins) depends on context/count, not on any distinct coloring or extra marking.

Super Spin OFF/ON state is shown by both the word ("OFF"/"ON") and an arrow-vs-checkmark icon change, not color alone; system-settings toggles use handle position in addition to green fill; the bet-menu ceiling is shown by a greyed-out (not just recolored) '+' button; the three info-booklet navigation icons are distinguished by triangle-left/cross/triangle-right shape; payline wins are traced with a gold line PLUS a text readout of the exact line and amount (e.g. 'LINE 10 PAYS $2.00').

No audio-only information was observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are decorative toggles in SYSTEM SETTINGS. All game state (bet, credit, win amounts, spins remaining, feature triggers, RTP/volatility/bet-limit text) is conveyed visually/textually on-screen.

Win amounts, free-spins counters ('Free spin N of 10', 'FREE SPINS LEFT n') and RTP/volatility/bet-limit text are all shown in large high-contrast gold/white lettering on dark backgrounds; Free Spins state is additionally reinforced by a background hue shift (warm gold base game vs cooler purple/violet Free Spins backdrop).

Large round click targets for MENU, SOUND, INFO, SPIN and AUTOPLAY; SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop a spin, reducing the need for precise pointer clicks. Bet changes are reachable via a dedicated stepper (-/+) rather than drag gestures; toggling Super Spin and buying Free Spins are each a single click plus one confirm click.

Control positions are stable across all base-game frames: menu+sound stacked at the far bottom-left, 'i' info button just to their right, bet -/+ flanking the large central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. Ways-to-win valid/invalid examples use a green checkmark vs a red X glyph, shape-coded rather than color alone

Settings toggle switches show handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to a green track color
No information is conveyed via audio only; Ambient Music and Sound FX are purely decorative toggles, all game state (ways count, free spins left, win amounts) is shown as on-screen text

Large circular touch targets for spin/menu/sound/info/autoplay; SPACE and ENTER keys can start/stop a spin without using the pointer; Autoplay up to a configurable spin count reduces required interactions

Control layout is stable across screens (menu+sound far-left, info button next to them, CREDIT/BET center-left, SPIN centered, Autoplay below); the rules booklet is a strict linear 7-page sequence with consistent nav position on every page

Game-state cues are duplicated by shape/position/text, not color alone: settings toggles show handle position plus green/grey track color; paytable navigation uses triangle/cross shapes; Free Spins is signalled by a background palette shift (grey-blue rain vs warm maroon) plus a persistent banner, not color alone. No audio-only information observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles. All game state (wins, feature status, credit, bet) is conveyed visually via on-screen text.

The history ribbon separates won and lost rounds only by the colour of the drawn coefficient (lime green or coral red); each tile also shows the target in white beneath it, so the two numbers can be compared to infer the result, but there is no text label.

My bet history marks results with colour plus text: x0 in red for a loss and x2 in green for a win, with the win amount or a dash alongside. The green shield icon on every row means verify, not win, so it carries no outcome information.

The menu has a Sound toggle (on) and a Music toggle (off). What sounds are played was not captured. The round outcome is shown visually by the face, colours and numbers, so no information is known to depend on audio.

Target and Chance are printed as large numbers in two read-only cards (for example 2x and 48.25%) and also appear in the editable inputs. Play is one large lime-green rounded button with white text on dark charcoal background.

Exact typing is not required: bet presets 2, 3 and 8 with MIN and MAX buttons, target presets 5X, 10X and 100X, and chance presets 25%, 50% and 85%. Not established: no screen-reader or ARIA inspection was performed. There is no separate textual announcement such as 'you won' or 'you lost'; the outcome is conveyed by the face emoji, the colours and the numbers in the result box.

Round outcome is not color-only: the winning bubble carries a golden five-pointed star glyph on a pale cyan bubble, and popped bubbles turn matte dark navy with markedly lower gloss and contrast than either the blue or orange states, so both of these states remain legible without relying on hue.

No audio-only information was found on any captured screen -- round outcomes, balance changes and payout math are all presented as on-screen text, and the Settings Sound toggle only controls background audio and effects.

Active or pressed controls (the Min and Max bet buttons, and marked bubbles) switch to a solid bright gold-yellow fill rather than a subtle hue shift, giving strong brightness contrast against the unpressed white or blue state.

Marking bubbles on larger grids requires many small precise taps -- up to 100 individual bubble targets, each roughly 39 by 39 pixels on the 10x10 layout -- with the only bulk-selection alternative being the single 'Choose randomly' shuffle button, which marks a fixed provider-side count rather than a player-chosen number.

The Rules booklet is a list of 7 independently openable named sections (How to Play?, Game Details, RTP, Autoplay, Settings, Disconnection Policy, Version) rather than a fixed page sequence, so a screen reader cannot assume one linear reading order across the whole booklet.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently togglable and purely decorative; all game state (win amounts, free spins count, feature triggers, bonus-buy cost/confirmation) is presented as on-screen text and numbers.

Multiplier ladder x1 / x2 / x3 / x5 under the reels: the active one is bright gold and larger, inactive ones are pale blue and faded, so size works besides color.
Scatter is a round wreath of red, pink and yellow flowers with a blue-lavender center carrying the script words Free Spin.

Buttons carry text labels (GET STARTED, Start, Collect, Max Bet, Confirm, Start Auto Spin); menu icons each have a label under them. The selected bet row is marked by a highlighted band and bolder white text.
Wins show the amount in numerals and Big Win banners; free spins show the remaining count in text. No information seen is delivered only by sound (audio was not assessed).

Panels (Bet Options, Auto Spin, Paytable, Rules) are dark charcoal grey with white text, yellow headings and yellow figures; Max Bet and Confirm buttons are yellow. Big decorative numerals for wins are gold on glowing blue (Big Win) or red-orange and gold (free spins total).

Spin, Turbo, Auto, plus and minus are large round buttons on the bottom bar. Space starts a spin on PC (hold to repeat, also skips reel animation). Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80, 1000. Max Bet sets the bet in one tap.

Paytable and Rules panels are real text in the page and readable by a screen reader; the playfield is a canvas, so symbol identities and wins are not exposed as text. Balance, bet and win are shown as text on the bottom bars.
Jackpot tiers (MINOR green, GRAND red, MAJOR magenta, MINI blue) are identified by tier-name text and a fixed left-to-right bar order, not colour alone
Money symbol variants (gold/green/red disc) always display their dollar value as text, so the amount is readable regardless of disc colour
Volatility badge is shown as a 4-of-5 lightning-bolt icon count, but the same rating is restated in plain text on the rules page ('Medium volatility games...')
No information is conveyed by audio alone; sound and music toggles are decorative; all wins, jackpot results, respin counts and feature outcomes are shown as on-screen text
Settings toggles (Battery Saver/Ambient Music/Sound FX/Intro Screen) show on/off state by handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey/green colour
Autoplay checkboxes (Turbo Spin/Quick Spin/Skip Screens) show checked state with a white check-mark glyph shape, not colour alone
All interactive targets are large filled circles; the central spin button is the largest target; autoplay offers adjustable spin count and a skip-screens option to reduce required interactions
Bottom-bar controls have stable positions across all screens: menu and sound icons stacked bottom-left, info button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central spin button, autoplay below spin

Four cash pots above reels differ by color (purple/red/green/dark navy blue left-to-right) AND by animal face motif (phoenix/dragon/tiger/fish) AND by fixed position — color is not the sole differentiator.

BUY FEATURE button (blue) and SPECIAL BETS button (red) on left panel are also distinguishable by vertical position (BUY FEATURE above, SPECIAL BETS below) and their text labels.
Multiplier badges during Free Spins (white circular overlays showing x2/x3/x5/x6/x10) use numeric text as primary information carrier; badge color is secondary.

Maneki-neko symbol is white/ceramic on dark purple-maroon tile; Coin Cauldron is dark blue/navy on dark teal tile — shapes (cat vs bowl) and paytable position distinguish them without relying on color.
All game mechanics communicated visually: win screen text, multiplier numeric badges on reel cells, pot visual activation states, free spins counter. No critical information is audio-only.

High-value symbols feature large distinct character art: elderly deity (Caishen), child holding fish, child holding ingots, white cat figurine, navy cauldron. Win amounts displayed in large numeric text. Multiplier badges overlaid directly on reel cells.

Free Spins remaining counter is a blue rectangle with large white number and white 'FREE SPINS LEFT' text in top-left of reel area. Win screen shows large centered dollar amount on contrasting colored rectangle.

SPACE bar starts and stops spin. ENTER also starts/stops spin. Holding SPACE activates TURBO SPIN for faster play. All critical controls (spin, bet, buy feature) reachable without precise pointer movement.

Bottom bar layout left-to-right: hamburger settings icon, speaker (sound), info 'i' icon, CREDIT label with balance, BET label, minus-bet button, SPIN button (large circular), plus-bet button, AUTOPLAY button. Left panel: BUY FEATURE button (top), SPECIAL BETS button (below).

Jackpot tiers (GRAND purple/MAJOR red/MINOR green/MINI blue) are distinguished by text label and a fixed left-to-right screen position, not color alone. Toggle switches show state by knob position (left=off, right=on) in addition to track color. The AUTOPLAY 'SKIP SCREENS' checkbox uses a white checkmark glyph, not only green fill. Winning symbol combinations are marked with a bright gold glow/sparkle line (brightness/shape cue), not a color change alone.
