Buy Feature and Special Bets are reached via two clearly-labelled stacked buttons on the left edge during base play.

BET/WIN/BALANCE values are always paired with a text label, never color-coded alone. The re-spin held-reel state uses a light-blue glow AND motion (spinning reels stay blurred while held reels are static) -- a dual, not color-only, channel.

Free Spins Remaining is a printed number in a gold badge, not a color/bar indicator. MINOR vs GRAND jackpot are told apart by their text label, both using the same red/gold plaque style, not by color.

The decorative numbered ovals running down the reel-frame side rails print their number in white/black text, but the ovals themselves are told apart mainly by color+position, which could be hard to distinguish by color alone.
All observed state changes (re-spin trigger, free-games award, win totals, jackpot ticker) are communicated visually via banners, badges and numeric text, not sound-only.
Core actions (Play, Stop, Bet +/-, Coin +/-) are large circular buttons with generous spacing in the bottom bar; Space bar is a documented keyboard alternative for spin/stop.

Auto Play removes the need for repeated manual spin presses, with configurable stop conditions (spin count, balance-drop threshold, single-win threshold) plus an unconditional stop on any jackpot win.

Canvas-rendered game with no separate DOM element per control; a screen-reader user would depend entirely on an accessible overlay/description layer built from this documentation's on-screen layout description.

All 7 symbols have distinct shapes independent of color. WILD: uniquely ornate gold rectangular border + yin-yang with dragon scales, visually larger and more complex than all gems. Pagoda: multi-tiered curved roofline building silhouette + unique golden amber tile (only non-gray tile in game). Fire: upward flame tongues (unique organic shape). Purple: S-curve swirl (two interlocking teardrops) vs Blue Water's single vertical teardrop. Green Leaf: organic lobed leaf with stem vs Red Crystal's angular mineral facets — critical distinction for deuteranopia/protanopia. WIN MULTIPLIER REEL values shown as large bold number+x text (1x through 100x); active ball at centered position highlighted by gold frame.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX independently toggleable in System Settings. All wins communicated visually: dollar amounts, WINNER/MEGA WIN text banners, light-burst ray effects from active multiplier ball, golden flaming dragon animations on Mega Win. No audio-only information detected across all 5 Game Rules pages.

WIN amounts in large bold yellow/gold text on dark banner; reinforced by bottom bar text. White and yellow text on dark backgrounds throughout UI. Settings toggles use both color (green=on, gray=off) AND position of fill indicator — dual coding. At low reel heights (2-3 symbols per reel per spin), symbols render larger and are more easily visible.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop spin (confirmed Game Rules page 2/5). AUTOPLAY supports up to 1000 automated spins with TURBO SPIN and QUICK SPIN options. Only two buttons (+/-) required for all bet changes. AUTOPLAY stopped by pressing AUTOPLAY button again.

Win amount displayed redundantly: large text overlay on reels during win + bottom bar always shows WIN $X.XX label + WINNER or MEGA WIN text. BET and CREDIT always visible as labeled dollar-amount fields. WIN MULTIPLIER selected value shown as number+x text (e.g. 3x, 10x) at centered/highlighted reel position.

The four jackpot plaques are told apart by printed name (GRAND, MAJOR, MINOR, MINI), by stacked position (GRAND on top) and by amount size, not by color alone. Colors: GRAND red, MAJOR green, MINOR blue, MINI purple, all with gold frames and yellow digits.
Red versus green (Grand versus Major plaque) is the only pair at risk for red-green color blindness; the plaque text separates them. Jackpot coins carry the name across the top plus a colored ring.
Collector (blue-and-green swirl orb in a gold ring), Coin (flat gold disc with a number) and Wild (gold disc with a red star and WILD banner) differ by shape and inner pattern, not only by hue.
Winning cells show a glowing outline plus the win amount number. The bonus is marked by the background turning from royal blue to deep red, the words BONUS GAME and a number in the spin button.
Toggles in settings: ON is a yellow track with the knob on the right, OFF is a dim track with the knob on the left, so position backs up color.

Sound and Music have separate buttons in Game Settings. Wins and the bonus are shown visually: glowing outlines, large gold win digits, background change, spin counter with three pips, TOTAL WIN banner. No information was seen to rely on sound only.

White and yellow text on deep maroon panels has high contrast. Rules body text is muted grey-pink on maroon with lower contrast. The FUN currency labels are small and grey. The disabled Advanced Settings in autoplay is dimmed on purpose.

Base game: royal blue velvet curtain, star marquee of white bulbs, orange-gold reel frame with a heap of gold coins. Bonus: deep red curtain, red stage, dark red empty cells with faint stars, glowing orange-red occupied cells.
Bonus start has coin and spark animations, flashing star outlines and flying coins on the total win. No way to disable them was seen in settings.

Spin can be started with the Space bar (Spacebar to spin, ON by default). Bonus intro and total win screens are dismissed by clicking anywhere. Bet is chosen from large pill buttons. Autoplay offers 8 round counts and stop conditions: stop on any win, stop if free spins is won, single win exceeds, cash increases by, cash decreases by.
The bottom strip BALANCE, WIN and BET is plain DOM text. Reels, coin values, jackpot plaque amounts and win banners are drawn graphics with no text equivalent, printed in large yellow-gold digits.

The four jackpot plaques (Grand/Major/Minor/Mini) differ by color (red/green/blue/purple) but each also carries a distinct printed tier name and a fixed top-to-bottom rank order, so identity does not depend on color alone.
The 5 payline diagrams use plain white dots on a dark panel, identified by a printed number (1-5) above each diagram, not by color.

Right-side control icons (turbo, autoplay, bet menu, hamburger menu) are white glyphs on red circular buttons distinguished by glyph shape, not color; the SPIN button is shape-distinct (larger, centered) rather than color-coded.
Balance/bet/win/jackpot and paytable/RTP-limits figures are large, high-contrast bright-yellow-on-dark or white-on-dark text, OCR-legible without zoom on every captured frame.

Spacebar-to-spin is available and defaults ON, offering a keyboard alternative to clicking SPIN; Autoplay supports configurable stop conditions (single-win exceeds / cash increases by / cash decreases by) to reduce repetitive manual spinning.

BLACK/RED gamble buttons carry literal text labels plus card-suit icons (spade+club vs diamond+heart). MINI (green)/MAJOR (cyan)/MEGA (white) jackpot ribbon entries are distinguished by text label and left/right position, not color alone. Royal letters A (magenta)/K (blue)/Q (red)/J (purple) are already differentiated by letter shape in addition to color. Toggle checkboxes use a check-mark glyph, not fill color, for on/off state.
Loading splash's active tab (of 4: Blazing Reels/Coin Respin/Free Spins/Tutti-Frutti Jackpot) is marked by a gold box outline shape, not only by its orange text color.

No audio-only information observed; all game state (win amounts, jackpot values, gamble outcomes, feature text) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers. Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative.

Spin and Autoplay are large circular icon buttons at a fixed screen position. Spacebar can substitute for clicking Spin (enabled by default). Autoplay presets (10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/unlimited) and multiple auto-stop conditions (on any win, bonus won, win/balance thresholds) reduce the number of required clicks for extended play.

Control positions are stable in the base game: info+settings icons and balance text bottom-left, bet stepper center-left, status/message strip center, Autoplay and Spin bottom-right (Gamble and Collect icons appear in that same cluster only after a win). Jackpot tiers (MINI green / MAJOR cyan / MEGA white-red) are colour-coded but each is also fully spelled out in text. Royal letters A (magenta), K (blue), Q (red), J (purple) remain distinguishable by letter glyph alone under any colour-vision deficiency. Winning paylines are marked by a green connecting line, an animated glow and a printed numeric win value, not colour alone.

No information is conveyed by audio only; Music and Sound FX are decorative and independently toggleable in Settings. Feature state (respins remaining, win amounts, jackpot values, gamble possible-win amounts) is always shown as on-screen text/numerals.

Paytable payout numbers are printed as plain white/grey digits on a near-black background for high contrast. Toggle states (Quick spin, Spacebar to spin, Music, Sound FX) are shown with a checkmark glyph inside a square box, a shape-based indicator rather than a subtle colour difference.

The Spin button is the largest circular target on screen. 'Spacebar to spin' (enabled by default, toggleable in Settings) allows spinning without pointing/clicking. Autoplay offers configurable stop conditions (on any win, bonus won, single win exceeds X, balance rises/falls by X) to reduce the number of required manual actions.

Control positions are stable across all screens: Information/Settings icons far-left of the bottom bar, Balance/Total bet readouts center-left, a context/status message center, Autoplay and Spin buttons on the right. Paytable and rules are both long linear scrollable documents reached via the 'i' Information button and a 3-icon left-edge section rail (Payments/History/Help).

Symbols are distinguished by letter or shape (K, Q, J, 10, grapes, cherries, king portrait, pot), not only by colour; J (blue), 10 (mint green) and Q (yellow) share a similar bevelled style and partly rely on colour for quick recognition.

The win multiplier box (yellow numeral, gold x, white word WIN on black with a light-gold frame) shows a numeral and text, so it does not depend on colour.
No on-screen captions for sounds, but all game state is also shown as text (WIN amount, multiplier, GOOD LUCK!). Ambient music and sound effects can be switched off in System Settings.
Black reel cells with thin grey borders; bright green cells mark trigger progress; credit and bet labels are light blue with yellow numbers; win text WIN is light blue with the amount in yellow.

Single-click controls; SPACE or ENTER spins and holding SPACE gives turbo spin; autoplay with a slider count (100 by default), quick spin, turbo spin and skip screens options; battery saver reduces animation.

A/K/Q/J/10 symbols use hue (magenta, orange-red, gold-yellow, blue, green) but each also carries its own distinct letter or number shape as a non-color cue

No audio-only information; sound is decorative (ambient music and sound FX toggles in Settings). Spin results, win amounts, feature progress and autoplay spins left are all conveyed visually via on-screen text and numbers

SPIN is the largest button on screen and SPACE/ENTER also spin; Autoplay with Skip Screens reduces most clicks, EXCEPT the Pick Me/Eliminator Bonus and the Rainbow Road Bonus mini slot, both of which REQUIRE manual clicks even during Autoplay - Autoplay pauses and waits for the player to click

Controls are stable across all screens: menu and sound buttons stacked far-left, info button beside them, bet +/- around the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN; the rules booklet is a linear 7-page sequence navigated with previous/close/next

Nothing is conveyed by sound alone: collections, wheel results, the free spins counter and the round total are all displayed as text. Ambient music and sound effects have separate toggles.

Credit, bet, win amounts and the free spins counter are large yellow or white type on dark strips. The info booklet prints white text on a near-black panel with an explicit Page N/7 counter; the buy and special bet plaques are large wooden signs with big lettering.

Large targets throughout: round spin button, plus and minus bet steppers, wooden plaques for buy and ante, and the wheel's own SPIN button. Keyboard SPACE and ENTER start and stop spins, and autoplay up to 100 spins avoids repeated clicking.

The game is a single canvas without DOM controls, so screen readers cannot reach it. Layout is stable between states, which helps magnifier users: credit and bet bottom left, spin and autoplay bottom right, buy and ante plaques top right, wheel to the right of the reels.
Winning clusters are marked by purple cells with white sparkle dots and a white-pink glowing outline, not by colour alone; the win amount is also printed as text in the hint bubble and banner
Symbols differ by silhouette: round face, dog ears, mug with handle, round bomb with fuse, diagonal blade, swirl; Wild and Scatter carry printed words WILD and SCATTER
No information is conveyed by sound alone: win amounts are printed; a Sound toggle is in the menu

Base game is bright sky blue with light cyan checkerboard; free spins turn the screen pink-magenta-red with peach-orange tiles; panels are dark charcoal-grey with lime-green titles and light-grey text

Green is reused for several 'positive/on' UI meanings (checked checkboxes, '+' buttons, BET MAX, START AUTOPLAY), but each also carries a distinct glyph or explicit text label.

No audio-only information found; a dedicated SOUND toggle exists in System Settings independent of Vibration, and all win amounts, feature ladders and rules are always rendered as on-screen text, never conveyed via audio alone.

All monetary values, the HEART BONUS ladder thresholds, bet limits ($0.10-$250.00), RTP (96.50%) and the volatility level are always printed as explicit high-contrast white/gold numeric text on black panels, never color-only.
Checked Autoplay checkboxes (e.g. SKIP SCREENS) show a green fill plus a white checkmark glyph, a shape-based cue in addition to color.
The large circular SPIN button is the dominant central target; holding it activates Turbo Spin without needing a separate control.

Autoplay (slider, default 100 spins) and quick bet '-'/'+' ovals beside SPIN reduce the number of required interactions; more granular Coins-Per-Line/Coin-Value/Total-Bet steppers are also available in the coin-stack menu.

Bottom control-bar icon order is stable on every screen: info 'i' far-left, spin-speed-cycle icon, coin-stack bet-menu icon, hamburger/settings icon far-right; CREDIT/BET readouts always sit at the bottom edge.
The HEART BONUS ladder is permanently displayed above the reels during base play, not hidden in a menu, aiding proximity-to-bonus tracking without needing to open a panel.

Royal letters A, K, Q and J are all rendered in the same silver/steel beveled style with no color-coding between them at all — distinguished only by letter shape, so this tier carries no color-blind risk by itself but requires letter-shape recognition.

The five high-value symbols sit on differently colored plaques (crown green, jewel sack red, gold bar purple, cash green, coins blue) but each is also visually distinct by icon shape, so plaque color is not the sole differentiator.
WILD (burglar-face card) and BONUS (double vault-door card) both carry bold gold 'WILD'/'BONUS' text labels in addition to their distinct icon art, not relying on color to identify them.

Settings toggle switches (Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen) show state via BOTH knob position (left=off, right=on) AND track color (grey=off, green=on); knob position is the non-color cue.
Every special-symbol effect on the 'BONUS TRIGGERED!' recap screen is paired with both its icon (shape) and explicit white caption text, readable without color perception.
MONEY-symbol values, RESPINS LEFT and TOTAL WIN during the feature are shown as plain numerals with text labels, not conveyed by color alone.

No audio-only information was observed on any captured screen; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are decorative and independently toggle-able in Settings. All game state (respins left, total win, bonus-triggered summary, big-win amount) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.

Large round click targets for SPIN, bet +/-, and menu icons. SPACE/ENTER are keyboard alternatives to clicking SPIN, and holding SPACE engages turbo spin. Autoplay (slider-selected spin count) reduces required manual actions. The bonus-buy confirmation uses two large, well-separated buttons (cancel left / confirm right).

The in-game rules/paytable booklet is a linear 8-page sequence navigated by previous/close/next controls with a consistent 'Page n/8' indicator, so position is always announceable; CREDIT/BET balance labels sit left-of-center and bet +/- flank the central SPIN button.

FIRE marks (orange/red cell glow, flame icon) versus ICE marks (cyan/blue cell glow, snowflake icon) are shown by color AND a distinct icon glyph, not color alone; the FIRE SCATTER (red/gold Eye of Horus) and ICE SCATTER (blue/gold Eye of Horus) share the same medallion shape and are told apart by color plus their fixed reel (1 vs 6).
Toggle switches (Ante Bet, Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen) use physical left/right switch position and an explicit text label in addition to red/green/white fill color.
The three paytable/rules navigation controls are shape-coded (left triangle / cross / right triangle) though all are rendered in the same green color.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and decorative. Bet, credit, win amounts, Feature Multiplier, remaining spins, and RTP/volatility/bet-limit figures are all conveyed as on-screen text/numbers.
Win amounts, CREDIT/BET, Feature Multiplier and remaining-spin counters are shown as large, high-contrast text (yellow-on-dark or gold-on-red digital readout), legible without color discrimination.

Large round click targets; the central SPIN button is the single largest target on screen. Keyboard SPACE/ENTER duplicate the spin action, holding SPACE triggers turbo. AUTOPLAY (captured up to a 100-spin run) reduces the number of repeated clicks needed.

Stable control layout: menu and sound icons stacked at the far left of the bottom bar, a larger 'i' info icon just to their right, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY beside/below SPIN. The info booklet is a strictly linear 8-page sequence with left/right triangle navigation, a single X to close, and a 'Page N/8' readout on every page.

Most state information is duplicated through text or icon shape rather than color alone: MONEY/collect values are printed numbers, Free Spins count is shown as duplicated text counters in two places, toggle switches use position plus an internal glyph, and the paytable win/no-win diagram uses check-mark/X shapes rather than color-only cues. Bonus buy confirm/cancel dialog distinguishes confirm vs cancel by both color (green/red) AND icon shape (checkmark vs X).

No information observed to be conveyed by audio alone; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles. All game state (spins left, win amounts, feature triggers, max-win cap) is conveyed through on-screen text.

Win amounts, free-spin counters and max-win/feature text are rendered as large gold or white text on dark backgrounds throughout (base game HUD, Free Spins trigger/end plaques, Freeze Time win counter). Primary UI icons (menu, info, sound, bet +/-, spin) are large white glyphs on dark circles rather than small color-only swatches.

Large circular touch targets for all primary controls; the SPIN button is the largest single target. SPACE/ENTER keys provide a keyboard-only spin path (holding SPACE engages turbo spin).
