Core actions (Spin, Bet Select, Autoplay, Bonus Buy, Push Bet toggle) are reachable via large circular buttons on the right-hand control bar or within the opened panels. Autoplay presets (Off/10/20/50/100/250/500/1000 rounds) reduce the number of repeated manual actions. The keyboard space bar also spins and skips animations ('Quick Play').

State changes are backed by text: the Push Bet toggle shows green/grey and also prints 'INCREASE chance to win feature by 42%'; WIN/BIG WIN/MEGA WIN/SUPER WIN banners always carry the fun amount as large numerals, not color alone; the Free Spins round is explicitly labelled 'INFINITE FREE SPINS' and shows a 'Free Spins: N' text counter. The four bottom-nav icons (paytable/rules/settings/info) keep a consistent position and switch between whole panels.
The three lowest-tier symbols (Pink Shell, Orange Scallop, Teal Mussel) share one identical payout table, so telling their colours apart carries no win-value consequence.

The green and purple fish-charm lures pay different amounts but are also told apart by shape (rounded charm-with-rope-coil vs striped-fish-with-hook) and by their printed currency numbers, not colour alone.
Fisherman (Wild) and Lighthouse pay identically and are told apart by silhouette (character portrait vs striped tower), not colour.
Push Bet ON/OFF is shown by toggle position AND toggle colour AND the printed bet number changing (e.g. 0.50 to 0.60 fun), never colour alone.
Base Game vs Free Spins Feature state is signalled by background colour (blue vs violet), distinct reel-frame artwork and on-screen text together, never colour alone.

Settings panel has independent mute toggles for All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music; all mechanics (Net nudging, Instant Prizes, Lock/Multiplier Meters) are shown visually and textually, nothing is audio-only.
Instant Prize and collector amounts are always printed as explicit currency numbers on the tile itself, never colour- or icon-only.
Autoplay is opened via a press-and-hold gesture rather than a simple click/tap; no alternative single-click path to the Autoplay panel was found. All other controls respond to a normal click/tap.

Lane risk is not conveyed by color alone: each lane shows a different fish shape/species (calm, rounded fish on early low-risk lanes vs spiky, sharp-toothed, warmer-colored fish on later high-multiplier lanes), reinforcing the risk cue independently of color.

The CASHOUT button's active state (gold/yellow fill, white amount and multiplier text) versus disabled state (dark charcoal fill, dim grey 'CASHOUT' text with no amount) is distinguished by both fill color and presence/absence of text, not color alone.
Settings toggle switches (Sound, Space-to-spin) show state by both color (green=on, dark grey=off) and knob position (right=on, left=off).
The Jackpot Shells pearl counter is printed as a numeric fraction (e.g. '23/60') next to the chest icon, not conveyed only by a fill bar or icon.

Autoplay can pre-configure a whole session without per-step input: cashout-step presets from 1 up to 15 and autospin counts from 10 up to 200. A settings toggle ('Space to spin & go', captured ON) lets the Space bar substitute for clicking GO/Play.

The bottom control bar keeps a stable left-to-right order across all in-round states (BALANCE, DIFFICULTY, CASHOUT, BET, GO/reload), and the Jackpot widget and free-bet progress bar occupy fixed positions, supporting predictable announcement order.
Ten payline markers on both sides of the grid are colored purple, orange, mint green, red, blue, white, magenta, light blue, yellow and green, and each also prints its number 1-10.
Red K and green Q are told apart by letter shape. Fish sit on deeper blue tiles and carry a cream price tag. The Scatter boat has the word SCATTER printed on it.
Free Games are announced by the status text Free Game N of 10 and by the sky changing from daylight blue to an orange-and-pink sunset, not by color alone.
All game status is also written as text in the ticker; a sound toggle (speaker icon) is in the menu.
Status ticker is yellow text on black and the bottom bar is white and yellow text on black. Winning cells get a bright frame plus an amount label above the first cell.
Rules overlay uses small thin white text with yellow headings over a dark translucent background, dense and hard to read.

Large round green SPIN button on the right, BET stepper with up and down arrows, stake picker with 17 large buttons, autoplay dialog with a start button. No hold-to-spin or quick-spin button confirmed.
Game is a canvas; status messages appear as ticker text and a bottom DOM strip prints the game name, clock and session result. No screen reader support was observed on frames.
Three tackle boxes are blue, red and green, but each carries its own icon (lure arrow, fisherman portraits, worms) and shows a text title when active: CAST AND CATCH, GOLDEN CATCH, TAKE THE BAIT
Jackpot plates are named in text (MEGA, MAJOR, MINOR, MINI); payline tags are numbered 1 to 10 as well as coloured
Express Bet uses a green tick and a red cross, which are also different shapes; fish prize amounts are printed as numbers on the fish
Bonus scatter boat comes in three flag colours (blue, red, green) but the boat shape is the same
Game state is given in on-screen text: PRESS TO SPIN, GOOD LUCK, GAMES n/10, TOTAL FEATURE PAID, BONUS COMPLETE
Menus use bright yellow text on dark blue panels; royals are large single glossy letters

Spin, autoplay, stake and menu are large round buttons; features start with a button prompted on screen; autoplay offers 10, 25, 50, 75 or 100 spins; spacebar may spin depending on operator configuration
Card symbols A, K, Q, J, 10 are yellow, red, green, blue and purple fish-themed letter shapes, also told apart by silhouette
Fish cells are marked by a darker blue cell and a beige price tag, not by colour alone; the scatter has the word SCATTER printed on it
Paytable rows are labelled with count digits and the words Of A Kind and Any, so no information is colour-only
Game messages are shown on screen; no information is carried only by sound (not verified, audio was muted)
Credit, total bet, paid amount, free game counter and ways banner are printed as yellow text on a black bar
In free games the sky turns sunset purple and orange and the water deepens to dark blue
Single large green spin button; autoplay with loss and single win limits; stake chosen in a modal of large buttons; free games start with one button press
All buttons are icon-only without text labels; a screen reader needs the canvas to expose names
Paylines are told apart by colour only in their number tabs, but each tab carries a number from 1 to 10, so colour is duplicated by a number.
Royals are distinguished by letter shape as well as colour: A golden yellow, K red, Q green, J blue, 10 purple.

Fish prizes are printed as numbers on cream tags, not only by colour; the Fisherman progress plaque goes from greyscale to full colour as fishermen are collected, a brightness and detail change rather than a hue change.
A sound toggle is in the menu; no outcome is announced by sound alone, every event has a banner or bar text.
Symbols are large with thick glossy dark outlines; the message bar, the win amount box and banners use large yellow or brown-gold text on dark or wooden backgrounds.
Large round single-click controls for spin, bet, autoplay and menu; autoplay offers loss and single-win limits; the Free Games intro and upgrade banners wait for a click instead of timing out.

Every key outcome is also on-screen text: bar messages (Place Your Bet, Good Luck, Game Over, Free Game x of N, BONUS COMPLETE), the PAID box, the win amount over the first winning symbol and the Feature Win banner.

FS choice risk bar graduates from bright green (WIN OFTEN, left) to orange-red (WIN BIG, right). Three redundant cues: text labels 'WIN OFTEN'/'WIN BIG', left/right directional arrows at each end, and the color gradient.
Winning payline cells are highlighted with red glowing rectangular frames. Frame shape and spin animation provide identification cues beyond color alone.
BONUS scatter is framed by a distinctive gold ornate border, visually separating it from regular-framed card-suit symbols and frameless equipment symbols (Mask, Flippers).
Settings toggles: ON = green oval with indicator to the right; OFF = gray oval with indicator to the left. Both color and position redundantly indicate toggle state.

FISH MONEY tokens display printed numeric dollar value as text on each fish. Value identification is text-based; color variants (blue-purple, orange, gold) give visual variety but are not the primary identification cue.

All game state (credit, bet, win, free spins count) is displayed as numeric text. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggled in settings; full gameplay is accessible with all audio disabled.
SPACE or ENTER starts/stops spin. HOLD SPACE activates turbo spin. Autoplay (up to 100 spins) with TURBO, QUICK SPIN, and SKIP SCREENS options reduces per-spin and per-feature interactions.

Credit, BET, WIN, and FREE SPINS LEFT values are rendered as numeric text labels. Icon-only controls (settings hamburger, speaker, info circle, spin button, +/- bet) require accessible label mappings for screen readers.
Fish payout tiers are identified by a printed multiplier-range text under each icon (e.g. 'x50-100'), not by colour alone; artwork also differs by shape/pattern per tier.
'BIG WIN' (green banner) vs 'MEGA WIN' (blue banner) win-size tiers are distinguished by the word itself as well as colour, so remain readable without colour discrimination.

Settings checkboxes ('Quick spin', 'Spacebar to spin', 'Music', 'Sound FX') show state via a white check mark inside a filled black square versus an empty square outline — shape-based, not colour-based.
Risk-level selector on the left uses a gold star-rating row under each bait icon (shape/count of filled stars), not a colour code, to indicate risk level.
Best Win (grey ribbon, gold '1st place' medal icon) and Best Catch (blue ribbon, gold fish-medal icon) cards are distinguished by icon shape and text label, not colour alone.

No audio-only information was observed; Music and Sound FX are decorative toggles in Settings and all outcomes (catch/no catch, win amount, bonus trigger, RTP, bet ladder) are conveyed through on-screen text/graphics.

Base game background: soft hazy morning lake, pale blue sky fading to white near the horizon, bright sun-glow, blue-grey misty hills, dark green pine forest at the edges, turquoise-blue water, tan sandy shoreline.

Alternate background (reached via background-switch arrows): warm orange-pink sunset sky, golden horizon glow, rust-orange and yellow autumn trees, purple-grey mountain silhouettes, small brown wooden cabin on the left shoreline.

Bonus-round background (tackle cabin, indoors): warm honey-brown wood-panel walls and floor, a hanging green rope landing-net, a tan wicker creel basket, pale wooden shelving with blue/red/green lure sets, a red-and-black TNT stick on a shelf, two dark rubber boots on the floor, bright windows showing the blue lake outside.

RISK selector: vertical blue ribbon/banner on the left edge with a lighter blue highlight border and white 'RISK' text; buy-bonus icon is bright yellow-orange in a rounded gold-bordered blue square, flashing orange/red right after a purchase.

Win text: 'BIG WIN' banner is green, 'MEGA WIN' banner is blue, both bold outlined 3D style; the FUN amount underneath is bright orange-yellow. Bottom UI bar is solid black with white/grey text and icons, no accent colour.

All primary actions are large circular/rounded buttons (spin/cast button, bonus-buy cart, bet step arrows). Spacebar can substitute for clicking to cast a line (toggle in Settings, ON by default), reducing required precision.

Autoplay supports round counts 10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/infinity plus configurable stop conditions (on any win, single win exceeds a set amount, balance increases/decreases by a set amount) and a Stop Autospins button, reducing the number of clicks needed for repeated play.

Control positions are stable across all base-game frames: info/settings icons bottom-left, bet field centre-left of the bottom bar, win readout centred, autospin/spin controls bottom-right, RISK level ribbon fixed to the left screen edge, buy-bonus cart icon fixed to the right edge on the boat.

The Payments (paytable) and Help (rules) info-panel sections are each a single continuous scroll with no page-N/M widget, reached via a 3-icon vertical rail inside the info modal: money-bag icon (Payments, opens by default), round-arrow/clock icon (round history), and '?' icon (Help/rules incl. RTP).

Sector categories (Regular White/Grey, Big Catch green, Huge Catch orange/amber, Mega Catch magenta/pink) are always paired with a printed text label and a distinct fish-icon silhouette shape, not color alone. Chip denominations are printed as numeral text on each chip face. Multiplier badges and most history-bar dots show the numeric multiplier as printed white text. Residual risk: the round-history dot grid distinguishes Big/Huge/Mega Catch results mainly by hue (green vs orange vs magenta) without a category letter/label on the small circle itself, though the same result is always shown with a full text label on the sector cards.

No game state is conveyed by audio only; bets, timer, results, balance and multipliers are all shown as on-screen text/numbers. Sound FX and Music are separately toggleable/adjustable (including full turn-off) in the Settings panel.

Placing a stake needs only two clicks (select chip, then click a sector card); the ALL BONUSES button stakes all three bonus categories (Big/Huge/Mega Catch) in a single click. No drag or slider interaction is required for betting; the only sliders in the game are Sound FX and Music volume in Settings.

Layout is stable across rounds: logo top-left, sound/settings icons top-right, Balance/Bet Amount bottom-left, the 5 sector-bet cards plus ALL BONUSES button at bottom-center, chip selector below that, menu and round-history grid at bottom-right. The countdown timer shows a numeric value (not just a filling ring), which should be exposed as text for remaining betting time.

Buy-feature panels share the same orange-red styling and are distinguished by text labels ('BUY FREE SPINS' vs 'BUY HOLD & SPIN' vs 'EXTRA CHANCE OF SCATTERS'), not colour alone. Confirm/cancel dialog buttons use a check-mark vs X shape, not colour alone. Toggle switches show state via knob position (left/right) as well as green-vs-dark track colour. Feature state also shifts background palette (blue base game / orange Hold & Spin / purple Free Spins) paired with explicit text ('FREE SPINS LEFT n', heart respin counter, 'WIN $n.nn').

Residual risk: the Free Spins retrigger-tracker tiles rely partly on a colour flip (greyscale to full colour, red highlight) for collected-WILD state, though this is paired with explicit '10 FREE SPINS xN' text on the milestone tiles.

No audio-only information was observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles. All game state (wins, spins left, respins left as hearts, retrigger multipliers, buy costs) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, bet +/-, menu, sound and info. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop a spin as a keyboard alternative to clicking. Autoplay (adjustable spin count plus a Skip Screens option) reduces the number of clicks needed for extended play.

Control positions are stable across all base-game screens: hamburger-menu, sound and info icons stacked at the far left; CREDIT/BET labels centre-left; bet +/- flank the large central SPIN button; AUTOPLAY sits directly beneath SPIN. The info booklet is a single linear 8-page sequence navigated with left/right triangle arrows and closed with a central X, consistent across every page.
Royal symbols A/K/Q/J/10 are colored (dark green/purple/red/blue/bright green) but always show a printed letter or number glyph as the primary identifier, readable without color vision
Hold & Spin respins remaining shown as a COUNT of heart icons, not a color distinction; toggle switches show on/off via knob left/right position, not color alone

Win tier is always paired with explicit text ('EPIC WIN!', 'SUPER WIN!', 'CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON HOLD & SPIN') alongside the orange-to-teal or orange-to-yellow-to-teal gradient text, so overlapping gradients need not be told apart by color alone

No information is conveyed by sound alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles. All game state (running totals, respins remaining, free spins count, win amounts) is shown as on-screen text/graphics

Key color words: base game sky is bright blue fading to an orange sunset at the bottom; Hold & Spin background is deep red/maroon; SCATTER is a red-and-gold dragon head; WILD is a portrait in a gold frame; MONEY symbol is a gold coin; DIAMOND MONEY is a white/blue diamond; decorations are pink cherry-blossom clusters

Large round click targets; central SPIN button is the biggest target. SPACE/ENTER keys start and stop a spin without the mouse; holding SPACE performs a turbo spin. AUTOPLAY (adjustable spin count, optional SKIP SCREENS) reduces required manual actions

Win amounts, CREDIT/BET, MEGAWAYS count, coin values all shown as text. Confirm/cancel buttons use X and checkmark icons (shape redundant with color). Settings toggles use knob position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey/green color.

BUY FREE SPINS and BUY HOLD & SPIN buttons are both purple-blue; differentiated only by text label and price ($200 vs $240). Buy dialogs differ by background color (purple-blue vs orange/amber) which may be indistinguishable to some; title text and price always unambiguous.
Royal symbols differentiated by color (A=red-orange, K=purple, Q=teal, J=blue, 10=dark teal) and by letter/number label on each symbol. Paytable lists all in consistent left-to-right order.

All game events accompanied by full-screen or large-text visual changes: feature triggers show overlay text, win screens show CONGRATULATIONS with amount. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggleable independently. No game-critical info conveyed solely through audio.

MEGAWAYS counter in large yellow-gold digits on dark banner (high contrast). CREDIT/BET in cyan labels with gold values on dark bar. Win announcements as full-screen large gold text on orange-red background. Coin values shown as dollar text on coin face.

SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts start/stop spin. Large circular spin button, tall rectangular buy buttons, full-width START AUTOPLAY button. Autoplay supports up to 100 spins. SKIP SCREENS reduces required interactions during features.

All key numeric info (CREDIT, BET, MEGAWAYS, spin count, win amounts) displayed as labeled text. Rules booklet (9 pages) fully text-based and machine-readable. Win screens include feature identifier text ('IN HOLD & SPIN BONUS').

Locked vs unlocked reel rows are shown by opacity/transparency plus padlock icons, not color alone; toggle switches use handle position (left=off/right=on); feature-state changes (free spins/hold & spin) pair a background palette shift with explicit on-screen text; Hold & Spin respins remaining use a heart-icon count rather than color.

Symbol colors described in words: dragon mascot body orange/red-brown with cream highlight dots, belly plates and horn fins teal/turquoise, mane golden yellow; letter glyphs A=dark green, K=purple/violet, J=blue, 10=bright green; WILD=red fan with gold lettering; SCATTER=gold medallion; DIAMOND MONEY=white/silver-grey gem.

No audio-only information observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are decorative/toggleable in settings, and all game state (wins, free spins/respins remaining, retriggers, feature announcements) is conveyed through on-screen text and iconography.

Win amounts, free-spins-remaining and respins-remaining counters are shown as large high-contrast gold text on dark or red plaques (e.g. 'FREE SPINS LEFT 9', 'X20 WIN GUARANTEED'), legible without color discrimination.

Large circular click targets for spin, bet +/-, and menu icons; SPACE/ENTER keys start/stop spins (holding SPACE also enables turbo); Autoplay offers adjustable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option to reduce required interactions.

Stable control positions (hamburger menu + info icon bottom-left, bet controls and spin centered-right, autoplay adjacent to spin); the rules/paytable booklet is a fixed linear 9-page sequence with a 'Page n/9' indicator on every page for progress announcement.

All 10 paying symbols differ by shape, not color alone (tree, bowl, lantern, envelope, coins cluster, letters A/K/Q/J/10). Lady WILD (woman) vs Horse WILD (horse silhouette) identifiable by subject. Lady Meter (red, above reels) vs Horse Meter (purple, below reels) also position-coded. Buy FS ($200, red scroll) vs Buy Super FS ($600, purple scroll) price text alone differentiates. Volatility: count of 5 filled bolt icons.

Ambient Music and Sound FX independently togglable in Settings. Win amount displayed as large on-screen text. Free Spins trigger shows text overlay CONGRATULATIONS with spin count. Folding Fans, Paper Lanterns, and Firecrackers features animated visually; no audio-only cues confirmed.

Credit and Bet values displayed in distinct cyan-blue text on dark background for contrast. Paytable payouts legible at full screen size. Low-value symbol payouts (minimum 0.2x at demo bet = $0.40) may be challenging to read at reduced display sizes.

Autoplay available up to 100 spins with Stop-on-Win options. Turbo Spin and Quick Spin toggles available. SPACE or ENTER key triggers spin; hold SPACE for Turbo Spin. Bet adjusted via minus and plus buttons on bottom bar or in Settings panel.

Credit, Bet, and Win values displayed as readable text overlays on screen. Paytable payouts listed as dollar amounts in 7-page scrollable info panel. Game is canvas-based; symbol positions on reels change each spin and cannot be pre-announced programmatically.

WILD, SCATTER, MONEY and the pre-round modifier icons are identified by distinct shapes/text labels, not color alone; card symbols A/K/Q/J/10 are colored (green/purple/red/blue/green) but each also shows a printed letter/number glyph as the non-color cue.

Active vs inactive free-spins modifier icons are shown full-color vs greyscale but the active one also carries an explicit text label (e.g. '+2 FREE SPINS'); Buy Free Spins confirm/cancel buttons use checkmark vs X shape in addition to green/red color; Settings toggle state is shown by switch-handle left/right position as well as green/grey track color.

No audio-only information observed; Ambient Music and Sound FX are independently togglable and purely decorative; all game state (wins, free spins remaining, modifier selection, retrigger multiplier, final win) is conveyed redundantly through on-screen text and numbers.

Large round click targets throughout; SPIN is the largest clickable element; SPACE/ENTER also start/stop spins and holding SPACE engages turbo spin; AUTOPLAY (configurable spin count plus Skip Screens option) reduces required clicks for extended play.

Controls have stable positions: menu/sound/info icons clustered bottom-left, CREDIT/BET readouts center-left, SPIN as the largest central control flanked by bet +/-, AUTOPLAY directly beneath; the 8-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigated with previous/close/next controls on every page.

Every paying symbol has its own outline shape (crescent moon, five-point star, round balloon, heart, and letter glyphs S/W) in addition to color, so symbols can be identified by shape alone; on/off toggle switches also show state by knob position (left/right), not color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone -- ambient music and sound effects are decorative and can be toggled off independently; all game state (bet, balance, win amounts, spins remaining, feature triggers) is shown as on-screen text and graphics.

BET, BET LEVEL, COIN and BALANCE fields use bright yellow/gold text on dark red pill fields for high contrast; control buttons are white icon glyphs on uniform teal circles rather than relying on subtle color differences.

All primary actions use large circular click targets (SPIN is the largest); the space bar also starts and stops spins, giving a keyboard-only path to the core loop; Autoplay with configurable stop conditions reduces the number of required interactions for extended play.

The game canvas has no accessible DOM/ARIA layer (confirmed empty); every button and field must be identified by fixed pixel position and icon shape. The in-game Help screen is the exception -- ordinary readable HTML text.
Royal symbols use dual coding: distinct letter shape AND distinct color (A=pink, K=gold, Q=green, J=light-blue, 10=purple). Reduces colorblind ambiguity between low-pay symbols.

High/mid symbols identifiable by silhouette independent of color: bottle, fish skeleton, yarn ball, toy mouse each have unique shape. WILD is cat portrait in medallion; SCATTER is paw print with 'SCATTER' text label.
DOUBLE CHANCE toggle uses green=ON and grey=OFF, but arrow direction and position also differ, providing non-color differentiation for red-green colorblind users.
Buy dialog confirm/cancel buttons use checkmark vs X symbol on yarn balls (green checkmark=confirm, red X=cancel). Symbol shape provides non-color cue.
All rules, payouts, and feature descriptions available in 7-page text info panel. Win amounts displayed as text in bottom bar ('WIN $X.XX'). No critical information is audio-only.
Free Spins spin counter displayed as large orange numeral top-center of reel frame. Win amount shown as text in bottom bar. Background shifts from dark blue to pink/rose to indicate Free Spins mode.

SPACE bar hold activates Turbo Spin (confirmed from in-game UI text). Autoplay supports up to 100 auto-spins. SKIP SCREENS option reduces required interaction during feature transitions. BUY buttons are large fixed targets in top bar.
All game content rendered on HTML5 canvas. No semantic DOM elements available for screen readers. Accessibility fully dependent on visual rendering.

Win vs loss outcome is never color-only: the busting tile shows a distinct photographic image (referee holding a red card) versus the safe tile's football image, and the corresponding ladder step is additionally bordered green (win) or red (loss) on top of the differing artwork.
The current multiplier step on the ladder is marked by bold/highlighted text and its fixed left-to-right position (advances one cell per successful pick), not by color alone.
Bet vs Cash-out state of the main action button is distinguished by BOTH color (gold vs green) AND the printed label text ('BET' vs 'CASHOUT <amount> FUN').

All panel text is high-contrast white/light-grey on dark green/near-black backgrounds; the Footballs/Mine Risk/Opened counters, Game Limits figures and ladder values are always printed as text, not conveyed only by icon or bar length.

The interface is confirmed DOM-based (zero-canvas). Settings documents two hotkeys: Space = Bet / Cash out / Stop auto, and R = Random pick tile, the latter offering a low-precision way to reveal a tile without targeting one of the 25 small grid cells with a pointer.
The interface is DOM-based rather than canvas, so button labels and the live counters/ladder values are exposed as text nodes rather than baked into a single rendered image.

RISK LEVEL is shown by the COUNT of lit flame icons (1/2/3 of 3), not by hue — unlit flames use the identical silhouette in a darker navy fill, lit flames are white, so the tier is readable from shape/brightness alone.
Every multiplier bin prints its value as white numeric text on top of the colored gradient chip, so the pink-to-teal bin color gradient is never the only way to read a bin's value.

The three paid features (Multipliers, Respin Chance, Multiplier Ball Chance) are each identified by a distinct icon shape (X+, zigzag arrow, flame+plus) used consistently across the splash carousel, the BUY FEATURES button and its dialog, not by color.
Win/loss outcome is conveyed by explicit signed text ('WIN N.NN FUN' banner, or a negative Profit figure in the round-history table), not by a color-only cue.

No information is conveyed by audio alone. Sound FX and Music volumes are independently adjustable and mutable in the settings panel, and every round outcome (win/loss, payout, profit, balance) is shown as on-screen text/numbers.

Primary adjustments (RISK LEVEL, LINES, BALLS AMOUNT, BET AMOUNT, AUTO) are small left/right stepper arrows rather than large single-tap controls; only the central PLAY button is large. The AUTO stepper reduces the number of manual PLAY clicks needed for repeated rounds.

Control layout is fixed and predictable: RISK LEVEL/LINES steppers top-right of the pitch, BUY FEATURES/PLAY/BET AMOUNT/BALLS AMOUNT/AUTO steppers bottom-center, Balance/Bet Amount readout fixed to the bottom bar. The rules/help content is one linear scrollable document with clearly headed sections (About the game, How to play, Features, Results, Return to Player, RNG, Additional information) reachable from a single top-right hamburger icon.
Each target ring prints its multiplier as text and is placed at a fixed radius, so ring value never depends on telling the burnt-orange, pale tan and charcoal-grey bands apart by hue.
Sound and music are separate toggles in the burger menu, and every outcome is printed on screen, so no result is carried by audio alone.

The round result is shown twice - as floating '+N $' marks over the target and as a per-ring list in the LAST WINS panel with a TOTAL WIN line - so the outcome can be read without following the animation.
Nothing is time-critical: the shot is a single press with no aiming, and holding the button is an alternative to tapping rather than a separate skill.
The control bar is real DOM with named elements, but the target and the arrows are drawn on canvas, so hits are not exposed as text.

Six picture symbols sit in colour-coded square frames: gold, red, purple, blue, green and cyan. The frame colours may be hard to tell apart, but every symbol also has its own unique picture and royals carry a letter, so identity never depends on colour alone.
Toggle state in settings is shown by knob position (left or right) as well as green versus grey track; active ante bet is marked by the text ANTE BET ACTIVE.
Every event has an on-screen banner (free spins intro, last free spin, total settlement, win-level banners). Sound can be turned off by the sound button and the AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles.

Reel tiles are dark and the illustration is low-contrast in the dark red scene; multiplier tags on top and bottom rows are small white numbers. Accent colours: crimson red, hot magenta pink, gold, violet purple, ice blue, emerald green.
Text colours: white for main labels; gold or yellow-orange for CREDIT, BET and WIN captions; bright yellow for the free-spins-left digit; red for settlement multiplier digits.

Autoplay with a slider up to 100 spins, Skip Screens option, SPACE and ENTER start and stop the spin, turbo and quick spin options and BATTERY SAVER reduce animation time. Spin, plus and minus buttons are large targets.
Neon glow around the frame, glitching text on the FOREVER SPLIT! banner, fast cascades and a zooming magic circle on free-spins banners; no photosensitivity warning on the frames.
All key values are printed as text: CREDIT, BET, WIN, FREE SPINS LEFT and SETTLEMENT MULTIPLIER. Ways counter is printed in gold above the top row.

SPIN/STOP button changes SHAPE (circular arrows vs. a red-outlined square) not just color; toggle switches (Ante, settings) show ON/OFF as TEXT plus handle POSITION (left/right), independent of handle color.

The 9 paying symbols are each a visually distinct shape (medallion, helmet, chalice, ring, triangle, two differently-colored squares, pentagon, diamond) in addition to color, so a match is identifiable by shape alone.
The 4 Buy Free Spins price tiers use green/magenta/blue/red plaque backgrounds, but each is also labelled with explicit price and level-number text, so the tier is not color-dependent.

No audio-only information observed. SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are decorative and independently toggleable; all game state (win amounts, free-spins count, current level, multiplier values, tumble progress) is conveyed via on-screen text/numerals.

Key numeric/text elements are large and high-contrast: the max-win banner and wordmark (yellow/gold on dark warm sky), and the Free Spins award count (large gold text on a teal banner), all legible without fine visual acuity.

Large round click targets; the central SPIN/STOP button is the largest control on screen. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin (keyboard-operable), and holding SPACE engages turbo spin. Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option, reducing required interactions for extended play.

Stable, predictable control layout: hamburger-menu and sound icons stacked bottom-left, 'i' info button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the large central SPIN/STOP button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. The rules/info booklet is a strictly linear 8-page sequence navigated with left/right triangle icons and closed with a center X.

Low symbols are distinguished by shape (spade, heart, club, diamond), not only colour; premium and mid symbols are distinct objects. Colours: dwarf with orange-red beard on purple, golden helmet with red plume, steel grey-blue anvil and hammer, red-pink, magenta, blue and green inner glows on the suit tiles.

Winning clusters are marked by an orange-yellow glow, a paler silver tone on the symbols and a printed WIN amount. Active multiplier slots have a bright orange outline and lit x2, inactive ones are dim grey, so brightness and outline carry the state.
No sound-only information was observed; every outcome is printed on screen. A Sound toggle exists in the menu row.
Orange digits on dark brown and charcoal capsules are high contrast; grey hint text on dark charcoal panels is lower contrast. In free spins the backdrop turns saturated red-orange flame.
Spin by tap or Space key, hold Space repeats spins; autoplay 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000; Turbo Spin toggle; Max Bet in one tap.
Paytable and rules are real text in the page; balance and bet are on-canvas digits. No text-to-speech notes were found.
Royal letters A (red/orange), K (purple), Q (green), J (blue) are differentiated primarily by letter shape, not hue alone.
SCATTER (blue war-hammer) and WILD (magenta ring) are distinguished by printed text ('SCATTER'/'WILD') and shape, not color alone.
A forged WILD's growing multiplier is shown as printed text ('WILD X5') beneath the symbol, not conveyed by color alone.
Settings toggle switches (Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen) show state via knob position (left=off, right=on) plus an icon, not color alone.

No audio-only information was observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles, and all game state (win amounts, pool count, multipliers, round totals) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.
CREDIT and BET labels are gold text on a dark bar, high contrast; primary controls (spin, bet +/-, autoplay) are large white glyph-on-dark-circle icons.
SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spins; holding SPACE engages turbo spin, reducing required clicks; Autoplay with configurable spin count further reduces interactions.
The info booklet is a strict linear 7-page sequence navigated with left/right triangle arrows and closed with a center X; each page carries a 'Page N/7' text indicator usable as an anchor.
Book Wild/Scatter symbol identified by shape (closed leather diary, gold clasp) and on-screen text, not color alone.
Winning payline traced by a distinct glowing gold wavy line shape, not just a color highlight; win amounts always printed as numbers.
The 10 payline diagrams use blue-highlighted cells against grey unhighlighted cells, but each diagram is also uniquely shaped and labeled with its line number in text.
Free Spins state is signaled by both a background/scene change (fence to wooden cabinet interior) and explicit 'BONUS ACTIVE' / 'Free spins: N/10' text, not by color alone.
Checkbox/toggle state (Settings, Autoplay) is shown by a white checkmark glyph inside the box, not by fill color alone.

All outcomes (spin wins, feature triggers, RTP, bet/price values) are presented as on-screen text; music and sound FX are adjustable/toggleable and are decorative, not carrying unique gameplay information otherwise unshown visually.
Overall palette is dark and low-contrast: weathered grey-brown wooden fence background with only a faint teal/cyan glow visible behind the pickets in the dark sky gap.

Paytable/rules booklet is a near-black charcoal-grey panel with white/light-grey body text; Buy Bonus and Double Chance buttons are distinguished from each other only by text label and stacked position (top vs bottom), both using the same red brush-stroke banner color.

Spacebar-to-spin is enabled by default; Spin/Buy Bonus/Double Chance are large clickable regions; autoplay with configurable stop conditions (on win, on bonus, win/balance thresholds) reduces the number of required pointer clicks.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across base game and free spins: info(i)+settings(gear) far-left, balance/bet-total center-left, spin/autoplay right, autospin-settings(A) far-right. Paytable/rules is one continuous scroll document split into Payments and Help sections, selectable via 3 icons on the panel's left edge.

Blue square gem and Purple hexagonal gem pay identically (3:0.10 / 4:0.30 / 5:0.50 / 6:1.00 of total bet) and are distinguished mainly by colour (blue vs violet/purple) with a secondary cut-shape difference (square-cut vs faceted hexagon); colourblind players relying on colour alone risk confusing these two symbols.

Fortuna SpinUp active/inactive state is signalled by more than colour: side-panel plaque swaps from purple to solid gold/tan, the '+' price prefix disappears, the SPIN button glyph changes from white circular arrows to a gold button with a white star, and the Total bet field value itself changes.

Coin Respin bonus-active state is signalled by a full background palette swap (daytime purple sky to a night-blue starfield) plus explicit on-screen text ('BONUS ACTIVE', 'Respins', 'CELLS'), not colour alone. The Bet Ways win/no-win diagram uses a green checkmark vs a red X glyph pair (shape-differentiated).

No information is conveyed by audio alone. The Settings panel exposes independent Music and Sound FX toggles plus a Volume slider; win amounts, feature triggers and jackpot progress are all shown as on-screen text/numerals.

The 6-reel grid changes height every spin (each reel independently shows 2 to 8 symbols; ways recalculated and printed on-screen each spin, e.g. 5040, 384, 288, 360) — the layout and total symbol count are not fixed from spin to spin.

Large round touch targets for SPIN and the purchase buttons; bet size and SpinUp/Coin-Respin prices use simple +/- steppers; autoplay offers preset round counts including an unlimited infinity option to reduce click count; Spacebar can be used to spin instead of clicking.

Control positions are stable across screens: info ('i') and settings icons at the far bottom-left, Balance/Total bet fields centre-left, autoplay ('A') and SPIN at the far bottom-right, Buy Bonus / Fortuna SpinUp purchase plaques stacked on the far left edge. The paytable/rules overlay is one continuous scroll panel reached via the 'i' button, with three tab icons (Payments / History / Help) on its left edge and a close 'X' top-right.

Wild and Scatter are identified by baked-in text labels plus distinct shapes (bells vs faceted sphere), not color alone; Free Spins state is signalled by a background palette shift AND explicit text counters, not color alone.

Weak spots: the paytable's 10 payline diagrams use a magenta-vs-grey cell highlight backed only by a text line-number, with no per-cell shape/border redundancy; the Gamble round's Red/Black color choice is inherently color-based, softened only by the 'Red'/'Black' text label on each button.

No audio-only information was found on any captured frame; wins, feature counters and gamble outcomes are all conveyed through on-screen numeric/text readouts. Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative.

Spin can be triggered via spacebar instead of clicking, reducing the need for precise clicking; Autoplay presets run from 10 up to Infinity to reduce repeat actions; the bet stepper uses small up/down triangle arrows, a comparatively small motor target.

Control positions are stable across base game, free spins and gamble states: info(i)+gear bottom-left, bet stepper center-left, spin/autoplay bottom-right (autoplay hidden during Free Spins); Payments/Rules content is a single linear scroll per document, not paged.

Prize Pot tiers (GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR/MINI) are always shown as text labels, not by colour alone. The doubling/tripling effect on the dog symbols is shown as an extra overlapping copy of the artwork, a shape cue rather than a colour change. Toggle switches use thumb position as well as colour. Wild (white noodle box), Scatter (gold paw) and Bonus (dark-red bowl) sit on similarly deep-red tiles but are distinguished by icon shape.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; every outcome (spin result, feature trigger, win total, retrigger) is shown as on-screen text and numbers. Ambient and Effects sound toggles are independent and optional.

Large circular touch targets for Spin, Bet Max and Autoplay. Space bar both starts and stops a spin. Autoplay supports configurable stop conditions (balance decreases by an amount, a single win exceeds an amount, Free Games is triggered) for long unattended sessions.

Bottom-bar controls hold stable left-to-right positions across all game screens (info, bet stepper, coin menu, spin, repeat, coin stepper, balance). The 11-page paytable/rules booklet is a fixed linear sequence with only previous/next/home controls, suited to sequential traversal. The separate Help overlay is real HTML text with clear section headers, unlike the canvas-drawn game field.
Symbols are told apart by silhouette (ingot, envelope, lantern, cylinder, knot, coins); the Wild also carries the written word Wild. No mechanic depends on hue alone.
A winning line is shown by a pink line drawn through the symbols, dimming of the other symbols, the line-number marker on the side rail turning bright yellow, the WIN figure and the TOTAL WIN banner.
Multiplier values are printed as text (x2, x5, x10); in the feature row each has a different outline colour (blue x2, green x5, pink-red x10), so the number carries the meaning and colour is extra.

Selected Auto Spin count has a lighter gold fill and yellow digits against grey unselected pills. Red and green are close neighbours on the dragon and the ingot band, but nothing depends on telling them apart.
Symbol payout numbers are printed in yellow text directly below each symbol picture in the paytable.
Big wins and the feature are announced by full-screen banners with large text (Big Win, Total Win, Fortune Spin counter), readable without sound; Sound can be switched off in the player menu.
Line-number markers on the pale lilac side rails are pale lilac on lilac and hard to read until they light up yellow.
Grey bullet text on the dark charcoal panels of Paytable and Rules is mid-grey on charcoal, lower contrast than the white headings.
The scrolling ticker strip uses cyan text on dark blue and is partly cut at both ends.

Large round spin button; Space key spins, hold Space repeats spins; Turbo Spin toggle; tapping the game area stops the reels. Bet Size column needed scrolling, and the mouse wheel did not move it in capture, while clicking a neighbouring row worked.

Control buttons are distinguished by distinct pictograms (lightning bolt, minus, horse head, plus, play-loop), not by color. Win amounts and remaining-spin counts are always printed as numerals rather than conveyed by a color-only meter. Selected-state contrast (Auto Spin preset, Bet Options scroll row) relies partly on brightness, which is generally colorblind-safe but was not tested against a simulator.

Payline identity is conveyed by printed numerals in the left and right margins of the reel frame and, on a win, by a numbered gold marker at each end of the lit-up line, rather than by line color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone. A dedicated Sound on/off toggle exists, and win/feature-state information (win amounts, remaining bonus spins, 'LAST BONUS SPIN', retrigger banners) is always shown as on-screen text/graphics as well.

Large circular touch targets throughout, with the Spin button the largest element in the control row. Auto Spin (5 presets up to 1000 spins) and holding the Space key for continuous spinning both reduce the number of individual actions required. Turbo Spin shortens each individual spin's duration.

Control positions are stable across states: profile/menu icon at the far left of the balance row, Bet Options opened via the dollar icon at the far right, Spin always the large central button with Minus/Plus flanking it and Turbo/Autoplay at the outer ends. Paytable and Rules are linear paginated sequences with a consistent bottom navigation row (Sound/Paytable/Rules/History/Quit) and a top-left back-chevron.

Symbols differ by shape and silhouette (mouse, swirl medallion, envelopes, pouch, firecrackers, orange, peanuts), not by colour alone; the Wild is also marked by the mouse face and the word WILD on a red-and-gold ribbon.

Wins are shown by an orange glow on winning symbols and dimming of the others, plus a text WIN amount; line ends carry numbered round badges 1 to 5; the turbo state is shown by a strike-through on the lightning icon, not by colour.
All information is visual text; the feature start is announced by banner text 'Fortune Mouse Feature!' and 'Respin Until Win'. Sound can be toggled in the player menu.
Palette is warm gold and lucky red with teal green on the roof and Wild tile and orange accents; panels are dark charcoal with yellow numbers and yellow primary buttons, which gives high contrast.
Space key starts a spin, holding it repeats spins, pressing during a spin skips the animation; autoplay offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; Max Bet is one tap.
Win total, balance and bet are printed as text in the banner and footer; no text-to-speech support was observed.

Most game-state info is duplicated in text or icon shape: base vs free spins is signalled by a background palette shift AND explicit text/counters; toggle switches use handle position plus word labels (ON/OFF); checkboxes use an explicit checkmark glyph, not color alone.

Residual risk in the BORDERS FEATURE: the silver-bordered vs gold-bordered symbol distinction relies primarily on a metallic hue difference (light grey vs yellow/gold outline) with no additional shape/text cue on the reel tile itself.
Free spins remaining count and the active multiplier are both printed as numbers/text (e.g. 'FREE SPINS LEFT 9', 'x4'), not conveyed by color alone.
Ante Bet toggle state is labeled with the words ON/OFF plus a checkmark glyph next to the switch, not conveyed by color alone.

Paytable symbol tiles each have a distinct background color (red, blue, green, brown, purple) that is purely decorative; symbol identity is conveyed by the pictorial icon or printed letter/number, not by tile color.

No audio-only information was observed; SOUND, VIBRATION and BATTERY SAVER are independently toggleable in System Settings, and all outcomes (wins, free-spins count, multiplier, trigger, round completion) are conveyed through on-screen text and numbers, not sound alone.

Base game uses a cool sky-blue/turquoise stone-temple background with gold-framed UI plaques and gold-yellow CREDIT/BET text; Free Spins shifts to a warm red/maroon torch-lit corridor with orange flame torches, same layout. Win/trigger banners use bold gold or white text on red, blue, or dark plaques for contrast; rules/paytable body text is white on a black overlay panel (high contrast).

All primary actions use large circular touch targets (SPIN, bet +/-, bottom-bar icons). Autoplay (up to a preset count, e.g. 100 spins) and Quick Spin/Turbo Spin options reduce the number of repeated manual actions needed. No keyboard-shortcut text (e.g. SPACE/ENTER to spin) was found in the captured rules pages for this title.

Control positions are stable across all base-game frames: the 'i' info button is the leftmost of 5 bottom-bar icons, SPIN is the large central circular control flanked by bet -/+, and the settings hamburger is the rightmost bottom-bar icon. Rules/paytable content is a single linear scrollable sheet (drag up/down), friendly to sequential screen-reader traversal.

Scene is Ancient Egypt at sunset: warm purple-to-orange sky above gold pyramid/city silhouettes, thick gold/bronze stone frame with a red-blue-gold striped winged banner, dark navy-blue reel cells with faint grey hieroglyph texture. The Free Spins Round swaps the reel background to dark violet/purple, reinforced by on-screen 'FREE SPINS LEFT n' text (not color alone).

Symbol colors: gold pharaoh mask with blue-gold headdress; blue-gold falcon-god Horus on a green card; purple jackal-god Anubis with a magenta collar on a purple card; blue/violet feline-goddess bust on a teal card; green snake bracelet with red gem eyes; gold ankh inlaid with red/blue/green enamel; card royals A (green), K (blue), Q (magenta), J (teal), 10 (gold/orange).

WILD and BONUS are never confused by color alone: WILD is a red/orange fireball orb inside a gold sun-disc bearing an explicit '2X' or '3X' numeric badge; BONUS is a blue pyramid-and-full-moon pictogram with a text banner reading 'BONUS'.

No information is conveyed exclusively through audio. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable, decorative audio layers. All game state (bet, credit, win amounts, free spins remaining, multiplier values) is presented as on-screen text/numerals.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop the spin without the mouse; all primary controls are large circular click targets, SPIN being the largest. Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count and a Skip Screens option, reducing manual actions for extended sessions.

The title banner above the reels cycles through three different messages in the same screen region: the 'FORTUNE OF GIZA' wordmark, 'WIN UP TO 6,750 X BET', and 'WILD MULTIPLIERS ON REELS 2, 3 AND 4' — one area conveys three separate pieces of information in rotation, not simultaneously; during the Free Spins Round this region is static (wordmark only).

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across all base-game/feature screens: menu+sound icons far-left, a separate 'i' info button just right of them, CREDIT/BET labels left-of-center, bet +/- around the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY button beneath SPIN. The info/rules booklet is a strictly linear 6-page sequence navigated by left-triangle/X-close/right-triangle icons with an explicit 'Page n/6' counter.

Symbols are distinguished by shape, not hue: lightning bolt, ring, helmet, goblet, square ruby, shield-cut amethyst, teardrop emerald, Zeus-face scatter portrait; MULTIPLIER value is always printed as numeric text on the tile.
Toggle switches in System Settings show state via handle position (left = off, right = on) in addition to fill color (grey = off, green = on).

Residual risk: the four Special Bets tiles (Ante Bet 1/2, Super Spin 1/2) are all within the red/orange family, but each carries a distinct text label, printed price and fixed left-to-right position; win-tier banners reuse red/green/orange across different meanings but are also labelled by text (NICE!/SENSATIONAL!).

Base game background is warm rose-pink marble with dark navy-blue near-black reel cells; Free Spins background shifts to warm gold/amber; Super Free Spins background becomes fiery orange/red with ember particles. Feature state is also confirmed by on-screen text ('FREE SPINS LEFT', 'TOTAL MULTIPLIER'), not color alone.

No audio-only information observed; music and sound effects are decorative and independently toggleable (AMBIENT MUSIC, SOUND FX in System Settings). All game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, total multiplier, special-bet status) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers, not sound alone.

Win amounts, free-spins-left and total-multiplier counters are shown as large high-contrast white/gold digits on dark plaques; MULTIPLIER tile values are always printed numeric text with an 'x' suffix, legible without color discrimination.

Large circular touch targets for the main actions, spin button is the largest. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop the spin. Autoplay with an adjustable spin count and a Skip Screens option reduce required clicks for extended play.

Control layout is stable across the session: menu/sound/info icons bottom-left, CREDIT/BET labels center-left-bottom, bet -/spin/+/autoplay bottom-right; Buy Feature and Special Bets buttons fixed top-left of the reels; paytable/rules booklet is a strictly linear 8-page sequence with a consistent 'Page N/8' indicator.
Winning lines are shown by dimming non-winning symbols and circling the line number in gold-red, so position and dimming carry the meaning, not colour alone.
Each symbol has its own silhouette: bull with the word WILD, ingot stack, box of coins, round bag, fanned envelopes, plate of fruit, cylinders. Wild is the only symbol with printed text.
Paytable line diagrams use yellow cells on a grey grid and differ in shape; the paytable values are golden-yellow numbers on dark grey.
Win ribbon is green for a 0.09 win and purple for 0.27 and 3.60 in the captured frames, but the amount is always written in digits.

No information is conveyed by sound alone on the captured frames: wins show as ribbon text and number, the feature as the text banner FORTUNE OX FEATURE! and the header RESPIN UNTIL WIN. Sound can be switched off in the player menu.
Menus and panels use white titles and pale grey body text on dark charcoal grey-blue, with golden-yellow highlights for the active item, numbers and Confirm and Start buttons.
Line numbers beside the reels are pink-red italic digits on dark crimson cloud-pattern sides; the circled winning line number turns gold-red.
Reels sit in a red temple gate with a green-tile roof; the outer reels stand on cream scroll panels and the middle reel on a cream strip.
Reels have different heights: the outer reels show 3 symbols each, the middle reel shows 4, and the outer cells sit about half a row lower than the middle reel cells.
Controls are large round buttons at the bottom of the screen, about 80 px. On PC the Space key starts a spin, holding it repeats spins, and pressing it mid-spin skips the animation.
Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 and 1000 spins; Turbo Spin shortens reel animation.
Feature and wins use glowing light effects, fireworks, confetti and a blurred spinning reel with a strong golden flare; no photosensitivity warning is printed on the captured frames.
The game is a canvas with a DOM overlay for panels only. Reel contents are not exposed as text; win amount and balance are printed as numbers in the info bar (not verified for readers).
Wins are signalled by the WIN text and amount, glowing winning cells against dimmed others, and lit line numbers, not by color alone.
Wild is identified by the word WILD on a gold-red banner with a blue glow and by the rabbit figure, not only by color.
On the Auto Spin panel the selected option (orange text on a brown fill) differs from the others (grey) mainly by color; the numbers 10, 30, 50, 80, 1000 are always printed.
Prize plaques carry their value as printed digits; digit color (dark red or brown for small values, red-orange, magenta-pink, purple for large) is only a secondary cue.
No audio-only cue is required: wins, feature progress and the last-spin notice appear as text and graphics. A Sound toggle is in the menu.
Panels (Paytable, Rules, Bet Options, Auto Spin) use white headings and grey body text on dark charcoal grey, with light orange for active labels and values.
Balance, bet, WIN and prize amounts use large decorative cream or gold digits on dark maroon and red backgrounds; the spin button is a large emerald-green round button with a cream-gold ring.

Large round buttons; Space starts a spin, holding Space repeats spins and pressing it during a spin skips the animation; Auto Spin offers 10 to 1000 spins; Turbo Spin shortens reel spins; no timed inputs.

Amounts and state changes are printed as text: WIN, TOTAL WIN, the FORTUNE SPIN counter, LAST FORTUNE SPIN, BIG WIN and MEGA WIN. The decorative digits on the playfield are not machine-readable; only the Paytable, Rules and History panels are DOM text.

The two packet outcomes are told apart by shape/icon, not color: a round gold coin means win, a pair of red firecrackers means loss, both shown on similarly dark tiles. The player's own pick is marked with a light-purple highlight BORDER (position/outline), and a round-ending losing pick turns solid black (a shape/luminance change) instead of showing the normal firecracker artwork. The one color-only cue is the active row's gold glow outline versus the darker/desaturated locked rows above it, which is reinforced by the active row also being the only clickable one and the only row still showing question-mark icons.

Every state change (step count, cashout value, win/loss result, balance) is conveyed as on-screen text/numbers; audio is limited to adjustable Music and Sound FX toggles in the settings dialog, implying sound is decorative rather than carrying unique information.

Only three kinds of click targets exist during play: the 5 packets in the single currently-active row, the CASH OUT button, and the bet up/down stepper. No timed reactions are required; each row waits for input indefinitely with no observed auto-timeout.

Bottom control-bar layout is stable across states: info/settings/history icons far left, bet stepper with numeric value printed as text center-left, 'Balance' printed as text bottom-left, and one large primary action button bottom-right whose text LABEL changes between START and CASH OUT rather than relying only on its color change.

The FEATURE x2 BONUS CHANCE switch: red knob on the left is off, green knob on the right is on. The knob also moves, the plaque glows brighter and the spin button gets a star icon, so state is not color-only.
The Wild is identified by the printed word WILD, not by color. Symbols differ by silhouette (frog, bird, pipes, flower, maracas, coins), not only by hue.
Autoplay and bet buttons are identified by printed numbers. The selected bet is yellow with dark text, the hovered one is white with green text, a luminance difference and not only hue.
The 25x medallion on the mascot's hand is readable by its number.
All game states are visible: Jaguar Feature as a green glow, Roar as a full-field giant symbol with a multiplier number, wins as a banner. Sound and Music can be switched off in settings.

Base game is a bright daytime jungle with sandy-yellow stone temples, turquoise river and green foliage. Reel frame is thick polished gold with vines. Reel cells are very dark green with symbols in gold-rimmed round medallions or bare.

Panels are dark forest green with white headings, grey-green body text and bright yellow numbers and buttons. During Jaguar Feature the reels glow lime green with sparkles. Win banner is deep red stone with red gems and a teal-blue number plate.

Win amounts appear on a banner above the reels, on a plate over the winning line and in the bottom WIN field; the final BIG WIN is a large text banner. Reel symbols have no text labels except WILD. Fixed text sizes only.
Flying coins, sparkles and pulsing glow on wins; no photosensitivity warning was shown in the frames.
One big spin button; Space key spins (Spacebar to spin is ON by default); autoplay has stop conditions; the buy dialog needs an explicit BUY press; no timed inputs were seen.
The bottom BALANCE, WIN and BET strip is DOM text readable by assistive tech. The reels and banner are drawn graphics.
Symbols are told apart by shape and size (ingot bowl, chain ring, envelope, microphone, coins, firecracker), not by colour alone.
A win is shown by a bright golden glowing square frame around winning symbols, the line number lit in gold on both side strips, and the win amount as text, so it does not rely on colour only.
Paytable line diagrams use orange cells on grey cells; the position of the cells, not only the colour, shows the line path.
Wild is a teal-green snake with a gold banner reading WILD and, in stacked form, a large gold x10 numeral, so it is marked by text and shape as well as colour.
Sound can be switched off from the player menu; feature entry and respins are also announced by on-screen ribbon messages.
Message ribbon text is pale green script on dark green; paytable and rules bullets are small mid-grey text on near-black, so contrast is lowish.
Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins, a Turbo Spin toggle and a one-tap Max Bet. Bet Options values are picked by scrolling wheels, with no typed entry.
Every amount (balance, bet, win) is printed as digits; the message ribbon under the reels describes feature entry and respins in text.

No control relies on color alone: buttons pair an icon shape with a text label in the menus, bet-line diagrams are distinguished by cell position/pattern (top/middle/bottom row, diagonal) rather than color, win amounts are always printed as numerals, and the WILD tile carries the printed word 'WiLD' in addition to its tiger artwork.

No mechanic appears to be audio-only; feature triggers, respins and wins all carry an on-screen text banner (e.g. 'Fortune Tiger Feature!', 'x10 Multiplier with full screen win!', 'MEGA WIN 2.25') in addition to any sound cue.

Controls are a small set of round icon buttons with a single large, centrally placed Spin button, easing targeting for motor-impaired users. PC users can hold Space to spin/skip the animation, and Space also activates the sole on-screen button when only one is available -- a strong single-switch affordance (PC only).

The interface is a small, consistent set of round buttons, each with a single unambiguous glyph, and (inside the Rules/Settings panels) an accompanying text label; the main Spin action is a single large centrally placed button.
Wild symbol is identified by the printed 'WILD' text beneath the red-and-gold warrior face, not by color alone
Jackpot bar above the reels is labelled with printed text 'MAJOR' (teal), 'MEGA' (magenta) and 'MINI' (green), not distinguished by color alone
Feature progress badges next to the flanking characters carry text labels ('GIANT SYMBOL' / 'HOLD & WIN' / 'HIGH SYMBOLS'), not color-coded only
Chance x2.5 toggle ON/OFF state in the Buy Bonus dialog is shown by printed 'ON'/'OFF' text, knob position (left/right) and dialog desaturation, not by toggle color alone
Paytable payline diagrams mark active cells with a gold fill against grey cells, and each diagram is additionally numbered in text ('Line N'), so the pattern is identifiable without relying on color
Win-tier wording ('BIG WIN' vs 'TOTAL WIN') and the exact FUN amount on win/bonus splash screens are always printed as text, not conveyed by color or size alone
The selected tab on the loading-splash feature carousel is marked with a gold box outline (shape cue); MAX WIN text and the game logo are rendered in large high-contrast gold-on-purple lettering
Settings and Autoplay checkboxes show state via a checkmark glyph inside a filled/unfilled box, not color alone; unavailable options are additionally dimmed as a redundant cue

Red Mask (crimson tile) and Green Jade Jaguar (dark green tile) may appear similar under red-green colorblindness; distinguish by silhouette — human mask face vs feline jaguar profile with pointed ear.
Q royal (dark teal tile) and 9 royal (lighter teal tile) share teal tones; Q has a circular wreath letterform, 9 has a single-digit numeral — text labels are color-independent.
K royal (terracotta tile) and 10 royal (similar terracotta tile) are distinguished by text label only: letter K vs two-digit number 10 — both fully color-independent.

WILD has 'WILD' gold text label. SCATTER pyramid (stacked receding rectangles) identifiable by shape alone. Bonus buy confirm/cancel buttons use X vs checkmark shape cues in addition to red vs green color.
All game events shown as on-screen text: win amounts, free spins count remaining, multiplier value, completion totals. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable in settings.
WIN MULTIPLIER value displayed as large numeric text (X2, X7, etc.) alongside the segmented progress bar — numeric text is the primary indicator; the bar is a secondary visual cue.

SPACE or ENTER key triggers spin without mouse. Autoplay supports up to 100 spins. TURBO SPIN and QUICK SPIN reduce animation duration. SKIP SCREENS eliminates manual dismissal of free spins intro screens.

Game renders on HTML5 canvas with no native button labels in the reel area. All game rules are available in the 7-page info panel accessible via the information icon. Win amounts and balance shown as text strings in the bottom bar.
Payline diagrams use a single highlight color against gray on a fixed grid layout, so line identity is conveyed by cell position, not hue; each diagram also carries a text heading ('Line N').

Grapes (cluster of many small blue/purple round berries) vs Plums (two larger purple/blue ellipse-shaped fruits) are the main residual color-risk pair but remain distinguishable by shape/count without color vision.

The result is only reliable once the table has fully settled: the close-up spinning-wheel view (with its own SKIP button) can show a transient/incorrect winning-number reading while the ball is still moving.
