Space bar starts a spin and holding it continues spins; autoplay offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; Max Bet button; Turbo Spin toggle.
Win amounts, bet and balance are on-screen text; prize discs print their value; the free spins counter is printed. No audio-only information observed.

Five low-value gem symbols are differentiated primarily by color (blue, red, purple, green, teal). Secondary non-color shape cues: blue diamond (4-pointed diamond silhouette), red gem (rectangular/square facets), purple gem (irregular faceted), green gem (pentagon, 5 sides), teal gem (hexagon, 6 sides). Green pentagon and teal hexagon may be confused by red-green colorblind users; the 5-sided vs 6-sided shape is the key non-color differentiator.

BUY FEATURE panel (bright green background) and SPECIAL BETS panel (dark red/crimson background) are visually adjacent on the left side. Non-color differentiation: distinct text labels ('BUY FEATURE / 5 OPTIONS' vs 'SPECIAL BETS / 3 OPTIONS'), Anubis head medallion artwork present only on SPECIAL BETS panel, and orange arrow indicator button present only on SPECIAL BETS.

Active tumble multiplier value is identified by large size and centered position inside the golden arch display — not color alone. Inactive adjacent multiplier values are smaller and dimmed at flanking positions. Size and position are primary differentiators.
SCATTER symbol identification is not color-only: 'SCATTER' text is printed in gold letters on the lower edge of the frame. Green glowing effect is supplementary.

All critical game events communicated visually: win amounts shown as on-screen text and numerals, Free Spins trigger shown as full-screen 'CONGRATULATIONS!' text overlay, gamble screen risk ('GAMBLING CAN RESULT IN NO FREE SPINS') displayed as text, win history sidebar logs tumble wins as text rows during Free Spins. No audio-only gameplay elements.

Win amounts and counters (CREDIT, BET, WIN, FREE SPINS LEFT) displayed in large numerals in the bottom bar. Current tumble multiplier shown in a large bright center panel of the golden arch display above the grid. During Free Spins, remaining spin count shown as large gold numerals on the left side of screen.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop spins. Held SPACE activates turbo spin. Autoplay available (up to 100 spins confirmed; SKIP SCREENS checkbox auto-skips feature intro and end screens reducing required interactions). BATTERY SAVER mode reduces animation speed. Bet can be changed from within the Settings overlay without separate navigation.

All settings toggles labeled with text (BATTERY SAVER, AMBIENT MUSIC, SOUND FX, INTRO SCREEN). Credit, bet, and win counters shown as numeric dollar amounts in prominent positions. Win announcements displayed as '$X.XX' on-screen. Gamble risk warning 'GAMBLING CAN RESULT IN NO FREE SPINS' is on-screen text. All buy feature and special bets option cards show text labels and prices.

Four high symbols have distinct tile backgrounds: Odin Elder has fiery orange-red background with white hair, Viking Warrior has sky-blue teal background, Mead Drinker has warm amber-brown background, Shieldmaiden has vivid pink-magenta background (unique among all symbols). All four also differ by portrait subject and composition. Card symbols A K Q J 10 9 are text-based letterforms readable by shape alone. WILD tile carries gold WILD text label. FURY tile carries FURY text label and is distinguishable by position (top row only) plus orange flame visual. SCATTER is the only circular coin-shaped symbol (all others are square tiles). MYSTERY has a distinctive eight-fold symmetric Vegvisir pattern in orange-amber on teal. Bonus buy confirmation dialog uses X icon for cancel and checkmark icon for confirm in addition to red vs green color coding.

Ambient music, sound effects, and intro screen can be toggled independently in SYSTEM SETTINGS. All mechanics have visual equivalents: tumble cascade shown by symbol disappearance and fall animation, FURY feature shown by large Odin deity overlay animation and 4 WILDS text label on reel, progressive multiplier tracked by left-panel numerical display, free spins count by persistent top-left counter.

CREDIT and BET labels shown in high-contrast gold-amber on dark bottom bar. SPIN button is large and centered. Megaways counter in top-right corner shows current ways in large bold golden-orange digits. Free spins remaining counter in top-left in large white-gold text. Progressive multiplier displayed on dedicated left panel throughout Free Spins and additionally overlaid in large numerals on the reels during active tumble cascades — two simultaneous display locations.

SPACE or ENTER key starts and stops the spin. Holding SPACE activates turbo spin (as shown by HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN instruction in bottom bar). Autoplay available for up to 100 auto-spins with turbo, quick, and skip-screens options to minimize required interactions.

All critical game values are rendered as text: balance (CREDIT), bet (BET), win amount (WIN), current megaways count, free spins remaining, progressive multiplier value. WILD symbol carries WILD text label. FURY symbol carries FURY text label. Win screen fully text-based: CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON $X.XX IN 10 FREE SPINS. FURY respin guarantees shown as numeric minimum ways label below the megaways counter.

The five risk-level buttons (1-5) mark the active setting with a red fill and glow, but the numeral stays legible in both states and the buttons keep a fixed left-to-right numeric order, so the active setting can also be tracked by screen position and by brightness (filled/lit vs outline-only).

Cleared board rows get a faint red tint versus unopened dark tiles, but the cue is backed up by shape and position: cleared rows also show teardrop-shaped fireball icons and sit below the player's token, so colour is not the only signal.

Body text is light grey or white on a near-black panel throughout, high contrast; balance, bet, multiplier and Cash Out amounts are consistently bold white or light-coloured numerals, never colour-only encoded.
All interactions are simple single clicks or taps - bet field, risk-level buttons, board tiles, Cash Out - no drag, hold, or precision-timing input is required anywhere in this game.

This build has no win banner or overlay of any kind: a successful cash-out or a lost round both reset the board silently to the idle Start Game state, and the only proof of the outcome is the balance counter changing. No screen-reader or spoken-feedback support was found, so a non-sighted player has no announced confirmation of a win or a loss.
Symbols differ by silhouette: tall cup, shirt, pair of boots, round ball, bottle with strap, angular whistle. None relies on colour alone.
Winning symbols get a glowing orange outline and sparks while others are dimmed; multiplier is a numeric badge (x2, x3, x5, x10); win tiers are printed words BIG WIN and MEGA WIN.
Respin buttons are green with two dots at rest and yellow digits with orange outline after a spin, so state is shown by digits as well as colour.
All outcomes are shown visually (win banners with amounts, multiplier badge, price digits, TOTAL WIN strip); a Sound toggle exists in the menu; no sound-only information found.
Balance, bet and win are large golden-yellow digits on dark teal capsules; panels use white text on dark charcoal; paytable description text is grey on charcoal with lower contrast.
Large round and pill buttons in the lower half; Space key spins on PC, holding it repeats; Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80, 1000; respin buttons are wide.
Game is drawn on a canvas; rules and paytable text exist as DOM text. Screen-reader labels on the canvas were not verified.

Of the 7 jelly symbols, color is the primary identifier but shape gives only partial redundancy: {Blue Cube, Green Cube} share one silhouette and are distinguished by color alone; {Yellow Pouch, Orange Pouch} likewise share one silhouette and are distinguished by color alone (a notoriously weak pairing for color-vision-deficient players). The remaining three symbols (Pink Swirl, Purple Dome, Red Fluted Jelly) each have a unique silhouette and remain identifiable without color.

All payout amounts, cluster-size ranges, multiplier badges, bet/win/balance figures and free-spins counters are always rendered as printed white/yellow numerals with dark outlines -- never color-only-coded.

No mechanic is audio-exclusive; the Lucky Feature and Bonus trigger both show full-screen text+visual announcements ('LUCKY!', 'BONUS!', 'AWESOME! YOU HAVE WON 6 FREE SPINS') in addition to any sound cue.

UI text is consistently white or bright yellow on a dark navy/teal background throughout every panel, giving strong contrast; toggle switches use a yellow-filled-track/white-knob (ON) vs dark-track/white-knob-left (OFF) pattern, legible by knob position and track color together.

Primary actions (spin, buy, autoplay, bet selection) are large circular or pill-shaped touch targets (~60-100px) with generous spacing; the 'Spacebar to spin' toggle in Settings offers a keyboard alternative to mouse/touch for the core spin action.
Gem symbols differ by shape, not only color: golden star-like cluster, red tall spiky cluster, green chunky block on a rocky base, purple single teardrop, blue rounded geode.
Royals A, K, Q, J, 10 are distinct letter shapes in steel grey; the thin colored outlines (orange, red, green, purple-pink, blue) are secondary.
Winning symbols are marked by a glowing orange-gold cell border plus the amount in the win strip, not by color alone. Blockers differ from symbols by shape and texture (grey rock on a cyan grid).
All information is visible: win amounts, multiplier badge, lives counter, BONUS RESPIN and BIG WIN banners. No evidence that sound carries information not shown visually.

Deep violet starry background with dark indigo cells; titles and payout numbers in gold-yellow, win amounts in orange-gold italic, neon cyan trim and idle slogan. Balance, bet and win sit in dark teal capsules with light cyan numerals.
Bonus Respin shows a large cyan-ringed multiplier badge with yellow-orange numerals, an orange-brown lives cylinder with cyan RESPIN LIFE text and a cyan progress bar n/15.
Bonus Respin has radiating light beams, glow pulses and a full-screen BIG WIN overlay; no photosensitivity warning was seen.

Spin by tapping the big button or the game area; on PC Space starts a spin, holding Space repeats spins. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80, 1000; Turbo shortens reel spins; Bet Options has a Max Bet shortcut and plus/minus buttons.

Paytable and Game Rules panels are real DOM text; the playfield is a canvas with no text alternative. Key events appear only visually: strip text (RESPIN WITH ANY WIN!, WIN x.xx, TOTAL WIN), multiplier badge, RESPIN LIFE counter, progress bar.
Balance, bet and win capsules are always on screen at fixed positions.
Prize tiers are told apart by rock shape and the printed value, not only colour: golden nugget, orange-red geode, purple crystal rock, green emerald rock; every Prize and Win Vortex shows its number.

Bonus Feature is marked by the VORTEX TRACKER text and numbered dials 1, 2, 3 as well as the red-magenta recolour; win size is shown by banner text, the pink panel versus orange-outlined dark panel is only extra.
Every outcome is shown as text and numbers (TOTAL WIN banner, VORTEX TRACKER dials, ONE MORE ticker hint); sound can be turned off in the menu.
Dark navy space background with thin gold grid lines; prize values are ice-blue digits on stones, win text is gold; the bonus screen turns hot red, magenta and orange.
Large spin button at the bottom centre; Space starts spins on PC and holding it repeats; Auto Spin up to 1000; Turbo mode.

Prize values are printed as numbers on stones and vortices; the TOTAL WIN banner and WIN bar repeat the amount. Tier names are not spoken; unlabelled icons: minus, plus and menu have no text, TURBO and AUTO do.
Jackpot tiers Mini (orange), Minor (green), Major (blue) and Mega (red) are told apart by printed labels and position, not only by colour

Collect banners: red Lannister (gold lion) and black-and-red Targaryen (three-headed dragon) differ by sigil and printed name; Night's Watch is silver-grey with a raven, Stark cream over green with a wolf, Baratheon orange-gold with a stag
House shields on the left are shape-coded: locked ones are wrapped in crossed chains and dimmed, unlocked ones glow without chains
Win Ways diagram separates valid and invalid examples by a check mark versus a cross shape as well as green versus red
Premium symbols differ by sigil and backdrop colour (red, blue, orange-brown, green); low symbols are letters and numerals, so identification does not rely on colour alone
Wins, bonus entry, re-triggers and unlocks are announced with on-screen text and animation; no information is carried by sound alone
Royal symbols are icy silver-blue with orange-gold edges; cash coins are bright gold discs with red-orange halos; key labels are bright yellow and body text white on dark panels
Iron Throne Spins turn the backdrop cold: icy blue-grey snowy hall with falling snow; the Stark Collect covers the reels with frost
The big win burst, the dragon fire breath and the frost flash of the Stark Collect contain bright flashing particles; no warning text was seen

Spin is one large round button on the right; spacebar may also start a spin depending on jurisdiction and operator. Autoplay offers 10, 25, 50, 75 and 100 spins with a STOP button; several splashes need PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE
The game is a canvas; on-screen text (PRESS TO SPIN, PAID, SCATTER PAYS, BONUS COMPLETE, banner names) is drawn as images, so no native text exists for a screen reader
Paying symbols differ by silhouette: a woman, a lamp tray, a flower basket, a bowl, and separate letterforms A K Q J in orange-gold with purple edge; none depends on colour alone.
Wild and Scatter tiles carry the written words Wild and Scatter, in addition to their magenta-gold and white-lilac artwork.

Winning cells are marked by a pale orange glow plus the printed WIN amount; selected options use orange together with a highlighted background, and Turbo off is shown by a slash through the lightning icon.
A Sound toggle exists in the player menu; no audio-only cues are documented on the captured frames.
Menu sheets are dark charcoal-grey with white text and orange accents; balance and bet numbers are orange on dark-grey pills; ticker text is gold on a deep purple plaque.
Spin by tap or the Space key; autoplay offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; bet changes with minus and plus buttons or the Bet Options picker.
Balance, bet and WIN are drawn on the game canvas; only the Paytable and Rules panels are readable text.

Symbols distinguished by a unique icon/shape (crosshair reticle, dollar sign, star badge, keyhole, monster face with cigar, frog face with scar, duck face with hat, T-Rex head with bow tie), not by hue alone, though several backgrounds use saturated violet/green/cyan/orange-red/magenta that could be confused if relying on color alone. Big Boss 'x2' and Wild 'W' markers are text/letter-based. Win amounts and the Safe progress counter are plain numeric text.

No information is conveyed by sound only; music and sound effects are decorative and both have independent on/off toggles in Settings. All game-state changes (wins, bonus purchase, progress-bar count, feature triggers) are represented visually with on-screen text and/or banners.

All primary actions (Spin, Buy Bonus, dialog Buy/Cancel, tab icons) are large circular or rectangular touch targets. Spacebar can trigger Spin as an alternative to clicking, reducing the need for precise pointer targeting. Autoplay with selectable round counts (10 up to unlimited) reduces the number of individual actions required to play.

Stable control layout: Info ('i') and Settings (gear) icons grouped bottom-left; Balance and Total Bet with +/- steppers center-left; Autoplay and Spin icons grouped bottom-right. The info overlay is a fixed 3-tab structure (Features/Payments money-bag icon, an apparently non-functional clock icon, Rules question-mark icon), each a linear scrollable multi-page document with a visible scrollbar.
Six gems differ by shape as well as colour: round violet amethyst, octagonal red ruby, shield-shaped orange topaz, rectangular green emerald, rhombus teal diamond, triangular blue sapphire
Royals differ by glyph (A, K, Q, J, 10, 9) not only colour: A purple, K coral red, Q pale gold, J olive green, 10 teal green, 9 light blue; J and 10 are close in colour but glyphs differ
Win multiplier is shown as a number in a ring, the gold ring fill is secondary; Mega Win (green burst) and Big Win (blue burst) are named in text
Disabled controls are dimmed by lower opacity, not by red or green
Free spin trigger and win sizes are shown as text banners (Big Win, Mega Win, Total Win) and a ribbon One more FREE SPIN; sound-only cues not tested
Wild is a golden Garuda bird with the gold word WILD along the bottom; Free Spin is a tall red banner with the words FREE SPIN

Paytable figures are orange-peach text on dark charcoal panels; amounts and ornament are gold on deep indigo-violet; free spins mode shifts to red, orange and gold with the large text Remaining Free Spin
Spin button about 170 px, plus and minus about 75 px, turbo and auto about 65 px; hamburger partly cut at the right edge
Space starts a spin, holding Space repeats, Space skips reel animation; autoplay 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; Max Bet sets the top bet in one tap
Board is drawn on a canvas with no readable text; regions: multiplier ring top centre, 6x4 board, message ribbon, balance, bet and win cells, control row
Paytable values are printed tiers; divide by 20 to get the multiplier of total bet

Eight paying symbols use both color and shape: Green Pentagon (5-sided), Cyan Octagon (8-sided), Red Square Gem (square), Orange Diamond (45-degree rotated rhombus), Purple Diamond (upright diamond) are geometrically distinct. Three circular symbols differ by internal motif and color: Gold Crown Orb (deep crimson sphere, gold crown), Skull Ring (forest green background, gold skull-ring, red ruby), Heart Amulet (medium blue background, bright red heart gem). Protanopia/deuteranopia risk: Gold Crown Orb and Skull Ring are both circular with gold frames — internal motif (crown vs skull-ring) is the key differentiator. CONFIRM/CANCEL bonus buy buttons text-labeled beyond green/red. Volatility labeled '5/5' numerically and 'HIGH' as text. WILD METER shows numeric values per column (e.g. '25x', '135x').

Ambient Music and Sound FX are independently disableable in Settings without information loss. All game state available visually: win amounts, cluster win details, WILD multiplier values, free spins counts, and feature trigger announcements all shown as on-screen text. No audio-only cues for spin results.

WILD METER uses 6 small circular indicator frames above the 6 grid columns — values shown as numbers inside glowing orange-gold rings, but indicators are small and may require close visual attention. Super Free Spins intro overlay is visually identical to regular Free Spins intro — no 'Super' label in the overlay text; distinction only apparent from WILD multiplier behavior (minimum 10x) during gameplay.

SPACE or ENTER key triggers spin. HOLD SPACE activates turbo spin. Large spin button target (approximately 80px diameter circle). Autoplay with configurable stop conditions: win limit, loss limit, stop on free spins trigger. Bonus Buy available for direct Free Spins and Super Free Spins access without natural scatter trigger dependency.

Grid 6x6, 36 cells total. All win amounts, WILD multiplier values, WILD METER per-column values, free spins remaining, and feature trigger announcements are displayed as on-screen text. Controls bottom row left to right: hamburger menu, info button, sound toggle, bet decrease, CREDIT display, BET display, SPIN button, bet increase, AUTOPLAY. Left panel: BUY FREE SPINS button, BUY SUPER FREE SPINS button. Keyboard: SPACE or ENTER to spin; HOLD SPACE for turbo spin.

High-pay symbols distinguished by unique shape: Crown (crown silhouette), Hourglass (amphora vessel with handles), Ring (serpent loop), Chalice (goblet with stem). Gem symbols distinguished by shape independent of color: red=pentagon (5-sided), purple=inverted triangle (pointing down), gold=hexagon (6-sided), green=upright triangle (pointing up), blue=four-pointed diamond star.
Multiplier orbs: 5 color variants (green, blue, purple, red, ornate crystal). All five variants behave identically in gameplay — distinguishing them by color is not required.
AMBIENT music and SOUND FX toggles independently controllable in settings. All wins and balances shown as numeric text on screen; no audio-only information.

HOLD SPACE keyboard shortcut for Turbo Spin. Spin speed button cycles: normal, quick spin, turbo spin. Autoplay with configurable spin count. SKIP SCREENS option reduces feature intro and win-screen interruptions.
Canvas game — no DOM elements or ARIA roles exposed. All interaction is coordinate-based. SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts can start and stop the spin.

The four high symbols (crown, hourglass, ring, goblet) are distinct artwork on round medallions of red, green, magenta and deep purple; the five gems are red pentagon, purple downward triangle, yellow hexagon, green upward triangle and cyan-blue diamond, so shape separates them, not colour alone.
Multiplier orbs are colour-coded (green, blue, purple, red, blue crystal, pink crystal) but each prints its numeric value, so value never depends on colour.

The four free spins types use blue, pink, green and red but are also named in text on the wheel, buy dialog buttons and intro banners. The active special bet is named in text on its plaque (for example ANTE BET 3 ACTIVE).

All outcomes are visible as text or animation: TUMBLE WIN, WIN, NICE!/SENSATIONAL! banners, FREE SPINS LEFT, TOTAL MULTIPLIER. Sound can be switched off with AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles. Audio content itself was not evaluated.

Symbols are large and distinct by shape; win amounts, balance, bet and free spins left are printed as numbers. The win list shows count, a small icon and an amount, and the icon is tiny, so the amount and highlighted symbols on the board carry the meaning. Greyed plus/minus buttons at limits are shown by dimming only.

One large spin button; SPACE or ENTER starts and stops spins, holding SPACE gives turbo spin; autoplay with a slider up to at least 100 spins; a spin-speed button cycles normal, quick, turbo. No timed input, but round popups need PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE unless SKIP SCREENS is on.
Everything important is drawn on a canvas; no screen-reader text is evident.

4 high symbols distinguishable by silhouette alone: crown (tall spires), hourglass (vessel shape), ring (circular band), chalice (shallow wide cup). 5 gem symbols by shape: star/pentagon, inverted triangle, regular hexagon, upright triangle, rotated-square diamond. Scatter is unique as a portrait card.

All 4 multiplier orb colors (green, blue, purple, red sphere) are functionally identical — same behavior, same random value range (2x-500x). Color-blind players are not disadvantaged by inability to distinguish orb colors.

Bonus buy dialog: cancel button has red background with X icon; confirm has blue background with green checkmark. X and checkmark shapes are distinct regardless of color. Ante bet toggle uses text labels OFF/ON plus thumb position (left=OFF, right=ON) in addition to red/green color.

All game information is visual: win amounts shown as numbers, Free Spins trigger shown as full-screen text overlay, TUMBLE WIN displayed in top-center banner, TOTAL MULTIPLIER and FREE SPINS LEFT shown as on-screen counters. No critical information is conveyed through sound alone.

SPACE and ENTER start/stop spin; HOLD SPACE for Turbo Spin. SKIP SCREENS autoplay option auto-dismisses Free Spins intro/outro overlays, reducing required click interactions. Autoplay supports up to 100 continuous spins.

All critical values shown as on-screen text: CREDIT, BET, WIN, TUMBLE WIN (per cascade step), TOTAL MULTIPLIER (during Free Spins), FREE SPINS LEFT. FS trigger and end overlays display full text: CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON $X.XX IN 15 FREE SPINS. PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE.
Bottom-bar control glyphs are shape-based, not color-based: info 'i', circular-arrow spin icon, triple-chevron turbo icon, stacked-coins bet-menu icon, hamburger-lines menu icon.
System Settings toggle switches show state by BOTH position (left=off, right=on) AND fill color (grey=off, green=on); autoplay checkboxes show state via a white checkmark glyph, not color alone.

Top banner SNAP (green) / BURST (magenta) / SPARK (light blue) tiles are distinguished mainly by tile color and position, but each also carries a unique text label and its own dollar amount, so color is a redundant cue rather than the sole one.

MULTIPLIER symbol comes in five color variants (blue, red, magenta/purple, green, gold-rainbow) but its random value is printed directly on the symbol as a numeral (e.g. '4X'), not conveyed by color alone.
Sound is decorative only (music/SFX toggle in System Settings); all game state (wins, free spins remaining, multiplier values, RTP, bet limits) is conveyed through on-screen text/graphics.

Free Spins mode is signalled by both a full background palette shift (warm pink/orange sunset in base game -> cool blue/purple night aurora in Free Spins) and explicit on-screen text ('FREE SPINS LEFT' counter), not by color alone.
Win amounts, credit/bet readouts, RTP and bet limits are printed as large high-contrast yellow/gold or white text on dark panels.
Large round tap targets for all primary actions (spin, info, menu, turbo, bet menu); autoplay configurable up to 100 spins reduces the number of required interactions.

All 5 gem symbols have unique geometric shapes: Red Gem=pentagon, Purple Gem=inverted triangle, Gold Gem=hexagon, Green Gem=upward triangle, Blue Gem=four-pointed star. Fully distinguishable by shape alone without color.

High-value symbols distinguished by object type: Crown=ornate crown shape, Hourglass=hourglass silhouette, Ring=ring shape, Chalice=goblet shape. Each on a distinct disc but identifiable by object without color.
SCATTER has Zeus portrait with explicit SCATTER text label. SUPER SCATTER has same portrait with SUPER SCATTER text label plus orange fire aura. Both identified by text regardless of color.

MULTIPLIER Orbs come in red, green, blue, purple variants but all share the same spherical shape with gold wings. Distinguished from regular symbols by wing motif and glow. Value shown as a number on or near the orb.
Settings toggles convey ON/OFF state via both color (green=ON, grey=OFF) and position of internal stripe graphic element, not color alone.
BUY FREE SPINS and BUY SUPER FREE SPINS buttons differentiated by large price text ($200.00 vs $1000.00) and label text, not by color alone.

All game mechanics and win announcements are text-based: bottom bar, overlay banners (CONGRATULATIONS, YOU HAVE WON, SENSATIONAL, MEGA). Win level names displayed as on-screen text. No audio-only information.

All win amounts, credit balance, bet, free spins remaining counter, and TOTAL MULTIPLIER value are displayed as large numeric text. Paytable is 8 navigable pages with count ranges and dollar amounts at current bet.
Keyboard controls: SPACE to start spin (hold for turbo), ENTER to start/stop spin. Autoplay with configurable count (up to 100 observed). TURBO SPIN and QUICK SPIN options reduce waiting time.

Nine distinct symbol types each with unique name and shape. All numeric values (wins, credits, bet, spins remaining, total multiplier) displayed as text in bottom bar and left panel. Free Spins trigger and retrigger shown as text banners.

Toggle switches are shown by handle position (not only fill color), checkboxes use a checkmark glyph, navigation arrows use triangle/X shapes, and winning cells are marked by a glowing outline rather than a color fill alone.
The MULTIPLIER orb's rolled value is always shown as printed gold text/number on the orb, legible regardless of the orb's random color (observed green, blue, magenta/purple, red).

No information is conveyed by audio alone; wins, spins remaining, multiplier value, bonus trigger/retrigger, and purchase cost are all duplicated in on-screen text/numbers. Ambient music and sound FX are independently toggleable in Settings.

Win amounts and free-spins counts are shown as large high-contrast gold numerals on dark scroll/plaque backgrounds (e.g. trigger and win-screen banners), legible at a distance without color discrimination.

Large circular touch targets, with the central SPIN button the largest control; SPACE and ENTER also trigger spin/stop; configurable Autoplay (up to 100 spins) with a SKIP SCREENS option reduces required manual interactions.

Control positions are stable across all game states: menu+sound bottom-far-left, info button next to them, bet +/- flanking the spin button, autoplay beside spin; the 7-page info booklet is a linear sequence with an explicit 'Page n/7' readout for orientation.

Symbol identity relies on distinct icon shapes (helmet vs. chalice vs. harp vs. sword&shield; round vs. hexagonal vs. oval gem outlines) in addition to color. The multiplier ladder and Total Multiplier badge always print the value as text, not a color code alone.
On the Buy Features menu, the two BUY cards (red) and the two ACTIVATE cards (teal/dark-grey) differ by button word and card icon as well as by color, so purchase type does not depend on color alone.

Feature state (base game vs Free Spins/Super Free Spins) is signalled by a background palette shift (blue sky to warm orange/amber ember tones) AND by explicit on-screen text ('Free spins: n/15', 'TOTAL MULTIPLIER'), not by color alone.

No audio-only information observed; Music and Sound FX toggles exist in Settings and default to on. Round outcomes, feature triggers, spin counters and multipliers are all conveyed as on-screen text/numerals, not sound alone.

The spin button is a large circular target bottom-right; Autoplay (configurable spin count up to infinity) and the four Buy/Activate feature shortcuts reduce the number of repeated clicks/spins required to reach specific game states.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across all base-game-derived screens: info/settings icons far left, Total Bet stepper and Balance center-left, Autoplay and Spin far right. The 9-page rules/paytable booklet is a single continuous vertical scroll rather than a paged sequence with next/previous arrows.

Low gem symbols: Gold Diamond and Blue Diamond share the same diamond/rhombus shape — distinguished only by gold/amber vs sapphire blue color. Deuteranopia/protanopia players may find these two ambiguous. Red Heart (heart shape), Green Clover (four-leaf clover shape) are shape-distinct. High symbols have unique portrait faces with different silhouettes. WILD is uniquely circular. FREE SPINS uses text label 'FREE SPINS' — no color-only reliance.
All game outcomes conveyed through visual animation and on-screen text. Sound FX and Ambient Music toggles available independently. No audio-exclusive information — all state changes shown visually.

WIN amounts shown in large bold yellow-gold text at bottom center. FREE SPINS LEFT counter in bottom bar during feature. WIN MULTIPLIER displayed as large numerical text (e.g. 'X6') on right-side stone tablet. All critical game state is conveyed as text, not color alone.

Keyboard support: SPACE or ENTER starts/stops spin; hold SPACE for turbo spin. Bet adjustable via +/- click buttons. Autoplay supports up to 100 autospins with SKIP SCREENS option for set-and-forget play.

Game runs on HTML5 canvas; standard screenreader tools cannot read canvas-rendered symbols or bet values. Critical numeric values (WIN amount, BET, CREDIT, FREE SPINS LEFT, WIN MULTIPLIER) are rendered as on-screen text graphics, not accessible DOM elements.

Symbol tiles are color-coded (falcon=red, ankh=dark teal-blue, eye=teal-green, anubis=violet/purple, heart=dark red, triangle=mid-blue, purple gem=purple, green gem=dark green) but each symbol is also identifiable by its unique icon artwork/shape, not tile color alone. WILD is an orange-to-white glowing letter 'W'; SCATTER is a gold medallion with an engraved scarab. Toggle on/off state is shown by both color and handle position; disabled bet-stepper buttons use a washed-out grey fill rather than a color swap.

No audio-only information observed. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, multiplier value, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

Monetary values and headings (BUY FREE SPINS, WIN, MULTIPLIER, CREDIT, BET) are shown in large gold lettering with a brown outline against a dark backdrop; CREDIT/BET labels are bright yellow on a dark bottom bar; the splash screen's max-win text and title use large high-contrast lettering.

Large circular click targets; SPIN is the largest and most central. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin as a keyboard alternative. Win amounts and round-close totals are large, high-contrast gold-embossed text on a dark background; paytable payout tables are plain black-on-white numeric grids, legible without colour discrimination.

Single large circular Spin button dominates the bottom right; Autoplay presets (10/20/50/100/250/500/1000 rounds) cut the number of clicks needed for extended play; Push Bet and Gamble are simple binary toggles/buttons, not drag controls.

Right-rail control stack (Bonus Buy star, Autoplay, Bet selector) keeps a stable vertical order with Spin always bottom-right and Balance/Total Bet always bottom-left/right; the 12-page rules and 10-page paytable booklets are continuous top-to-bottom scrolls.

Money-respin values are printed in bright green text with a dark outline on the gold medallion; local multipliers appear as bold blue 'x1' or magenta 'x2' text directly on the medallion, always with the explicit numeral, never color-only.
Ante-bet toggle shows state via the word 'OFF'/'ON' plus a maroon/dark-red button with an orange arrow icon (redundant, not color-only).
Settings toggles: OFF = grey track with knob at left (pause-bars glyph); ON = green track with knob at right (pause-bars glyph) — knob position is the non-color cue.
Autoplay checkboxes show checked state via a white checkmark glyph on a green box, not color alone; unchecked boxes are empty.
Info-booklet/paytable navigation uses a green left-triangle, green X (close), and green right-triangle — distinguished by shape, not color.
Buy Free Respins confirmation dialog: cancel is a red button with a white X, confirm is a green button with a white checkmark — shape-coded, not color-only.
HIGH volatility is shown as a dark teal-green pill with 5 of 5 solid gold-orange lightning-bolt icons (no dimmed bolts) plus explicit 'High volatility' descriptive text.

No game information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative. All state (win amounts, feature progress, multipliers) is shown as on-screen text/numerals.

Large round click targets throughout; the central SPIN button is the single largest control. SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop a spin. Autoplay (adjustable spin count + SKIP SCREENS option) reduces clicks needed for extended play.

Stable control layout: menu+sound stacked far-left, info 'i' button beside them, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, bet +/- around the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. The info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence navigated with triangle icons and closed with an X.

Safe vs trap cell outcomes are distinguished by both color (green/olive tile vs red tile) and distinct icon shape (round coin/pot vs mouse-trap badge) - a colorblind player can rely on the icon shape alone.

The active-row highlight (orange outline) is not paired with a text label, but its position (directly above the greyed lower rows) and the removal of the diagonal-X texture give a second, shape-based cue that a row is currently selectable.
Difficulty-level selection state is conveyed by both fill color (green vs cream) and font weight/color (white bold vs muted brown) - two redundant cues.
BET / CASH OUT / PLAY AGAIN states are distinguished by both button color (green / amber / red) and by their text label, so color-blind players are not solely dependent on hue.

Jackpot tiers (Mini/Major/Mega), symbol identities, and respins/free-spins counters are all reinforced with text/numerals, not color alone. The four low-value directional-character symbols are each a different color (East red, South blue/teal, West magenta/pink, North green) but remain distinguishable by their distinct Chinese-character shapes even if color perception is impaired.

No audio-only information is used anywhere in the game; Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable in Settings and are decorative/ambient. All game state (wins, respins remaining, free spins remaining, jackpot values) is conveyed via on-screen text and numerals.

Win amounts are shown as large high-contrast gold-on-cream text (Free Spins end screen) or white/gold text (Hold & Win end state), each with an explicit bet-multiplier label (e.g. '62x Bet'), legible without fine color discrimination.

Spin can be triggered via the keyboard Spacebar when 'Spacebar to spin' is enabled (default on). Autoplay offers fixed round counts (10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 750, 1000, or infinite) to reduce required manual actions. Bet adjustment uses a small up/down triangle stepper rather than large +/- buttons, a harder target for motor-impaired users.

The info/paytable/rules content is one continuous 22-page scrolling booklet with no visible 'Page N/M' indicator, which may make progress harder to gauge for screen-reader users than a paged design. Control layout is stable across screens: info and settings icons bottom-left, Balance/Total bet centered, Autoplay and Spin bottom-right.

The three low-value gems (magenta, green, blue) and the three thematic high symbols (bird, Anubis jackal, Eye of Horus) each carry a distinct shape/silhouette (octagon/hexagon/triangle; bird/jackal-head/eye glyph) as a secondary cue alongside their color coding.
Depleting Wild multiplier value is printed as text (X2/X3/X5/X7/X10) directly on the red medallion tile, readable independent of tile hue.

Reel-cell background tiling alternates dark teal-blue and dark maroon-red stone tiles; this is purely decorative background art and carries no game-relevant meaning (does not indicate paylines or wins).

Feature state changes (Free Spins active, last spin, completed) pair a background palette shift (outdoor warm sunset vs indoor torch-lit temple) with explicit text: 'FREE SPINS LEFT n', 'LAST FREE SPIN', 'FREE SPINS COMPLETED', 'WINNER'.
The spin button changes both outline color and shape (circle double-arrows to a red-outlined square 'stop' icon) while a spin/tumble sequence is resolving, so the state is not color-only.
Settings/autoplay toggle switches show state via handle left/right position (not just green/grey track color); autoplay checkboxes show a white checkmark glyph rather than relying on color alone.

No audio-only information was observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are decorative toggles. All game state (win amounts, spins remaining, active multiplier, bonus-active status) is conveyed through on-screen text and iconography, not sound alone.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, bet +/-, menu, sound and info. SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop a spin. Autoplay (default 100 spins, adjustable via slider) reduces the number of clicks needed for extended play.

Control layout is stable across all screens: menu+sound stacked far-left, a separate 'i' info button beside them, CREDIT/BET labels left-of-center, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. The rules/paytable booklet is a linear 7-page sequence with left/right triangle navigation, a green X close, and an explicit 'Page N/7' indicator on every page.

Symbol identity is never colour-only: each high-value character has a unique portrait, each royal card a unique printed letter/number, and the Bonus symbol has unique tower/zeppelin artwork plus the word 'BONUS'. UI buttons are white icon-glyphs (i/gear/A/arrows) on uniform dark circles, not colour-coded.
Win-highlight on winning symbol tiles is a plain white/gold sparkle glow, not colour-coded to a specific meaning, and is always accompanied by explicit 'Line N pays' text.

All game-state information (balance, bet, wins, bonus progress, RTP/rules text) is presented on-screen as text; music and sound effects are toggle-able in Settings and appear decorative rather than carrying unique information.
Key numeric callouts (MAX WIN figures, bonus card multipliers, win totals) are rendered as high-contrast white/gold text against dark backgrounds throughout the preview, base game and bonus screens.

Large circular touch targets for all primary actions (spin, autoplay, buy bonus). Spacebar can be used instead of clicking Spin. Autoplay offers configurable stop-conditions (on any win, single-win threshold, balance-increase/decrease thresholds), reducing required manual actions.

Control layout is stable across all screens: info and settings buttons bottom-left, autoplay and spin buttons bottom-right, Buy Bonus fixed on the reel frame's left wing, History fixed on the right wing. Paytable and Rules are each one continuous scrollable document, both reached through a single 'i' entry point.
The two Buy Feature panels (purple 'BUY FREE SPINS' vs dark-red 'BUY SUPER FREE SPINS') are differentiated by full text labels and different prices ($200.00 vs $400.00), not color alone
Settings menu toggle switches show on/off state by handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to color (white=off, green=on)

Autoplay checkboxes show checked state via a white checkmark glyph on a filled green box versus a plain outline, not color alone; paytable navigation icons are differentiated by shape (triangle/cross/triangle)

No audio-only information is present; Ambient Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative; all game state (win amounts, free spins left, duel-ladder progress, buy-feature prices) is conveyed via on-screen text and numbers
Large round click targets with SPIN the largest and most central; SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin; Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count and a Skip Screens option to reduce required clicks

Controls are in stable positions: menu and sound stacked left of the reel housing, info 'i' button beside them, bet +/- flank the central spin button, autoplay sits below spin; the rules booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with 'Page N/7' shown on every page

Win highlight is a gold/amber glowing bordered box, shape-distinct from symbols. Residual risk: royal letters (A/K/Q/J) and other regular symbols are always rendered gold/amber whether or not part of a win, and the win-glow is also gold/amber -- a red-green or color-weak user must rely on the glow-border shape/position, not hue, to tell a winning cell from a merely gold-colored symbol.

No audio-only information observed; Music and Sound FX are decorative and independently toggleable/mutable in Settings. Game state (win amounts, respin counter, multiplier value, bonus prices) is always shown as on-screen text/numerals.

Large circular Spin button; Spacebar-to-spin is enabled by default, reducing precise-click need. Autoplay offers preset round counts (10 up to unlimited). Buy Bonus purchase needs only 2 clicks (choose variant, then BUY), no drag/precision gestures.

Bottom bar control positions are stable across all base-game screens: info(i)+settings(gear) far left with Balance below, Total Bet with +/- stepper center-left, status/win text center, Autoplay(A) and Spin buttons at right. Info booklet is two linear sections (Paytable 8 pages, Rules 6 pages) reached via distinct money-bag and question-mark icons in one overlay.

Symbol identities rely on distinct artwork (leprechaun face, unicorn head, horseshoe, harp, cottage), not colour alone. Royal symbols are differentiated by letter shape in addition to colour. Payline win highlights use a glowing gold outline around winning cells — distinguishable by brightness/glow intensity rather than colour only. Confirm/cancel buttons in bonus buy dialog use distinct shapes: red circle with X (cancel) and green circle with checkmark (confirm) — shape-identifiable without colour.

Critical colour dependency: jackpot tier spheres (GRAND=dark magenta-red, MAJOR=dark orange-amber, MINOR=dark forest-green, MINI=deep purple-violet) differ primarily by colour of sphere. Fallback: each sphere has its tier name (GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR/MINI) and dollar value printed on or adjacent to it. Settings toggles (green=ON, grey=OFF) have a partial positional cue (internal dot right=on, left=off) but are small.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX can be individually toggled off in Settings. All win information, feature instructions ('PRESS TO BEGIN THE AFTER HOURS BONUS', 'PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE'), and rule descriptions are presented in text. Winning paylines highlighted visually with glow outline.

All monetary values are printed as text on each MONEY pot symbol and in the jackpot sidebar. Win amounts displayed in large text: 'YOU'RE A CHAMPION $XX.XX' and 'CONGRATULATIONS YOU WON $XX.XX'. CREDIT and BET balances in large vivid yellow-gold numerals on dark bottom bar. Paytable pages navigated by left/right arrows with page N/9 text counter.

Keyboard: SPACE and ENTER start/stop spin. HOLD SPACE activates turbo spin. Autoplay: up to 100 auto-spins configurable, with SKIP SCREENS option to reduce interaction during bonus sequences. Bonus buy dialog allows one-click feature purchase (with confirmation) reducing need for organic trigger. Large centred SPIN button.

CREDIT and BET labels with numerical values update each spin. WIN label appears on wins. Paytable has 9 pages with page N/9 counter. Win screens are fully text-based with explicit dollar amounts. Bottom bar buttons (MENU, Information i, Sound, SPIN, AUTOPLAY, minus, plus, BUY MONEY RESPIN, START AUTOPLAY) are icon-only round buttons without adjacent visible text labels — require aria-label attributes for screen-reader accessibility.

Each symbol has a unique silhouette and subject (portrait, animal, object, numeral) — color is not the sole identifier. MONEY symbol is identified by its cauldron shape and embedded numeric value, not color alone. WILD has a Tree of Life shape on a pale blue field.

GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR/MINI jackpot matrices are labeled with text and differ in dollar value. In bonus mode they have red/blue/green/purple backgrounds; for red-green color-blind users GRAND (red) vs MINOR (green) may look similar, but text labels and jackpot values ($10,000 vs $100 at $2 bet) provide redundant identification.

Winning symbols are highlighted with a bright gold glow border — a luminance increase distinguishable even for red-green color-blind users, not a hue-only change. MULTIPLIER and EXTRA SPIN symbols have distinct shapes and embedded text labels.

Separate AMBIENT and SOUND FX toggles in settings; full mute via speaker icon in bottom bar. All wins, jackpots, and feature triggers are communicated via on-screen text and animation. Congratulations panel shows explicit dollar amount text (POP THE CHAMPAGNE! $X.XX) — sound not required to understand game state.

Win amounts displayed as large on-screen text (WIN $X.XX) and a secondary line (Nx SYMBOL LINE Y PAYS $Z.ZZ). Jackpot values shown as large bold text in the header bar. Respin counter shows both a numeral and the text RESPINS LEFT during bonus.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop the spin (HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN). Large circular spin button (~90px diameter). Autoplay with configurable count (up to 100) and speed options (TURBO/QUICK/normal). SKIP SCREENS option reduces required interactions during bonus.

All symbols have unique visual identities: Leprechaun (portrait with green top hat), Unicorn (white horse with gold horn), Horseshoe (U-shape with clovers), Mushroom House (red-capped cottage), Harp (gold musical instrument), WILD (Tree of Life medallion), plus six distinct royal letters (A/K/Q/J/10/9). Info panel uses explicit left/right arrow icons and an X close button at consistent positions.

WILD (red dynamite) identified by distinct shape and WILD text label. SCATTER (mine shaft tunnel) vs Mine Cart (wheeled cart) are clearly different shapes. Settings toggle position (left=off, right=on) supplements green/gray color. FS mode confirmed by LEVEL N and POINTS X/Y text HUD, not background color alone.
All wins shown visually via symbol glow, win amount text, and banner overlays in Free Spins. No audio-only information delivery. Complete game rules available as text on info pages.
SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts start and stop spins. Autoplay available up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option to minimize manual interaction.

Win amounts shown as explicit text WIN $X.XX. Game state labels: PLACE YOUR BETS!, WINNER, NICE WIN. Free Spins level and progress as LEVEL N and POINTS X/Y text. Full paytable and rules in text across 6 info pages.

Jackpot tiers MINI (green text)/MAJOR (light-blue text)/MEGA (gold text) are distinguished by text and position, not color alone. Win highlights use a bright yellow glow outline around the winning symbols rather than a color change. Feature-active states change the button text ('BONUS ACTIVE'/'CHANCE x2 ACTIVE'), not just its fill color. The four low-value royal letters are differentiated by letterform as well as color: A is red, K is purple, Q is a brown wood medallion, J is green.

No audio-only information: wins, spins-left, respins-left, coins-collected and active features are all shown as on-screen text/numbers in addition to any sound effects. Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable in Settings.

Reel cells are dark navy-blue against a dark reddish-brown wood frame, set on a warm orange/tan saloon background for high contrast. Payout numbers on the paytable are plain white/gold text next to each symbol icon, legible without relying on color discrimination.

Large circular spin button dominates the bottom-right; bet +/- controls and the autoplay round-count tiles (10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/infinity) are sizeable single-click targets. Spacebar can be used instead of clicking Spin (enabled by default in Settings).

Control positions are stable across all base-game states: info/settings icons bottom-left, bet field center-left, scrolling marquee message center, autoplay and spin buttons bottom-right. Buy Bonus, Chance x2 and the live ways-counter plaque form a consistent vertical stack on the far left of the reel frame.

Winning 3-of-a-kind cells are marked with a reddish-orange radial glow highlight, but this is not the only cue: the win is also confirmed by plain white text ('WIN $X.XX' and 'TOTAL WIN $X.XX') and by the three matching cells showing the identical printed dollar figure -- redundantly conveyed by text and matching digits, not by glow color alone.

The top $250,000 tier is distinguished from the other nine cash tiers by a unique dynamite-bundle icon and gold/orange lettering, not by color coding; all other revealed values use the same fixed green digit color regardless of amount, so amount is conveyed by the printed number itself.
Package selection on the buy screen is shown by both an orange radio-button fill and its position/order in the list, not by color alone; prices are plain high-contrast yellow-on-red text.

No audio-only information was observed on any captured screen; AMBIENT and SOUND FX are separately toggleable in settings and purely decorative/musical, and all game state (tickets left, win amounts, credit) is shown as on-screen text.

Prize amounts on the scratch card are large green digits with a black outline and thin gold highlight edge on a dark red background; headings ('BUY CARDS TO PLAY!', 'MATCH 3 TO WIN!') are yellow/gold letters with black outline and drop shadow for high contrast.

Only 2 primary actions exist per screen (choose package + BUY NOW on the buy screen; SCRATCH!/AUTOPLAY/STOP on the ticket screen), all large wood-plank buttons; AUTOPLAY removes the need for repeated manual clicks across a multi-ticket package, with STOP always available to interrupt it.

Layout is simple and stable across all screens: gear/back icons top-left, provider text top-right, PAYTABLE/BACK bottom-left, CREDIT/WIN readouts on the bottom bar; the persistent on-screen reminder 'MATCH 3 TO WIN!' restates the entire game mechanic on every gameplay frame. The paytable is a single static non-scrolling screen, simplifying traversal.

Regular symbols differ by shape: seven, bell, plum, lemon, cherries are different pictures; royals A, K, Q, J, 10, 9 are letters and numerals, so their glow colours (teal, blue, green, orange, purple, red) are redundant.

Jackpot plates carry the words MEGA, MAJOR, MINOR as well as colours red, purple, green, with amounts in digits. Cash chips are all blue and print their amount as a number; cashpot chips (green, purple, red) also print the pot name.

Cash Strike trail steps carry printed labels x2, x3, x5, x10 and +SPIN; lit chevrons are bright orange-gold, dark ones unfilled, the current target is also pink. Wild Strike and Cash Strike differ by name on badge and intro, not only by red versus amber.
Winning cells are shown by a bright white-yellow border while the rest of the field is dimmed (brightness and outline, not hue).
Every feature state is shown in text: SPIN n/8, multiplier badges, CHOOSE YOUR BONUS, GOOD LUCK, CONGRATULATIONS YOU'VE WON. Sound content was not captured.
Game Information text is white or yellow on near-black; rules text is small uppercase. Win banner amounts are large digits with a thick red outline in gold.
The PAID and WILD STRIKE PAYS / CASH STRIKE PAYS lines under the reels are relatively small text.

Spin by button or spacebar (jurisdiction dependent); autoplay 10, 25, 50, 75, 100 spins; turbo button; Buy Bonus needs two clicks on the price. The congratulations screen disappears by itself after about 3 seconds with no confirm button.
Only the footer strip (build name, clock, session time, net result) is real text; reels, chips and banners are drawn on a canvas and expose no text.
Jackpot tiers are told apart by the written words GRAND, MAJOR and MINOR on plates, gems and carriages, not by colour alone (red, magenta-purple and royal blue respectively).
Royals A, K, Q, J and 10 are told apart by letter shape (red, purple, blue, green and orange-gold).
Express Bet state is shown by a green tick versus a red cross that differ in shape and in which one is bright; winning lines get a bright yellow glowing frame plus the text PAID.
All feature progress is visual: spins remaining counter, START card, banners and carriage values. A sound toggle button exists and no audio-only cues were found.

Wins are printed as PAID in the bottom message line in yellow and white text, with LINE n PAYS or SCATTER PAYS; big wins show a green BIG WIN banner with a large gold number. Nugget and carriage values are decorative-font numbers on the canvas.
The Game Information panel is white text with bright yellow headings on a near-black translucent background; the footer bar with game name, clock, session time and net result is real text.

Autoplay offers 10, 25, 50, 75 or 100 spins, a fast-forward button speeds play, SKIP and START are large green buttons, and no timed input was found. The spacebar may start a spin depending on operator.
The game is drawn on a canvas; stake select and autoplay dialogs are canvas buttons, and no screen-reader text layer was observed.
WILD (gold locomotive with white steam) and the SCATTER/UPGRADE ticket pair (blue vs gold, identical shape) are each distinguished by printed name text and iconography, not colour alone.

System-settings toggles (Battery Saver/Ambient Music/Sound FX/Intro Screen) show on/off via knob position (left=off, right=on) as well as track colour; the autoplay Skip Screens checkbox uses a checkmark glyph, not colour alone.
Paytable/rules booklet navigation (previous/close/next) is shape-coded (left triangle / X / right triangle) despite all three controls being rendered green.

No information is conveyed through audio alone; bet/credit/win amounts, carriage counts, feature progress and settings toggle states are all shown as on-screen text or iconography. Ambient Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable and decorative only.

Bet-menu buttons at the minimum/maximum stake are disabled mainly via a grey-vs-white/green brightness change rather than an independent shape cue; the printed numeric field (e.g. total bet '$0.03' or '$240.00') is the reliable ground truth.

All primary controls (spin, bet +/-, autoplay, menu, info, sound) are large circular or oval targets. SPACE and ENTER keys are equivalents for spin/stop. Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count plus a Skip Screens option to reduce repeated manual actions.

Control layout is stable across all screens: menu and sound stacked bottom-left, a larger 'i' info button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central spin button, autoplay directly beneath spin. The rules/paytable booklet is a linear 5-page sequence with a printed 'Page N/5' indicator.

Jackpot ladder differentiates the four tiers (Mini green, Minor blue, Major dark red/maroon, Grand purple) by BOTH ribbon color AND printed name/value text, so it stays legible without color vision. Hold & Win lock bars show a literal 'N MORE TO UNLOCK' coin count rather than a color fill. Ways-to-win validity diagrams use a green check-mark vs a magenta/pink X-mark, distinguished by shape as well as color.

The four low-value gem symbols are each a differently colored AND differently shaped gem (red heart, blue-purple spade, orange-amber diamond, teal-green club), so suit identity does not rely on color alone. The five Buy Bonus cards also each carry a distinct icon shape (twin-coin, plain chest, gem chest, question-mark chest) in addition to their color wash.

No information observed to be conveyed by audio only; all wins, respin counts, unlocked-row counts and feature outcomes are shown as on-screen text/numerals. Music and Sound FX are togglable in Settings and separate from gameplay-critical feedback.

Bet stepper (+/-) and the Buy Bonus cart button are large, well-separated circular/rounded targets. Spacebar-to-spin is enabled by default, reducing required pointer precision. Autoplay with configurable stop conditions further reduces the number of manual actions needed.

Control layout is stable across screens: info ('i') and settings (gear) bottom-left, balance/bet readout bottom-center, autoplay ('A') and spin bottom-right. Both info booklets ('i' paytable, '?' rules) are continuous-scroll with no page-number indicator, so a screen-reader implementation would need to expose scroll position rather than a page number.

Free Hits (blue banner) vs Hold and Win (pink banner) are also distinguished by icon shape (crowned donkey head vs stacked coins) and text label, not color alone. Coin vs Collect grid tiles differ in icon fill (gold vs purple) and printed text ('COLLECT' vs a number). Free Hits mode is also signalled by a full day-to-night background/lighting change and an explicit text badge, not color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; bet, balance, win amounts and feature counters ('n/10 Free hits', 'n Respins') are all duplicated in on-screen text. Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable and not gameplay-critical.

The base game has no spin button in the classic sense -- progress is driven entirely by clicking a single large circular 'HIT' control, and both bonus rounds (Hold and Win respins, Free Hits) auto-advance off that same control. A 'Spacebar to hit' toggle in Settings lets the whole base loop be played by keyboard alone. Autoplay with configurable stop conditions further reduces required clicks.

Base game is a click-based mini-mechanic with no reels/paylines/ways to announce; a blind user needs this structural difference stated up front rather than assuming a standard slot layout. Control positions are stable across screens: info(i)+gear bottom-left, Total bet with steppers centered, autoplay('A') and the hit button bottom-right. The rules/paytable booklet is a single continuously-scrolling panel (no page-N-of-M indicator), closed via an 'X' at the panel's top-right.

The BUY BONUS / BONUS ACTIVE banner changes its printed text (not just color) when a purchased round is active; settings and autoplay toggles use a check-mark glyph, not color-only; the Bet-ways diagram distinguishes a valid win from an invalid one with a green check-mark versus a red X shape, not color alone; the four royal letters A, K, Q, J are all rendered in the same gold color and are distinguished only by letter shape, never by color coding.

No information is conveyed by sound only; wins, the respin multiplier, bonus active/inactive state and balance are all duplicated in on-screen text. Music and Sound FX are togglable and purely decorative.

Large circular spin and autoplay targets; Spacebar-to-spin is available and on by default, reducing the need for precise clicking. Autoplay basic and advanced stop-conditions further reduce required interactions. The bet dropdown list offers direct-tap preset amounts as an alternative to repeated +/- stepping.

Bottom bar control positions are stable across all screens: info + settings icons at far left, Balance/Total-bet readouts center-left, contextual message center, autoplay + spin at far right. Paytable/rules is a single continuous scroll (not discrete numbered pages) reached via 5 left-edge tab icons (payouts/features/rules/settings/history); the history/clock tab is inactive in this build.

Functional state is mostly dual-coded: toggle switches use both color and handle position; confirm/cancel dialogs use both color and glyph shape (checkmark/X); Hold and Spin lives use both color and a cracked-icon texture; Free Spins state is signalled by both a background palette shift and text counters. Residual risk: the five royal cards (A/K/Q/J/10) are differentiated mainly by outline color, and A and 10 share the same purple/violet hue - the printed glyph/text is the reliable non-color cue.

No information is conveyed through audio alone; Ambient Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (wins, spins remaining, multipliers, feature outcomes, bet amounts) is presented as on-screen text/numbers.

Large round click targets for all primary controls; SPIN is the largest single target. SPACE/ENTER also spin, reducing the need for precise pointer aim. Autoplay with an adjustable spin count and a Skip Screens option reduces required interactions during long sessions.

Stable control layout: menu/sound/info stacked bottom-left, bet -/spin/+/autoplay centered-right, CREDIT/BET readout centered-left. The 8-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigated with left-arrow/X/right-arrow icons - predictable for sequential traversal.

The four low-value gem symbols (orange, green, purple, red) are distinguished not only by color but also by a fixed column position on the paytable and by different payout values printed as text, so a colorblind player is not dependent on color alone.

The bright red Wild lamp and the golden oil lamp (diya) high-win symbol look similar in silhouette but differ in color, and the Wild also carries the printed word 'Wild', so they remain distinguishable without color perception.
Reel Rewards multiplier prizes (X2/X3/X5) are shown as plain numerals in the reel-top windows, not color-coded.
The Jackpot Race badge text and the WIN/BET/BALANCE fields use high-contrast gold-on-dark-red or white-on-black text rather than color-only encoding.

All key game events (feature triggers, wins, re-spin counters) are accompanied by clearly readable on-screen text ('Feature Triggered', 'Congratulations! You Won...', 'X Free Games Left', 'X Re-spins Left', 'YOU HAVE WON'), so no information is conveyed through sound alone.
The space bar can be used to both spin and stop the reels, giving a keyboard alternative to clicking the small SPIN button.
Bet Level and Coin denomination are adjusted with small +/- stepper buttons rather than sliders, which is easier for imprecise pointing but requires many repeated clicks to reach the maximum.

The core game (reels, symbols, bottom bar, Jackpot Race badge) is rendered entirely on a single canvas with no accessible DOM tree or ARIA labelling, so a screen reader gets no information from this part of the game natively.
The Help screen is plain HTML text in the same document and is fully readable by a screen reader once opened via the gear icon.
The Autoplay panel and the Settings/gear menu are HTML overlays and should be reachable by screen readers, unlike the reels themselves.

The paylines diagram in the paytable booklet marks winning cells only as orange-filled squares against dark-gray unfilled squares at small size, with no per-line text description of the shape - a color-blind or low-vision user may struggle to tell filled from unfilled cells there.
