The bet-history panel marks every row with a green shield/checkmark icon confirming provable-fairness verification; the icon's shield+check shape itself carries the meaning, not just its green color.

The free-spins mini-slot distinguishes a 'miss' outcome with a red X glyph versus a win with gold 'xN'/'NFS' text - shape and position differ from color alone, so the distinction does not rely on color perception.
Floating '+$X' reward badges are gold/orange text with a dark outline against a busy purple background, readable by shape/contrast rather than being color-coded against any alternative state.
The A/K/Q/J/10 royals are identical grey stone tablets with gold frames, differing only by the letter/number glyph, not colour - a colour-blind-safe design choice.
WILD is identified by the letter 'W' glyph; disc colour (blue = plain, red = carrying a multiplier) is reinforced by printed '+2x/+3x/+5x/+10x' text, not colour alone.
SCATTER is identified by its hand-gesture icon plus the word 'SCATTER', not colour.

Sticky WILD in Free Spins uses the same blue/red disc styling as a normal WILD; the only documented distinction of 'sticky' status is that it stays fixed in its cell across subsequent spins - no separate border, glow, or icon is described for sticky status specifically.

Rules-booklet nav arrows are differentiated by triangle direction/shape (left / close-X / right), not colour; toggle switches show handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey/green fill; bonus-buy confirm/cancel use checkmark/X glyphs in addition to green/red fill.

No game information is conveyed by audio only; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC toggles are purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, spins remaining, round multiplier, feature triggers) is shown as on-screen text and numbers.

All primary targets are large round buttons (SPIN is the largest); SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin for keyboard-only play; Autoplay with an adjustable spin count and optional skip-screens reduces required interactions for extended play.

Control layout is stable across screens: menu and sound stacked bottom-left, info 'i' button beside them, bet -/+ flank the central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY sits directly below SPIN; the rules/paytable booklet is a strict linear 6-page sequence with the same left-arrow/close/right-arrow control on every page.

The four top-bar Prize Pot capsules (bell/bauble/moon/star) are distinguished by colour (green/purple/teal/pink) plus a distinct icon shape and a printed currency value, so no information is colour-only.

The four low symbols are each a distinct shape as well as a distinct colour — Bell (gold), Star (pink/magenta), Moon (cyan-blue), Ornament/Bauble (purple) — so shape alone is enough to tell them apart.
Settings and autoplay toggle switches encode on/off by both switch position (left/right) and fill colour, so position alone identifies the state.
Feature state is always shown as on-screen text/banners (full-screen 'FEATURE TRIGGERED' interstitial, 'N FREE GAMES LEFT' banner, 'YOU HAVE WON' end screen) rather than conveyed by sound alone.
Wild tiles are labelled with the literal word WILD in addition to the tree icon during free-spin overlays, so the wild is identifiable by text even if icon colours are hard to distinguish.

The Prize Pot Feature's four collection counters (progress toward 3 of each low symbol) have no visible UI representation anywhere in the build; a screen-reader user has no way to know how close the feature is to triggering.

The four card-suit low symbols intentionally break from red/black convention (green spade, purple heart, cyan club, red diamond) and rely on shape for suit identity. Chest Prize awards are always spelled out as text (X2, X3, WILD) or given a unique icon shape (double-arrow for Two-Way Pays), never color-only. Settings toggle switches use handle position in addition to fill color. The jackpot ticker alternates 'Minor Jackpot' and 'Grand Jackpot' in similar gold/orange styling, but the label text itself is the disambiguator, so no information is color-only.

No information is conveyed by audio alone. The settings menu separates Ambient (music) and Effects (sound) toggles, both independently mutable. All game state -- wins, free-games count remaining, chest awards, bet and balance -- is shown as on-screen text and graphics.

All primary controls are large circular touch targets; the central SPIN button is the largest target on screen. The space bar can both start and stop a spin, reducing the need for precise pointer clicks. Autoplay offers configurable spin counts and stop conditions, further reducing required interactions.

Bottom control bar keeps a stable left-to-right order across every screen: info (i), BET, BET LEVEL -/+, BET MAX, SPIN, AUTO PLAY, COIN -/+, BALANCE. The paytable booklet is a strictly linear 14-page sequence (previous/home/next), and the separate Help screen is a strictly linear vertical scroll of labelled sections; both are easy to describe as ordered lists to a screen-reader user.

The four card-suit tokens are told apart even without color by three independent cues: a hanzi glyph engraved in the center, a distinct token background hue, and the suit outline shape (club/heart/spade/diamond) itself. Jackpot tier names and feature-symbol roles are always paired with text labels, not conveyed by color alone.

WILD (square gold tile with two koi fish and the word WILD) is told apart from the same-value Panda symbol (round medallion with a yin-yang emblem and panda face) by shape and imagery, not by color. Weaker point: the Mystery Jackpot Symbol's four possible outcomes (MINI/MINOR/MEGA/GRAND) lean partly on distinct plaque colors in the illustrative paytable art, though each also carries its own text name.

No audio-only information was observed; the three sound toggles (All Sounds / Sound Effects / Music) are purely cosmetic, and win amounts, feature names, jackpot tiers and feature states are all conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

Base-game spin and bet/balance-menu controls are small circular icons on the right edge of the screen, noticeably smaller than typical large round spin buttons on other slots. Autoplay presets (Off/10/20/50/100/250/500/1000) reduce the number of manual actions needed for extended play.

Panel navigation is consistent across paytable/rules/settings/autoplay/bet-select: a fixed bottom nav bar (grid / '?' / gear / shield icons) opens each panel, and every panel closes via a top-right 'X'. Paytable (14 pages) and rules (9 pages) are long single-scroll panels with no visible 'page N of M' indicator or jump-to-section links.
Each of the 6 paytable symbols is identifiable by distinct shape/object (ingot, lantern, purse, drum, sunglasses, dumplings), not by colour alone.
Multiplier reels: values are shown as text (x2/x3/x5/x10) on gold, and the no-multiplier state by a distinct pink/magenta-outlined diamond shape on dark navy, not by colour alone.
Bet '-'/'+' buttons are distinguished by their glyphs, not colour, and both visibly dim in brightness when their bet limit is reached.
Settings toggle ON/OFF state is shown by thumb position (left=off, right=on) in addition to the green fill.
Winning paylines are marked by a bright gold glow/outline around the symbols rather than a colour change alone.
No game state is conveyed by audio alone; sound/music toggles are purely optional and all wins, free-spins-remaining and multiplier values are shown as on-screen text/graphics.

Playable game area is a narrow portrait strip centred in the wide desktop viewport; the left/right thirds of the screen are the same background artwork repeated only as letterboxing, not extra game content.

Primary targets (SPIN, bet +/-, autoplay start) are large circular buttons; bet limits are clearly gated (dim/disable at the $0.10 floor and $250.00 ceiling); default Autoplay is 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS on, reducing required manual actions.

Fixed row of five bottom icon buttons (info/history/spin-speed/bet-menu/settings) plus a fixed bet minus/spin/plus row; the paytable and rules content is a single continuously scrolling panel with no 'Page N/M' indicator, needing chunked-heading handling rather than simple page navigation.

The four symbol groups (red, green, purple, blue) are never distinguished by color alone: card symbols carry distinct letters (A/K/Q/J) and horse symbols have different coat colors (dark maroon / tan / chestnut / white) in addition to their colored frame borders.
Toggle switches in Settings and checkboxes in Autoplay use handle position or a white checkmark glyph in addition to color (green=on/checked, white-grey=off/unchecked).
The winning payline highlight is a gold/yellow positional outline around the winning cells, not a color fill; win amounts and the round multiplier are always printed as text (e.g. 'x7', 'x12').
Cancel and confirm buttons in the Buy Respin Feature dialog are differentiated by both color (red/green) and glyph shape (X vs checkmark).
Red is reused for both 'cancel/X' controls and the red-horse symbol group, but the two never appear in a context where they could be confused, and both are additionally shape/text-differentiated.

No audio-only information is used; all game state (feature name, win amounts, round multiplier, progress) is conveyed through on-screen text and iconography. Ambient Music and Sound FX are independently togglable and purely decorative/reinforcing.

Entry into the PowerNudge Respin feature is signalled by a full background palette shift from the dark warm-brown barn interior to a warm sunset purple/orange desert-ranch scene, reinforced by the on-screen text label 'FREE RESPINS' rather than a subtle color change alone.
Win-screen and mid-feature text (win amount, feature name, round multiplier) is large, high-contrast gold/white lettering on dark wooden-plaque panels, legible without fine color discrimination.

Large round click targets, with the central SPIN button the largest element in the bottom bar; SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin. Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option (on by default), reducing required manual actions during the repetitive PowerNudge nudge/respin loop.

Control positions are stable across all base-game screens: hamburger menu and sound speaker stacked bottom-left, 'i' info button to their right, bet -/+ flanking the central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY pill below SPIN; the 7-page rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence with the same left-arrow/close-X/right-arrow controls on every page.

Each of 9 fish has a distinct shape: orange sphere, pink disc, blue open-mouth oval, lime-green wide jaw, flat asymmetric flounder, compact lavender round, dark spiny-back, slim ochre elongated, spotted trout. Shape alone identifies each fish without colour.

Worm/hook is the only C-shaped hooked symbol — entirely distinct from all fish shapes. BONUS basket shows explicit 'BONUS' text label in red/orange and a multi-fish container silhouette unique among all symbols.

Win net overlay is a silver wire-mesh square/rectangle (shape-based). WIN badge shows explicit text 'WIN'. Win banner shows 'WIN $X.XX' text. Toggle states conveyed by position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey/green colour.

SOUND toggle in System Settings turns off all audio. All win amounts, game state prompts ('PLACE YOUR BETS!', 'GOOD LUCK!', 'WIN $X.XX'), and rule text are conveyed visually. No audio-only information observed.

Spin button is a large round button at screen centre-bottom. Autoplay supports up to 100 auto-spins with SKIP SCREENS option to bypass feature intros. BET MAX shortcut available. Stop button occupies the same large central target as spin.

All payouts and rules are accessible via the scrollable info panel (press 'i' button). Panel contains: all 9 fish payouts in USD text, 6 RANDOM PAYS values, MONEY COLLECT rules, FREE SPINS trigger counts, RTP 96.50%, bet range $0.20–$240.00. Win amounts displayed as explicit '$X.XX' text.

Bottom bar buttons at fixed positions: sound (far-left), info 'i' (centre-left), spin (centre), bet controls (centre-right), settings three-lines (far-right). Info panel requires drag-to-scroll — all rules are below the initial view; announce that content continues below.

Feature state is generally dual-coded: toggle switches use physical left/right handle position in addition to grey/green fill; the three info-booklet navigation icons are distinguished by shape (left triangle/cross/right triangle), not color alone; win amounts and respin counts are printed as large numerals; disabled bet +/- arrows at floor/ceiling change brightness/opacity, not hue. Residual risk: green is reused for many different confirm/on affordances (Bet Max, Yes, Start Autoplay, toggle-on) and red for stop/cancel/off, but all of these also carry a text label.

No audio-only information was observed on any captured frame; Sound FX and Ambient Music are purely decorative toggles. All game state (win amounts, respins remaining, multiplier values, feature triggers) is conveyed as on-screen text and numerals.

The large circular SPIN button is the biggest click target on screen; SPACE/ENTER are keyboard equivalents (holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin). Autoplay with Skip Screens enabled removes the need to click through every feature intro/end screen.

Control positions are stable: menu/sound/info stacked bottom-left, credit/bet labels center-left, bet -/spin/+/autoplay grouped bottom-right, buy feature/ante bet stacked top-left of the reel frame. The 8-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence (left/right triangles, green X to close) with a persistent 'Page N/8' indicator.

All symbols use distinct shapes and text labels — WILD identified by hooded skeleton figure plus dripping 'WILD' text; SCATTER by crimson circle orb with bat silhouettes. No symbol relies solely on color for identification.

Free Spins state communicated by 'FREE SPINS LEFT N' text label in left panel in addition to deep crimson-red background change. Super Free Spins labeled 'SUPER FREE SPINS LEFT N'. Text labels are primary identifiers independent of color perception.

Multiplier values on WILD frames shown as numeric text (e.g. 7X, 10X) in lime-green — value not color-encoded. BUY FEATURE (red) and SPECIAL BETS (purple) buttons use both color AND distinct text labels as dual cues.
AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX independently toggleable in Settings. All game state and outcomes communicated visually. No audio-only critical cues identified.
SPACE key activates Turbo Spin to reduce click frequency. Autoplay panel with configurable spin count and SKIP SCREENS option minimizes repeated manual interaction for extended sessions.
Game renders on HTML5 Canvas with no native DOM accessibility tree. This documentation provides a semantic description layer for assistive technology integration.

Card suits are told apart by shape (spade, heart, club, diamond), not only by muted wood-like colours: pale sage green, dusty pink-brown, light tan, blue-grey. They pay identically, so shape is the only cue a colour-blind player needs.
Wild is a golden totem column with a large W and the word WILD on the paytable tile; Scatter is a volcano tile with a red-orange ribbon reading SCATTER. Both have unique shapes and text.
Winning symbols are marked by a gold glow and an explosion, and the amount is printed on the Win ribbon, so a win is not signalled by colour alone.
Selected Auto Spin count is shown by brighter fill and gold text, and is the first item on the left.
Sound can be switched in the profile menu; no captions for sound. All results are also shown as numbers (balance, Win ribbon, remaining free spins counter).
Balance and bet use small yellow numerals on a dark translucent pill at the bottom bar; during win banners and free spins the bar is dimmed under the overlay.
Menus use dark charcoal panels with yellow text and a yellow primary button; free spins background is a deep purple-red dusk with orange fire glow.
Spin is a large central round button, about 160 px wide on the 760 px canvas. Space key spins on desktop, held to repeat and skip reel animation.
Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; Turbo Spin toggle is the lightning icon at the left of the bottom bar.
The game is highly visual and drawn on a canvas; results are shown only as on-screen numbers and text, no text alternative is described.
Each symbol family sits on a differently-tinted stone tile (gold/tan, dark teal-blue, olive-green, purple) as a secondary non-shape cue alongside each symbol's distinct artwork.
WILD (Cleopatra portrait) and BONUS (golden pyramid) are distinguished by shape/artwork, not color alone; WILD substitutes everything except BONUS regardless of color.

Money Spot hearts visually shift from green to red as the multiplier grows (an observed pattern, not stated in the rules text), but the multiplier number (e.g. x1, x16, x32) is always printed as legible text on the heart, so color is a redundant, not the sole, cue.

Settings toggle switches show state via both knob position (left=off/right=on) and track color (grey/green); autoplay checkboxes show a white checkmark glyph, not color alone; Buy Free Spins confirm/cancel use an X glyph vs a checkmark glyph, not red/green alone.

No audio-only information was found; sound (Ambient Music, Sound FX) is decorative and all game state (wins, free spins remaining, buy confirmation, Money Spot values) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

SPIN, MENU, SOUND and INFO are large circular click targets; SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin from the keyboard (holding SPACE triggers turbo spin); Autoplay (up to 100 spins) and a Skip Screens option reduce the number of clicks needed.

Control layout is stable across all screens: hamburger-menu and sound stacked bottom-left, a separate info button to their right, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN; the rules booklet is a strict linear 7-page sequence with an explicit 'Page N/7' indicator and fixed-position previous/close/next icons.

The five COLLECT hearts on reel 5 differ by color (gold/orange, blue, pink/magenta, red, green) but each also prints its own name text, so color-blind players can rely on the label rather than the color.

Base game vs Free Spins state is signalled by a reel-panel color shift (dark green in base game, deep maroon/burgundy in Free Spins) AND by explicit on-screen text ('FREE SPINS LEFT N', 'SUPER_RESPIN'), not by color alone.
Settings toggle switches show state by BOTH thumb position (left=off, right=on) and a fill-color change (white-gray vs green) — position gives a non-color cue.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independent, clearly labeled on/off toggles in Settings; no information is conveyed by audio alone — wins, spins remaining and pot totals are always shown as on-screen text/numbers.
Rules/paytable booklet uses high-contrast white body text on a near-black panel with gold headings; CREDIT/BET/WIN amounts are large white or gold text against dark backgrounds.

All primary controls (spin, bet +/-, menu, info, autoplay) are large circular targets. SPACE and ENTER keys are documented alternatives to clicking spin; autoplay offers a selectable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option that shortens feature transitions, reducing required interactions.

Control layout is stable in the base game (menu+sound stacked far-left, info button beside them, bet -/+ flanking spin, autoplay under spin). The 7-page rules booklet is strictly linear with a 'Page N/7' indicator, making position announceable.
Bottom-bar and dialog controls use white glyphs on dark circles distinguished by shape, not color; info-booklet navigation arrows use triangle/cross shapes rather than hue.
Multiplier values are printed as numbers directly on every heart tile rather than conveyed by color; locked vs reached Multiplier Boost ladder steps use a padlock icon vs a number, not color.
System Settings toggle switches show state by BOTH handle position (left=off, right=on) and fill color; autoplay checkboxes use a checkmark glyph, not color alone.

The Special Bets dialog distinguishes Ante Bet (navy blue) from Super Spin 1/2/3 (teal-to-green) mainly by hue, close for some color-blind types, but each tile also carries its own printed name and price, so no information is color-only.
AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable in Settings; all game state (wins, free spins remaining, multiplier boost, gamble odds) is conveyed visually/textually, not by audio alone.

Free Spins mode is signalled by both a background palette shift (pastel blue/purple base game -> deep magenta/purple starry Free Spins) and explicit text ('FREE SPINS LEFT', 'MULTIPLIER BOOST'), not color alone.
Win amounts, credit/bet readouts and feature counters are large high-contrast white/gold text on dark plaques.
Large circular touch targets; SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin. Autoplay with adjustable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option reduces required interactions for long sessions.

All 3 COLLECT types differentiated by shape AND color: GREEN COLLECT is the only lantern shape (elongated vertical), RED COLLECT is the only bottle (cylindrical, narrow neck), YELLOW COLLECT is the only sphere (round). WILD identified by pink crystalline heart shape and absence of rectangular frame — shape alone distinguishes it. Multiplier row uses text numerals (x1-x100), not color only. Payline wins show box outlines in addition to color. Mode labels (ANTE BET ACTIVE, SUPER SPIN ACTIVE, NORMAL) shown as text on left panel sign.

All game events have visible text counterparts: WIN $X.XX in bottom bar, CONGRATULATIONS on trigger screen, SENSATIONAL! on respin completion, N RESPINS LEFT counter during feature. Plus-Nx popup text appears at GREEN COLLECT position when multiplier is added. No audio-only game information identified.

SPACE or ENTER triggers spin; hold SPACE activates Turbo Spin (shown as hint in bottom bar). AUTOPLAY with configurable spin count slider reduces repetitive interaction. Turbo Spin, Quick Spin, and Skip Screens checkboxes in Autoplay dialog available. Single left-panel arrow click toggles Ante Bet or Super Spin modes on and off. REBUY sign on left panel provides one-click re-purchase without re-entering full dialog.

CREDIT and BET amounts always labeled in bottom bar. Current play mode shown as text on left panel sign (ANTE BET ACTIVE / SUPER SPIN ACTIVE / NORMAL). All 5 multiplier row cells display numeric text with x prefix (x1, x2, x3, etc.). RESPIN counter shows N RESPINS LEFT with integer count. Wins shown as WIN $X.XX and GAME PAYS $X.XX in bottom bar. Game Rules panel shows page N/8 with explicit left and right navigation arrows.

The two BAR symbols are near-identical in shape and layout and differ mainly by color (pink vs. mint-green); their payouts differ (12.5x/4x/1.5x vs 10x/3x/1x at 5/4/3-of-a-kind), so a red-green color-blind player could misjudge win size from color alone.
The Push Bet toggle state is shown by handle position (left = off, right = on) as well as by green/grey fill, not by color alone.
Held/locked Heart symbols during Free Spins carry an explicit padlock/chain-link icon overlay rather than relying on a color cue.

A Settings panel offers separate mute toggles for All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music; wins, feature triggers, RTP and rules are all also delivered as on-screen text, so the game is fully playable with sound off.
Golden Heart Meter progress above reels 2, 3 and 4 is shown as individually countable heart-outline pips (filled gold vs. empty black), not a single color-coded bar.
The Free Spins award screen shows both a large numeral spin count and a countable row of gold heart icons, not a color-only cue.
Quick Play: pressing anywhere on screen or the space bar during a round skips certain animations, reducing the time and repeated input needed to complete spins.
WILD symbol is identified by the printed word 'WILD' plus a badge/crossed-revolvers graphic, not by color alone
Settings toggle switches show state via both handle position (left=off, right=on) and track color; autoplay checkboxes use a white checkmark glyph, not color alone
Paytable navigation controls are differentiated by shape (left triangle / X-close / right triangle), all rendered green

BUY FEATURE is a distinct hanging sign outside the main control bar with explicit '$' price text, not color alone; confirm/cancel buttons in the buy dialog use green/red but are also marked with a checkmark/X glyph
Win amounts, free-spins count and NUGGET VALUE/MONEY values are always shown as plain readable numerals/text, not conveyed by color alone

No audio-only information observed on any captured screen; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative; all game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, NUGGET VALUE, feature trigger/completion, bet/credit) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals
All primary targets (SPIN, MENU, SOUND, INFO, bet +/-, AUTOPLAY, BUY FEATURE, paytable nav) are large circular/rectangular buttons with generous spacing
SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop a spin without mouse use; holding SPACE engages turbo spin
Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option; BUY FEATURE requires only two clicks (open dialog, confirm) to enter the Free Spins round

Control positions are stable across all screens: menu+sound stacked far-left, 'i' info button next to them, bet -/+ flank the central SPIN circle, AUTOPLAY beside SPIN, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, branding fixed bottom-left; BUY FEATURE is a separate hanging sign outside the main control bar
Info/paytable booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with an explicit 'Page N/7' text readout
Paying symbols differ by shape (safe, sack, handbag, banknotes, purse) and letters A, K, Q, J by their printed letter, not by colour alone.
Wild (magenta-purple tile) is marked by the printed word WILD and the masked heroine; Scatter (gold wheel) by the printed word SCATTER and its shape.
Winning tiles are marked by a glowing gold outline while the other tiles darken, and the win amount is printed.
Sound toggle is in the menu; every outcome is also shown as text, nothing is delivered by sound alone.
Amounts are printed as numbers in gold or white on dark charcoal-grey panels; the multiplier is written as x3, x4 on a pink gem.
One large central round spin button, large round plus and minus bet buttons, Space key on PC, Turbo button, Auto Spin up to 1000.

All 7 paying symbols differentiated by shape and subject alone (cauldron / heart / skull+brain / bucket / cleaver / eyeball / shackles) — color-independent identification. Excellent for all color blindness profiles.

Three SCATTER types share same skull/demonic design but differ by aura color only: blue=SCATTER, green=NO MISS SCATTER, red=MADNESS SCATTER. Red-green color blind users (deuteranopia/protanopia) cannot distinguish green from red scatter, risking wrong FS mode expectation.

FS mode backgrounds differ by color: orange-red (Standard), teal-green (No Miss), deep purple (Madness). Purple distinguishable by all color-blind profiles. Teal-green vs orange is safer than red vs green. No persistent mode text label confirmed visible during FS.

AMBIENT and SOUND FX independently toggleable in Settings. WIN amounts displayed as large numerals. FS mode identified by background color change (requires color vision). WILD HOOK vs MISS needs clear visual differentiation beyond audio cues.

Multiplier bar shows bold yellow text on dark gray stone (high contrast): 2x/4x/8x/16x escalating up to 512x. DEAD PANEL shows destroyed values as text (e.g. 16x, 8x). Win amounts displayed as large bright white or yellow numerals. High contrast UI labels.

SPACE or ENTER starts/stops spin (keyboard shortcuts). HOLD SPACE activates turbo spin (sustained keypress may challenge motor-impaired users). Autoplay configurable with spin count and loss/win limit stops, reducing repeated activation burden.

6x6 grid is fully canvas-based with no DOM text labels. Requires audio events for: WILD HOOK vs MISS, multiplier value changes, DEAD PANEL additions, cluster win amounts per tumble, FREE SPINS LEFT counter updates, FS mode name on trigger, win screen total.
Royal letters A/K/Q/J share the same silver/chrome color with no per-letter color-coding, distinguished only by letter shape.

WILD (purple disc with gold 'WILD' text) vs GOLDEN WILD (plain gold disc, no text) differ mainly by hue -- a color-vision-deficient player may confuse them at a glance; the 'WILD' text on the standard WILD is a partial non-color cue.
Paytable/rules navigation (previous/close/next) uses green-outlined triangle/X/triangle glyphs, distinguishable by shape, not color alone.
Bonus buy dialog cancel (red X) vs confirm (green checkmark) are distinguished by both color and glyph shape.

No audio-only information observed; music (AMBIENT MUSIC) and sound effects (SOUND FX) are decorative and independently toggleable in Settings; all game state (wins, spins left, multipliers, triggers) is conveyed via on-screen text.
CREDIT and BET labels render in high-contrast yellow/orange text on a dark purple background; win amounts and 'SUPERB!' celebration text are high-contrast gold/yellow on dark backgrounds.
Free-spins-left count, total win and per-reel multiplier values are shown as large printed numbers on high-contrast plates/boxes.

Large round click targets with the central SPIN button the largest; SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin, holding SPACE engages turbo spin; Autoplay (adjustable spin count plus Skip Screens) reduces required interactions.

Stable control layout: hamburger-menu, sound and info icons cluster at bottom-far-left; BUY FEATURE and Ante Bet panel stacked vertically on the far left above the reels; bet -/+ flank the central round SPIN button with AUTOPLAY directly beneath it.
Royal symbols are distinguished by their printed letter, not color alone: A is red, R is purple/magenta, Q is blue, J is green.
Right-side control bar icons (star, play-triangle, coin-stack, circular spin arrows) are identified by shape, not by color.
Bonus Buy purchase buttons are red with white 'BUY' text, identifiable by the text label rather than the red color alone.
Push Bet toggle state (on/off) is shown by switch position plus a text banner reading 'PUSH BET - INCREASE chance to win feature', not by color alone.
Rules-panel section headers carry a red vertical accent bar for position, but are also marked by bold white text, not by color alone.
Settings sound toggles use a speaker icon with or without a cross/mute mark through it, distinguishable by shape rather than color.
All feature triggers, wins and RTP figures are shown as on-screen text; Sound Effects, Music and All Sounds can each be muted independently in Settings without losing any game information.
Symbol payout numbers are plain white/gold text on dark tiles next to each icon, high-contrast and legible independent of icon color.
Free Spins award numbers and round win totals are shown as large embossed text on dark panels, high-contrast against the background.
The selected Autoplay option is a solid white pill with black text versus grey pills with white text for the rest, a high-contrast selection state.

Settings toggles show state by switch position (left=off/right=on) plus an icon in the knob, not color alone. Paytable nav controls are shape-differentiated (left-triangle/X/right-triangle), not color-coded. Free-spins progress ladders always carry explicit numeric text (WILDS ADDED 10/15/25/50, ALL WINS X2/X3/X4/X5). Royal letter symbols are colored (A gold, K magenta/pink, Q green, J red/crimson, 10 blue) but are distinguished primarily by the letter/number glyph, not hue.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles. Win amounts, feature triggers, spins/tiers remaining and multiplier level are all shown as on-screen text and numeric labels.
CREDIT/BET/WIN readouts are large gold/orange text on a dark brown bottom bar (high contrast); win-screen 'WINNER' text is large white/gold on the dark reel background, legible without close vision.

Large round click targets; SPIN doubles as SPIN/STOP toggle. SPACE and ENTER are keyboard alternatives to clicking SPIN. The 'Pick a Scroll' random modifier interrupts autoplay and SKIP SCREENS, requiring one manual click on a scroll before autoplay resumes.

Win amounts appear as large gold/yellow high-contrast overlay numbers on a black background; monetary values, headings and key button labels use gold/yellow, warnings/BUY use red, all against the uniform black-brick background.

Large round spin button; stake and autoplay each open a pop-up with big buttons (autoplay 10, 25, 50, 75, 100 spins); the spacebar may start a spin depending on jurisdiction and operator; no hold-to-spin option seen.

Bottom-bar icons (hamburger menu, speaker/sound, info 'i', circular spin arrows, +/-) are white glyphs on dark circular buttons distinguished by shape, not by color.

Canvas-rendered game with no native DOM/ARIA structure; a screen reader cannot access game state directly, though all numeric state (balance, bet, win, ways, free-spins remaining, jackpot amounts) is rendered as on-screen text/digits rather than purely graphical indicators.

Bottom status bar shows BALANCE/WIN (or TAKE)/BET labels in muted grey capitalised text with bright yellow numeric values beside each, high contrast against the near-black bar.

Settings toggle switches show state via handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey/green fill color.

Central SPIN button is the largest click target; SPACE/ENTER also start/stop the spin (keyboard-operable), holding SPACE engages turbo; Autoplay with configurable spin count and Skip Screens reduces required clicks.

Feature state (free spins remaining, current win, buy-bonus price) is always shown as on-screen text alongside iconography; control layout is stable: menu+sound far-left, info button beside them, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, autoplay adjacent.
Four suit symbols differ by shape (spade, heart, club, diamond) and not only by color: red spade, magenta-pink heart, blue club, green diamond.

Paytable, Rules and Bet Options are real DOM text readable by a screen reader; reels and counters are drawn on canvas without DOM text.

Paying symbols are told apart by picture and shape, not colour alone. The four stone-tile suits differ by shape (spade, heart, club, green diamond gem) as well as by colour (purple, dusty red, blue, green).
Framed symbols are marked by a gold-orange thorny vine frame with green corner leaves, a shape cue, not only a colour cue. The Wild is an emerald-green and gold emblem with a gold letter W.
No sound information is needed to read results; a Sound toggle is in the bottom navigation.

Ways count, balance, bet and win are printed as numbers; the multiplier is shown as large xN digits (gold in base game, green in free spins). Paytable and Rules panels are real text on dark charcoal with white text and orange values.
Wins are shown by numbers on the field and the WIN plate plus a glow; Turbo state is shown by a slash through the lightning icon.

Space key starts a spin on PC, holding Space continues, Space skips reel animation. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 and 1000 spins; a Max Bet button exists; there is no Skip Screens switch in this build.

Jackpot tiers doubly redundant: colour (SUPER GRAND=dark red/maroon, GRAND=green, MAJOR=orange, MINOR=purple/magenta, MINI=blue) is backed by explicit tier-name text, a numeric pip-count meter (2/4/6/8/10 pips) and a dollar amount. Toggle switches show state via colour (green=on) AND knob position; Ante Bet also shows explicit ON/OFF text with a check-mark icon. Winning symbols are marked with a light-blue/white glow outline (shape), not colour alone. Win-tier magnitude uses distinct wording ('NICE!' vs 'SENSATIONAL!'), not colour alone.

No game state is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative/atmospheric. All game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, jackpot awards, bet, credit) is presented as on-screen text/numbers.

Win amounts, jackpot badge amounts, CREDIT/BET readouts and free-spins counters are rendered in large gold/yellow lettering with dark red/brown drop-shadow outlines against the purple/neon background; the preview screen's max-win banner ('WIN UP TO 5000X BET') is large white 3D text with a blue glow.

Large circular click targets for SPIN and the menu/sound/info icons. SPACE and ENTER also spin (keyboard-operable); holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin. Autoplay offers a configurable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option, reducing the number of required interactions for extended play.

Stable control layout: hamburger-menu, sound and info icons cluster bottom-left; bet +/- flank the central SPIN button; AUTOPLAY sits directly below SPIN. The 8-page paytable/rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence (prev/next one page at a time, 'Page N/8' always shown, X to close). Buy-feature and Ante Bet controls are permanently docked at top-left of the base game, not nested in a menu, so their enabled/disabled/ON/OFF state is always visible.

Jackpot tiers are labelled by name (MAJOR/GRAND/MINI) in addition to badge color (dark red, magenta/purple, green); WILD and JACKPOT reel symbols carry their own text label inside the cell besides a distinct frame color; navigation arrows are distinguished by triangle-left/X/triangle-right shape even though all three are rendered green; free-spins mode is signalled by a full background and frame color shift (daytime teal-green to night-time blue, grey stone frame to darker cyan-trimmed frame) plus explicit 'FREE SPINS LEFT' text, not by color alone.

System Settings toggle state is shown by physical switch position (left=off, right=on) plus a pause-bar icon on the knob, not color alone; Autoplay checkboxes (Turbo Spin/Quick Spin/Skip Screens) combine fill color with an explicit white checkmark glyph.

No game state is conveyed by sound only; ambient music and sound effects are decorative and independently toggleable (AMBIENT MUSIC, SOUND FX in System Settings). Spins left, win amounts, jackpot values and feature triggers are all shown as on-screen text and numbers.

High-contrast presentation throughout: orange/gold 3D text and win amounts on dark teal/purple backgrounds; jackpot ticker badges are large pill shapes with white dollar values on saturated red/magenta/green fills; the base game's grey stone reel frame changes to a darker near-black frame with cyan trim in free spins, giving a strong overall brightness and color shift as a mode cue.

All primary controls are large round targets; SPACE and ENTER can start and stop a spin without the mouse. Autoplay offers a configurable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option that auto-skips feature intro/outro screens, reducing the number of clicks needed to play many rounds.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across screens: hamburger menu and sound icons far left, a separate 'i' info icon just to their right, CREDIT/BET readout center-left, bet -/+ around the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY beneath SPIN. The paytable/rules booklet is one continuous linear sequence of 7 pages (paytable content pages 1-4, rules content pages 5-7), navigated with the same left-arrow/X/right-arrow control on every page.

WILD is a large teal/jade butterfly filling the whole tile with visible wing veining; do not confuse with the small plain gold/yellow decorative butterfly that flutters beside royal-letter symbols as idle animation - it is NOT the WILD and differs in size, shape detail and color (teal vs gold)

the 5 flower symbols are differentiated by petal shape as well as color (layered lotus vs ruffled peony vs cupped rose with dark center vs pom-pom chrysanthemum vs star-pointed blue lotus); gold lotus, orange-red rose and green lotus may still be harder to tell apart by color alone under red-green color blindness - blue lotus is the most distinct
royal letters (A/K/Q/J/10/9) are safe for color-blind users because the letter/number itself is the primary identifier, color is secondary

no audio-only information observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are independently toggleable and purely decorative; all game state (win amounts, free spins left, multiplier, respin prices, feature triggers) is conveyed redundantly in on-screen text

the individual-reel-respin 'disabled' button state (grey vs purple/magenta) relies mainly on color/luminance contrast rather than an added glyph or text change - a residual risk; screen-reader/ARIA disabled-state semantics would be a safer fix

the 5 per-reel RESPIN buttons are smaller than the main SPIN button and sit close together under the reels, harder to target precisely; no keyboard shortcut for individual-reel respin was found on the info pages; SPACE/ENTER remain available for the main SPIN action

control positions are stable across every screen (menu+sound bottom-left, larger 'i' info button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY below SPIN); the info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence navigated with previous/close/next controls and a 'Page N/7' counter
Low-value gems are distinguishable by shape as well as colour: red ruby is square-cut, green gem is diamond/rhombus-shaped, pink gem is round/octagonal, blue gem is hexagonal.
Volatility badge communicates level by the COUNT of gold lightning bolts (5 of 5 filled) plus the word 'VOLATILITY', not colour alone.
Grid multiplier badges show the numeral (e.g. 'x2', 'x8') rather than relying on badge colour alone. Special-bet activation is shown as a text-labelled 'ACTIVE' box, not just a colour change.
Toggle switches in System Settings (Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen) show state by handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to colour (white=off, green=on).

No audio-only information identified; Ambient Music and Sound FX are purely decorative toggles. All game state (win amounts, spins remaining, active special bet, gamble odds) is conveyed through on-screen text.

CREDIT and BET labels are gold/orange high-contrast text on a dark translucent strip; win-tier banners and round-summary cards always carry the numeric amount as large high-contrast text rather than relying on iconography.

All primary controls are large round or pill hit-targets. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin. Autoplay (configurable spin count, default 100) and Skip Screens (default ON) both reduce the number of required clicks/taps during long free-spins rounds.

The mid-round win-tier celebration banner (e.g. 'SENSATIONAL! $159.20') can show a SMALLER amount than the simultaneous running-total footer ('WIN $164.80') at the same instant, because the banner shows a per-spin/per-tumble amount, not the round total. A screen reader must not announce the banner amount as the final round result; the true round total is only the closing 'YOU HAVE WON $X IN N FREE SPINS' card shown at the very end of a free-spins round.

Control layout is stable across every screen: hamburger-menu and sound icons stacked bottom-left, a separate 'i' info icon to their right opening the 8-page rules booklet (a strictly linear sequence, two directional controls plus a close control), CREDIT/BET labels centre-left, bet -/+ flanking the spin button, AUTOPLAY beneath it.
Every symbol is distinguished by shape as well as colour (jaguar heads vs frog vs gem shapes vs card-suit outlines); mid-tier gems and low-tier suits stay identifiable by shape alone.
Coin denominations are always confirmed by a printed number on the tile, never by tile colour alone.
The Push Bet toggle is confirmed by both colour (green=on/grey=off) and knob position (right=on/left=off).

Settings expose three independent audio toggles (All Sounds, Sound Effects, Music); no game information (RTP, bet, win amounts, feature states) depends on audio alone, all of it is also shown as on-screen text.
All panel text (paytable, rules, settings, autoplay, bet-select, know-the-game) is white/cream on a near-black background for high contrast; the in-game HUD is white on a semi-opaque black bar.
The row-multiplier ladder and life-ladder pips beside the Free Drop board are small and tightly stacked (about 70x70px at 1280x800); zooming may be needed to tell the active tier from inactive ones.

Spin can be triggered by the on-screen button or the keyboard space bar; Quick Play (space bar or tap anywhere) skips animations to shorten a round; Autoplay supports up to 1000 consecutive rounds without repeated manual input.

The six fruit symbols are distinguishable by shape and size as well as colour: pomegranate's crown shape, pineapple's leafy top and scale texture, watermelon's stripes, peach's teardrop shape, blackberry's clustered-bumps texture, blueberry's plain round shape.

Instant Prize denomination is always confirmed by a printed number on the coin disc, not by tile colour alone; different values additionally use silver/pewter (lower) versus warm-gold (higher) tones only as a secondary, non-essential cue.
The Wild Jar Symbol's accumulated multiplier is shown as a printed 'xN' text badge on the jar, not conveyed by colour alone.

Settings expose three independent audio toggles (All Sounds, Sound Effects, Music); no gameplay information observed (triggers, results, free-spin counter, win banners, multiplier badges) is conveyed by sound alone, all of it also appears as on-screen text or graphics.
Balance, Total Bet and Win values are shown in large, high-contrast white-on-dark-charcoal bold text in the bottom bar; paytable numbers are similarly high-contrast white-on-near-black.

The currently-selected bet or autoplay option is marked by a light-grey/white fill-brightness change on the button rather than a shape or checkmark change, which may be hard to distinguish at low vision without additional magnification.

A single space-bar shortcut covers both Spin and the Quick-Play skip function; Autoplay supports 10 to 1000 consecutive spins with configurable loss-limit and single-win-limit stops, reducing the number of repeated manual actions required.

The six fruit symbols remain distinguishable without color perception via shape and surface texture: bumpy raspberry vs smooth plum, star-leaf strawberry vs star-calyx orange vs crown-calyx blueberry vs stemmed apple. Payout tiers are labelled with plain numerals rather than color bands.

The Jam Jar's growing strength is always printed as a plain number on the jar, not conveyed by jar color alone; the active navigation-rail icon is shown by white-vs-grey brightness and by its fixed position in the rail, not by hue.

No audio-only information was observed on any captured screen; balance, bet, win amount, free-spins count, feature triggers and RTP are all conveyed as on-screen text. Sound is purely decorative and independently toggleable (All Sounds / Sound Effects / Music).

Large circular Spin button; the keyboard space bar is a documented alternative to clicking Spin and to skipping animations in Quick Play. Autoplay (selectable spin count, loss limit and single-win limit) reduces the number of required manual actions.

A fixed 5-icon panel-switch rail is always in the same order and position (Autoplay, Total Bet, Paytable, Settings, Game Info). A persistent bottom status bar shows plain-text BALANCE/TOTAL BET/WIN readouts. The rules booklet and paytable are strictly linear multi-page sequences reached from the same rail icon.

MONEY/BONUS/WILD/SCATTER are identified by icon shape and text labels (e.g. dollar-value banners, 'WILD', 'SCATTER'), not color alone; royal letters A/K/Q/J/10 are color-coded (red/yellow/green/purple/light-blue respectively) but each is also a distinct alphanumeric glyph, so identity does not depend on color perception

base game uses a bright teal/turquoise reel frame and daylight blue-sky jungle background; Free Spins switches to a dark maroon/wine-red reel background and a dim volcanic cave scene with orange/red lava cracks, giving a strong non-color brightness/scene cue for mode changes

no game information is conveyed by audio alone; Ambient Music and Sound FX are purely decorative toggles; all state (win amounts, free spins remaining, money-meter values/progress, feature triggers) is shown as on-screen text

WILD is a gold medallion shaped like a mask with a turquoise headband and red gem accents; SCATTER is a golden stepped pyramid on a teal card labeled 'SCATTER'; BONUS is an Aztec chief portrait with a yellow feather headdress and turquoise/gold facial jewelry

primary controls are large round/rectangular click targets; SPACE and ENTER start/stop a spin, holding SPACE triggers turbo spin; Autoplay (adjustable spin count, optional Skip Screens) reduces the number of required manual actions

bottom bar layout is stable across all screens: menu+sound icons far-left, 'i' info button next to them, CREDIT/BET text labels left-of-center, SPIN center-right flanked by -/+ bet buttons, AUTOPLAY below SPIN; the 7-page rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence with the same prev/close/next controls and a 'Page N/7' readout on every page

WILD is a magenta/purple genie figure and SCATTER is a golden dome icon, both labelled with 'WILD'/'SCATTER' text; card royals A/K/Q/J are distinguished primarily by letter shape (red/green/purple/blue color is a secondary cue); Settings toggle switches show state by knob position (left=off/right=on) as well as track color; Autoplay checkboxes use a white checkmark glyph, not color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable in Settings and default to on. All game state (wins, spins remaining, feature trigger/end, implied multiplier count) is presented as on-screen text and imagery.

All interactive targets are large circular/pill buttons; SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop a spin (keyboard-operable, no click required), and holding SPACE engages turbo spin. Autoplay up to a slider-selected spin count (observed default 100) and the SKIP SCREENS option reduce required clicking during Free Spins.

Control layout is stable across all screens: menu+sound icons bottom-left, info 'i' button beside them, CREDIT/BET readout left-of-center, bet +/- flank the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly beneath SPIN. The rules/paytable booklet is a strictly linear 6-page sequence navigated with left/right arrows and a center close, with an explicit 'Page N/6' readout on every page.

Symbol colors: spade blue, diamond orange/gold, heart red/pink, club green, swirl candies pink/orange/purple, WILD yellow lemon slice. All differentiated primarily by icon shape (suit-glyph vs swirl vs lemon) not just hue. Toggle switches pair color with handle position, checkboxes pair color with a checkmark glyph, and the volatility badge pairs lit-bolt color with a literal count (3 of 5) rather than color alone.

No audio-only information observed on any captured screen; sound is a purely optional toggle and all game state (win amount, bet, credit, multiplier values, autoplay count) is conveyed as on-screen text/numerals.

Win amounts and prompts render as large bold white text on saturated pink/gold gradient banners; balance labels (CREDIT/BET) are bold yellow on a dark bottom bar; win state is additionally confirmed by an explicit 'WINNER' text label, not color or size alone.

Spin, bet +/-, and menu controls are large circular click targets clustered in the lower-middle of the narrow play column. No keyboard shortcut (SPACE/ENTER) for spin was found in the captured rules text. Autoplay (adjustable up to at least 100 spins, with a SKIP SCREENS option) reduces manual actions needed for extended sessions.

Bottom icon row has a stable left-to-right order across all screens: info -> spin-history -> spin-speed -> bet-menu -> hamburger menu. The GAME RULES/INFORMATION overlay is one continuous vertical scroll sheet (drag to scroll), not paginated via next/prev buttons.

Game state (free-spins count, win amounts, multipliers) is always shown as printed numbers/words in addition to color; toggle switches use handle position (left=off, right=on) as well as green fill; navigation icons use distinct arrow/cross shapes, not color alone.

Residual color dependence: SUPER SPIN 1 (teal/white star border) vs SUPER SPIN 2 (gold star border) special-bet cards are distinguished mainly by border color, but both also carry distinct text labels and prices.
BUY FEATURE (blue candy-stripe) and SPECIAL BETS (magenta candy-stripe) side buttons are also distinguished by button label text, not color alone.

Paytable symbol cards use colored borders as a secondary cue only (red, purple, magenta, light-blue, gold, teal); each symbol is primarily identified by its printed name/shape, not by card color alone.
No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative — all wins, spin counts, and multipliers are shown as on-screen text/graphics.

Body text in the 8-page info booklet is white/light on a dark translucent panel for high contrast; volatility and max-win text on the preview splash are large high-contrast text rather than color-coded.

All primary controls are large circular/rounded targets, SPIN being the largest on screen; SPACE and ENTER give keyboard-only spin control; Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option to reduce required interactions.

Control layout is stable across screens: hamburger-menu and speaker icons at far bottom-left, 'i' info button beside them, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY just below/right of SPIN; BUY FEATURE and SPECIAL BETS stack at the left edge of the reel frame during base game. The 8-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigable with two arrow controls plus a close (X).

State is conveyed by text as well as color: the main action button always carries a printed label (Start / Hit Stone! / Cash Out + amount) alongside its green/gold fill; the AUTO START toggle uses handle position (left=off, right=on) plus track color; Sound/Music sliders use handle position plus distinct muted/active speaker icons, not color alone.

No audio-only information was observed. Sound and Music are separate toggles/sliders that appear decorative/ambient; balance, multiplier, Bank, limits, RTP, and version are all presented as on-screen text, so the game is fully playable without sound.

Balance, multiplier, and Bank amounts are large bold high-contrast white/green text on a dark background; the Cash Out button also prints the exact dollar amount, not just its gold fill. The exception is a lost round: there is no red flash, icon, or enlarged 'you lost' text -- the only visible change is the balance number not having increased.

Only two controls need repeated interaction: the stone itself (must be clicked repeatedly to raise the multiplier) and the single large round main-action button, which is reused for Start / Hit Stone! / Cash Out. Bet Amount +/- buttons are small round targets pressed individually per unit change, with no drag or slider alternative for setting the bet.

A lost round (pickaxe breaks before Cash Out) produces no dedicated text or banner -- the field silently reverts to the idle 'Start' label with the balance simply not increased. There is no announced 'you lost' message, so a screen-reader user has no textual cue distinguishing a finished losing round from a round that has not yet resolved.

7 gem symbols distinguished by shape: Pink=hexagonal filigree frame; Red=rotated-rhombus frame; Teal=pentagon pointed-bottom frame; Green=axis-aligned square frame; Purple=unframed round brilliant; Orange=unframed heart; Blue=unframed compact hexagon
High-value gems (Pink/Red/Teal/Green) have gold frames; lower-value gems (Purple/Orange/Blue) are unframed — secondary grouping cue beyond individual shape
Scatter is the only large round brilliant-cut diamond on the grid — distinct from all regular gems by circular facet pattern and larger apparent size within its cell
Multiplier tokens are gold circular badges with bold x2 or x4 text — identifiable by text label independent of color
All critical info — win amounts, free spins count remaining, feature trigger, congratulations screen — communicated via on-screen text labels and numeric displays; no info exclusive to audio
Settings toggles have both color (grey=off, green=on) and positional (left=off, right=on) cues; win history panel uses symbol icon plus text count plus dollar amount, not color alone

Space/Enter keyboard shortcuts for spin start/stop; Autoplay with configurable spin count (slider, up to 100); Skip Screens option reduces required interactions during feature intro/outro; Turbo Spin mode available

All win amounts shown as text in bottom strip (WIN $X.XX) and left win-history panel (icon + count + multiplier badge + dollar amount). Feature labels text-based: FREE SPINS LEFT N, FREE SPINS COMPLETED
No outcome depends on hue alone: winning cells get a bright gold glow outline while all other cells darken (a brightness cue). Wild and Scatter carry the printed words WILD and SCATTER on the tile.

Royals K (salmon pink) and Q (bronze brown) are close in hue but differ by letter shape. In free spins reels 1 and 6 stay crimson red and reels 2-5 turn purple; the +1 Free Spin symbol is only on reels 1 and 6 and carries the printed text +1 FREESPIN.
In Paytable and Rules panels symbol counts are white and payout values amber, also separated by column position. BIG WIN banner is electric cyan-blue with gold-outlined letters.
All feature information appears as text or symbols (7 FREE SPINS WON, sticky wild ticker, REMAINING FREE SPIN, BIG WIN, TOTAL WIN). Sound can be toggled in the menu; nothing visible depends on sound.

Dark charcoal grey-blue panels with white and amber headings and light grey body text; reel field is deep crimson inside a thin bright gold rim. Wins use glowing outlines and sparkles; BIG WIN uses a bright cyan flash panel.
Only single taps; Space key spins on PC; Turbo and Auto cut repeated taps; no timing-critical input. Bet Options wheels are scroll gestures, but Max Bet is a single tap.

Everything is drawn on a canvas with no verified text alternative. State lives in banners: rolling banner under the field, WIN banner, REMAINING FREE SPIN counter, TOTAL WIN banner and the balance, bet and win read-outs. Paytable, Rules, Bet Options and Auto Spin are overlay pages with real text.
MONEY scarab colours (blue, green, red, golden) are duplicated by the currency amount printed on the beetle body during play; colour is not needed to read the value.
Winning symbols are marked with a gold jewelled frame and sparkles, plus a text line such as '7X 10 PAYS $4.80 ON 12 WAYS' at the bottom.
Synchronized reels are marked by a golden background and by the identical symbols themselves.
Low pay symbols are distinguished by letter shape (A, K, Q, J, 10) in addition to colour (red, purple, magenta-pink, green, light blue).
Autoplay and settings toggles combine colour (green on, white off) with check marks and the slider-handle position.
Special bet cards ANTE BET and SUPER SPIN are separated by a text label and price; the selected card has a golden border instead of the white border of the unselected one.

Win and state information is printed as text (banners SUPERB!, CONGRATULATIONS!, RESPINS LEFT counter, GOOD LUCK!, SPIN TO WIN!); sound can be toggled with the sound button and the AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX switches.
SPACE and ENTER start and stop the spin; HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN; autoplay up to 100 spins selectable with a slider; the spin speed button cycles normal, quick and turbo.
The game is canvas-rendered; no DOM text is readable on the booklet panel, so a screen reader would get nothing from the canvas.

The three Celtic-knot/clover paying symbols are distinguishable by shape without colour: the red knot has sharp pointed star/petal tips, the green clover is a thin open-loop quatrefoil with visible gem dots, the purple knot is a rounded closed pretzel-loop shape.
The four jackpot tokens (MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/MEGA) each carry their own printed name text in addition to their accent colour, so identity does not rely on colour alone.
The Volatility widget communicates its value by the count of lit bars (1 of 5 for this game), not by colour alone.
The Cash Booster meter communicates its value by which tile (X1-X5+) is highlighted, with the multiplier number printed on every tile regardless of state.

All game state changes (wins, feature triggers, jackpot collections) are also communicated visually via on-screen text/numbers and animated banners, not audio alone; the Settings panel allows muting All Sounds / Sound Effects / Music independently.

Every payout, bet, balance, RTP and feature-award figure observed is rendered as large on-screen printed text rather than encoded only in an icon or animation, which is favourable for screen magnification.

The keyboard space bar can be pressed to start a spin and again to skip round animations (Quick Play). Autoplay presets (10/20/50/100/250/500/1000 spins, or Off) reduce the need for repeated manual clicks.

The active bet-mode tab is distinguished by both a lighter/raised plaque shape AND bold blue text, not by hue alone. Board tiles all share the identical teal background and are told apart purely by illustration plus printed number text - the board itself uses no colour-coding at all.
Win state is communicated through large printed text amounts and a real balance change (verified by balance delta, not just the popup claim), not through colour alone.

No audio-only information was observed; all round outcomes (win amount, drawn animals/numbers, balance) are presented as on-screen text/graphics. Sound appears decorative/ambient only, controlled by a single mute toggle.

All interactive targets (animal tiles, digit pad, bet stepper arrows, mode tabs, header icons, bottom-bar buttons) are large, well-separated wooden buttons or square board tiles - no small or fine-motor-demanding controls observed. Autoplay via press-and-hold reduces the number of discrete clicks needed for repeated play, though it requires a sustained press rather than a single tap.

Control layout is stable across all captured states: header icons (history?/rules?/sound) top-right; bet-mode tab row directly under the title; 25-tile animal board centre; draw crates fixed left; BETS panel fixed right; bottom bar (Balance / Random / Play-Rebet / bet stepper / History) fixed at the bottom. Every board tile carries its own printed number range as a text label, an alternative identifier to the animal illustration.
Every animal tile carries its four numbers as text under the icon, and the animals differ in silhouette as well as colour, so nothing depends on hue alone. Bet types are selected by named tabs.

A dark navy screen with a 5x5 grid of brightly coloured animal icons in flat gradients; the results column on the left shows five empty slots marked with question marks until the draw. The action button is a wide green PLAY.

Selections are single clicks on large tiles, and RANDOM fills them automatically. Autoplay needs a press-and-hold on the play button rather than a click, which is the one gesture that requires sustained input.

Settings toggle switches show on/off by BOTH switch position (left=off, right=on) and color (grey=off, green=on) — position is the redundant non-color cue.
SCATTER vs SUPER SCATTER differ by emblem shape (plain gold gem vs gold masonic-style diamond) and by glowing halo color (purple vs red), not by color alone.
