Residual risk: GREEN SCATTER (emerald green) and DIAMOND SCATTER (light-blue/white), both labelled 'SCATTER', differ mainly by gem hue/plaque tint; the buy-confirmation NO/YES buttons share identical maroon/pink styling, told apart only by text.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles. Win amounts, free spins left, matrix-unlock progress, retrigger counts and bet values are all conveyed through on-screen text/icons.

Key state text (win amounts, free spins left, spin counts, MIN/MAX BET, RTP) is rendered as large high-contrast gold-on-dark or white-on-dark text throughout the base game, free spins and win screens.

All primary targets are large round buttons (SPIN is the largest). SPACE/ENTER are keyboard equivalents to start/stop spin, and HOLD SPACE engages turbo spin, reducing discrete clicks. Autoplay (with a SKIP SCREENS option) further reduces required interactions during Free Spins.

Control layout is stable across all base-game/feature screens: menu + sound stacked far-left, 'i' info button next to them, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, autoplay below spin, Buy-Free-Spins placard fixed at the far-left edge. The 6-page rules booklet is strictly linear (prev/next/close) with a redundant 'Page n/6' textual indicator on every page.

Toggle switches (ANTE BET, all SETTINGS toggles) use handle position plus an explicit ON/OFF word, not color alone; paytable navigation triangles are differentiated by shape (left-triangle/X/right-triangle); the BUY FREE SPINS confirm/cancel buttons use a checkmark vs an X icon in addition to green/red; free-spin counts and prize values are always printed as text. Residual risk: the royal letters A/K (red-orange) vs Q (green) vs J (blue) rely partly on color to distinguish letter identity at a glance, though the letter shape itself remains legible.

Free Spins state is signalled both by a full background palette shift (green daylight base game to red/orange sunset Free Spins) and by explicit text ('FREE SPINS LEFT n', 'WIN $'), not by color alone.

No information is conveyed through audio only; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC toggles are purely decorative/optional. All game state (wins, spins remaining, feature status, prize values, bet amounts) is conveyed through on-screen text and imagery.

All primary controls are large circular touch targets; SPIN is the largest single control. SPACE and ENTER can start/stop a spin without the mouse, and holding SPACE activates turbo spin. AUTOPLAY (configurable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option) reduces the number of required interactions for repeated play.

Control positions are stable across all screens: menu + sound icons at the far bottom-left, the 'i' info button just to their right, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, the large circular SPIN button at the far right with bet +/- immediately around it, AUTOPLAY just below/beside SPIN. The rules/paytable booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence navigated with left-triangle/X/right-triangle and a 'Page n/7' indicator, always in the same position.

The number on the platform the hero stands on is bright green, numbers on upcoming platforms are cyan, but the hero position and a white X marker over the next platform show the target as well. Active CASHOUT is yellow, inactive is grey with the amount unchanged. Bonus platforms have gold frames against steel grey in the base game, duplicated by the TOTAL WIN banner and the FREE BETS LEFT text. The only colour-only cue is the green versus cyan tint of the numbers, which has no functional meaning beyond hero position.
Sound and Music toggles exist in the menu. As far as seen, no outcome depends on sound, since results appear on screen. The sound content itself was not examined.

Platform multipliers are printed as numbers directly on the platforms, and the CASHOUT button carries the current amount as text. Difficulty is labelled with a word (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD), not only by colour. GO and play are marked by shape and word.

The outcome of an ordinary round is not announced by text: there is no banner, the field simply returns to its initial state. A fall is shown only by animation (the platform splits and drops) and by the CASHOUT button going grey while still showing the last amount. Win banners (BIG Win, MEGA Win) appear only after bonuses.

The menu has a toggle Space to spin and go, which lets the player move forward with the Space key (rule 6 of How to play). A SPEED selector speeds up animations. Buttons are large. There is no autoplay and no auto cash-out in the interface.
Winning symbols are marked by a glowing light-green leafy frame, a thin drawn gold line, a printed amount on the symbol and a line-number badge, so colour is not the only cue.
Sticky symbols in free spins sit in rectangular wooden-and-vine frames (shape cue); the first sticky cell in the middle of reel 3 has a golden frame with a Greek-key border.

Win banners differ by wording as well as colour: BIG WIN has blue lettering on a blue light-shaft background, SUPER MEGA WIN has red-orange lettering on a blazing orange-yellow background; the amount is golden.
Fruit of similar hue differ in silhouette: red apple, magenta plum pair and red-and-green watermelon; yellow star fruit and yellow banana bunch differ strongly in shape.

Control buttons (spin, minus, plus, turbo, auto) are distinguished by icon shape and position, not colour. The selected auto-spin value (10) shows gold text on a warm brown pill against grey text on dark pills for the others; Max Bet dims when unavailable.
Wins, features and banners are all visual (printed numerals, banners, glow); no frame indicates sound-only cues. A Sound toggle is in the bottom menu row.

Base game is a night jungle in deep blue and teal with a near-black teal reel field; free spins switch to a bright golden-yellow temple scene with warm green sky and burning torches. UI panels are dark charcoal-slate with white titles, mid-grey body text and golden-yellow numbers.

Balance, bet, WIN, TOTAL WIN and FREE SPINS REMAINING are printed as golden-yellow numerals. The grid is a regular 5 reels by 3 rows; line numbers 1 to 20 are printed in small green round tags on both sides of the field.
Wild and Scatter carry printed words (WILD, SCATTER) on the symbol itself, which helps magnified reading.

One tap per action. The spin button is about 190 px wide; plus, minus, turbo and auto about 80 px. On PC the Space key starts a spin, holding Space repeats, Space during a spin skips the reel animation. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 and 1000 spins; Turbo shortens spins.
Reels are a pure canvas with no text alternatives for symbols. The Paytable and Rules panels are real text panels; the game field is not.

A cycling marquee on a wooden plank in the header shows messages such as 'triggers 10 free spins' or '15 free spins' about 5 scatters; text changes about once a second and is cut by the frame edge. It is a hint, not the award of the current trigger.

High-value symbols are primarily distinguished by frame color (blue/orange/magenta/red/green for Gorilla/Tiger/Elephant/Parrot/Chameleon), but distinct animal artwork is the reliable non-color cue. Reel multipliers are shown as readable numeric text ('1X'-'5X') on every plaque regardless of its red/gold coloring. Toggle switches use handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to green/white fill. The volatility badge pairs a bolt-count with descriptive text ('Medium volatility...').

No audio-only information observed. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are decorative and independently toggleable in System Settings. All game state (multiplier values, win amounts, line numbers) is conveyed visually/textually.

Large round click targets, SPIN is the largest. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop a spin (keyboard-operable), holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin. Configurable Autoplay (observed default 100 spins) reduces the number of required manual actions.

Stable control layout across all screens: menu+sound icons far-left, 'i' info button just to their right, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. The GAME RULES booklet is a strictly linear 6-page sequence navigated with prev/close/next icons and a 'Page N/6' text indicator on every page.
Free Spins state is signalled by both a background palette shift (teal to navy) and explicit text counters ('Freespins n/n', 'MULTIPLIER nX', 'COLLECTED n/target'), not by color alone.
The top-edge symbol-legend strip marks symbols already converted to Butterfly with an added butterfly-shaped badge icon in addition to color (grayscale vs colored), not by color alone.
Payline diagrams pair a light-teal (active) vs dark-green (inactive) cell contrast with a printed line number below each diagram, so lines are identifiable without relying on the color contrast.
The six royal symbols (A, K, Q, J, 10, 9) are each a distinct wood-carved glyph shape as well as an individual color: red A, green K, teal/turquoise Q, orange/amber J, magenta/pink 10, blue/purple 9.
No information is conveyed by audio alone; Music and Sound FX are independently togglable, and all win amounts, feature states and prompts are shown as on-screen text/numerals.
Disabled controls (Quick Spin, Spacebar to spin checkboxes) are distinguished by dim grey text brightness plus the checkbox fill state, not only by hue.

Primary actions (Spin, Buy Bonus, Continue) are large single-click targets; bet adjustment offers both a small stepper and a full dropdown listing all 9 bet values, reducing clicks to reach extreme bets. Spacebar-to-spin and Quick Spin exist but were shown disabled/greyed-out (license-dependent).

Fixed control layout: info/settings icons bottom-far-left, Balance/Total bet center-left, Autoplay/Spin bottom-far-right, BUY BONUS/logo top-far-left (base game only, hidden during Free Spins); Payments and Help are two independently scrollable multi-page panels, each opened from the same 'i' button and closed via its own 'X'.

Symbols distinguished by subject/shape not color alone: Mammoth (shaggy quadruped), T-Rex (reptile head), Cavewoman (human figure with spear), Sabre-Tooth (cat with elongated fangs), Amber (round sphere with insect inside), Fire Torch (elongated stick with flame), card royals (unique letter shapes A/K/Q/J/10). WILD Volcano has 'WILD' text printed on symbol. Diamond scatter is the only faceted gem on the reels. FS mode indicated by top banner text 'ALL FREE SPINS WINS ARE MULTIPLIED BY 2X, 3X OR 4X' and 'FREE SPINS LEFT N' counter alongside the green vine reel frame.

All feature triggers and game states communicated via on-screen text: CONGRATULATIONS panel for FS award, 'FREE SPINS LEFT N' counter, '2x, 3x or 4x' multiplier banner, WIN $XX in bottom bar, retrigger banner '10 OR MORE DIAMOND RETRIGGER FEATURE'. No critical game information is conveyed by audio alone.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spins; HOLD SPACE activates Turbo Spin. Autoplay panel available with configurable spin count via slider and SKIP SCREENS option (checked by default) to reduce repeated manual interaction.

Win amounts shown as explicit dollar text (WIN $XX.XX, CREDIT $XX.XX, BET $2.50). Paytable values are plain text pairs (N of a kind = $X.XX). FS countdown shown as 'FREE SPINS LEFT N' text. No dedicated screen reader API detected in captured frames.
MINOR JACKPOT and GRAND JACKPOT plaques are visually identical (orange label on black background) and are told apart only by the text string, never by hue -- colour carries no information here.

The 25-line payline diagram highlights every line with the same single orange colour against a dark grey grid; lines are told apart by shape/position and the printed line number, never by colour-coding between lines.

The seven royal symbols (A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8) each sit on a distinct background tile colour (tan, coral-pink, pale khaki, mint green, red-orange, lavender-pink, magenta-purple) as a primary visual cue, but each also carries its own printed letter/number glyph as a reliable non-colour cue, since some tile-colour pairs could be confused under some colourblindness types.

The Hut/Canoe/Knife ignite effect adds an orange/yellow animated flame texture and shape distortion over the symbol, not just a colour shift, so the change stays perceivable without colour discrimination.
All primary actions (Spin, Bet Max, Auto Play, Coin +/-, Bet Level +/-) are large discrete on-screen buttons in a single horizontal row, plus a keyboard Space-bar shortcut to spin/stop the reels.

Auto Play offers fixed spin counts (10/20/30/50/100/500) with configurable stop conditions (balance decrease, single win exceeds an amount, feature triggered), reducing repeated manual input for extended play.

The only in-game indicator of which of the 25 fixed paylines won is a small 2-digit number badge; the 25-line shape diagram (booklet) should be exposed as alt-text/structured data so line numbers and shapes can be announced on wins.

The per-line win amount is shown only as a large graphical number overlaid on the reels, with no separate readable text element distinct from the service-bar WIN figure; a screen-reader adaptation needs to synthesise it from game state, not from the graphic.
MINOR JACKPOT and GRAND JACKPOT share one identical plaque shape/size/colour and are distinguished only by their text label, which is real (extractable) text rather than baked into an image font.

Low-value royals differ by letter shape and art, not just color: A is magenta/pink carved stone blocks, K is red/orange stone with gold trim, Q is a gold ring with a purple flower and a green serpent tail, J is a jade-green hook, and the lowest symbol is a grey stone tablet with wooden sticks tied by a green vine (no letter).

The four high-value symbols (serpent-head ring, sun-disc, stone idol, jade mask) are distinguished primarily by distinct artwork shape, but each also sits on a different background card color (red, purple, blue, green respectively) used as a secondary quick-recognition cue.

Sticky WILD tiles in free spins print their multiplier as text ('WILD x2', 'WILD x3', 'WILD x4') rather than relying on color alone, so the multiplier value stays readable without color discrimination.
No audio-only information observed; Music and Sound FX toggle independently in Settings, and all outcomes (wins, free-spins count, feature trigger) are also shown as on-screen text/graphics.

Headline numbers (bet, balance, free-spins counter n/12, win amounts, RTP 97.01%, max win 10000x) are shown as large high-contrast gold or ice-blue/white text on dark panels, not conveyed by color alone.

Bet adjustment uses only a small up/down stepper (no large +/- buttons observed in captured frames). Autoplay offers large discrete round-count buttons (10 up to 1000, plus unlimited), reducing the number of individual spin clicks needed.

Control layout is stable across all screens: info (i) and settings (gear) bottom-left, autoplay (A) and spin bottom-right, bet display/stepper bottom-center. The info booklet has two switchable sections (paytable via a money-bag icon, rules via a '?' icon) reached from the same 'i' button.
Premium symbols are colour-framed (magenta, purple, blue, orange, lime green) but each has a distinct character, so colour is redundant

Low symbols have no frame and differ by silhouette: rose, helmet, pom-poms, cassette player, sunglasses. Orange rocker vs orange cassette player and green nerd vs green sunglasses differ by shape and frame
SCATTER (silver-blue disco ball) and SUPER SCATTER (orange disco ball) have the same shape and differ only by colour plus paytable text
Toggle state is shown by knob position (left off, right on) as well as grey versus green; autoplay checkbox state shown by tick mark; special bet boxes (red, amber, yellow) are labelled by text
Volatility is shown as the text HIGH VOLATILITY with a wave icon, not by colour; the start button on the promo screen is identified by shape (circular arrows)
All outcomes are shown as text and numbers (WIN, LINE n PAYS, FREE SPINS LEFT, CONGRATULATIONS banners); sound toggles exist for music and effects; no information is audio-only in captured frames
Feature banners and bright neon glows; Battery Saver in SYSTEM SETTINGS reduces animation speed
Large spin button (about 130 px ring); SPACE and ENTER start and stop spin, holding SPACE gives turbo spin; autoplay and SKIP SCREENS reduce interaction; PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE on feature banners

Game is drawn on a canvas, no DOM text for the panel. Bottom bar order left to right: menu, sound, info, CREDIT, BET, minus, SPIN, plus, AUTOPLAY. Left panels BUY FEATURE and SPECIAL BETS open dialogs. Booklet pages 1/7 to 7/7 carry full text including limits

Every payable symbol is disambiguated by shape/pose/frame detail, not colour alone: the four High Win frogs and four Low Win tadpoles share a red/gold/blue/magenta colour code, but sit in identically shaped frames with the count tier and currency value printed as plain text next to each icon, so payouts remain readable from the numbers alone. The Wild (green) and Scatter (gold crown) are shape-distinct from all eight paying symbols. The Minor/Grand jackpot banners are distinguished by the printed words 'Minor'/'Grand', not colour. The Super Bet badge's on/off state is shown by a change in outline brightness AND its numeric price/label text changing, not colour alone.

All functional information observed (bet amounts, feature triggers, win totals, jackpot rules, feature purchase terms) is delivered as on-screen text; no audio-only cues were identified as necessary to understand outcomes from the captured frames.

Bet/balance/win readouts use plain high-contrast text in the bottom bar, but the large decorative win-amount overlay stamped over the reels is stylised artwork rather than plain text, making it a weaker channel for low-vision users than the footer strip's plain WIN figure.

Core actions are single-click/tap targets (SPIN, BET MAX, AUTO PLAY, COIN/BET LEVEL steppers, Buy Feature, Super Bet toggle) with no drag or timed-precision gestures observed; a spacebar shortcut is documented for starting and stopping the reels, giving a keyboard alternative to pointer clicks.

All monetary values, bet controls (BET, BET LEVEL, COIN, BALANCE) and toggle states in Settings/Autoplay are printed as plain on-screen text. However, the 'pays anywhere' win amount overlay (the large stylised win number stamped over the reels) is decorative custom-font artwork rather than a UI text element and could not be read by OCR in our own testing; the footer strip's plain-text WIN figure is the reliable source for that number.
Ranks A, K, Q, J are told apart by the printed letter and carved-stone shape (orange-gold, purple, green, dark red), animals by their pictures, so colour is never the only cue.
COLLECT (red) and GAMBLE (green) are the only red/green pair and both carry words on the buttons.
Locked symbols in Kong Respin are marked with a LOCKED text plank, not only by colour.
Wins are shown as framed cells plus a printed amount in the PAID cell, not by colour alone.
All feature information is also visual text; sound could not be assessed from frames.
Every feature state carries large on-screen text: modifier banners, SPINS LEFT, BONUS WIN, TOTAL WON.
Bottom bar is white text on black with BALANCE, BET and PAID cells; the stake window is a grid of 13 large buttons with the value printed on each.

Single-click spin; bonus screens need press anywhere; stake window is a large-button grid; autoplay offers 10 to 100 plays with loss and single-win limits; keyboard or hold-to-spin controls were not seen.
No screen-reader support could be verified from the captured frames.
Jackpot plaques are red MEGA, blue MAJOR and green MINOR, and each also carries the tier name as text.
Collect variants differ by border colour (green Collect, purple Expand, orange Cascade, blue Colossal, red Reel) and each has a title plate with its name.
Upgrade chests are blue Collect Boost, red Extra Spins, green Trail Boost, all with text labels; an active chest is open with shining gold, an inactive one is crossed by two ropes.
Power Play levels are a green, blue and orange panel, also told apart by the titles POWER PLAY, SUPER, ULTRA! and price plates 0.50, 1.00, 2.00 at base stake 0.10.
Royals A, K, Q, J, 10, 9 are orange-yellow, purple, green, red, blue, teal, and also differ by letter shape. Bonus chests come in red-orange, green and blue, all with BONUS lettering.
The three golden jackpot fish differ mainly by stripe colour (green, blue, red) but carry a MEGA or MINOR text tag when they are the jackpot.
The ways diagram in the rules uses a check mark and an X in addition to green and red. The selected stake in STAKE SELECT is shown by inverted fill, white against black.
Every event has a visible cue: GOOD LUCK, PAID, SCATTER PAYS, 1 WAY PAYS, BIG WIN and MEGA WIN titles, and the 13 ADDED caption. A sound button is at the bottom right.
STAKE, CREDIT, PAID, SPIN n/m, N SPINS LEFT, WINNINGS and jackpot titles are large high-contrast text, yellow or white on dark. Cash values on fish tags are small dark digits on cream tags.
All controls are on-screen round buttons of about 50-100 px; popups close with a visible X. Intro cards need PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE. Spacebar may start a spin depending on operator configuration.
Clicks on SPIN are ignored during win presentation, so a second click may be needed. Autoplay offers 10, 25, 50, 75 or 100 spins and is stopped with a STOP button.
The bottom strip with game name, clock, session time and net result is real HTML text. Win amounts on banners are decorative glyphs; a screen reader gets them only from the PAID line.

Payline diagrams in the paytable mark the active cells for each of the 5 lines with green fill against grey inactive cells, but the same pattern is also reproduced by row position (top/middle/bottom row, or diagonal V-shape), so it remains legible without green/grey discrimination.
Royal letter symbols J/Q/K/10 are colour-coded (red/purple/green/teal respectively), but each also carries a distinct letter or number glyph, so identity does not depend on colour alone.
No audio-only information was found; Music and Sound FX toggles in Settings are decorative ambience/SFX only. All win amounts, bonus multipliers, and RTP/rule text are conveyed as on-screen text.

The Buy Bonus price is shown as white text on a solid red plaque (high-contrast), not colour-only coding; the win celebration overlay uses large white/cream and yellow text against a deep blue glow for high contrast.

Spin is triggered by a single large round button, with Spacebar confirmed as an alternate control (checked ON by default in Settings). Autoplay with configurable stop conditions (on any win, on bonus trigger, on win/loss thresholds) reduces the number of required manual actions. Total-bet +/- controls are small triangle up/down arrows, visually smaller than the Spin/Autoplay buttons.

Bottom bar layout is stable across base-game/menu screens: info(i) and settings(gear) buttons far-left, balance and total bet centre-left, a rotating status/message strip centre, autoplay(A) and spin buttons far-right. The Buy Bonus widget is a separate fixed element in the top-left corner, outside the bottom bar, and is easy to miss for a pass that only announces the bottom bar.

Toggle switches are shown by knob position (left=off, right=on), checkboxes by a checkmark glyph, cancel/confirm by X-vs-checkmark glyph, bet controls by +/- glyph, and the Ante Bet OFF state by the word 'OFF' plus an arrow icon - none rely on colour alone.

The nine paying symbols are each visually distinct by picture (portrait, mask, jackal head, beetle, letter), not by background colour alone; the five card royals differ in letter colour plus a distinct gem or flourish detail.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; ambient music and sound FX are independently toggleable in system settings. All game state (bet, credit, win amounts, free spins remaining, active mystery symbol) is shown as on-screen text or graphics.

All primary controls are large circular or pill-shaped targets. SPACE and ENTER keys can start/stop a spin. Autoplay with an adjustable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option reduces the number of repeated manual actions needed.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across all screens: menu/sound/info icons bottom-left, CREDIT/BET/WIN as text centre-left, bet +/- and the circular SPIN control centre-right, AUTOPLAY near it. The rules/info booklet is a fixed linear 6-page sequence with an explicit 'Page n/6' text readout on every page.

Symbol identity is conveyed by distinct artwork/shape (pig, egg, scroll-and-candle, shield-and-sword, treasure-chest wild, knight-portrait scatter), not by frame color alone; card-frame colors (purple pig, red/pink egg, green scroll, teal/blue shield, red/gold A, green/gold K, purple/gold Q, blue/gold J) are decorative. Paytable navigation uses shape-coded green controls (left triangle / cross / right triangle), not color alone. Toggle switches (settings menu) show state by BOTH handle position (left=off, right=on) and track color (grey=off, green=on). Win amounts, free-spins-left counts, and every MONEY-symbol value are always printed as text/numbers, so no information is color-only. Residual risk: small sparkle particles around MONEY symbols (green vs blue) may encode marking-upgrade level, but this is not stated in the rules and is not needed since the dollar amount is always printed as text.

No information is conveyed by audio alone. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative. All game state - win amounts, free spins remaining, current bet, credit balance, and retrigger counts - is always shown as on-screen text/numbers.

High-contrast presentation throughout: CREDIT/BET labels are orange/yellow text on a dark translucent bar, win amounts and free-spins counts are large bold gold digits on dark plaques (e.g. the $710.50 / '15 FREE SPINS' win screen), and MONEY-symbol values in the free-spins payout reveal are bold gold digits on an orange-red token. One weaker cue: disabled bet-menu steppers (at the $0.25 floor or $250.00 ceiling) are distinguished only by a brightness/shade difference on the same white glyph rather than by a stronger contrast change, which could be harder to perceive for users relying on brightness discrimination.

Click targets are large and round; the central SPIN button is the largest element in the bottom bar. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin (keyboard-operable), and holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin. The Autoplay menu offers a configurable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option that auto-skips feature introduction and end screens, reducing the number of clicks needed for extended play.

Control positions are stable across every screen: menu and sound icons far-left, the 'i' information button just to their right, bet -/+ steppers flanking the central spin button, and the AUTOPLAY button below the spin button. The in-game rules are a strictly linear 6-page booklet (paytable page 1, then Free Spins rules, Game Rules/RTP/volatility/bet limits, How to Play, Settings/Information/Bet Menu, Autoplay), navigated with left/close/right controls and an explicit 'Page n/6' readout on every page, giving a reliable landmark for announcements.

KNIGHTS SCATTER (blue-gold shield with gold lion), BARBARIANS SCATTER (red-black horned demon mask), and BATTLE SCATTER (blue-gold shield with red diagonal lightning slash) are distinguishable by shape and icon content, not color alone. Royal symbols A/K/Q/J use distinct letters as primary identifiers alongside their violet/crimson/emerald-green/cobalt-blue colors. Winning cells are highlighted with gold border frames AND described in text at the bottom bar (e.g., 'LINE 7 PAYS...'). Settings toggles use both color (green = on, grey = off) and position (right = on, left = off). BUY FEATURE (orange, fire art) and SPECIAL BETS (blue, ice-tone art) panels differ in text label and visual art in addition to color. CANCEL/YES confirm buttons are labeled in text alongside their red/green colors.

SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC can be toggled off independently in SYSTEM SETTINGS. All feature triggers and wins are accompanied by full-screen text announcements (CONGRATULATIONS, SENSATIONAL!, WIN amounts) that do not rely on audio. CENTER SYMBOL FEATURE activation is indicated by a large visible fire explosion animation as a visual-only cue.

High-value symbols rendered as large portrait/helmet/weapon art on ornate colored cards (blue-teal for knight-themed, dark-red for barbarian-themed). Center position marked by a bright gold square border on each reel, distinguishable at normal play size. Win amounts always shown numerically in the bottom bar. Multiplier badges (x2-x100) displayed as large gold numerals overlaid on WILD cells.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop the spin. Autoplay supports up to 100 auto-spins with SKIP SCREENS option to minimize required interactions during feature sequences. TURBO SPIN (hold SPACE or checkbox in Autoplay) and QUICK SPIN (checkbox in Autoplay) reduce animation time. BUY FEATURE and SPECIAL BETS require two clicks (select card + confirm dialog with CANCEL/YES buttons) — no accidental single-click activation.

All high-value symbols have distinct thematic names (KNIGHT Hero Portrait, BARBARIAN Hero Portrait, KNIGHT Helmet, BARBARIAN Horned Helmet, KNIGHT Spiked Mace, BARBARIAN Battle Axe). Feature announcements are full-screen text overlays (CONGRATULATIONS / YOU HAVE WON / N FREE SPINS / PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE). Wins displayed as numeric text (WIN $X.XX). FREE SPINS LEFT counter is a numeric text panel. Multiplier values on WILDs are numeric overlays. The center marked position is textually described in the game rules.

Each of the 5 symbols is doubly coded by a unique silhouette/shape (round ball, wide stadium scene, elongated boots, hand-shaped gloves, wedge-shaped whistle) and by a unique flat background tile colour (orange, none/photographic, teal, green, purple), so colour-only confusion between symbols is unlikely. Winning rows/columns are marked with a white/cyan glow outline, a shape-based highlight rather than a colour-only cue.

Every interactive control (BET, BET LEVEL, COIN, BALANCE, SPIN, AUTO PLAY) is distinguished by shape and a printed numeric/text label, not colour alone. The two on-screen currency glyphs, the demo token '‡' and the jackpot pool sign '€', are also distinguished by shape, not only by digit colour, so the two are not mistaken for each other.

Sound toggles ('Sound - Ambient', 'Sound - Effects') are exposed in the settings menu and default to on. No game information observed to be conveyed by audio alone: win amounts, feature triggers and jackpot tickers are all also shown as text/graphics.

All controls are large, clearly separated rounded buttons on the bottom bar with a generous hit area. SPIN can also be triggered by the space bar (also used to stop the reels), and Auto Play offers configurable stop conditions (balance-decrease / single-win-exceeds limits), reducing the need for repetitive manual spin-clicking.

All numeric game state (BET, BET LEVEL, COIN, BALANCE, WIN) is presented as printed text on the UI bar, not solely via icon or colour, and should map cleanly to text-to-speech. The demo currency glyph '‡' and the jackpot pool glyph '€' are visually distinct shapes and should be verbalised with distinct names, not both read as 'currency sign', to avoid implying the jackpot value is spendable player balance.

WILD (bell) vs SCATTER (star badge) are told apart by icon shape and the printed word baked into each badge, not by color; the live ways count is always paired with the digits + word 'WAYS'; winning cells are marked with a bright glow outline (shape/brightness cue), not a flat color fill; royal ranks (A K Q J 10) are readable as letters/digits independent of their tile tint.

Wins and features are announced visually (banner, big win scenes, counters); sound can be turned off in the menu.

Settings toggles, autoplay checkboxes and rules-booklet navigation controls use a non-color cue in addition to color: toggle thumb position (left=off/right=on), a checkmark glyph on checked boxes, and distinct triangle/cross shapes for prev/close/next

Large round click targets for menu/sound/info/spin/bet-steppers with SPIN as the largest target; HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN gives a keyboard alternative to repeated clicking; the autoplay slider (up to at least 100 spins observed) reduces the number of required interactions

Paying symbol colors: Red 7 = crimson red with pink highlight and gold outline; Diamond = light blue faceted gem; Lemon = yellow/gold oval; Bell = orange/gold; Plum = dark blue-violet with a green leaf; Cherry = bright red with green stems; Triple/Double BAR = light grey/silver 'BAR' text on a dark purple tile, distinguished from each other by row count (3 vs 2), not by color.

Win/feature states are reinforced by shape and text, not color alone: flame-glow highlight plus 'Line N pays' label on wins, red sunburst '1 RESPIN' banner plus a 'Respins: n/1' counter for the respin feature.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable and purely atmospheric. All wins, feature triggers and RTP/rules information are presented as on-screen text and/or graphics.

Key indicators use large bold high-contrast text/numerals independent of hue: yellow '20 LINES' on the red background, white Balance/Total bet text on the black bottom bar, large win-amount plaques. Checkbox state is shown by a filled checkmark glyph inside the box, not by color fill alone.

Bet size uses small up/down triangle steppers rather than a drag control (the audio Volume control is the only slider). Spin button and win/feature banners are large, centrally placed targets. Large, well-separated round/square targets for all primary actions (spin, autoplay, buy bonus, chance x2). Large round click targets; the central spin button (crowned-monkey icon with curved arrows) is the largest single target. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop the spin. Autoplay with a Skip Screens option reduces required clicks for repeated spins.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across all base-game screens: menu/sound icons far-left, separate 'i' info icon next to them, bet -/+ flanking the central spin button, autoplay directly below spin. CASH symbol always prints its dollar value as text; COLLECT symbol is a distinctively shaped red envelope versus the round gold CASH coin; toggle switches use handle position and checkboxes use a checkmark glyph, not color alone. Residual risk: the three gem symbols (green, blue, yellow) share an identical teardrop shape and are differentiated primarily by hue, though each also has a distinct printed payout value and fixed left-to-right paytable position.
No audio-only information observed; SOUND toggle is decorative/optional. Win amounts, feature triggers (caption 'GOOD LUCK!'), and respin state are all conveyed via on-screen text/graphics.

Portrait 'Spark Game' format: the actual playable canvas is a narrow vertical strip centered in the capture, with the same background artwork mirrored/repeated as decorative fill on the left and right margins outside the playable area - low-vision users zooming in should focus on the narrow central column.

All primary controls are large round tap targets; the spin button is the largest single target and supports a hold-to-turbo gesture (potential barrier for users who cannot sustain a hold - no alternate turbo toggle observed outside the autoplay panel's TURBO SPIN checkbox); autoplay with SKIP SCREENS reduces required interactions per spin.

Bottom control cluster has a stable layout: sound button isolated at the far-left margin; info/history/quick-spin/coin-menu/hamburger buttons form a row beneath the spin button; bet +/- flank the spin button directly. The rules/info booklet is a linear, vertically-scrollable multi-page document closed by a consistent top-right X.
Royal-letter symbols are distinguished by their letter/number glyph in addition to a colored card outline: A green, K red, Q gold/yellow, J cyan/teal, 10 magenta/pink, 9 purple.
Free Spins mode is signalled by a full background scene change — a green-and-teal aurora borealis over a starry night sky replacing the base game's purple twilight — not by color alone.
Toggle switches (Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen) show state by handle left/right position in addition to green-when-on.
Info-booklet navigation uses distinct triangle-left / cross / triangle-right shapes rather than color alone.

No audio-only information observed; Sound FX and Ambient Music toggles are purely ambience controls. All game state (wins, spins remaining, multiplier text, retrigger/completion messages) is conveyed through on-screen text and imagery.

Win amounts, spin counters and feature labels are always large legible text/numerals (e.g. 'WIN $80.00', 'FREE SPINS LEFT 11'), and the central SPIN/round controls are large high-contrast round targets.

Large round click targets; SPIN is the largest control. SPACE and ENTER are keyboard alternatives to clicking SPIN, and holding SPACE also engages Turbo Spin. Autoplay with an adjustable spin count reduces the number of required interactions.

Stable control layout: hamburger menu and sound toggle stacked at far-left, 'i' info button beside them, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, autoplay directly below. The paytable/rules booklet is a linear 7-page sequence navigated by left/right arrows with a single close X; every page prints its own 'Page n/7' position.
WILD (fairy portrait) and SCATTER (green magician hat) are told apart from every other symbol by unique icon shape, not color.

Payline-number plaques on both wooden side-rails pair a color with a printed digit (top to bottom: 2 yellow, 4 red, 6 orange, 8 yellow-green/lime, 1 blue, 9 crimson/red, 7 cyan/turquoise, 5 green, 3 magenta/pink), so line numbers are never color-only.
Letter/number symbols use one accent color each (A green, K red, Q gold/yellow, J purple/magenta, 10 blue, 9 cyan/turquoise) but each is also distinguished by its own letterform or digit shape.
Winning symbols get a bright gold outline box in addition to a red connecting payline, so a win is legible by shape/position, not color alone.

The nine payline diagrams on the Rules & Lines page use nine distinct colors (Line1 red, Line2 green, Line3 yellow, Line4 blue, Line5 turquoise, Line6 purple/indigo, Line7 orange, Line8 red/crimson, Line9 yellow-green/lime), each also numbered - residual risk noted as the colors are the primary way to tell lines apart at a glance.

No audio-only information observed; the only audio elements are decorative Music and Sound-effects volume sliders in Settings. All game state (balance, bet, win amounts, free-spins count, gamble odds) is conveyed as on-screen text.
Info panel (Settings/Paytable/Rules & Lines/History) is plain white body text on a near-black panel throughout the 16 rules pages and 2 paytable pages, high contrast.
Bottom-bar stepper controls (LINE COUNT, BET VALUE) use large round green +/- glyph buttons, not small or color-only controls; the central SPIN button is the largest target on screen.

Large round/pill hit targets throughout the bottom bar; the central SPIN button is the largest target on screen. A 'Spacebar to spin' setting (checked by default in Settings) offers a keyboard alternative to clicking.

AUTO SPINS panel offers fixed round counts (10 up to 1000) plus configurable auto-stop conditions (on any win, if bonus won, if single win/balance change exceeds an amount), reducing the number of required manual actions.

Control positions are stable across states: BALANCE far left, then LINE COUNT / MAX BET / SPIN / AUTO SPINS / BET VALUE / TOTAL BET left to right on the bottom bar, three round icon buttons fixed top-right. The info overlay has one persistent left-hand tab list (Settings/Paytable/Rules & Lines/History).

Icon glyphs, toggle-switch position, checkbox check marks, and printed dollar values or jackpot names on every MONEY coin (pale-purple/gold/silver) make state legible without colour vision; the WILD zone (reels 1-2) vs MONEY zone (reels 3-6) is also marked by box position, not colour.

No information is conveyed by audio only; sound/music are toggle-able decorative layers (Ambient Music, Sound FX); win amounts, free spins remaining, wild/collection events and jackpot names are all shown as on-screen text and imagery.

Large round click targets with the central SPIN icon the largest control; SPACE/ENTER also start/stop a spin; Autoplay (settable spin count plus a 'Skip Screens' option) reduces required clicks for repeated play.

Stable control layout across the session: menu+sound stacked far-left, 'i' info button beside them, bet -/+ flank the central spin button, autoplay sits below spin; rules/paytable is one linear 7-page sequence (left/right triangle to move, X to close) rather than several separate menus.

Tile state is carried by shape as well as colour: an untouched tile shows a flat dot, a safe tile shows a star, a mine shows a bomb with a burst behind it. The running cash-out amount is printed as a number on the button, not signalled by colour.

A dark navy board with a faint star-and-circle pattern; the 5x5 grid sits in the middle in large rounded tiles. Safe tiles turn solid orange-gold, a hit mine turns bright pink. The action button is a wide green arrow that becomes a gold CASHOUT with the amount on it.
Every action is a single click; nothing needs holding or timing. Auto game removes the per-tile clicking entirely by letting tiles be marked in advance.

The interface is real DOM: tiles, the bet stepper, the mine-count selector and the action button are HTML controls, and the two amount pills above the board carry the current and the next payout as text.

Low symbols are told apart by letter or number shape, not only colour (A gold-orange, K red, Q purple, J blue-teal, 10 green). High symbols differ strongly by shape: crown, slot machine, roulette wheel, cards, dice.
Free spins differ from the base game by violet reels instead of dark green, plus red demon claws on the frame and the printed texts Remaining Free Spin and Last Free Spin.

Winning cells glow orange-yellow and are joined by a thin line while other cells are dimmed, so a win is visible by brightness and line, not by hue alone. Line numbers are printed on small blue tags at the reel edges.
The selected pill in Auto Spin and the selected row in Bet Options are marked by position and a highlight bar as well as colour; the GET STARTED button carries its text.
Wins and feature starts are shown by text banners (Free spins won!, Last Free Spin, Total Win), so no audio-only information was observed. A sound toggle is in the player menu.

Paytable and Rules panels are real text readable by screen readers; the reels are canvas graphics without text. The win banner, the Win strip and the line banner (for example 5 OF A KIND) print the amounts.

Large round spin button; Space key spins (hold Space for continuous spins, Space during a spin skips the animation); Auto Spin presets 10, 30, 50, 80, 1000; Max Bet shortcut in Bet Options; tap the spin button or game area to stop reels.
Paytable and Rules panels are real DOM text; the reels themselves are canvas graphics without text labels.

Toggle switches signal ON/OFF by handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to track color; checkboxes use a checkmark glyph plus green fill; MONEY-symbol values are printed as text over a gold banner shape rather than color alone; payline diagrams use lit-cell position, not color; volatility badge's half-filled bolt relies on yellow-vs-grey brightness contrast

No information is conveyed via audio only; SOUND and BATTERY SAVER are simple on/off toggles for decorative music/sound effects; win amounts and feature results are always shown as on-screen text/numbers

Win amounts rendered in large bold red-on-gold and yellow-green-on-teal text; CREDIT/BET shown in high-contrast yellow text on a dark green strip; info-panel body text is white on a black semi-transparent panel

Large round SPIN button is the biggest click target, flanked by smaller +/- bet buttons; Autoplay with adjustable spin count and a Skip Screens option reduces required repeated clicks; no confirmed keyboard-shortcut text (e.g. SPACE/ENTER) was found on the captured rules pages

Bottom bar has stable icon positions: info button far-left, spin-speed/history/coin-stack icon cluster center, hamburger menu far-right, CREDIT/BET text row beneath. The info/rules panel is a single continuous vertical scroll (no 'Page N/M' textual indicator) reached via the info button and closed via an 'X' icon

All 7 symbols have distinct shapes and silhouettes requiring no color recognition. WILD Lucky Mouse is a unique character face with 'WILD' text label. Winning cells gain a luminous halo ring visible as brightness contrast. Settings toggle ON/OFF distinguished by thumb position: left=OFF, right=ON — not color alone.

Sound toggle available in System Settings (can be turned off). Win amounts and game state shown as text. Raining Wilds feature activation accompanied by large golden starburst visual explosion effect — game is fully playable without audio. No game-critical information appears to be conveyed through sound alone.

Large central spin button is the primary and easiest interaction target. Autoplay supports up to 100 automatic spins with Quick Spin and Skip Screens options, minimizing required clicks. Turbo Spin requires sustained button hold — may be challenging for some motor-impaired users; Quick Spin checkbox is the accessible alternative.

Win amounts displayed as text ('WIN $16.00', 'WINNER'). Credit and bet shown as labeled values. RTP 96.57%, bet range $0.10-$250, and all rules available as scrollable text panel. Control buttons (spin, +, -, 5 nav-bar icons) use icon-only design — no visible ARIA text labels captured. Raining Wilds activation has no text banner captured; trigger is primarily a visual golden explosion.
the jackpot bar's three tiers are distinguished by text labels (MINOR/MAJOR/GRAND) and printed dollar amounts, not by ribbon color alone (blue/orange-red/green)
card letter symbols A (pink/red gem), K (green gem), Q (purple gem) and J (cyan gem) are identified primarily by their letterform, with gem color only a secondary, non-essential cue
Money Respin round state is conveyed by the numeric text counter 'N RESPINS LEFT', not by color
each Money symbol lantern prints its dollar value as a legible numeral directly on the icon face rather than relying on color or size alone
Card royals A (orange/red), K (red), Q (blue) and J (green) each use a different color but are always distinguishable by their printed letter shape.
A winning spin is marked by a yellow glow on the matched symbols plus an explicit payout-amount overlay and a 'Line N pays' text message, not by color alone.
In the Buy Bonus dialog, the red CANCEL and green BUY buttons both carry explicit text labels alongside their color.

Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable in Settings; all game state (wins, bet, balance, bonus multiplier, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and imagery, with no audio-only information.
Settings and Autoplay checkboxes (Quick spin, Spacebar to spin, Music, Sound FX) show a white checkmark glyph inside a filled black square rather than relying on color fill alone.

The large circular SPIN button is the dominant click target; Spacebar can also trigger a spin (on by default). Autoplay offers preset round counts from 10 up to unlimited ('infinity') with four automatic stop-conditions, reducing the number of manual actions required.

The bottom control bar keeps a stable layout across all base-game states: info and settings icons far-left, balance/bet fields center-left, a rotating status text in the true center, autoplay and spin buttons on the right. The combined paytable/help modal is a single continuously-scrollable document per section, reached from three fixed icons on the modal's left edge.
Volatility badge shows a filled-vs-outline lightning-bolt count (3 of 5 filled) plus the text label 'Medium volatility' — count and words carry the meaning, not bolt color alone.

Toggle switches (Sound/Battery Saver/Vibration) use handle position (right=on, left=off) in addition to track color (green=on, dark grey=off); checkboxes use an explicit white checkmark glyph rather than fill color alone.
WILD (gold-framed jade-green card with the red bull mascot face) and MONEY (round gold coin) are distinguished by shape and printed text/value, not by color alone.

No audio-only information observed; all game state (bet, credit, win amounts, respins left, feature values, RTP/volatility/bet-limit disclosures) is conveyed via on-screen text, and the SOUND toggle is optional/decorative.
Win amounts, CREDIT/BET values, and respin-left counts are shown as large high-contrast numerals (yellow-on-red or white-on-dark-red), legible without color discrimination.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, ENTER and menu buttons; autoplay dialog offers QUICK SPIN and SKIP SCREENS to reduce manual actions; 'HOLD FOR TURBO SPIN' offers a press-and-hold alternative to repeated tapping.

Bottom control bar has a stable left-to-right order across all screens: info ('i') far left, then autoplay/quick-spin/bet-coins icon cluster center-left, hamburger menu far right, with spin controls (bet-, SPIN, bet+) directly above; all dialogs share the same top-right round 'X' close-button convention.

Buy Bonus pack tiers are distinguishable without color: each foil card (copper/orange, steel-blue/silver, yellow/gold, silver/pearl) is also labelled with its tier name and printed cap text ('WIN UP TO 999x' / '2997x' / '9990x'), so foil hue is not the only cue

Country/team-flag selection icons (Portugal, France, Mexico, Germany, Brazil, India) are distinguished mainly by their color pattern (stripes, quarters, emblem) with no printed country-name text next to them, so a color-blind user may have difficulty telling the six flags apart on that screen alone

No audio-only information was observed: wins, the Bonus Game trigger, and Buy Bonus outcomes are all conveyed through on-screen text and numbers; music/sound-FX/volume controls are adjustable and purely supplementary

Win banners ('TOTAL WIN' green-to-yellow, 'SUPER MEGA WIN' purple-to-pink) and the 'MAX WIN 10490x' banner use large bold high-contrast text with an outline, legible without fine color discrimination; the two win-tier banners are also distinguished by different wording, not only by gradient color

The largest, easiest click target is the circular SPIN button at bottom-right. The Total Bet stepper uses small triangular +/- arrows, a comparatively small target. Spacebar can also start a spin (enabled by default in Settings), and Autoplay offers presets up to an infinity option, reducing the number of precise clicks needed

The country/flag selection screen (6 national teams, default Portugal) only recolors the player character's kit and the flag icon shown in the corner of the base game; it does not change any symbol, payline, payout or feature. A screen reader should announce it as a purely cosmetic, optional preference, not a choice that affects odds or gameplay

The Bonus Game presents 5 visually identical face-down 'LP 2026' cards under 'CHOOSE YOUR CARD'; the revealed multiplier comes from an already-determined outcome capped by the trigger tier. All 7 symbols are distinct pictographic shapes (panda character, chest, koi fish, ball, drum, firecrackers, bamboo) with no card-suit royals — distinguishable by shape alone. Multiplier values shown as large numeric text on panda scroll drum (blue neon on red background). Win state uses golden glow on winning symbols and gold header change as dual visual cues.
All game information (paylines, multipliers, win amounts) presented visually. SOUND toggle available in settings. Game fully playable without sound.

Win amount tracked only via CREDIT counter change — no floating win text overlay during normal play. BATTERY SAVER option in settings reduces animation speed, which may assist users sensitive to visual motion.

Single large circular SPIN button is the primary game interaction. Autoplay available with up to 100 spins and SKIP SCREENS checkbox to reduce repeated interaction. Bet adjusted via discrete minus and plus buttons. Autoplay spin-count slider may require fine motor control.

Win amount not shown as floating text overlay — tracked only by CREDIT counter change. Multiplier activation and Free Spins trigger are visual-only with no separate text announcement. All game state changes rely on visual indicators.
Base game background is a cool blue-violet night sky with hazy mountain silhouettes; the reel frame is an ornate red-and-gold lacquer border with red pillars.
WILD symbol is a fiery orange-red phoenix head on a dark gold-bordered plaque, also marked with the word 'WILD'.
High-value symbols use distinct colors: the top symbol is a gold ingot with a red gem accent, the next is a jade-green dragon coin with gold trim.

Residual risk: the green letter K and the green jade dragon coin share the same color family and are distinguished only by shape (letter glyph vs coiled-dragon medallion), not by an additional non-color cue.

No audio-only information observed; sound and vibration toggles are decorative. All game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, multiplier, bet, credit, volatility rating) is conveyed via on-screen text/graphics.

Primary controls (spin, bet +/-, icon bar) are large circular touch-style targets even though rendered on desktop. Autoplay offers a configurable spin count and a skip-screens option that reduces the number of interactions needed for extended play.

Game canvas is a fixed narrow portrait (mobile-style) column centered in the desktop window; control positions are stable across screens. Paytable/rules is one continuous scrollable document rather than fixed pages (order: game rules, free spins rules, paylines diagram, RTP and bet limits).
Winning cells are marked by a bright yellow-gold glow and a banner reading WIN with the amount, not by colour alone.
Scatter Wild (red mallet with pig snout) and Wild (golden piggy bank) sit on golden-orange tiles with printed word labels SCATTER or WILD in addition to their colours.
Letters A (orange to yellow), K (violet to pink), Q (green) and J (sky-blue) differ by letter shape as well as colour.
Cherry (red pair of fruit) and Clover (green leaves) differ by shape; Lemon, Bell, Coin stack, Cash roll and Diamond have distinct silhouettes.

Active menu item and selected auto-spin count are shown by cyan text on a lighter background, inactive ones by grey text. Turbo state is shown by a slash through the lightning bolt icon, not by colour.
A Sound button exists in the bottom menu; win and feature events are also shown as on-screen banners (WIN amount, One more scatter, Free Spins Won, remaining free spins counter).
White and cyan text on dark charcoal panels is high contrast; grey inactive labels are lower contrast. The scrolling tip banner is pale blue on teal glass.
Win multiplier is shown as dotted-LED numerals in neon cyan on dark glass at the top-left; ways plate is pale-teal LED dots on dark teal glass.
Spin by tap or the Space bar on PC; holding Space repeats spins until released; Space during a spin skips the reel animation; Space activates the only button on screen when just one is available.
Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 and 1000 spins; Turbo button shortens reel spin time in the main game.

Nearly every colour-coded element (jackpot tiers, ZONE/DOUBLIN'/LIFE pots, Multiplier Zone badges, settings toggle switches) is paired with an explicit text label or printed number, so colour is never the sole carrier of information.

Colour key for reference: jackpot bar cells are green (Mini), blue (Minor), purple/magenta (Major), dark red (Grand); pot icons are purple (ZONE), red (DOUBLIN'), green (LIFE) — each also carries its tier/pot name as text.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (bet, credit, win amounts, positions filled, respins remaining, jackpot names/amounts) is conveyed as on-screen text.

Win totals and jackpot awards are shown as large, high-contrast white/gold text on dark plaques (e.g. 'CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON $X'); disabled bet controls are visibly dimmed rather than only colour-shifted.

All primary targets are large round buttons; SPIN is the largest. SPACE/ENTER also trigger spin/stop (keyboard-operable), holding SPACE engages turbo spin. Stable control positions across every screen: hamburger menu + sound stacked at far-left, a separate 'i' info button just to their right, CREDIT/BET readout centre-left, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY beneath SPIN. The three jackpot tiers/pots (MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/GRAND, FORTUNE/DOUBLIN'/LIFE) are labelled with text in addition to color; MONEY symbol values are printed as legible white numerals on a uniformly gold coin regardless of color; confirm/cancel buttons use a checkmark vs X glyph, not color alone.

Residual risk: the two purchase dialogs (Buy Random = red, Buy Triple = orange/amber) rely partly on color/gradient to feel visually distinct, but the button text ('BUY RANDOM POT FEATURE' vs 'BUY GUARANTEED TRIPLE POT FEATURE') and price already disambiguate them without color.
In the dual-grid Pot Respin round, each grid's respins-remaining count is duplicated as printed text ('RESPINS REMAINING N'), not only as a colored side plaque.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles. All game state (win amounts, positions filled, respins remaining, bonus totals) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.
Win and BONUS TOTAL amounts are shown as large bold white numerals on a dark red plaque/ribbon, high-contrast and legible without fine color discrimination.

All primary controls are large circular click targets. SPACE and ENTER both start/stop a spin without requiring a mouse. BET MAX reaches the maximum stake in one click; Autoplay reduces the number of repeated actions needed.

Bottom bar layout is stable across all base-game frames (MENU/INFO/SOUND bottom-left, CREDIT/BET labels, SPIN centered, AUTOPLAY below); the 8-page rules booklet is strictly linear with a 'Page N/8' indicator, announceable as a simple paginated sequence.
Toggle switches (Battery Saver/Ambient Music/Sound FX) convey on/off by BOTH handle position (left=off, right=on) AND track color (grey=off, green=on) — position is the redundant non-color cue

No audio-only information is used; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles and all game state (spins, wins, feature triggers, bet/credit) is conveyed through on-screen text and visuals

Primary controls (SPIN, bet +/-, AUTOPLAY) are large circular buttons clustered bottom-right; SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop the spin as keyboard alternatives to pointer clicks; holding SPACE also activates turbo spin

All game values (CREDIT, BET, WIN, GAME PAYS) rendered as readable text. Complete 6-page GAME RULES panel via info button covers all mechanics in plain text. White and gold labels on dark red-maroon bar provide high luminance contrast.
SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop spins; hold SPACE for turbo spin. Autoplay with configurable spin count eliminates repeated clicks. Large circular spin button provides ample target area.
