Bottom bar layout is stable: 'i' (paytable) at the far left, a Bet field with steppers, a central circular Spin button, a Coin field with steppers, and Balance at the far right; a second strip below carries the settings gear, fullscreen, sound and turbo toggles. The paytable/rules booklet is a linear 15-page document with dot-indicator pagination and prev/next/close controls (looping correctly from page 15 back to page 1). The separate in-game Help overlay is a single continuous scrollable document, not tabbed or branching.

WILD is identified by the repeated red-haired barmaid character art and the word 'Wild' baked into the symbol graphic, not by color alone; MONEY symbol is a golden-amber beer glass on a deep blue plaque, distinct in shape/iconography from all other symbols.

Settings toggle switches show on/off via BOTH handle position (left=off/right=on) AND pill color (grey/green); AUTOPLAY 'SKIP SCREENS' checkbox uses a checkmark glyph; paytable navigation uses triangle-left/cross/triangle-right shapes, not color coding.

Winning positions on the reels are marked with a pulsing gold outline AND the winning symbols are re-displayed as small thumbnail icons next to the 'LINE N PAYS' text, giving a non-color identity cue for the win.

One residual color/icon-only cue: the VOLATILITY lightning-bolt badge on the preview and rules screens conveys the volatility level primarily via bolt count/fill; the accompanying rules text on page 4/7 also states the level in words ('High volatility...'), providing a text-based fallback.

No audio-only information observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles in Settings. All game-state information (wins, spins remaining, collected progressive value, bonus-buy prices, feature triggers) is presented as on-screen text/numerals.
CREDIT/BET/WIN amounts, spins-remaining counter and the progressive collected value are all rendered as large high-contrast gold or white numerals on a dark background.

All primary controls are large round or pill-shaped touch targets; SPACE/ENTER keys provide keyboard-only spin control, holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin; Autoplay (adjustable spin count, Skip Screens option) reduces required interactions for extended play.

Control layout is stable across all base-game screens (menu/sound/info bottom-left; CREDIT/BET center-left; bet -/+ and AUTOPLAY around SPIN on the right). The 7-page info booklet is strictly linear and explicitly paginated ('Page N/7'), navigable only via left/right arrows or the X-close, no free scrolling.
WILD trophy cup is gold with a turquoise-outlined white 'WILD' word beneath it — distinguished by shape and text, not color alone

The three HORSE symbols are differentiated by both jockey-silk color and horse coat color (blue silks/grey horse, green-yellow silks/brown horse, red silks/black horse), a double non-color-dependent cue
Ante Bet 'EXTRA CHANCE FOR BONUS SYMBOLS' toggle uses explicit 'ON' (green) and 'OFF' (red) text labels, not color alone
Royal card letters A/K/Q/J/10 use colored outlines (magenta, red, green, cyan-blue, gold) purely for stylistic contrast between letters, not functional information
SPACE and ENTER keys can start/stop the spin as an alternative to mouse click; holding SPACE also engages Turbo Spin
Wild and Scatter carry the words WILD and SCATTER printed on the tile, so they are not identified by color alone
Low symbols are letters A, K, Q, J and numeral 10 on brown wooden tiles (orange-yellow, red, lavender-purple, olive-green and dusty rose-brown); the letter shape identifies them, not the hue
Multiplier ladder lanterns carry numeric labels x2 to x1024; the active lantern glows orange and is pink-white when inactive, but the number gives the value
Win state is shown by brightness: non-winning tiles dim to dark while winning tiles glow orange-gold, plus a numeric WIN banner
Bonus triggers are announced visually with banners (One More scatter, 10 FREESPINS, MEGAWIN, SUPER MEGAWIN, TOTAL WIN) and a REMAINING FREE SPIN counter
Balance and bet numbers are pale gold on a dark pill; menu labels are light gray with the active one gold; win numbers are gold-orange
Splash GET STARTED button is a large purple pill with white text; Confirm and Start buttons are gold-orange; START and COLLECT buttons are red-pink
Control bar buttons (turbo, minus, spin, plus, auto-spin) are icons only without text labels; settings sheet icons (Sound, Paytable, Rules, History, Quit) have text labels
Selected autoplay pill (10, 30, 50, 80, 1000) is marked by brighter gold text and brown fill
Keyboard on PC: Space starts a spin, holding Space keeps spinning, Space during a spin skips the animation
Turbo Spin toggle (lightning icon left of minus) and autoplay of 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins reduce repeated button presses
Ways count, multiplier values, balance, bet and win are printed as numbers; Paytable and Rules panels are real DOM text rather than canvas pixels

Symbol identity never relies on color alone: the gorgon-mask Wild, each helmeted warrior, the lettered royal cards and the mechanical low symbols are all distinct illustrated shapes; payout tier (base vs. upgraded) is shown structurally by a plain square border versus an ornate gold picture-frame border, not by color saturation.

All feature outcomes (Expand/Surround/Upgrade/Shift/Additional Row, Unleashed Feature progress) are shown as on-screen text banners such as 'AWARDS A FEATURE:' and 'INCREASES THE [symbol] PAYOUT'; Settings lets All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music be muted independently, so a round can be followed with sound off.

The Base Game arena glows purple/magenta with a light steel-blue reel frame; the Unleashed Feature re-tints the whole arena acid-green and swaps the reel frame to warm bronze-copper, giving a large-scale material/frame change as a non-color cue that the game state has switched.

Spin can be triggered by a single space-bar press instead of a precise click on the small spin button; Quick Play (tap anywhere) skips in-round animations, and Autoplay supports up to 1000 rounds without repeated input.

Balance, Total Bet, WIN amount and the Free Spins counter ('n / m') are always printed as plain numerals in the bottom bar rather than conveyed only by icon animation, so they can be read directly by a screen-reader overlay.

Low-value royals (A/K/Q/J/10) are differentiated mainly by color (red/green/blue/purple/pink); the printed glyph shape is the only non-color cue for color-vision-deficient players — the biggest colorblind risk in the game.
The paytable's ways-to-win diagram pairs a green checkmark (valid) with a red X (invalid), a red-green-unfriendly combination, though the check/X shapes remain distinguishable without color.
Toggle switches (Sound/Battery Saver/Vibration) show state via BOTH knob position and track color, and checkboxes use a checkmark glyph — these are colorblind-safe by design.

No audio-only information observed; Sound and Vibration toggles are purely optional. All game state (wins, free spins remaining, active multiplier, trigger/award amounts) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals, not audio cues.

Primary controls (SPIN, MENU, bet-menu, bet +/- steppers) are large round/oval buttons. Autoplay (adjustable spin count, Skip Screens option) and mutually-exclusive Turbo Spin/Quick Spin modifiers reduce repeated clicks for extended play. No keyboard-shortcut (SPACE/ENTER) info was found in the rules booklet.

Control layout is stable across base-game screens: info/spin-speed/bet-menu buttons bottom-left, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, hamburger MENU bottom-right, CREDIT/BET labels along the bottom. The 7-page rules booklet plus 2-page paytable form one continuous scrollable document reachable via the 'i' button.

Symbols differ by shape as well as color: red chili pepper, pale pink naruto/fish-cake swirl, two-tone green avocado, white-shelled orange-yolk boiled egg, brown mushroom, bright green bok choy; the four royal letters A/K/Q/J share one gold color and are told apart only by letterform. Feature-active state uses text ('FEATURE ACTIVE', 'FREE SPINS') and numeric bowl overlays, not color alone; the base-to-free-spins palette shift (blue/amber to purple/pink) is reinforced by explicit text labels. Bonus-buy confirm/cancel uses checkmark vs X shape in addition to red/green color.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, multiplier, bowl awards, feature trigger) is presented as on-screen text/numbers.

CREDIT, BET and WIN values render as large bold yellow text on a dark maroon/black bottom bar; win/award announcements ('CONGRATULATIONS', bowl amounts, free-spins counters) use large bold gold/white text on tan or dark backgrounds for high contrast.

All primary controls are large round touch targets; SPIN is the largest single control. SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop a spin as a keyboard alternative to mouse/touch. Autoplay (adjustable spin count, Skip Screens option) reduces the number of discrete interactions needed for extended sessions.

Control layout is stable across all base-game screens: menu+sound stacked far-left, info 'i' button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY beneath SPIN, CREDIT/BET/WIN readouts centered on the bottom bar. The rules/paytable booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with an explicit 'Page N/7' counter on every page, navigated by the same three icons (previous/close/next).

WILD (orange ringed planet) and SCATTER (orange-to-magenta cratered planet) are marked mainly by an orange/red glow halo around the icon, but both also spell out their name in bold white text (WILD / SCATTER) on the icon itself, so color is not the only cue.

Buy Bonus / Bonus Active state is conveyed by explicit text labels (orange 'BUY BONUS' vs yellow-orange 'BONUS ACTIVE') always shown in the same top-right position, not by color alone; the bonus-buy dialog's red CANCEL / green BUY buttons are also text-labelled and fixed left/right.

The currently selected preset in the Autospin 'Numbers of rounds' button grid (10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/unlimited) is distinguished only by a subtle fill-shade difference, with no clear text or shape selection indicator visible in the captured frame - a residual color-only risk.

No information observed is conveyed by audio only; Settings exposes independent Music and Sound FX toggles, and all win/feature state (Total win, Free spins counter, Bonus Active) is duplicated in on-screen text.

Base game runs on a very dark near-black/navy-purple starfield background with no reel-cell borders; symbols float directly on it as glossy neon-lit 3D icons in orange, pink/magenta, teal/cyan and purple, each wrapped in a soft blue glow halo (WILD and SCATTER add an extra orange/red glow) to help them stand out against the dark backdrop.

Paytable, rules and settings panels use a near-black charcoal background with bold white section headers and light-grey body text (high contrast); payout values are printed as yellow/gold numerals next to each symbol icon.

Total bet +/- uses small stepper arrows (a possible small-target concern) versus the large round Spin/Autospin buttons; Autoplay offers preset round counts from 10 up to unlimited, reducing the number of manual clicks needed.

Control layout is stable across screens: info 'i' and settings gear stacked bottom-left, Balance/Total bet center, Autospin 'A' and Spin stacked bottom-right. The paytable and rules are each a single continuous scrolling document (not paginated with next/prev arrows), which suits sequential reading and should be exposed as one continuous text block per booklet.

The 4 high-value creature symbols are heavily color-tiled (red/purple/teal/blue) but each also has a distinct creature silhouette: lion, silver ram (curled horns + nose ring), turquoise goat (straight ridged horns, no nose ring), owl. Ram vs goat is best told apart by the nose ring and horn shape, not color.

The 3 low-value gem symbols (red, blue, green) sit on the same tan/stone tile and are distinguished primarily by the zodiac glyph engraved on the gem: red gem=Leo glyph, blue gem=Pisces glyph, green gem=Cancer glyph, not by color alone.
WILD is a pink/magenta glowing medallion with a white/gold letter 'W' at its center — identity carried by the letter, not the glow color.
SCATTER is a framed portrait card of a hooded oracle woman with the word 'SCATTER' printed at the bottom — identity carried by text, not by the card's warm-orange glow color.
Settings toggles show state via handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey-vs-green fill; autoplay checkboxes show an explicit white checkmark glyph rather than relying on fill color.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, free spins left, extra multiplier, buy-feature prices, RTP/volatility/bet-limit disclosures) is conveyed as on-screen text/numerals.

Win amounts, the round Extra Multiplier value, and Free Spins Left counter are always shown as large high-contrast gold or white numerals on a dark plaque/panel, legible independent of color discrimination.

Large round click targets; SPIN is the biggest interactive element. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop a spin, holding SPACE engages turbo spin. Autoplay (adjustable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option) reduces clicks needed for extended play.

Control positions are stable across screens: hamburger-menu + sound stacked bottom-left, 'i' info button to their right, bet -/+ flank the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY below SPIN. The info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence, always announced as 'Page n/7' bottom-right of the panel.

Controls are white/pale icon glyphs on dark-navy circles, distinguished by shape and position rather than color. MINOR and GRAND jackpots are labelled by name in addition to their green/purple text color. BET, BALANCE and COIN fields are distinguished by printed text labels, not color. Settings toggles use handle position in addition to an orange/grey fill change. Wild orbs carry a unique flame icon and glow ring, not identified by hue alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; music, effects and background-fish animation are independently mutable toggles in the settings panel. Every state change observed (feature trigger, win amounts, free games remaining, buy-feature cost) is shown as on-screen text or numerals.

The Help screen renders as plain high-contrast white/orange text on a black background with no color-only meaning at all, the most legible screen in the game. Bottom-bar fields (BET, BALANCE, COIN, jackpot MINOR/GRAND) are labelled with printed words, not color alone, and primary controls are large filled circles rather than small icons.

All primary controls are large filled circular targets, with SPIN the largest. Autoplay offers configurable spin counts and stop conditions (including 'stop if Free Games triggered' and 'stop if jackpot won'), reducing the number of required interactions. Bet/coin adjustment uses simple +/- steppers, not sliders or drag gestures.

Stable bottom bar order: info (i) far left, then BET, BET LEVEL -/+, a coin-menu button, SPIN centered, AUTOPLAY next to it, COIN -/+, BALANCE far right. The paginated 12-page booklet uses a strictly linear previous/home/next sequence with a page-dot indicator; the separate Help screen is a single long, linearly ordered scroll of labelled sections.
Volatility badge is conveyed by both the count of lit lightning bolts and adjacent text ('Medium volatility games pay out steadily...'), not color alone.

The 4 high-value character symbols and 5 royal letter/number symbols use a card-frame color (green/blue/red/pink for characters; purple/orange/gold/blue/red for royals) as a secondary cue only; each symbol also has a unique illustrated silhouette as the primary cue.
MULTIPLIER WILD ring color (blue = normal, gold = 'golden rim') is paired with an explicit printed multiplier number inside the circle and an on-screen 'WILD MULTIPLIER <N>x' plaque.
Free Spins state is signalled by both a full background palette shift (indigo night vs warm orange base game) and explicit text ('FREE SPINS LEFT' counter).
Settings-menu toggle switches show state via handle position (left=off/right=on) and a small pause/bars icon inside the handle, not the green-vs-grey track color alone.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, spins left, active multiplier value, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.

Win amounts and end-screen text use large high-contrast gold/yellow numerals on dark backgrounds; character identity on end-screen shields is conveyed by silhouette shape (antlers/ears/beak/beard), legible without color discrimination.

Large circular touch targets, SPIN being the largest. SPACE/ENTER keys operate spin, holding SPACE performs turbo spin. Autoplay (adjustable spin count, Skip Screens option) reduces required interactions for extended play.

Stable, consistently positioned control layout: menu/sound/info icons bottom-left, bet +/- flanking the central spin button, autoplay beside spin; Buy Feature and Special Bets are two separate fixed plaque buttons; the info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with a 'Page N/7' text indicator.

Toggle switches (Sound Ambient/Effects, Quick Spin) show state by knob position as well as color. The selected Auto Play spin-count preset uses a fill/contrast change, not color alone. Feature entry is signalled by a full background shift (pink theatre stage to sunlit garden) plus explicit 'Free Spins Remaining' text, not color alone.

All feature state (jackpot totals, free spins remaining, win amounts, retriggers, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals; sound (Ambient/Effects) is optional and independently toggleable in the settings menu.

Win and feature banners ('FEATURE TRIGGERED', 'BIG WIN', 'YOU HAVE WON') use large bold gold-on-red 3D lettering with a bright white/yellow sunburst glow behind them, giving strong contrast against the base game's curtain and garden backgrounds.

Large circular touch targets for Spin, Bet Max, Auto Play and the info button. Space bar can both start and stop a spin. Auto Play offers preset spin counts (10-500) plus stop-if-feature-triggered, stop-if-balance-decreases-by and stop-if-single-win-exceeds conditions, reducing the number of manual actions needed.

Canvas-rendered game with no native DOM/ARIA structure; a screen reader cannot access game state directly. Control layout is stable across screens (info button and Bet field far-left, Bet Level/Bet Max/Spin/Auto Play/Coin centered, Balance far-right), and both the paytable booklet and the Help screen are single continuous documents, simplifying a manual linear read-order.

Scatter Bar Meter conveys state through BOTH gold-fill extent (position-based, thermometer-like) AND printed numerals on every cell (1-12) - count is readable as text, not inferred from a red/gold color split.

Per-type multiplier badges are shown as text ('Xn', e.g. 'X10') on a dark ribbon over the symbol art, not as a color code; ribbon hue varies slightly with the underlying card color but the 'X'+number text format stays constant and readable regardless of hue.

Residual risk: the three low-value card suits are differentiated primarily by hue (purple spade / sky-blue club / red heart), with shape (spade/club/heart silhouette) as the more reliable secondary cue, remaining distinguishable in greyscale.
The green 'natural win' highlight glow on winning cells is color-based but is reinforced by a numeric win-amount overlay and a 'Symbol Pays' text caption.

No audio-only information found on any captured screen; all game state (win amounts, free-spins count, Scatter count via the meter, multiplier values) is expressed as on-screen text/numerals. Sound is decorative (Music & Ambience / Sound Effects toggles in Settings, independently mutable).

Large circular Spin/Autoplay targets; autoplay offers up to unlimited spins plus five stop conditions (Advanced mode) to minimize repeated manual input; Quick Spin toggle reduces per-spin wait time (where license permits); a single-price Buy Bonus button skips the need to grind for the feature.

Bottom bar keeps a stable left-to-right order across every game state (info/settings icons, Balance, Total bet, Win/Total win, Free spins counter during the feature, Autoplay, Spin) - controls do not move between states. The info booklet is a strictly linear single-column scroll (Payouts vs Rules via two distinct icon buttons), not a paged left/right-arrow booklet.

Base symbols are readable by printed shape/glyph as well as color: royal letters K (magenta/purple), Q (cyan/blue), J (green) and 10 (orange/brown) are distinguished by their letter; the drum (purple/maroon with gold rim), firecracker bundle (blue tubes with red fuse), gold coin-knot (gold with green cord) and red angular emblem are shape-distinct from each other. Bonus-game multiplier badges always print 'X' plus a number rather than relying on hue alone.

No audio-only information was found. Music and Sound FX are decorative toggles independent of gameplay; all feature/win state (multiplier, respins remaining, win amount) is shown as on-screen text/graphics.
Playing field is a compact 3x3 grid with large symbol tiles. Win amounts, active multiplier and the respin counter are shown as large printed text/numbers, not small icons.

Buy Bonus is a single large click target that avoids manual feature-hunting. The bet stepper and fixed autoplay round-count buttons (10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/unlimited) reduce the number of precise interactions needed. Spacebar-to-spin is available as a keyboard alternative to clicking the round Spin button (on by default).

Stable control layout: info (i) and settings (gear) buttons bottom-left with balance printed next to them; Total bet stepper centered; Autoplay (A) and Spin buttons bottom-right; Buy Bonus plaque fixed top-right of the reel frame. Paytable and Rules are reached via distinct icons (bag/ticket vs question-mark) inside the info panel's left icon column.
Jackpot bar tiers (MAJOR purple-left, GRAND red-center, MINOR blue-right) labeled by name in text and fixed left/center/right positions — tier identifiable without color.
Card symbols (A/K/Q/J/10/9) differ by color (red/teal/orange/magenta/sky-blue/lime) but each displays its own letter or numeral — readable without color.
BONUS (Yin-Yang) identified by printed 'BONUS' text in green and unique yin-yang shape — orange-red glow not required for recognition.
Settings toggles: ON/OFF state indicated by thumb position (right=ON, left=OFF) in addition to green/gray color.
Free Spins mode signaled by stop-button icon change and '12 FREE SPINS' text overlay on trigger, not relying solely on the red/crimson background shift.

FS trigger shown as full-screen text overlay ('CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON 12 FREE SPINS'). Win amounts displayed numerically each spin. Jackpot bar values visible at all times. No audio-only feedback path.
SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spins; hold SPACE for Turbo Spin. Autoplay supports up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option. Three spin speed modes: Normal, Quick, Turbo.

Info panel (i button) covers all symbol payouts, 25-line rules, RTP 96.51%, and Golden Symbols mechanic across 7 pages. Jackpot bar shows MAJOR/GRAND/MINOR with dollar amounts. CREDIT and BET numerically labeled.
Jackpot tiers GRAND (red banner), MAJOR (green banner) and MINOR (blue/teal banner) are each explicitly labelled with text and kept in a fixed left-to-right position, not conveyed by color alone.

Golden reel-5 variants of the picture symbols (butterfly, guardian lion, toad, koi fish, bonsai) rely mainly on a gold color/tone shift versus the normal-colored version, with the same silhouette; letter symbols instead use a differently shaped red medallion for the golden version, which is easier to distinguish without color.
Letter symbols are individually colored (A=red, K=teal/turquoise-green, Q=orange/amber, J=pink/magenta, 10=blue, 9=bright green) but are primarily distinguished by their own glyph shape, not color.
Paytable/rules navigation icons (previous/close/next) are green but also distinguished by shape (left triangle / cross / right triangle).

No audio-only information is used; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are decorative toggles in Settings; all game state (wins, spins remaining, jackpot values, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and imagery.
Win amounts, free-spins-left counters and jackpot values are shown as large, high-contrast cream/white or yellow text on dark plaques.

Large circular click targets for SPIN, bet -/+, menu, sound and info; SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop the spin; Autoplay offers a selectable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option, reducing required interactions.

Bottom-bar control layout is stable across all screens: menu and sound stacked at far left, a separate info button, CREDIT/BET labels centre-left, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY just below SPIN. The 8-page rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigated with previous/close/next icons and a 'Page n/8' counter.

The 4 low-value glyph symbols are the one place color is a primary cue, but each also has a distinct brushstroke silhouette (gold/orange, cyan/light-blue, purple/violet, green) -- color is never the sole cue.
A winning payline is marked by a bright green connecting line traced through the exact winning cells, reinforced by a glow/highlight on the symbols themselves, not color alone.
CANCEL vs BUY buttons in the Buy Bonus confirmation dialog are also distinguished by their text labels, not red/green color alone.

No audio-only information observed; Music and Sound FX are decorative and independently toggleable in Settings. All game state (bet, balance, win amount, bonus multiplier, buy-bonus price) is conveyed as on-screen text/numbers.

All primary controls are large round tap targets. Spacebar can substitute for clicking Spin (toggle in Settings). Autoplay preset buttons (10 up to infinity) reduce the number of repeated clicks needed for long sessions.

Stable control layout: info(i)+settings(gear) stacked far-left above the Balance text; Total bet stepper center-left; Autoplay(A) and Spin icons far-right; the Buy Bonus badge is a separate standalone element hanging left of the reel frame. The info panel is a linear 3-section (Paytable/History/Rules) multi-page sequence navigated by scrolling, with a fixed close X.
Buy Feature vs Special Bets buttons are distinguished by color (green vs blue/purple) AND icon/text label (toxic-smoke vs toggle-switch icon, 'BUY FEATURE' vs 'SPECIAL BETS'), not color alone

The premium tile in both the Buy Feature and Special Bets dialogs (Super Free Spins / Super Spin) is marked with a yellow-and-black hazard-stripe border and biohazard corner icons, not by a blue tint alone
Card royals A/K/Q/J/10 are each a distinct bevelled metal color (rusty orange/purple-lavender/blue/green/red) but remain distinguishable by their printed letter or number shape

The WILD multiplier badge and the free-spins virus multiplier meter use green/orange/purple hues that may be hard to distinguish for some color-blind users, but both always carry a printed numeral (e.g. '3X') as the primary information
System Settings toggle switches (Battery Saver / Ambient Music / Sound FX) show state by both color (white/grey=off, green=on) and thumb position (left=off, right=on)

No audio-only information was observed on any captured frame; all state (wins, spins left, multiplier tier, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and imagery; Sound/Ambient Music are purely decorative toggles in System Settings

Rules-booklet navigation icons are shaped as triangle-left / cross / triangle-right rather than color-coded; disabled '-' bet-stepper buttons at minimum bet are shown greyed out with reduced contrast in addition to being unresponsive

SPIN is the largest tap target on screen; SPACE and ENTER also start/stop spins (keyboard-operable); AUTOPLAY supports up to 100 auto-spins to reduce required interactions; during any spin the SPIN button is replaced by a differently-shaped red-outlined square stop icon

Control layout is stable across all screens: menu+sound stacked far-left, info 'i' button just to their right, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN; the 7-page rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence with a clear text header on each page

WIN MULTIPLIER strip uses many different hues per value, but every value is also printed as a legible number, and the active value carries an added gold-outline highlight box (position/shape cue), not color alone.
Autoplay checkboxes and settings toggles show state via a checkmark glyph / switch position and an icon, in addition to fill color (green=on/grey=off).
Paytable/rules booklet navigation uses shape-differentiated controls (left triangle / green X / right triangle), not color alone.

No audio-only information observed; all game state (wins, free spins remaining, active multiplier, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and imagery. Sound (music/SFX) is independently togglable and appears decorative rather than load-bearing.
Win amounts, free-spin counts and multiplier values are shown as large, high-contrast numerals with outline/shadow treatment, distinct from decorative background art.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, MENU, SOUND, INFO, bet +/-, and AUTOPLAY. SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop the spin. Autoplay with an adjustable spin count and a Skip Screens option reduces the number of manual actions needed for extended play.

Stable control layout: menu+sound stacked at the far left, a separate info 'i' button beside them, CREDIT/BET left-of-center, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY nearby. The 7-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence (prev/next one page at a time, X to close) with a visible 'Page N/7' counter on every page.

Four high symbols use distinct shapes: Radiation=hexagon (amber-gold), Fire Diamond=diamond (red-orange), Green Energy Orb=circle (green-cyan), Blue Water Hexagon=hexagon (blue-grey). The two hexagons differ by inner icon: radiation trefoil vs water droplet. BAR symbols distinguished by bar count (1/2/3 visible stacks). SCATTER unique by size and atomic orbit arc pattern. All payline multiplier values rendered as text numerals (e.g. 5x, 400x), never colour-only.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX individually toggleable in System Settings. All win amounts, payline multipliers, spin counts, and feature events displayed as on-screen text. Win notification is a full-screen text panel (CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON $X IN N FREE SPINS). No game information conveyed by sound alone.

WIN amount displayed in large yellow text centred in HUD. Payline multiplier badges show numeric value in high-contrast amber text against dark background. Win-total screen uses large bold text with full dollar amount. CONGRATULATIONS panel is high-contrast blue-bordered overlay.

Autoplay available with configurable spin count (slider; at least 100 spins observed). TURBO SPIN and QUICK SPIN checkboxes reduce wait time. SKIP SCREENS option auto-dismisses feature intro and end overlays. Keyboard SPACE or ENTER starts/stops spin; holding SPACE activates Turbo Spin. No mouse required for spinning.

Toggle switches show state by handle position (left=off/right=on) as well as green=on fill; paytable/rules navigation uses shape (left triangle/cross/right triangle) not color alone; WILD substitution and free-spins feature state are signalled by text and a background palette shift, not color alone.

No audio-only information observed; wins, free spins remaining, multiplier value and feature trigger/results are all conveyed through on-screen text and numbers. Music/ambient/SFX are independently toggleable and purely decorative.
Win amounts, free-spin counts and the multiplier value are shown as large high-contrast white/gold/red numerals on dark panels, legible without fine color discrimination.

Large round click targets; SPIN is the largest interactive element. SPACE/ENTER keys also start/stop the spin, and holding SPACE activates Turbo Spin. Autoplay (up to a slider-selected number of spins, e.g. 100) and a SKIP SCREENS option reduce clicks needed to play through feature intro/end screens.

Stable control layout across all screens: menu and sound icons stacked far-left, 'i' information button to their right, bet +/- flanking the central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY pill directly below SPIN. The paytable/rules info booklet is a single linear 7-page sequence (arrow buttons to move, X to close) that always opens on page 1.
Jackpot plates MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, GRAND (green, blue, purple, red-orange) carry printed names and sit left to right in ascending value, so colour is not the only cue.
Royal symbols differ by letter shape, not only colour: A pink, K coral, Q golden yellow, J purple, each with a golden outline.
Special symbols differ by shape and framing: SCATTER is a lighthouse in a red frame, MONEY is a barrel with a printed value, COLLECT is the pelican in a gold frame.
Free spins mode is recognised by the pot barrel above the reels as well as by the colour change from sunny blue day to pink-orange sunset with purple reel backdrop.
Toggles: ON is green fill with the knob on the right, OFF is grey with the knob on the left; a checked checkbox shows a tick.
All results are shown as text (WIN amounts, LINE n PAYS, CONGRATULATIONS screens); sound can be switched off in SYSTEM SETTINGS and with the round sound button.
Jackpot amounts, MONEY values and the pot are large decorative gold digits; the rules text is small white text on a black panel with orange headings.
Spin button supports tap and hold for turbo; autoplay slider up to 100 spins; SKIP SCREENS auto-skips feature intro and end screens; info pages scroll by drag; popups close with a white X.
Canvas-based interface; no text is exposed to a screen reader (scene probe found no nodes).

Team selection: opponent-country identity is conveyed by flag colour pattern plus a printed country name in white bold text above the grid; the currently selected shield also gets a light-blue highlight box, but the name text is the reliable non-colour cue for telling similarly-patterned tricolour flags apart.

Mid-round cashout affordance: the 'Last Win' bottom-bar panel turns solid green and its label switches from 'Last Win FUN' to 'Collect FUN' with the live cashable amount once a goal is scored -- the state change is signalled by both a colour change and a text/label change, not colour alone.
Settings panel toggles (Spacebar to spin, Welcome Screen): on/off state is shown by both knob position (left/right) and fill colour (yellow = on), so toggle state is not colour-only.

The bottom-centre goal-zone multiplier (behind/between the goalkeeper's legs -- x1.8 on Easy, x3.5 on Medium, x7 on Hard) is only partially visible in the unmodified frame and was legible only after a 5x digital zoom crop; low-vision players relying on default screen size may struggle to read this one label.

'Spacebar to spin' in the Settings panel is a leftover reel-slot template label carried into this non-reel game; it most likely triggers the same keyboard shortcut for taking a penalty shot / advancing the round, giving keyboard-only players an alternative to clicking the central shoot button, though the panel text itself was not reworded for this game type.

All 10 goal-zone multipliers are conveyed purely by printed white numerals on identically-colored tiles - no color-coding of value anywhere, fully colorblind-safe by design. The Chance x5 toggle's ON/OFF state is conveyed by both a color change and the physical left/right position of the switch handle.

Residual gap: the golden-ball state is conveyed only by an orange glow versus the ball's normal blue/white appearance, with no accompanying text or shape cue in this build - a genuine accessibility gap for players who cannot perceive that color distinction.
No audio-only information was observed in any captured frame; all outcomes (WIN banners, TOTAL COST, balance changes, feature prompts) are conveyed through on-screen text, sound is purely decorative.

The ball is the largest and most forgiving click target (~200px) and can be clicked instead of aiming at a specific zone. The four small corner badges (x12, x15, x8, x9) and two small edge badges (x6, x4) are visually smaller than the large x3/x2 side panels and may be harder to target precisely for motor-impaired users.

The goal is a fixed 10-zone target layout with the goalkeeper's body occupying the true center (no zone there). Reading top-to-bottom, left-to-right: TOP ROW - top-left corner x12, top-center (above goalkeeper's head) x6, top-right corner x15. MIDDLE ROW - mid-left large panel x3, mid-right large panel x3 (true center blocked by goalkeeper). LOWER ROW - lower-left large panel x2, lower-right large panel x2. BOTTOM EDGE - bottom-left corner x8, bottom-center (between goalkeeper's legs) x4, bottom-right corner x9. Each zone carries its own printed numeral that could be announced directly, e.g. 'zone, times twelve, top-left corner'. Only 4 other stable interactive controls exist per screen: bet stepper (bottom-left), the ball/shot button (bottom-center, largest target), Chance x5 toggle, and Bonus Buy button (bottom-right).
Round progress is shown by a green fill along the multiplier ladder and also by football icons sitting on every reached node, so the state is readable without colour.

The CLAIM button differs between inactive and active by brightness (dim dark green versus bright green) and by content: the inactive button shows only the word CLAIM, the active one adds a coin icon and the current win amount.

In the BUY BONUS dialog the three tiers (bronze, silver and gold shield cards) are also marked by the labels EASY, MEDIUM, HARD and by the count of filled yellow lightning bolts out of five (2, 4, 5).
Menu toggles are marked by knob position (right = on, left = off) as well as by colour; Sound is on, Music and Spacebar for playing are off by default.
The goalkeeper kit changes with difficulty (blue for Easy, yellow for Medium, red for Hard), but the current difficulty is also printed as text in the DIFFICULTY box.
A Sound toggle and a Music toggle exist in the menu; no captions or subtitles were observed, and all results are shown visually (ladder, banners, counters).

Ladder multipliers are italic white numerals with a dark outline; the BET, DIFFICULTY and LAST WIN labels are white on a dark charcoal panel with yellow digits in the SHOTS counter. Modal body text (rules, provably fair, history) is small white on dark grey.

A single tap on the ball starts a kick; an optional menu toggle Spacebar for playing lets the space key start kicks. No hold or drag gestures are needed. Bet and difficulty are chosen with chevron steppers and a chip grid of eight bet presets.
The BONUS WIN screen waits for a tap (PRESS ANYWAY TO CONTINUE); the YOU WIN banner after CLAIM stays on screen for a few seconds. No autoplay and no configurable auto cash-out were observed.
The interface is drawn on a canvas; no screen reader support was observed or documented.

Progress is not green-versus-grey only: the ladder track fills lime green, the ball marker moves to the next node, and the CLAIM button shows the numeric amount. CLAIM inactive is a dull olive-brown with no amount; active is a bright green gradient with the amount.

Goal versus save is shown by the ball and goalkeeper animation, not by a colour flag. The chosen bet chip is highlighted green and also shows its number. In My bet history each row ends with a green shield icon, and the Win column shows a dash for a loss.
No on-screen captions replace sound; the outcome is visible in the animation and in the numbers LAST WIN and balance.

Dark chocolate-brown control bar and dialogs and a near-black navy header with white text. Ladder numerals are drawn in a large decorative italic face that OCR does not read on the last page; the ladder shows 5 steps per page with arrow buttons at the track ends.

A shot is taken by clicking any of 15 large ring targets or the single large Ball button. Bet chips in the drop-up grid are large click targets; difficulty and bet are chevron steppers, no drag needed. Controls lock during a live round.
The scene has a DOM text layer, but a shot result is conveyed only by animation, LAST WIN and the balance: no printed result message exists. Ladder numerals are decorative art text.

Collectible modifiers are told apart by their printed value (x3, +1, /2) and shape as well as by colour, so a player who cannot separate the gold xN discs from the red /2 token still reads the effect from the glyph.
Sound and music are separate sliders in the burger menu; every round outcome is printed on screen, so nothing is announced by audio alone.
The running MULTIPLIER is printed in a dedicated labelled field of the bottom bar rather than only floating over the action, which keeps it readable while the flight animates.
No action is time-critical: the round resolves without input once launched, and autoplay can run up to 1000 rounds unattended.
The control bar is real DOM (the play button, the burger and the autoplay control are elements with their own bounds), but the playfield itself is canvas, so flight events are not exposed as text.

BOOGIE BACK wheel uses red sector (BOOGIE OVER = lose) vs green sector (10 FREE SPINS xN = win). Disambiguation: text labels within each sector and needle position (upper vs lower half of wheel) provide color-independent cues.

BUY FREE SPINS confirmation dialog: red balloon with X (cancel) vs green balloon with checkmark (confirm). The X and checkmark shape symbols inside each balloon provide shape-based disambiguation independent of color.

WILD PARTY mode: bright solid green stage background is primary visual cue for mode. Mode name 'WILD PARTY' labeled on reveal screen; WILD reel identifiable by bold 'WILD' text on the disco ball symbol, not color alone.
SNOWBALL BOOSTER: x2 multiplier markers displayed in cyan text on symbols, visible in most colorblindness types. Snow-marked reels use frost/ice texture (shape-based, not color-only).

POP A BALLOON pick: all three balloons are same golden-orange color, differentiated by surface pattern (stars vs fish vs snowflakes). Pattern-based distinction is effective for most colorblindness types.
All game states communicated visually: WIN amounts, FREE SPINS counter, mode names on reveal screens, REWIND! text overlay, BOOGIE OVER and win labels on wheel. No audio-only information identified.
Single tap/click SPIN button; hold SPACE for turbo spin (keyboard shortcut). Autoplay with preset spin count eliminates repeated button presses. All control targets are large circular buttons.

CREDIT, BET, WIN amounts and FREE SPINS counter are visible text throughout play. Autoplay speed selector lacks visible selected-state text label; aria-checked needed. Spin count slider needs accessible value announcement.

BOOGIE BACK wheel result (BOOGIE OVER or multiplier value) and REWIND! event are visual-only overlays; audio announcements required for screen reader users. POP A BALLOON balloon labels are not visible until after selection.
Wild multiplier badges always carry a printed 'x2'/'x3' numeral, not conveyed by color alone.
Payline diagrams use plain grey-vs-gold cell fill together with a numeric 'Line N' heading, so a player can follow the diagram by the heading text alone.
The info booklet's 3 section icons (Paytable/History/Rules) differ by pictogram (money-bag / clock / question-mark), not only by active-vs-inactive shading.
Disabled controls (e.g. Quick spin) are shown by dimmed/grey text plus a visually inert, unclickable look, not by color alone.
No information is conveyed by audio alone; Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable in Settings; win amounts and spins-remaining counters are always shown as on-screen text/numerals.
Large circular touch targets for Spin and Autoplay; Spacebar can substitute for the Spin button (toggle in Settings, on by default).

Bottom bar layout is stable across all screens: info(i)+settings(gear) far left, balance/bet-adjust center-left, autoplay(A)+spin far right; the Buy Bonus button is a separate fixed element to the left of the reel frame.

Free spins pre-round modifier badges: active modifiers shown in full color with a red-and-gold ring border, inactive modifiers shown fully grayscale/silver — ring shape plus printed text/numbers ('+2', 'x2', 'STAGE 2') give non-color cues
Retrigger progress wheel is a 4-quarter pizza-pie: filled/baked quarters shown full color, unfilled quarters shown grayscale/raw dough, plus a printed 'xN' multiplier caption alongside
Buy-free-spins confirmation: cancel is a red circle with a white X glyph, confirm is a green circle with a white checkmark glyph — differentiated by icon shape in addition to red/green color
Ante Bet toggle switch is green when OFF; state is also communicated by the literal word 'OFF' and switch-handle position, not by color alone

High-value symbol colors named for red/green discrimination: pepperoni slice is dark red, green olive is dark green, basil leaf is bright green, mushroom is beige/tan, tomato & pepper pair combines red and yellow/orange

Win totals (mid-round pop-ups and final free-spins summary) are shown as large, high-contrast black-on-white or white-on-dark numerals; MONEY symbol dollar-value tags are smaller paper-ribbon text overlays whose legibility depends on tag size, with the top 2000x-total-bet tier rendered on a brighter gold-tinted icon for emphasis

Symbols differ by silhouette: ball, glove, tilted bottle, rolled towel, cluster of three pins, pair of pins, single pin, two-handled cup. Green pins (teal-green) versus bronze pins differ by pin count (three versus two) as well as colour.
Trophy tiers on the scoreboard carry digits and X multipliers (9 = 200X down to 4 = 1X). The lit tier is brighter and bolder, passed tiers are orange, unreached ones dim.

Wins are also shown as text: a WIN or TOTAL WIN banner and a numeric WIN box in the centre of the info row, besides the glow and the line drawn across winning symbols. Paytable line diagrams use orange cells on grey and are numbered 1 to 5.

Sound can be toggled in the player menu. Feature states are also shown visually: the scoreboard strip reads '3 WILL TRIGGER RESPINS' in base game and 'Respins' during respins, and win banners (BIG WIN, MEGA WIN) show the amount.

Panel text is white or light grey on dark charcoal with orange highlights. Balance and bet digits are orange on dark violet. Game art is magenta, violet and orange neon; lanes are pale pink-orange with violet gutters. Trophy is gold with a red ribbon.

Large round spin button in the centre of the bottom row, with plus and minus bet buttons and an autoplay button (10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins). Turbo toggle available. Space key spins on desktop; holding Space continues spins.

Interface text is English. Paytable and Rules panels are real text overlays (not images). The teal towel carries the printed letters PG on its fold. Marquee ticker above the controls scrolls, so its text is only partly visible at any moment.
Symbol tiers are told apart by letter badges (K, Q, J, 10) and different figures, not by frame colour alone: orange-gold frame for K, pink for Q, green for J, light blue for 10.
A winning line is shown by a cyan glow plus the printed WIN and TOTAL WIN numbers and the matching tier plaque lighting up.
The selected multiplier is shown by shape (a raised lit plaque, orange-gold in free spins) and the number x2/x3/x5/x10 is always printed.
The Scatter is identified by the word SCATTER on its gold plaque.
Sound can be toggled in the menu; all feature outcomes appear as text banners (Free Spins Won, +10 Free Spins, Guaranteed Win!, win banners).
Space bar starts a spin, holding it repeats spins; autoplay offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; turbo toggle; large circular spin button.
Cash amounts and balances are DOM text in panels, but the main game canvas has no readable labels in captured frames; not verified with a screen reader.

Symbol identity is doubly coded: gem hue plus a distinctly-shaped metal medallion per symbol (cross/red, triangle/amber, shield/green, pentagon/blue, diamond/purple, tilted shard/orange, hexagon/turquoise), so similar hues like green vs turquoise or blue vs purple remain distinguishable by frame shape alone. Toggle switches encode on/off by both color and handle position. Win/feature state is also conveyed by on-screen text and numbers, not by color alone.

No audio-only information was found. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggle-able and purely decorative; every observed game-state change (wins, Hot Spot multiplier values, RTP/limits) is conveyed through on-screen text or numbers.
Large circular touch targets for SPIN/menu/sound/info/autoplay. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin. Autoplay (slider-adjustable spin count) reduces the number of repeated actions needed.

Control positions are stable: menu+sound stacked far-left, a separate 'i' info button just to their right, bet -/+ flanking the central spin button, autoplay directly below spin. The info booklet is a strictly linear 6-page sequence with an explicit 'Page N/6' readout on every page.
Symbol identity is carried by shape (ingot, scepter, disc, scroll, letters A K Q J), never by colour alone. Royals: A red, K green, Q blue, J purple, told apart by letter shape.
Win feedback is an orange glowing frame around winning cells with the other cells dimmed, plus a numeric WIN amount, not only a colour change.
Autoplay Start button changes from dim brown (disabled) to a bright state; the disabled state differs mainly by brightness, low contrast.
Paytable count labels (5/4/3) are copper-orange next to white values; contrast is moderate.
All outcomes are shown as text (WIN amount, FREE SPINS WON 12, TOTAL WIN, Remaining Free Spin); sound can be switched off from the menu; no feature is announced by audio only.

Base game: pale blue-lavender mountains under a white-yellow moon; free spins: dark violet and magenta background with orange flames, lavender-purple reels. Panels are dark charcoal with white titles and copper-orange values; the scrolling marquee text is partly cut off at any instant.

Spin by tap on the button or game area, or Space on PC (hold Space for continuous spins); Auto Spin 10/30/50/80/1000 and Turbo reduce repeated input; bet changed by scroll picker or minus/plus; the hamburger icon is cut off at the right edge.
Rules and paytable are real DOM text panels readable by a screen reader; the reel grid itself is canvas pixels with no text.
jackpot tiers distinguished by position (left/center/right) and printed text labels MINI/MAJOR/MEGA, not color alone
WILD is a pink pig character and SCATTER a yellow tractor with a 'SCATTER' text ribbon; identified by shape/character art and rules text, not color
royal letters A (red/orange), K (gold/yellow), Q (blue), J (green) are color-coded but each is also a unique letter glyph, so shape remains the reliable cue
MONEY symbol (gold coin with pig face) shows its dollar value printed in white/dark text directly on the coin, legible regardless of the gold coin color
toggle switches (Battery Saver/Sound/Vibration) use knob position (left=off, right=on) in addition to track color (grey/green); checkboxes use a white checkmark glyph on green fill, not color alone
winning cells are marked with a glowing highlight border around each cell plus explicit 'WIN $...' / 'WINNER' text, not a color change of the symbol alone
all game state (wins, spins remaining, jackpot values, feature triggers) is shown as on-screen text and imagery; sound/vibration toggles are purely decorative on/off
Free Spins round switches the reel background and jackpot-plaque outlines from a daytime warm palette to a night purple/indigo tint, paired with explicit 'FREE SPINS LEFT <n>' text
large circular touch targets for SPIN and bet +/- controls; Autoplay (adjustable count, default 100, with Skip Screens) and Turbo/Quick Spin reduce the number of individual interactions required

Every paying tier carries a printed numeral (e.g. '10x'), a distinct pig character illustration, and a distinct card shape/position, in addition to a card background color (teal, magenta, lavender, blue, gold, green, peach, burgundy) -- color is only a bonus cue. WILD and SCATTER also carry printed words ('WILD', 'FREE'/'GAMES') on the card. Toggle switches use handle position, not fill color alone.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles. All game state (wins, free spins remaining, multipliers, RTP, bet limits) is conveyed as on-screen text/numerals.
Large round click targets; central SPIN is the largest single target. SPACE/ENTER also spin. Autoplay (default 100 spins) with QUICK SPIN and SKIP SCREENS on by default reduces repeated interaction.

Stable control layout: menu+sound far-left, 'i' info button beside them, bet +/- flanking the central spin, autoplay below spin. Info booklet is a strict linear 7-page sequence with a printed 'Page N/7' indicator.

Bonus vs base state is shown by a hue shift (cool purple base background vs warm magenta bonus background) but is always paired with explicit 'BONUS ACTIVE' text and a Respins counter, so it does not rely on color alone.

Jackpot tiers are named in text on every plaque (MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/GRAND/ROYAL with their value) in addition to plaque color (green/blue/purple/orange-red gradient), so tier identity does not depend on color discrimination.

Piggy mascot identity uses color (SAVE teal-green, X-SHOOT magenta-pink, EXTEND light blue/periwinkle) plus a printed name label under each character and a fixed left-to-right order, so it can be read without color discrimination.
The center-row trigger zone, where 3 Coins must land to start the bonus, is marked by a light blue-white glow outline as well as by its fixed middle-row position, independent of color.

No audio-only information is used; Music and Sound FX are togglable/decorative, and all game state (balance, bet, respins remaining, bonus cost, win amount, jackpot ladder) is shown as on-screen text or numerals.

Win amount and multiplier are shown as very large, high-contrast white/blue numerals on a dark background; checkbox and active-bet states use a large gold fill plus a white checkmark or bold text, not a subtle color-only change.

Large circular tap targets for the SPIN button and the BUY BONUS icon; autoplay with configurable stop conditions reduces the number of required interactions; bet can be chosen from an explicit button list or via a +/- stepper.

Control layout is stable across screens: hamburger menu bottom-left, Balance/Total-bet readout center-left with an adjacent +/- bet stepper, autoplay/turbo/spin stacked on the far right, BUY BONUS icon above them; the info booklet has a fixed 4-tab structure (Paytable/About the game/Settings/Rounds history).

Feature/bonus state is announced via banner text ('BONUS ACTIVE', 'FREE SPINS', 'FREE SPINS LEFT n'), not color alone; toggle switches use handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey/green color; checkboxes use a checkmark glyph; the buy-dialog confirm/cancel buttons use a checkmark/X glyph in addition to green/red.

The 8 Banknotes Reel denominations are each printed on a differently colored note (orange/tan, purple/lavender, green, pale green, blue/purple, violet/pink, pink/magenta, teal/mint), but each also prints its numeric multiplier value redundantly in three corners, so the value stays legible without color discrimination. Royal card letters (A blue, K red/orange, Q pink/magenta, J teal/cyan, 10 green) are each a distinct color but are also distinguished by the letter/number glyph itself.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles. Bet, credit, win amount, spins remaining and feature status are all conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

Win and spin-count amounts are shown as large high-contrast gold/yellow numerals on a dark bottom bar (e.g. 'WIN $34.50', a large gold '5' inside a green box for awarded free spins), legible at low acuity without color discrimination.

Large round click targets with the central SPIN button being the largest control; SPACE and ENTER keys can also start/stop the spin. Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option that auto-skips feature-intro/end screens, reducing required clicks per round.

Control positions are stable across every screen: menu and sound icons at far bottom-left, the 'i' info button just to their right, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, bet -/+ flanking the large central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY just below SPIN. The paytable/rules booklet is a fixed linear 8-page sequence navigated with left/right triangle icons and closed with an X.
Card tiles A, K, Q, J differ by printed letter as well as colour (orange-red, teal-green, periwinkle-blue, violet-purple), so colour is never the only cue.
Wild shows the word WILD on a portrait of a woman with a pink flower; Scatter shows the word Scatter on a star-shaped pinata; they differ from each other in shape as well as colour.
Gold framed symbols are marked by an orange-gold ornamental frame and a printed multiplier number (x2 to x100) in a red-orange pill with yellow digits, not by colour alone.

Winning lines are shown by a glow, a thin white line through the winning symbols, a blue numbered badge at the left edge and the cash amount as text. Big Win and Mega Win banners carry the tier word, plus teal or purple colouring.
A Sound toggle exists in the panel menu. All feature information seen on the frames is shown visually; whether anything is audio-only could not be checked from still frames.

Balance and bet are small yellow numbers on dark translucent pills; win and total win amounts are very large cream-yellow or gold digits. Paytable notes are grey text on dark grey, lower contrast than the yellow values.

All actions are single taps or the Space key; holding Space repeats spins, and a tap or Space during a spin skips the reel animation. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins. Panels need vertical scrolling.
Canvas-rendered game; no evidence of screen-reader text was found on the frames.

Symbol identity never depends on color alone: every paying symbol is also a distinct pictogram or letterform (pirate head, bottle, compass, bombs, A-K-Q-J-10 coral letters), and Wild is always the treasure-chest shape with a printed 'W'.
Wild chest multiplier values (x2/x3/x4/x5) are printed as white numerals on the chest lid, readable independent of any color cue.
Toggle switches (Sound, Music, Spacebar to spin, Welcome Screen, autoplay stop conditions) show state by knob position (left=off, right=on) in addition to the color fill.
The right-hand payline-number column (1-10) is rendered as plain white numerals on blue-grey circles, not color-differentiated.

Sound and Music are independently toggleable in Game Settings; all game state (win amounts, spins remaining, multipliers, purchase price, balance) is shown as on-screen text/numerals, no audio-only information observed.
Selected bet amount is marked by a solid yellow pill fill AND black instead of white text, a double cue beyond color alone.
Win amounts are shown as large high-contrast cyan-blue 3D numerals with a white glow burst behind them, legible independent of color discrimination.

The SPIN button is the largest button on screen; autoplay offers configurable stop conditions (win exceeds / cash increases / cash decreases / free spins won) to reduce required taps; the bonus-buy path needs only two confirms (Buy Bonus sign, then checkmark) to reach the feature.

The right-side control column has five stable stacked round buttons in a fixed order (turbo, loop/autoplay, SPIN, buy-bonus, menu); the payline-number column sits between the reels and the right-side parrot decoration.

WILD red lips identified by unique mouth shape and 'Wild' text label with gold frame — not color alone. SCATTER car identified by vintage convertible silhouette and 'Scatter' text with gold frame — not color alone.

Free Spins vs base game distinguished by three simultaneous cues: navy blue reel background (vs teal), 'FREE SPINS LEFT N' counter text at screen bottom, and X/5 vs X/10 in the Spins to Wild Multiplier progress banner.

Buy Free Spins dialog: Cancel = red + left position + X icon; Confirm = green + right position + checkmark icon — triple redundancy, not color alone. Settings toggles: ON = green + right slider; OFF = gray + left slider — dual redundancy.

All game mechanics communicated visually: win amounts as text in bottom bar and overlay screens, mode changes via reel background color shift and counter labels, intro and win screens with text. No audio-only mechanics.

Keyboard shortcuts: SPACE or ENTER to spin; hold SPACE for turbo spin. AUTOPLAY enables continuous play with a single click; stopped by single click on the pink square stop button. Buy Free Spins panel is a permanent large button at top-left requiring only two clicks.

All key counters and amounts are readable text: 'Spins to Wild Multiplier X/10' (base) and 'X/5' (FS) banner; 'FREE SPINS LEFT N' at screen bottom; numerical multiplier badges on each reel 2-4 position; CREDIT and BET labels in bottom bar; all win amounts as dollar text.

The MAJOR/GRAND/MINOR jackpot ticker plaques are distinguished by colour (maroon/green/maroon) but also carry printed label text, the safe channel. Settings toggles are shown by both colour (grey/green) and handle position (left=off/right=on). The base-game-to-feature mood shift (sunset harbour vs stormy night) is always accompanied by explicit banner text, not colour alone. MONEY-bag values are printed as plain numbers regardless of bag colour.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles in SYSTEM SETTINGS. All wins, feature triggers, counters and jackpot values are shown as on-screen text.

Jackpot values (MAJOR/GRAND/MINOR) are shown in high-contrast cyan text on dark plaques, permanently visible above the reels on every screen. Feature counters ('FREE SPINS LEFT N') and win amounts are large on-screen text.

All primary controls are large round targets, SPIN being the largest. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop a spin and holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin. Autoplay (up to 100 spins via a slider) reduces the number of clicks needed for extended play.

Control layout is stable throughout the session (menu/sound/info stacked far-left, bet -/SPIN/+ centre-right, autoplay beneath SPIN). The info booklet is a strictly linear 9-page sequence with left-triangle/X/right-triangle navigation and a constant 'Page N/9' counter.
Money-bag colors (gold/purple/red/green) are always paired with a printed dollar value or an explicit written rule for what that color collects, so color is never the sole information carrier.

WILD (glowing open treasure chest full of loot) and the feature-only RETRIGGER symbol (closed dark red chest with a white skull emblem) are both chest-shaped but visually distinct beyond color, and appear in different contexts.
System-settings toggle switches show state via knob position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey/green track color; checkboxes use a checkmark glyph, not color alone.

No audio-exclusive information observed; all game state (bet, credit, respins left, win amounts, 'BONUS ACTIVE' status) is conveyed via on-screen text. Ambient music and sound effects are independently toggleable and purely decorative.
Win-screen amount is rendered as large, high-contrast gold-on-dark 3D text with a red outline, legible independent of hue perception.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN and bottom-bar controls; SPACE/ENTER keys start and stop a spin without the mouse; HOLD SPACE engages turbo spin; Autoplay with an optional SKIP SCREENS toggle reduces required manual actions during extended play and during the money-respin feature.

Stable control layout across all screens: menu/sound icons stacked bottom-left, info ('i') button beside them, CREDIT/BET center-left, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY below/right of SPIN. The paytable/rules booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence navigable with prev/close/next arrows and a 'Page N/7' indicator.
Royals A/K/Q/J distinguished by letter shape alone — red A, magenta K, blue Q, green J. Shape is sufficient; color is fully redundant.

Parrot (bright green oval border) and Male Pirate (blue oval border) both use oval frames. Green/blue may be confused in protanopia/deuteranopia — bird vs human silhouette is the reliable shape discriminator.
Blackbeard (square frame, dark red background) and Female Pirate (square frame, dark purple background) share square gold frame. Gender appearance and clothing distinguish them without color.
WILD and BONUS both carry embedded text labels — 'WILD' on golden skull, 'BONUS' on compass — readable without relying on fire-glow art or color.
Settings toggles use both position (left=off, right=on) and color (grey=off, green=on). Position alone is sufficient.
All paytable and win information displayed visually. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX individually toggleable in SYSTEM SETTINGS. Game fully playable with sound disabled.
Keyboard play: SPACE/ENTER start/stop spin; hold SPACE for Turbo Spin. Autoplay up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option. Three spin speeds: Normal, Quick, Turbo.
Special symbols carry visible text: 'WILD' on golden skull, 'BONUS' on compass. Royals are alphabetic (A/K/Q/J). Win tier shown as text 'MEGA!'. Info panel displays page indicator N/6.

Free-Spins marking-level WILD portraits are identified by a gold-bordered cell frame plus printed text (WILD/x2/x3/x4/x5); the badge-circle colour behind each portrait (blue/magenta/red/green/purple) is only a secondary cue.
Low-value card-suit symbols (spade/club/heart/diamond) rely primarily on their traditional shape; fill colour (magenta/green/red/teal) is a secondary cue only.

Settings toggle on/off state is shown by BOTH switch position (left=off, right=on) and colour (grey=off, green=on); bonus-buy confirm/cancel buttons use checkmark vs X glyphs in addition to green/red colour.

No audio-only information observed; ambient music and sound-FX are decorative toggles. All game state (bet, credit, win amount, spins remaining, multiplier level) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.
Win amounts are shown in large high-contrast gold text on a blue ribbon; free-spins-remaining counter and multiplier levels are printed as numerals rather than conveyed by colour alone.

Large round click targets (SPIN is the largest). SPACE and ENTER start/stop the spin; holding SPACE triggers turbo spin. Autoplay (with optional Skip Screens) reduces the number of manual actions needed to play a session.

Control positions are stable: menu+sound far left, info ('i') button beside them, bet -/+ flank the central round spin button, autoplay directly below it. Feature-state changes are announced via full-screen interstitial text ('YOU HAVE WON N FREE SPINS' / 'N SUPER FREE SPINS') before gameplay resumes.

Symbols identified by character portrait/shape, not colour alone: KING (white-haired male elf), QUEEN (pink-haired female fairy with wings), PRINCE (teal-haired male elf in armour), PRINCESS (red-haired female fairy in green outfit).
