FS option labels also include large numeric counts (5/7/9/11/3-12).

UI controls are differentiated by shape: settings (hamburger three-lines), info (i in circle), spin (curved arrow), autoplay (multiple arrows), stop (square). Toggle on/off states use position (left=off, right=on) in addition to colour.

All critical game info — win amounts, feature triggers, RTP, rules — presented as on-screen text. No audio-only mechanics identified. Separate toggles for Ambient Music and Sound FX in System Settings.

Background: deep dark teal forest with glowing golden-white highlights. FS background is deep violet/purple. Win overlay is vivid purple/magenta with golden sparkles. Win amounts displayed in bold gold text. Top FS banner in bold orange-gold on blue-purple strip. Symbol portraits are large and distinct. Intro screen can be disabled via SETTINGS.

SPACE and ENTER keys trigger spin/stop. Full autoplay with configurable spin count and SKIP SCREENS option minimises required interactions during feature intro/outro. Win screen dismissed by pressing anywhere — no precise click target needed. Hold SPACE for Turbo Spin reduces session time.

All symbols have distinct named identities used consistently in rules text. Win amounts shown as text in bottom bar (WIN $X.XX) and in full-screen FS win overlay. Rules pages 1-7 include page counter (e.g., Page 4/7). FS trigger announced by top banner text '3X AWARDS FREE SPINS'.

WILD (grey/white delivery van) and GOLDEN WILD (gold/orange-yellow delivery van) share an identical checkerboard-badge silhouette and are distinguished mainly by van body colour; their gameplay effects differ meaningfully (GOLDEN WILD triggers grid-expansion collect) so this is a genuine colour-dependent ambiguity not resolvable by shape alone.

Most affordances are non-colour: icon glyphs, toggle-knob position (left=off/right=on paired with grey/green fill), checkmark vs X icon shapes on confirm/cancel buttons, shape-based navigation triangles (left/right) plus an X for close.

No audio-only information observed; music and sound effects are separately toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, spins left, collected money values, retrigger multipliers) is conveyed via on-screen text/numbers, not audio cues alone.

During Free Spins, 'FREE SPINS LEFT' and 'WIN' HUD readouts use high-contrast text (blue/yellow) over a dark bottom bar; MONEY symbol dollar values are shown on a white price-tag ribbon with dark text for contrast against the amber reel background.

Large round click targets; the central SPIN/AUTOPLAY button is the largest single target. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop the spin (keyboard-operable), and holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin. Autoplay (slider up to at least 100 spins) reduces required repeated clicks.

Stable control layout across the whole session: menu and sound icons stacked bottom-far-left, 'i' info button just right of them, bet +/- flanking the central spin/autoplay button, Ante Bet panel far left of the reels, Buy Free Spins panel far right. The info/rules booklet is a linear 7-page sequence navigated with previous/close/next controls and a 'Page N/7' label.

Payline number tokens on both reel edges are colorblind-safe: every colored token also prints its line number (1-25), so payline identity does not depend on color perception; matches the numbered 'Line N' captions printed in the Rules & Lines panel.
Special symbols carry printed text beneath the artwork ('WILD' in red letters, 'SCATTER' in blue letters, 'BONUS' in dark red letters), so identification does not rely on color alone.

Gambling Round color guess buttons carry text labels 'Black'/'Red' in addition to color, and the suit guess buttons show distinct suit icon shapes (Spade/Club vs Diamond/Heart) rather than relying on color alone.

Special symbols are self-labelled by name text on the tile, not by color alone: WILD (gold/red ancient ship on light-blue sky), SCATTER (Poseidon, white-bearded, blue/white tones), BONUS (Minotaur, red fur, gold horns, orange flame). Free Spins entry is signalled by a full background-palette swap (daytime blue-teal temple to dark navy/midnight sky) plus explicit text, not a single color swatch.

Winning payline is marked by three redundant non-color cues: an animated blue glow outline on the winning symbols, a traced blue line across the payline shape, and explicit 'LINE n PAYS' text (win highlight glow is blue, not red).

Gamble suit choice is doubly coded: by icon shape (spade/club vs diamond/heart) in addition to the black 'Black' button (left) and red 'Red' button (right), so suit or button position can be used instead of hue.

No audio-only information was observed. Music and sound effects are adjustable independently via Settings sliders and are decorative; all win/feature-state information (amounts, spins remaining, gamble outcomes) is presented as on-screen text.

Bottom-bar readouts are white/yellow text on a near-black bar for high contrast; paytable payouts are printed as plain white/gold text next to each symbol icon, never color-only; rules body text is plain white on a dark panel.

The round Spin button is the largest single target on screen; +/- steppers for Line Count and Bet Value are grouped tightly so one pointer region covers both bet dimensions; MAX BET offers a one-click way to reach maximum stake without repeated stepper clicks.

Control positions are stable across all game states: top-right cluster (gear/speaker/menu) is constant; bottom bar keeps Line Count left-of-center, Spin dead-center, Bet Value right-of-center, with Balance/Total Bet as outermost readouts. Rules & Lines and Paytable are both plain, linear scrolling documents reached from the same left-hand tab list.

Multiplier board never relies on color alone: all 14 payout cells and the SPIN gate carry their value/label as printed text. The board's color gradient runs magenta/hot-pink at the outer '100' cells, through pink-red, red-orange, orange-red, orange, yellow-orange, to pale yellow near the center, with the center SPIN gate in cyan/sky-blue, distinctly different from every payout cell.

The three bonus-meter bumpers are distinguishable from the plain grey pin dots by color (bright orange/gold vs pale grey), by shape and size (larger glossy circle with an internal sun/gear glyph vs a small flat dot), and by fixed position (always the same triangular cluster in the upper-middle of the board) - redundant cues beyond color alone.

Sound and Music are OFF by default. No gameplay-critical information appears to depend on audio in the captured frames - wheel results, drop results and bonus awards are all also shown as on-screen text/numbers.

The FAST GAME toggle and the settings-menu Sound/Music/Animation toggles use both track color (grey=off vs green=on) and the position of the white circle (left=off, right=on), so switch state can be read by position even where color contrast is hard to perceive.

Bet adjustments (BET PER BALL, BALL PER DROP) are only via small stepper up/down arrow buttons - no keyboard or free-text entry alternative exists. Reaching extreme values (e.g. BET PER BALL from 0.01 to 10) may require many repeated taps; no hold-to-repeat or drag-to-set behavior was confirmed.

The game is entirely canvas-rendered, so no native DOM text exists for a screen reader to read; every element described in this documentation (bet/win amounts, board labels, wheel outcomes) would need to be exposed via an accessibility overlay layer. Monetary values (BET/WIN/balance) are always paired with a small circular '$' coin icon rather than relying on symbol placement alone.

Payout buckets are color-coded red -> orange -> yellow -> green by multiplier size (edge buckets red/orange on higher-risk tables, center buckets green), but every bucket also always prints its multiplier as bold black text (e.g. 'x1000', 'x0.2'), so no payout information is conveyed by color alone.

The selected Risk Level and Bet Mode option is marked by a solid magenta/pink pill fill plus bold white text; unselected options sit on the plain dark-purple panel with muted lavender-grey text, so selection state has both a shape and a text-weight cue beyond color.

The decorative sunburst/fern motif behind the history table is intentionally very low-contrast pale blue against the blue background and carries no game information, so low-vision players who cannot perceive it are not missing anything functional.

Bet stepper buttons (Min/-/+/Max) show a distinct greyed/desaturated visual state and stop responding to clicks once the minimum or maximum bet is reached; during ball flight, Risk Level and the row-count selector are likewise visibly greyed and locked, leaving only Bet Mode interactive, so users relying on visual feedback can tell which controls are currently actionable.

The orange 'Win X.XX FUN' banner appears after every round, even when the bucket multiplier is below x1 and the round is a net loss (all three captured real rounds landed below x1 and were shown as 'Win'). The true signed result only appears in the separate 'Profit' column of the history table (e.g. '-0.50 FUN'), inside a plain cyan pill that does not itself change color for win vs loss. A screen-reader script must announce the signed Profit value, not just the 'Win' banner text, or a player could believe every round was a win.

All 4 plushie symbols distinguishable by shape alone: Chick (round, no ears), Turtle (shell dome, flippers), Cat (pointed triangular ears), Round-eared animal (rounded ears, wide muzzle). Color is secondary. Payline arrows are pink triangular arrowheads on cabinet frame — shape-redundant. Volatility badge uses 3-of-5 count fill, readable in grayscale. Win highlight uses brightness glow on center-row cell borders plus large pink win-amount text above grid.

SOUND toggle in System Settings (hamburger menu) and speaker button in side panel. Win outcome fully communicated visually: win-amount dollar text above center row, cyan LED-glow border on winning cells, brightness change on message bar below grid. No audio-only game information identified.

Win amount displayed as large hot-pink dollar text centered above center row (e.g. '$1.00'). CREDIT and BET values shown as numeric text in bottom bar at all times. Modal headings in orange-amber high-contrast text. Volatility badge: 3 of 5 lightning bolts filled — count readable even at reduced display size.

Single large SPIN button centered at bottom; hold for turbo spin (text printed on button ring). Autoplay supports up to 100 spins; SKIP SCREENS is pre-checked by default, reducing interaction needs. Bet adjustable via bottom-bar +/- ovals, bet menu (coin-stack icon), or system settings — multiple paths. Feature-free slot: no bonus choices, pick screens, or secondary interactions required per spin.

Win amounts appear as on-screen dollar text ($1.00, $5.00, $20.00 etc.). CREDIT and BET labels with numeric values always visible in bottom bar. Modal dialogs (system settings, bet menu, autoplay) have text headings and labeled fields. Single fixed center payline — only the center row scores, simplifying screen-reader narration of outcomes.

The four suit tiles are four different symbols with non-standard tints: spade red, heart purple, club blue, diamond green. Only the suit SHAPE on the tile is a reliable cue; the red spade and green diamond can look alike under red-green colorblindness.
The two knights differ by plume color (red vs blue), the mark on the tabard (red diamond vs dark club) and card tint, so shape and color both identify them.

Wild is recognized by the gold letter W and stack-of-cards look; Scatter carries the text label SCATTER on the chest. Multiplier-Ways value is a numeral xN on a red ribbon. Win amounts and way counts are printed as numbers.
All information appears on screen as text and visual effects; the sound toggle is in the menu. No audio-only cues documented, though not verified with sound.

Panels use white headings and grey text on a dark grey-navy background with orange numeric values; the selected autoplay option is orange text on a darker brown fill, so state is also readable by contrast.

All main controls are large round buttons in one bottom row, the Spin button being the biggest. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; free spins run automatically after Start. PC version: Space starts a spin, hold Space to continue spins, Space during a spin skips the reel animation.
The game is drawn on a canvas with a DOM control layer. Paytable and Rules panels are real readable DOM text; the reel field itself is not text.

High symbols distinguished by unique illustration subjects: portrait face, armor silhouette with pauldrons, chariot wheels, elongated military object, round coin. Low symbols are distinct letter and numeral shapes. Color is secondary — shape alone identifies each symbol.

WILD has both volcano eruption illustration AND bold 'WILD' text label. SCATTER identified by fiery sphere shape and paytable context, not color alone. Bonus buy dialog options distinguished by full text labels. Settings toggles: knob position (right=on, left=off) supplements green/grey color.

All win amounts, Free Spins remaining counts, multiplier values, and complete game rules displayed as visible text. No audio-only information detected. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX independently toggleable off from System Settings.

SPIN button is the largest and most prominent element in the bottom bar. CREDIT and BET amounts displayed in large gold numerals. Live MEGAWAYS counter at top of reel area updates each spin in large green numerals. Symbol frames use high-contrast gold (high symbols) and silver (low symbols) borders.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spin; hold SPACE for Turbo Spin. Autoplay available for up to 100 spins. SKIP SCREENS option in autoplay reduces required interactions during bonus feature intro and end screens. Large SPIN button is the most prominent and easiest-to-target UI element.

CREDIT and BET are labeled text fields in bottom bar, readable as amounts. All game rules presented as text across 6 info pages. During Free Spins, 'FREE SPINS LEFT' count and 'MULTIPLIER' label are readable text elements on left panel. Live MEGAWAYS counter shows current ways-to-win as a numeral.

The 4 high-value bubbles use redundant coding: Star (deep violet-purple tile + gold star icon), Heart (magenta/pink tile + gold heart icon), Diamond (red tile + gold diamond/gem icon) are each identified by BOTH tile color and a distinct icon shape - not color alone.

Risk: the 4 low-value bubbles (sky-blue, green, teal/turquoise, pink-lavender/orchid) carry no icon at all - they are plain flat circles distinguished from one another ONLY by tile color. Same risk applies to the Orange ball bubble, which has no icon, only a slightly darker orange shading versus its tile.

All 9 feature/mini-feature badges (Wild Blast, Clone, X-Lines, Smash, Re-Spin, Wild Drop, Big Symbol, W Symbol, Progress Bar) print a letter glyph AND a full text name on screen alongside their color, so feature identity does not depend on hue perception.

Minor residual gap: the 4-page splash carousel's page-indicator dots use a single solid-orange dot among plain white-outlined circles with no numeral - a color-only cue, though dot position (1st/2nd/3rd/4th) remains a usable non-color fallback.
Buy Bonus disabled state (price exceeds balance) is shown by desaturating the whole ribbon while the price number stays fully legible text, not a color-only signal.

No information is audio-only: the Settings panel exposes explicit Music and Sound FX toggles plus a Volume slider, and all game feedback (wins, feature names, progress bar, balance) is rendered as on-screen text/graphics.

Large round primary targets for Spin and Autoplay. Spacebar can substitute for clicking Spin (togglable in Settings), reducing required precise clicks. Autoplay round count is chosen from large preset buttons (10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 750, 1000, infinity) rather than free-text entry.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across all gameplay screens: info+settings bottom-left, bet stepper center, autoplay+spin bottom-right, balance readout left-of-center. Paytable (21 pages) and rules (14 pages) are strictly linear scrollable booklets rather than tabbed structures, suiting sequential traversal.
ANTE BET toggle state is shown by both hue (dull red = off, bright green = on) and by the fill length of the pill-shaped bar (empty vs completely full), not colour alone
AUTOPLAY checkboxes (Turbo Spin / Quick Spin / Skip Screens) show checked state via fill colour AND a white checkmark glyph, not colour alone
Settings toggles (Ambient Music / Sound FX / Battery Saver) show ON/OFF via track colour, knob position (left vs right), and a pause-bars icon that appears only in the ON state
Sticky WILD symbols left on the board during Free Spins are marked by a glowing halo/brightness effect around the symbol border, not by colour alone
High and low paytable symbols are each identifiable by a unique pictogram, letter or number shape in addition to any colour coding
Paytable and rules text is white or gold on a near-black semi-transparent panel; HUD text is gold/orange on a dark strip - both high-contrast combinations
All interactions are simple single clicks/taps on buttons or a horizontal slider; SPACE and ENTER keyboard keys are offered as alternatives to clicking the spin button

Same-hue symbol pairs are also distinguished by silhouette/shape: Blue potion (round bottle+cork) vs Eye (eyeball with pupil); Purple potion (bottle) vs Purple snail (coiled shell). The four Countdown sub-features are each coded by color AND a distinct icon shape (flask/shield-arrow/lightning bolt/arrow) AND a printed word.

Honest gap: the four potion-bottle symbols (green/red/purple/blue) are shape-identical (round bottle, gold cork) and differ ONLY by liquid color. This does not change payout within a pair (Green=Red ladder, Purple=Blue ladder), but a color-blind player cannot tell the two ladders apart by shape alone if hue perception fails.
Win-tier escalation (BIG WIN green/yellow gradient, MEGA WIN green/yellow-green gradient, TOTAL WIN orange/red gradient) is also conveyed by the printed words themselves, not by color alone.

No audio-only information was observed on any captured screen; all state (wins, bonus active, feature name, RTP, bet) is shown as on-screen text/numbers. Settings panel exposes independent Music and Sound FX toggles plus a master Volume slider, so audio can be fully disabled without losing any information.

Bet amount is adjusted with small up/down triangle buttons rather than a slider, which is easy to mis-click. Spacebar-to-spin is available and enabled by default, reducing the need for precise mouse clicks. Autoplay presets (10 up to infinite) reduce required repeated clicks.

Bottom control bar has stable, always-in-the-same-place controls: Info(i) and Settings at far left, Balance/Total-bet center-left, Autospin(A) and Spin/refresh at far right. Buy Bonus button and price are always in a fixed banner above the top-right of the reel grid. Paytable/Rules booklets are single continuously-scrollable panels (no next/prev pagination), reachable via 3 stacked icon buttons on the panel's left edge.

Toggle switches show state via both color and knob position (right=on/left=off); checkboxes use a checkmark glyph, not color alone. Royal-letter low-value symbols are distinguished primarily by their printed letter and secondarily by glow color: A=red/pink, K=cyan/turquoise, Q=purple/magenta, J=green, 10=blue, 9=orange. Free-spins-left, multiplier and ways counters are printed numerals, not color cues. Residual risk: the gamble screen's WIN (green) vs LOSE (red) banners rely partly on color, but each also carries its own text label.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles in System Settings. All game state (free spins remaining, multiplier value, ways count, win amounts, bonus-active status) is conveyed with on-screen text and numerals.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN and menu/sound icons. The bet menu offers both incremental +/- steppers and a one-click 'BET MAX' shortcut. SPACE/ENTER give keyboard-only spin control, and holding SPACE activates turbo spin without opening the settings menu. Autoplay supports fixed counts up to 100, reducing repeated clicks.

Bottom-bar controls sit in stable positions across all frames: hamburger-menu and sound icons far-left, a separate 'i' info icon next to them, CREDIT/BET readout left-of-centre, bet -/+ flanking the large central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY pill below SPIN. The paytable/rules booklet is a linear 8-page sequence navigated with left/right green triangle arrows and closed with a green 'X', with a 'Page N/8' counter always bottom-right.

Royal symbols (A red, K gold/yellow, Q purple/lavender, J blue/cyan, 10 green, 9 pink/magenta) are color-coded per rank but each always shows its own letter/number text, so rank stays legible without color discrimination; toggle switches, confirm/cancel controls and feature-state changes (free spins remaining, multiplier value) are conveyed via shape/position/text, not color alone.

No audio-only information observed; wins, spins remaining, multiplier growth and feature triggers are all conveyed via on-screen text/plaques; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative to comprehension.
Win amounts, free-spins-remaining counts and multiplier values are shown as large high-contrast gold/white text on dark panels, legible without fine color discrimination.

Large circular SPIN button is the largest touch target; SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spins without a mouse; AUTOPLAY (configurable spin count, default 100) with a SKIP SCREENS option reduces required interactions through the multi-step Buy Free Spins -> Gamble -> Free Spins -> Win sequence.

Info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with an explicit 'Page n/7' readout on every page, navigable via dedicated previous/next/close controls; bottom-bar control layout (menu/sound/info icons far-left, CREDIT/BET labels, bet +/- flanking SPIN, AUTOPLAY below SPIN) is stable across all screens.
Jackpot tiers differ by chip colour (Mini blue, Minor green, Mega red, Grand gold) but are also labelled with text and ordered by size, smallest at bottom rising to largest at top.
Multiplier tags (pink/magenta) and Addition tags (blue) always carry an 'xN' or '+N' glyph, so the two remain distinguishable without relying on colour alone.
Settings panel exposes three independent mute toggles (All Sounds / Sound Effects / Music); all feature triggers and outcomes are also shown as on-screen text, so no audio-only information was found.
The 3-gem Enhancer track shown on the right edge of the reel frame during the Bonus Game conveys its state purely by a lit/unlit teal gem, with no numeric or text label anywhere on screen.

Spin, Autoplay and Bet Select are large, clearly separated circular buttons stacked on the right edge; a single Spin press also cancels an active Autoplay run, and 'Quick Play' (press anywhere or the space bar) skips animations to shorten the wait between actions.

The Wild Symbol's rule text calls the Instant Prize Symbol the 'Coin Symbol' in one sentence and the 'Instant Prize Symbol' elsewhere for the same object; a screen-reader script should normalise this to one name.

'MEGA WIN' is a generic win-size celebration label, distinct from the 'MEGA' jackpot tier name; the two are visually and verbally identical words for unrelated concepts and should be disambiguated in narration.
The active step of the multiplier ladder x1, x2, x3, x5 is shown by larger size and brightness (large bright red versus small dull brown) and by position, not only by colour.

Symbols differ by shape and picture (pot, ingot, pouch, lantern, ring, knot), not by hue alone; letters A, K, Q, J and numbers 10, 9 are in different colours (teal-green, cyan, blue, magenta-purple, violet, grey-blue) but each has its own glyph.

Wild is a gold coin with the word WILD; Bonus is a red envelope with the word Bonus; Angpau (red) and Golden Angpau (golden-yellow) are told apart by envelope emblem (diamond versus ingot) as well as colour.

Win amounts are printed as numbers on banners (teal WIN, red-and-gold TOTAL WIN). Bonus prize cells show a number on a red burst, and remaining bonus spins are shown as text BONUS SPIN plus lit or dark ingot icons.
A Sound toggle exists in the panel menu; no captions were captured. Win and bonus information is on-screen text.
Panel notes are light grey on dark grey, lower contrast than the yellow values. Balance, bet and win sit in fixed pills (balance left, win centre, bet right).

Spin by tapping the large centre button or pressing Space; holding Space spins continuously. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; a Turbo toggle exists. Minus and plus buttons beside the spin button are small.
Canvas-rendered game; no evidence of screen-reader text was found on the frames.

Base game uses a warm red-gold-orange palette (title wordmark, frame, Buy Feature/Super Bet pills, Firecrackers symbol, K letter) against jade-green accents (Gold Horseshoe Wild, Q letter, pagoda roofs) and a violet Multiplier badge with a teal/cyan Lines badge; the two most hue-similar low symbols, K (red/orange) and A (gold/orange), remain distinguishable by their letter shape, not colour alone.

State changes are cued redundantly, not by colour alone: the Super Bet pill changes colour (dark red to bright blue) AND its printed price doubles AND gains a border highlight; winning symbols are marked by a flame-shaped outline AND a numeral win overlay AND bottom-bar WIN text; Free Games are cued by a day-to-night background palette shift AND an explicit 'N FREE GAMES LEFT' text watermark.

No audio-only information was observed. Ambient sound and sound effects are independently togglable and purely decorative; all wins, feature triggers, free-game counts and multiplier values are conveyed as on-screen text/numerals in addition to any sound effect.

Bet/Win/Balance amounts, feature-trigger banners and the Help screen all use large high-contrast text (white/orange on black, or cream/gold on a dark wood panel) with key numbers repeated in more than one place on the same frame, e.g. a win amount shown both as an overlay on the winning line and again in the bottom service strip.

All primary actions (Spin, Auto Play, Info) are large circular buttons; Buy Feature and Super Bet are large pill buttons directly on the play field, reachable without opening a submenu. Auto Play offers configurable stop conditions (Free Games triggered, balance drop, single win threshold, jackpot won) to reduce the number of manual actions needed for extended play.

Control positions are stable across states: info button far-left of the bottom bar, bet controls left-of-centre, Spin dead-centre, Auto Play immediately right of Spin, coin controls right-of-centre, balance far-right. The paytable/rules booklet is a strictly linear 16-page sequence (wraps at the end) navigable with 3 buttons (previous/close/next); the Help screen is a single linear scroll with clearly labelled section headers, well suited to top-to-bottom screen-reader traversal.

The 5 Viking characters differ by unique appearance — gender (one female), age (young vs. old), hair color (orange-red, brown, red, light), and helmet presence — in addition to frame color (purple, teal/dark-green, blue/steel-blue, brown/warm-wood, pink/magenta). Royals are identified by letter or numeral (A/K/Q/J/10); color differences are secondary to character shape. SCATTER has a unique helmet-face-mask shape and 'SCATTER' text label — identifiable without color. Buy Free Spins dialog uses an X mark for cancel and a checkmark for confirm; shape-coded, not color-coded.

All feature triggers and win amounts are communicated visually. Free Spins trigger and end both show full-screen text overlays with numeric win values and 'PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE' prompt. Level Up tracker bar displays beer counts and level award multipliers as numbers updated after each free spin. Win tiers (e.g., MEGA!) are shown as text labels. Ambient Music and Sound FX can be toggled independently via System Settings.

SPIN is a large circular button (dominant element, right of bottom bar). SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts available. Bet adjusted via dedicated +/- oval buttons flanking the spin button, or via bet menu. Full autoplay up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option enabled by default (auto-skips intro/end overlays). Turbo Spin via SPACE hold or Autoplay Settings checkbox.

CREDIT and BET values in bottom bar update after each spin. During Free Spins, Level Up tracker bar shows beer count (circular badge with numeral) and current level award multiplier in gold numerals per reel — all numerical. Feature transitions use full-screen text overlays. Settings, Autoplay, and Buy Free Spins dialogs are modal overlays with labeled toggle controls, numeric displays, and X close button at top-right.

The PUMP button's colour change from an orange-to-yellow gradient (idle and holding) to a desaturated olive/mustard gradient (after a loss) is reinforced by the avatar's frowning facial expression and by the balance figure staying unchanged, so the loss is not colour-dependent to understand, only for a faster glance. The selected bet amount is marked by both bold weight and colour (green versus pale grey), and the gender-toggle handle position (top versus bottom) is a positional cue independent of colour.

No audio-only information was identified; a sound on/off slider exists in Settings, implying audio (music and sound effects) is decorative rather than carrying unique game-state information. All observed state changes (multiplier growth, win, loss, balance) are conveyed visually and/or as text.

The live multiplier (white text with a light outline) and the Bank value (bright green) are printed large and high-contrast, growing more prominent as the round progresses, and the win banner text ('YOU WIN!', win amount) is bold and high-contrast. However round outcome in the ordinary case is signalled only by a small top-left balance counter changing, which is easy to miss without magnification.

The entire round outcome depends on how precisely and for how long the player holds the PUMP button before an unpredictable cut-off point (the character 'gets tired'). There is no auto-cash-out target, no turbo or slow timing option, and no keyboard-equivalent control confirmed in the captured frames. This hold-and-release mechanic is the primary accessibility barrier of the game for players with limited fine motor control or reaction speed.

Control layout is stable and simple: balance top-left; TURBO UNIVERSE, sound and settings icons top-right; a single large PUMP button bottom-centre flanked by a bet-amount stepper; a two-position gender toggle on the far right edge. The rules booklet is reachable via six named jump links (How to Play?, Game Details, RTP, Settings, Disconnection Policy, Version), which suits heading-based navigation.

The six playing-card low symbols (A/K/Q/J/10/9) share the same orange plaid treatment and are distinguished purely by printed glyph, safe for all forms of color blindness. Free Games are signalled by a background palette shift AND a changing text label ('FREE GAMES COLLECTED' to 'FREE GAMES LEFT') AND an icon change on the spin button, not by color alone. Toggle switches show slider position in addition to color.

No information observed is conveyed by audio alone. The Settings panel exposes independent Sound - Ambient and Sound - Effects toggles plus a master Volume slider, and every state change (wins, feature triggers, counters, jackpot amounts) is also rendered as on-screen text or numerals.

The central SPIN button is the largest target on the bar. Space bar can both start and stop the reels, reducing the need for precise pointer clicks. Autoplay offers configurable stop conditions (feature-triggered, balance-decrease, single-win-exceeds), further reducing the number of required interactions.

The game's own bottom bar is stable and left-to-right ordered: info -> bet -> bet level -> bet max -> spin (largest, centered) -> autoplay -> coin -> balance. The Help screen is a genuine scrollable HTML document with real section headers, and the paytable/rules booklet is a strictly linear 8-page sequence navigable with just two directional controls plus one close/home control.

Bonus Game booster tiles: the ADD-vs-MULTIPLY distinction is marked by an on-tile symbol ('+' or '×'), not colour. However the single-reel-vs-all-reels distinction IS colour-coded only (green cauldrons act on one reel, blue cauldrons act on all reels), with no shape/text backup on the tile itself beyond the one-time explainer screen shown at the start of the Bonus Game -- flagged as a mild colour-dependency risk for colourblind players relying on cauldron colour alone during fast play.

Sound and Music are separate, independently toggleable channels in Game Settings. All game state (balance, win, bet, remaining Free Spins shown both on the spin button and as crystal icons, purchase confirmations, total-win summaries) is conveyed as on-screen text/numerals, not through audio cues alone.

The five low-value potion-flask symbols differ only by colour/silhouette (blue/teal/grey/pink/purple) but share an IDENTICAL payout table across all three match tiers -- a colour-vision-deficient or low-vision player loses no payout information by confusing them, since they are financially interchangeable; shape differences (rounded vs angular vs slumped vs twin-spout) provide a secondary non-colour cue regardless.

The bet ladder offers direct tap-to-select across 31 preset bet values (50 to 100000 FUN) instead of repeated +/- taps. Autoplay removes the need for repeated manual spins and offers 'Stop on any win'/'Stop if free spins is won' plus numeric cash-change stop conditions to limit unattended play length.

UI element positions documented as stable across screens: BALANCE/WIN/BET are always shown as three labelled fields at the bottom of the screen in that left-to-right order; the large circular spin button sits at the right edge of the screen and switches to showing the remaining-spins count as a number during the Bonus Game instead of the spin icon.

Base game background: clear blue sky with white clouds, green grass strip, grey rocks, dark pink/maroon bush, pale pink windmill in the distance; switches to a dark navy sky with warm orange lamp glow during the Bonus Game.

Coop structure: dark reddish-brown wood-shingle roof, brick-red/terracotta stone pillars, amber-glowing hanging bulbs. Reel cells are dark maroon crates with tan straw; higher-value cells (fox, dog, Wild) are additionally marked by a silver chain-link overlay and a gold/yellow border, a non-colour cue.
Purple Fox symbol: purple body, lavender/white muzzle-chest-paws, white-and-purple ears with pale pink inner ear, black nose, red/orange mouth, amber-gold eyes, purple tail with white tip.
Farm dog symbol: white body with brown/tan patches, pink mouth with red tongue, blue collar with a round gold 'DOG' tag.

Rooster symbol: orange-tan body, dark green tail/wing feathers, red comb, orange beak, white cheek patches; from behind the green feathers over the orange body can look like a root vegetable but it is the same symbol seen from an unusual pose.
Grey hen symbol: pale grey/white plump body with faint blue-grey wing shading, small red comb dot, orange beak.
White standing bird symbol: flat plain white body, wings spread, tiny red comb mark, orange beak, closed sleepy eyes.
Two chicks with egg symbol: two yellow fuzzy chicks beside a whole and a broken salmon-pink egg in golden straw.
Eggs in nest symbol: three plain salmon-pink eggs piled in straw, no characters.
Wild symbol: weathered orange/tan wooden crate boards with 'WILD' painted in dripping magenta paint, identified by printed text and shape, not colour alone.
Bonus Scatter symbol: silver bear-trap/crown-shaped trap in straw under blue-grey 'BONUS SCATTER' 3D letters, identified by printed text, not colour alone.

Super Game Counter column (right of reel 5): purple/lilac strip with 3 round chrome discs, blank/unlit when empty and replaced by a coloured badge once a booster is won; the booster's name is always printed as text on the badge, not colour-coded only.
Bottom bar: dark brown/near-black strip with white 'BALANCE'/'WIN'/'BET' labels and bright yellow numeric values, distinguished by fixed left/centre/right position and label text, not colour alone.
Toggle switches in Game Settings and Autoplay stop-conditions are dual-coded: knob position (left=off, right=on) plus fill colour (grey=off, yellow=on).

Residual colour-only cue: in the bet selector the 'currently applied' bet is highlighted solid yellow while a previously browsed bet is highlighted solid white, with no additional shape or text cue distinguishing the two states on that screen.

No audio-only information observed; Sound and Music are independently toggleable in Game Settings. All game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, booster assignment, RTP/bet limits) is conveyed as on-screen text and numbers.

Right-hand control column and primary controls use large circular touch targets, with SPIN the largest; bet and autoplay round-count selection use large pill buttons rather than fine sliders, though the autoplay numeric stop-condition fields use small +/- steppers.

Right-hand control column keeps a stable top-to-bottom order (turbo, autoplay, spin, bet, menu) across every base-game and Bonus Game frame; rules/paytable/booster/paylines content is a single linear scroll reached via the '?' icon.

Jackpot tiers MINOR (green), GRAND (red, center) and MAJOR (purple) are labelled with text in fixed left/center/right positions, not color alone. Volatility is shown as a lightning-bolt fill-count plus the explicit word 'Medium'. Settings toggles use knob left/right position in addition to color (white=off, green=on). Autoplay/free-spins running state also changes the control icon shape (play-arrows vs stop-square), not just color.

No audio-only information observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are decorative toggles. Spin results, respins left, free spins left, win amounts and feature triggers are all conveyed via on-screen text and imagery.
Win amounts and feature banners ('WINNER', 'CONGRATULATIONS', 'FREE SPINS COMPLETED') are rendered as large, high-contrast gold text on a dark background.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop spins; holding SPACE activates turbo spin. Autoplay (settable spin count, SKIP SCREENS option) reduces required clicks. The Money Respin RESPIN button is manual only — no auto-respin toggle was observed.

Control positions are stable across screens: menu/sound icons stacked bottom-left, info 'i' button beside them, bet +/- flanking the SPIN button, autoplay button below it. The 7-page rules booklet is a linear sequence navigated with previous/close/next, with an explicit 'Page N/7' readout on every page.
Card suits (Spade, Heart, Club, Diamond) each have a unique internationally-recognized shape independent of color, allowing full distinction without color perception

WILD symbol carries large WILD text label in gold; during Free Spins and Super Free Spins the multiplier value (x2 or x3) is displayed as text directly on the Wild cell, confirming the multiplier without color reliance
Super Scatter is differentiated from regular Scatter by a bold SUPER text label printed on the symbol face — readable without distinguishing golden shell from orange shell by color alone
SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC independently toggleable in settings; all win amounts, feature triggers, spin counts, and game outcomes communicated entirely through on-screen text and numerals
All win amounts, credit, bet, spin count, and feature counters displayed as large high-contrast amber-gold numerals on dark background in the bottom bar and center overlays throughout gameplay
SPACE and ENTER keyboard keys trigger spin; autoplay configurable up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option to auto-dismiss intro and end overlays; TURBO and QUICK spin modes reduce cycle time
Win overlays use explicit text (CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON $X IN N FREE SPINS!); scrolling top ticker announces active rules and feature states in text form; info pages labeled Page N/8
The lit multiplier medallion (red-orange with gold rim; inactive steps dark grey) is also larger and raised, and every step carries its printed number
Symbols differ by shape and illustration, not only colour; low symbols are the letters A, K, Q on dark blue-purple stone tiles with gold letters
Scatter and Wild carry a text label on the tile itself (Scatter label, WILD lettering on the chest)
Autoplay tile selection: selected value turns orange and the Start Auto Spin button changes from dull brown to solid orange; disabled state is also lower contrast
Free spin choice scrolls are distinguished by colour of the multiplier numbers (red, blue, purple) and also by printed spin counts and numbers
Win amounts are printed as numbers in the banner and in the WIN strip; info strip text is pale cyan-white on dark brown
Orange is used for panel titles, paytable numbers and active buttons; gold for lettering and rims on a dark panel background
Keyboard Space starts a spin on PC; Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins; Turbo toggle available
Free spin choice has a countdown timer that auto-selects a variant, so a player who cannot tap in time gets an automatically chosen variant
Feature outcomes (Remaining Free Spin count, Total Win, Win banner) are printed as text; no audio-only information observed in frames (sound not evaluated)

Most affordances are non-color: settings toggles use thumb position, checkboxes use a check-mark glyph, the three info-page nav icons use distinct shapes (triangle-left/X/triangle-right), free-spins choice plaques carry explicit printed spin-count and multiplier numbers regardless of plaque color, and volatility is shown as a lightning-bolt count plus explanatory text. The four high-value symbols are additionally distinguished by distinct pictorial content (queen face/falcon head/cobra head/jackal head), not only by their card-frame color (red/pink/green/navy-blue).
WILD medallion tiles are turquoise/teal but also carry the printed word 'WILD' in gold lettering, so identity does not rely on color alone even when stacked vertically across a reel.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, free spins left, chosen multiplier, round completion) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

Large round click targets for SPIN, bet +/-, menu, sound and info buttons. SPACE and ENTER are keyboard-operable alternatives to clicking SPIN. AUTOPLAY (configurable spin count plus a SKIP SCREENS option) reduces repeated clicks; the free-spins choice screen requires an explicit click/tap on one of the 4 plaques, with no documented keyboard shortcut found for that specific screen.

Stable control positions across all base-game screens: menu (hamburger) + sound + info ('i') clustered bottom-left, CREDIT/BET readout center-left, bet -/+ and SPIN clustered center-right, AUTOPLAY beside SPIN, provider name bottom-left. The info booklet is a fixed linear 6-page sequence navigated with prev/next arrows and closed with a center X.

All 10 prize tiers use the same navy medallion cell art (queen's profile with vulture/cobra headdress) distinguished only by the printed dollar-amount text, not by color or shape — a numeric-literacy dependency rather than a color dependency, so it is broadly consistent across color-blind types but remains a legibility burden (no shape/position/connecting-line cue marks the winning trio of 3 matching cells). A gold border highlight + red-orange text is applied to whichever cell(s) show the card's own single highest-value tier present (observed on $100,000 cells); this is COSMETIC ONLY (marks 'biggest prize printed on this card'), NOT a win indicator — confirmed by a losing card with one highlighted $100,000 cell and no WIN text, and by winning cards with unrelated highlighted cells. The sole reliable win indicator is the text 'WIN $X.XX' readout at the bottom of the screen.

AMBIENT and SOUND FX audio toggles are independently controllable in the Settings dropdown (gear icon). All outcomes — prize values, win/loss state, ticket count, and instructions — are conveyed via visible text; no game information is audio-only.

Minimal interaction: select a bundle radio button, click BUY NOW, then either click SCRATCH! (reveals all 9 cells at once, no cell-by-cell clicking required) or press AUTOPLAY once to auto-resolve every purchased ticket in the session hands-free. A single STOP button halts AUTOPLAY at any point. No time pressure or rapid input required.

All game state readable as text: CREDIT balance, TICKETS LEFT count, persistent 'MATCH 3 TO WIN!' instruction, TOTAL WIN and WIN amounts appear only after a winning card. Prize table is a structured 3-column text table (Tier / Prizes Available / Award) with total tickets (10,000,000) and theoretical RTP range (76.5%-85%) stated as text on a single static page. Each revealed cell shows the dollar prize value as text beneath/on the relief. Purchase bundle rows are labeled with quantity, discount, and total price in text (e.g. '25 games (save 5%) $23.75').

Free Games is signalled by a full scene change (sunset sky to night starfield), not a single hue swap; jackpot identity is printed as text ('Grand Jackpot'/'Minor Jackpot') alongside its ticker; settings toggles use knob position in addition to color (orange=on/grey=off)

Residual color-only risk: winning symbol positions are marked with a cyan glow box rather than an outline-shape change, though their position around the winning symbols and an adjacent floating win number provide a non-color anchor
No audio-only information observed; bet, win, balance, remaining free spins and feature triggers are all conveyed as on-screen text; sound (Ambient/Effects toggles in settings) is decorative only

Pay Table and Help panels use a plain black background with white body text and orange numerals for payout tiers -- a fixed high-contrast palette, not user-adjustable, but consistently legible without relying on color alone

All primary buttons are large circular touch targets (SPIN is the largest); BET MAX and AUTOPLAY reduce the number of clicks needed to reach maximum stake or run unattended spins; the Help text documents Space-bar support to both start and stop a spin

Bottom control bar order is stable across all states: info/paytable button far left, bet controls center-left, SPIN centered, autoplay control just right of SPIN, coin controls center-right, balance far right; a secondary gear/settings control sits on the thin service bar below. Pay Table and Help are each one continuous scrolling document with no blind-navigation tabs
Royal symbols carry both a distinct color and a small heart-suit (or spade-suit on J) corner mark: A magenta/pink, K orange, Q gold/yellow, J blue, 10 red, 9 green.
Jackpot tier names (GRAND red-outlined, MAJOR blue-outlined, MINOR green-outlined, MINI purple/lavender-outlined) are shown as printed text, not by outline color alone.
WILD is a solid glossy red heart with no other players relying on color alone since it also has a distinct shape (heart) and is called out by name in the rules text.

Free Spins mode is signalled by a full scene/background palette shift (deep purple/teal base game to a saturated red heart-pattern background with black reel cells) plus an explicit 'FREE SPINS LEFT n' text counter, not by color alone.
Wheel Feature wedge segments each carry a distinct background color AND printed text (JACKPOT / dollar value / FREE GAMES / MULTIPLIER), so wedge meaning is not color-only.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; win amounts, feature triggers, spins-left counters and jackpot values are all shown as on-screen text/graphics. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable in Settings.
Primary controls (SPIN, bet +/-, AUTOPLAY, BUY FREE SPINS) are large, high-contrast round or pill-shaped targets; SPACE and ENTER also start/stop spins, reducing precise mouse targeting.
Autoplay supports up to 100 spins with a 'SKIP SCREENS' option, reducing the number of individual actions needed for extended play.

Control layout is stable across all screens: hamburger-menu and sound icons at far-left of the bottom bar, 'i' info button beside them, CREDIT/BET labels left-of-centre, round SPIN button centred with bet +/- flanking it, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN.
The 7-page rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigated with left-triangle/right-triangle controls and closed with a centre X, suitable for sequential traversal.

The RA and OSIRIS volatility profiles differ mainly by color (a warm orange-red sunset scene versus a dark green misty scene), yet they carry different RTP (96.53% versus 96.54%) and different Free Spins trigger frequency and average win. For a player who cannot rely on the orange-versus-green cue, the two modes are also distinguished by on-screen text labels ('HIGH VS RA' / 'VERY HIGH VS OSIRIS'), by different character portraits, and by an overall brightness difference (bright warm scene versus dark scene).

The SCATTER symbol differs in shape as well as color between modes: a solid orange-gold disc in RA mode versus a black orb with a glowing outline in OSIRIS mode, so identifying the active mode on the reels does not rely on red-versus-green or orange-versus-green discrimination alone.

The pre-round Free Spins gamble wheel is split into a green 'WIN' sector and a red/maroon 'LOSE' sector; the only non-color fallback is the printed word inside each sector, which is present but small. This is flagged as a residual risk for deuteranope/protanope players, who should still be able to read the 'WIN'/'LOSE' text directly.

No information is conveyed by sound alone: wins, spins remaining, multipliers, RTP, bet values and feature outcomes are all shown as on-screen text or graphics. Ambient music and sound effects are purely decorative and can be switched off independently in system settings.

Enabled bet plus/minus buttons render bright and saturated (grey minus circle, bright green plus circle); a control at its limit renders visibly desaturated and darker (pale near-white minus circle at the floor, dark muted olive-green plus circle at the ceiling) -- a brightness/desaturation cue independent of exact hue discrimination.

The loading splash and the RA/OSIRIS choice gate both use high-contrast text (white/orange on black; gold lettering on warm or dark backgrounds), and toggle switches show ON/OFF by physical left/right handle position in addition to green fill color.

Large round click targets, with SPIN the largest. SPACE and ENTER start and stop spins without the mouse. Autoplay, with an adjustable spin count and configurable loss/win limits, sharply reduces the number of clicks needed for extended play. The Special Bets Super Spin modifier can also reduce the number of spins needed to see a guaranteed wild, at a real-money cost.

Control layout is fixed and identical across both modes: menu and info icons bottom-left, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, SPIN centered-right flanked by minus/plus, AUTOPLAY just below SPIN. The two volatility-mode toggle badges sit at a fixed position on the right edge of the base game and are always visible, not hidden in a menu. The info booklet is a strictly linear ten-page sequence navigated with the same three controls throughout.

Base-game background is a bright sunny daytime farm (pale blue sky, green fields); Free Spins switches the same scene to a warm sunset/dusk palette (deep orange-red sky, dark silhouetted tree) as a non-color-alone cue for the feature. Free-spins level is also shown as an explicit 'X2/X3/X5' text badge and a numeric points 'current/target' readout, not only by a color shift or fill level.

Royal letters are color-coded (A=red/orange, K=orange/amber, Q=light blue/cyan, J=green) but each also carries a distinct printed glyph (the letter itself), so identity remains legible without color discrimination.

Winning clusters are marked by a bright yellow/lime glow outline around each tile (shape/position cue), not by color alone. Toggle switches are also distinguished by handle position (left=off, right=on); checkboxes and cancel/confirm dialogs use glyph shapes (checkmark/X) in addition to color.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles. Win amounts, spins remaining, level/multiplier and points progress are all conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

Win amounts use large high-contrast gold or white text on a dark bottom bar; balance labels CREDIT/BET are gold/orange text; the free-spins points meter is an orange-liquid vertical gauge with a numeric readout.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, bet +/-, and menu/sound/info icons. SPACE and ENTER keys can start/stop a spin without a mouse. Autoplay (up to 100 spins) and the SKIP SCREENS option reduce the number of required interactions during long free-spins sequences.

Bottom-bar control layout is stable across all frames: menu/sound icons far-left, 'i' info button next to them, bet +/- flanking the central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY pill directly below SPIN. The 7-page rule booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigated with left-triangle/X/right-triangle and a 'Page N/7' indicator.
A crossed bed changes SHAPE, not just colour: its carrot becomes a gold coin bearing a carrot silhouette, so progress is legible without distinguishing hues.
Sound and music are separate toggles and every outcome is printed on screen, so nothing is carried by audio alone.
Each bed's multiplier is printed on its own signpost at a fixed height, and the pending payout is shown in a labelled CASHOUT field, so a still screen carries the whole state of the round.
The round is turn-based rather than timed - it waits for a step or a cash-out - and the menu offers stepping with the space bar instead of a precise tap.
The control bar is real DOM with named elements, but the garden and the rabbit are drawn on canvas, so progress is not exposed as text.

All 6 high-value symbols are sea creatures with distinct shapes: oyster shell, anchor, spiral snail, crab, starfish, fish — distinguishable by shape alone without color. All 4 gem symbols differ in shape (pentagon, square, cube, triangle) as well as color — fully shape-distinguishable.
WILD symbol has the text 'WILD' printed on it in white letters. SCATTER symbol has the text 'SCATTER' in green bubble letters — both are text-labeled, not color-only.

Volatility indicator shows 5 lightning-bolt icons plus the word 'VOLATILITY' — count and text convey the information, not just color. Ante Bet ON/OFF toggle is labeled with text and differentiated by indicator position (left=OFF, right=ON), not color alone.

Free Spins multiplier counter displays numeric text (e.g. '2X') plus label 'TOTAL MULTIPLIER' on a distinct wooden panel — no color dependency. MEGAWAYS counter is numeric text on a brown wooden board.

All game rules, feature descriptions, and win outcomes are provided in written text on the 7-page paytable/rules overlay. Win amounts displayed visually as text. Feature triggers show full text overlays. No audio-only information identified.

In Free Spins, reel cell backgrounds shift from aqua-blue to warm golden-amber and the waterfall behind the reels becomes a brilliant cascade of amber/golden light — a major environmental color change signals the bonus round. TOTAL MULTIPLIER and FREE SPINS LEFT displayed as large bold yellow digits on brown wooden panels on the left side of the screen.

All actions require a single click: spin, bet change, feature toggle, autoplay start. Autoplay available for up to 100 spins. SKIP SCREENS option in autoplay reduces required interactions during feature overlays. Keyboard support: SPACE and ENTER start/stop spin.

All interactive controls have visible text labels: BUY FREE SPINS, BET amount, DOUBLE CHANCE TO WIN FEATURE, SPIN, AUTOPLAY, START AUTOPLAY (N). CREDIT and BET balances shown as text. Win amounts displayed as 'WIN $XX.XX'. Feature trigger overlay displays 'CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON 8 FREE SPINS'. Paytable contains all rules in paragraph text across 7 pages with 'Page N/7' indicators.

The red and gold/orange low-value lanterns share a near-identical white heart-like swirl motif and are told apart mainly by hue; the green lantern (white star/shuriken) and purple lantern (white clover) are shape-distinct from the other two and from each other.
Buy Feature (red/maroon) and Super Bet (cyan/blue) buttons are colour-differentiated but also carry distinct text labels and a fixed vertical stacking order, so colour is not the only cue.
Settings toggle switches use handle position (left = off, right = on) in addition to an orange fill colour.
The selected Auto Play spin-count preset is shown by a filled white background against the other buttons' dark background, not by a colour change alone.
Free Games win highlight uses a bright yellow high-luminance glow outline around winning cells rather than relying on hue alone.

No audio-only information was identified. Sound toggles (Ambient/Effects/Swoosh) are purely decorative feedback; all game state (bet, win, multiplier, spins remaining, jackpot countdown) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.
Payout tiers are printed as white numerals (5/4/3) beside each currency value; multiplier and win amounts are shown as large embossed, high-contrast numerals legible without colour discrimination.

Space bar both starts and stops a spin (keyboard-operable). During an active round the SPIN button also functions as SKIP, so a player with limited fine motor control tapping it again can unintentionally skip through automatic Free Games spins. Autoplay supports configurable loss/win stop-limits.

The in-canvas rules booklet is rendered pixels with no underlying text; the separate DOM 'Help' overlay is a single scrollable page with real text and labelled section headers, which is friendlier to a screen reader.
Symbols are told apart by silhouette and illustration, not only hue; royals carry printed letters and numerals on parchment-coloured tiles.
Wild is the only tile with a portrait of a person, glows violet-pink and shows a printed number; Scatter is the only skull-mask tile and carries the printed word 'scatter'.
Winning tiles flash with orange fire while losing tiles dim, so a win is visible by brightness contrast and not only by colour.
Sound can be toggled in the menu; no information observed is carried by sound alone, but this was not verified.
Bottom sheets are dark charcoal with white text, gold titles and yellow-gold values; Paytable and Rules panels are dark grey-navy with gold headings and white or grey text.
Balance, bet, win, remaining free spins and win multiplier are all printed as text; the Wild's remaining life is a numeral on the tile.
Turbo and Auto Spin (10, 30, 50, 80, 1000) are available; the spin button doubles as stop; holding Space repeats spins on PC; touch targets are large round or wide buttons.
Paytable and Rules panels are real text and can be read by a screen reader; the reel field is a canvas and is not text-accessible.
WILD symbol is a brown wood-grain medallion identified by the embossed gold word 'WILD' and shape, not by color alone
Royal letters A/K/Q/J/10 each use a different color (red/gold/purple/blue/green) but are also distinct letter/number glyphs, so color is not the only cue
Top Tracker prize chests (grey-blue stone) print prize values as lime-green text/numbers (e.g. '2x'-'100x', 'ALL IN VIEW', 'SUPER SPINS x4 REELS') regardless of chest color
No audio-only information observed; Ambient Music and Sound FX are purely decorative toggles, all game state is conveyed via on-screen text/numbers
Ante Bet and Settings toggle switches show state via knob position (left/right) in addition to color (orange/grey = off, green = on)
Large circular touch targets; central SPIN button is the largest control; SPACE/ENTER keys also start/stop spins; Autoplay with Skip Screens reduces required interactions

Stable control layout (menu/sound/info icons stacked at far-left, bet/spin/autoplay centered); the rules/paytable booklet is a fixed linear 8-page sequence navigable with prev/next icons and a numeric 'Page N/8' indicator

WILD symbol identified by gold 'WILD' text label and rainbow arc shape — not color alone. SCATTER has 'SCATTER' text on golden banner. Cancel/confirm buttons use X and checkmark icons in addition to red/green color. Layer depth (1–7) shown as numbered badge column, not color only. Volatility shown as 5 countable lightning-bolt icons.

High-value symbols: Leprechaun (circular portrait, rank 1), Green Top Hat (rank 2), Leprechaun Boots (rank 3), Horseshoe (rank 4), Beer Mug (rank 5), Smoking Pipe (rank 6). Low-value royals: A (purple/violet), K (red-orange), Q (teal/cyan-blue), J (bright green), 10 (orange-amber). Each symbol category distinguished by distinct shape and subject, not solely color.
Spin triggered by SPACE or ENTER keys. Autoplay available (up to 100 spins observed). Large spin button and AUTOPLAY button provide substantial click/tap targets.

BET and CREDIT labels precede numeric values. Win display uses 'WIN $N.NN' format. Feature trigger announces 'you have won 12 free spins'. Paytable has explicit page indicators ('Page 1/6' etc.). Button functions labeled textually in rules overlay.

Dud symbols are distinguished from paying candy symbols both by color (fully desaturated grey vs. saturated hues) and by being visually flatter/less glossy, so the distinction does not rely on hue discrimination alone.

The background is a deep purple/near-black factory scene with dark UI panels; candy symbols are the only fully saturated, brightly-lit elements on screen, helping them stand out against the darker backdrop.

Settings panel audio toggles ('All Sounds', 'Sound Effects', 'Music') are icon-only (a speaker glyph with an 'x' for muted); there is no separate text label distinguishing muted/unmuted state beyond the icon shape itself.
The four gem rats use four gem colours (red, purple, green, blue) but also differ in pose, armour, hood and tile frame, so they are told apart by shape and not only by colour.
The four Rat King wilds differ by gem colour (red, purple, green, blue); the gem shape and brightness differ too, and the behaviour text names the colour in words.
Valid and invalid ways diagrams in the paytable use a green check mark glyph and a red cross glyph, so meaning is carried by the glyph shape.

Special bet slabs (teal Ante Bet 1, maroon Ante Bet 2) carry captions and prices as text. Settings toggles differ by knob position (left off, right on) as well as grey versus green; autoplay checkboxes differ by tick mark.
Ambient music and sound effects are separate switches in settings; the speaker button toggles sound. Every outcome is also shown as text and banners, so sound is not required.

Dark charcoal and stone-grey scene with antique gold and dried-blood red accents; white text on black translucent panels; orange-gold CREDIT, BET and WIN labels with white numbers. Free spins use a saturated blood-red crypt background.
Winning paths are highlighted by glowing orange tile backgrounds and a text line such as 3X K PAYS $0.03. Letter tiles are cream-beige on dark stone.

Spin with the round button or SPACE or ENTER; hold SPACE for turbo spin; the speed button cycles normal, quick, turbo. Autoplay up to 100 spins with Skip Screens on by default; entry and total screens continue on a press anywhere. Battery Saver slows animation.
Win amounts are printed as text in the bottom strip and in banners (SUPERB, MEGA, SENSATIONAL); free spin counter is a text plaque FREE SPINS LEFT. The game is a canvas, so no DOM text was confirmed.

Toggle ON/OFF state shown by both color (green vs grey) and knob position; checkboxes use a white checkmark glyph on green rather than color alone; WILD trigger signaled by text ('Nice!', 'WILD' label, win amount) plus a flash effect, not color alone. The one color-only element is the VOLATILITY badge (gold-filled vs grey-outline bolts), softened by a text fallback sentence describing the general tier.

No audio-only information observed on any captured screen. SOUND and VIBRATION are optional toggles (vibration off by default in the capture); win and feature information (amounts, line numbers, credit/bet) is always shown as on-screen text/graphics.

The interactive play area is a narrow vertical strip (~393px wide) centered in the desktop viewport; the blurred, mirrored art filling the left/right letterbox bars is purely decorative and carries no information, so magnification should target only the center column.

Spin, +/-, and menu targets are all large round buttons; Autoplay (up to 100 spins via slider or preset buttons) reduces repeated manual actions. Turbo spin requires a press-and-hold gesture ('HOLD FOR TURBO SPIN'), which may be harder for some motor-impaired users; the Skip Screens autoplay option does not remove this hold requirement.

Bottom control icons hold stable positions (info/history/spin-speed cluster bottom-left; bet-menu/hamburger-menu bottom-right) and each pictogram has a written description available in the in-game rules text, favorable for building alt-text/ARIA labels.

Activation spots differ only by ring color on the symbol (yellow, green, red-pink); a second cue is position of the glowing DJ deck: left deck for Bass Blast, centre pad for Mass Transform, right deck for Wild Deejay.
Premium symbols are told apart by shape (ball, record player, headphones, microphone, girl with WILD banner); letters by glyph shape.
Winning cells get a gold-amber square background and non-winning cells darken, readable by brightness contrast.
Collection bar fills as a pink gradient from the left and repeats the count as text n / 65.
Game is music-driven with a sound toggle in the menu; no gameplay information is delivered only by sound per the rules text, not tested.
Letter symbols are low-saturation pastels (pale yellow, rose, pale blue, lilac) on a light-violet checkerboard with low contrast; the chromatic fringe makes thin strokes harder to read.
Win overlays use strong glow, light beams and sparks; no photosensitivity warning was seen.
Spin by tap or Space; hold Space repeats; auto spin 10 to 1000; small round minus/plus buttons are disabled during rounds.
Canvas-based Cocos build; Paytable and Rules panels are real DOM text. A minimum-bet toast appears in Chinese even with English locale (capturer note).

Win tier banners (Big Win, Super Win, Epic Win, Razor Win) are always named in text, not colour alone; the Push Bet toggle is also distinguished by knob position (left=off, right=on) and by the printed bet change, not by colour alone

Free spins trigger, win tiers, feature completion and gamble results are all shown as on-screen text/animation, not only through audio; Settings mute All Sounds/Sound Effects/Music independently, plus a one-click speaker icon on the base game screen

All interactions are single clicks/taps (Spin, Buy, Collect/Gamble, bet +/-, toggle); Autoplay and Quick Play (click-anywhere or space bar) reduce repeated actions; no drag, multi-touch or timed-reaction inputs observed

Every numeric outcome (win amount, multiplier, bet, RTP, purchase price) is printed as on-screen text, giving full OCR/alt-text coverage; only the identity of which shark/item symbol occupies a reel cell is purely graphical

Shark species are told apart by artwork and by printed payout numbers next to each icon, so misreading a hue does not lose payout information; the five paying sharks mainly differ by frame colour and body tint (orange, magenta, green, blue) with similar silhouettes, which may be harder to tell apart at a glance during fast base-game play.

No audio-only information is used; sound is decorative and independently mutable (All Sounds, Sound Effects, Music toggles). Feature state (trigger, multiplier, spins, win amount) is always also shown as on-screen text.

Large circular SPIN target; SPACE bar is a keyboard alternative for spinning. Autoplay (10 to 1000 spins) with Loss Limit and Single Win Limit reduces the number of manual actions needed and lets a player cap exposure without repeated clicking.

Bottom bar control positions are stable across states: menu-grid and mute far left, BALANCE/TOTAL BET/WIN centre, quick-action and SPIN far right. Paytable and rules are a single continuous-scroll document, reached from the same left-rail icon set on every panel.
Jackpot ladder tiers (Mega, Major, Maxi, Minor, Mini) are distinguished by colour AND by a printed text label on every badge, never colour alone
Jackpot Token Symbols always carry their tier name as text on the coin face, not colour alone
The Volatility badge shows its level both by which bar is coloured red and by bar position/height (3rd of 5 ascending bars)
Push Bet ON/OFF state is shown by toggle position (left/right) in addition to a green/grey colour change
Settings panel exposes three independent mute toggles (All Sounds, Sound Effects, Music); wins and features are also announced with full-screen text banners, not audio cues alone
Jackpot meter fill progress (e.g. Mega 2/6) is shown as a numeric fraction plus a row of dot indicators, not colour-fill alone

Spin can be triggered by mouse click or the keyboard space bar, an alternative input path to a small on-screen target; Autoplay presets (10 up to 1000 spins) reduce the number of discrete inputs required for extended play

Every payout tier is shown with both a colour-coded frame and a unique creature/object silhouette (shark vs starfish vs kelp vs helmet vs compass) plus printed values, so tier can be read by shape and number without colour.
Push Bet tiles and Base Bet rows mark the active selection with a lightness change (white fill vs dark fill) rather than a hue change, legible to all forms of colour blindness.
The progressive multiplier tower marks the active Free Spins level with printed numerals (x10/x5/x3) in addition to a brightness/glow difference.
Instant Prize coin tiers (bronze/silver/gold) differ in printed numeral as well as material colour, so the exact value is always readable.

Every audio cue (spin, cascade, reveal) has a matching on-screen text or animation cue, so outcomes can be followed without sound; the Settings panel exposes three independent audio toggles (All Sounds, Sound Effects, Music).
Balance, Total Bet, WIN and the Free Spins counter are printed as plain white/gold text with strong dark outlines, high contrast against the dark backgrounds throughout.
Spin can be triggered by mouse/touch click on the Spin button or by pressing the keyboard space bar; Autoplay and a tap/space Quick Play skip reduce the number of manual actions needed per round.

Base game reading order: logo badge (top-left) -> sound/menu buttons (top-right) -> reel grid in dive-cage frame (centre) -> right-side control strip: Bonus Buy, Autoplay, Bet Select, Spin (top to bottom) -> ways-count badge and Balance (bottom-left) -> Total Bet (bottom-right).
The five BONUS scatter chests (red, purple, orange, green, blue) all read BONUS and differ by colour only; the colour maps to the bank above the reels, whose name and flames are the alternative cue.
Express Bet state: the green button is the cross when off and the tick when on; backed by the tick or cross glyph and by the increased number in the STAKE label.
The letter symbols have different colours (A orange-gold, K dark red, Q purple, J green) but are also distinguished by the letter shape.

The five chests above the reels carry printed names (Devil Fish, Cash Inferno, Super Collect, Cash Boost, Devil's Respin); active enhancements are shown by flames and, on re-trigger, the word ACTIVATED.

Every outcome has text: PAID n, LINE n PAYS, SCATTER PAYS, BONUS RE-TRIGGER, ACTIVATED, win-tier banners (NICE, BIG, HUGE, EPIC WIN) and CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON totals. Audio content was not assessed.

All numbers (stake, credit, paid, collect plates, spin counter, win totals) are real text. Information panel: white body text and yellow headings on charcoal; dialogs are white text on near-black; the selected button is filled white with dark text (a luminance cue).

The system strip at the bottom (game name, clock, session time, net result) is real DOM text, white on near-black. CREDIT stops rising above 1,000.00 in the demo, so winnings are read from the PAID text, banners or the net-result strip.

Everything is a single click, with no drag or hold. Autoplay has five presets (10, 25, 50, 75, 100). The intro waits for a click on PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE. Spacebar spin depends on jurisdiction and operator configuration and was not verified.
The bottom strip is DOM text; the reel field is canvas. Wild carries the word WILD, and the four letter symbols are read by their letter.

All 7 symbols are distinguishable by shape and glyph independent of color: Ruby=pentagon gem, Emerald=hexagon gem, Sapphire=rhombus gem, Ace=letter A, King=letter K, Queen=letter Q, Jack=letter J. No symbol is identified by color alone.
Bonus Buy dialog cancel/confirm buttons use shape (X vs checkmark) in addition to color (red vs green), making them accessible to red-green colorblind users.
Settings toggles use position (right=on, left=off) in addition to color. Win amounts and PowerPays points/multiplier values are always shown as numeric text, not color-coded tiers alone.

All game mechanics, win amounts, free spin counts, and multiplier values are displayed as on-screen text. Ambient music and sound effects can be toggled independently in Settings. No audio-only information for game mechanics.

SPACE and ENTER keyboard keys can start/stop the spin as alternatives to mouse click. Autoplay supports up to 100+ autospins with SKIP SCREENS option to eliminate need to dismiss feature intro/end screens.

All key values (credit, bet, win, free spins count, points, multiplier) are rendered as on-screen numeric text. Navigation uses standard arrow glyphs. Canvas-rendered game may limit programmatic accessibility; no confirmed DOM exposure of game state.

Every symbol is identifiable by shape alone (numeral 7, bell, dual-piece watermelon, grape cluster with leaf, single orange, oval lemon, twin cherries); payline numbers are printed as white numerals on the reel frame, and the Hot Multiplier badge always shows its value as text (e.g. 'x2') in addition to its gold glow highlight.
All outcomes (wins, multiplier assignment, winning line) are represented visually with no audio-only information; the settings panel lets All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music be muted independently.
Payout, RTP and rules text is set in high-contrast white-on-dark-charcoal or white-on-red, in a clear sans-serif font, at a legible size on the standard desktop viewport.

All controls (spin, autoplay, bet select, sound, menu) are large individually clickable circular/rectangular targets; spinning and skipping animations can also be triggered with the keyboard space bar as a non-mouse input path.
Card suits (spade/club/heart/diamond) use non-traditional colors (red spade, magenta club, green heart, blue diamond) but are distinguished primarily by outline shape, not color alone
MONEY symbol vs COLLECT symbol (base game) are differentiated by distinct icon shape (coin-stack vs circular safe-dial) and by explicit on-tile text 'COLLECT', not by color alone
Every Free Spins special symbol carries its own explicit text label (REEL COLLECT / ALL COLLECT / [n] ALL / [n] REEL / +3 SPINS) overlaid on the tile, so plaque color is a redundant cue
Settings toggle switches duplicate ON/OFF state with both color (green/grey) and handle position (right/left); Buy Free Spins confirm/cancel buttons duplicate green/red with checkmark/X glyph shape
All feature outcomes (Money Collect trigger, Free Spins win, Reel Collect, etc.) are always accompanied by on-screen text and animated numeric counters, so no information is conveyed by sound alone
SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC can each be independently muted via the Settings menu without disabling any visible game information
Win, bet and credit amounts are displayed in a large, high-contrast gold/white font against a dark background bar at the bottom of the screen at all times
The 25-payline reference diagram in the rules is small and would benefit from further zoom, though it is not required to play since lines are pre-set and not selectable
Autoplay (up to 100 spins) and Turbo Spin / Quick Spin speed options reduce the number of discrete clicks required for extended play
SPACE and ENTER keyboard keys can start/stop spins as an alternative to mouse clicks; holding SPACE also engages Turbo Spin
Bet amount and Autoplay count can be set once via menus rather than requiring repeated fine motor interaction per spin

The multiplier reel (x1/x2/x3/x5) is static/decorative in the base game and becomes live and spinning during Free Spins, but looks visually near-identical between the two states aside from context -- rely on the full background/scene change and 'Free spins: N/7' text, not the reel's red-circle highlight alone.
