SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts start and stop the spin. HOLD SPACE activates Turbo Spin. Full autoplay available: slider for 1-100 spins with TURBO SPIN, QUICK SPIN, and SKIP SCREENS options to reduce repetitive interaction.

All feature triggers and win amounts communicated via full-screen popup text (CONGRATULATIONS / YOU HAVE WON / N FREE SPINS / PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE). Win amounts also appear in the bottom bar status text. Feature state shown as text: FREE SPINS LEFT [N], MULTIPLIER x[N], FEATURE ACTIVE badge.
WILD tile is a gold-bordered orange-flame rectangle labelled 'WILD' in white bevelled text — identified by text and flame texture, not colour alone.
Double Chance and Settings on/off toggles encode state by knob position (left = off, right = on) and check-mark shape, not colour alone.
CANCEL (red) and BUY (green) buttons in the Buy Free Spins dialog also carry explicit text labels, so they remain unambiguous without colour discrimination.

Free Spins mode is signalled by a large-scale scene change (bright desert daytime background switches to a dark night-time city street) plus an explicit 'Free spins: N/8' counter, not a subtle hue shift alone.

No information is conveyed through audio only; Music and Sound FX are togglable ambient effects. Wins, feature triggers, jackpot ticker values and free-spin counts are all shown as on-screen text/numbers.
Win and jackpot amounts (Total win, jackpot ticker values, '58x BET') are rendered as large high-contrast text (yellow/white on a dark background), legible without fine colour discrimination.

Bet stepper, Buy Bonus and spin/autoplay controls are large round/rectangular touch targets; a 'Spacebar to spin' setting allows spinning without a precise mouse click; Autoplay offers configurable round counts (10 up to 1000, or unlimited) to reduce required manual actions.

Control layout is stable across the session: info ('i') and settings icons bottom-left; Buy Bonus and Double Chance stacked at the left edge; Balance and Total bet with stepper arrows centre-left; status text centre; autoplay and spin controls bottom-right; jackpot ticker fixed across the top; paytable/rules/lines form one continuous scrollable panel reachable from the 'i' button.

The two Wild tile types (eagle badge vs orange flame tile) both carry the literal word WILD plus a distinguishing icon (eagle head present/absent), so they remain identifiable without color perception.
MINI (green) / MAJOR (blue) / MEGA (gold) jackpot labels are distinguished by fixed screen position and text label in addition to color.
Winning symbols are marked by a glowing outline (shape/brightness cue) around them, not by a color change to the symbol art itself.

Royal-card symbols (A K Q J 10 9) differ only by a small color-accent highlight on an otherwise identical chrome letter/numeral shape; each also carries its own distinct letter/number glyph, so identity does not depend on color.

No information is conveyed by sound alone; all game state (wins, free spins remaining, jackpot values, prompts like 'Push Spin to start free spins') is shown as on-screen text. Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable and a master Volume slider can be set to zero.

All state and value information (bet, jackpot values, win amounts, free-spin counters, payout tiers, line numbers) is duplicated as plain high-contrast text rather than relying on color or icon alone.

Bet adjustment, Autoplay round-count selection and Buy Bonus are single-click actions; Spacebar can substitute for clicking Spin; Autoplay offers large fixed round-count buttons up to 1000 plus an unlimited option, reducing repeated actions for extended play.

Controls sit in fixed positions across screens: info/settings icons bottom-left next to Balance, Buy Bonus/Double Chance in a left-side column, Total bet with adjusters center-bottom, Autoplay/Spin bottom-right; the rules booklet is organized under clear text headings usable as a table of contents.

The two sides of the bet are not told apart by color alone. The left button is blue and the right button is red, but each is labelled in words and range: 'ROLL UNDER < 500 000' and 'ROLL OVER > 500 000'. The slider halves repeat the same blue (left) and red (right) pairing.
Win chance and coefficient are printed as numbers (for example 50% and COEF X 1.94), so the payout odds do not depend on color.

A rejected bet is shown with a red outline on the bet field and also with the figure typed in the field. No colorblind mode or contrast setting exists in the menu, which has only Sound and Music toggles.
The menu has Sound (on by default in capture) and Music (off by default) toggles. All round information is also visual; no audio-only cue was documented.

The result display uses very large seven-segment digits, bright cyan on dark housings: good size and contrast. Unlit segments are a dim dark teal, which can make similar digits such as 8 and 6 harder to tell apart for some users.
Small grey captions (COEF, WIN tiles and the preset buttons) sit on dark steel grey-blue panels and have low contrast.

The outcome of a round is not announced by any banner or text. It must be read from the digit display against the range on the button, from the balance change and from the bet history. The WIN tile shows the possible win at the current bet, not a result, and can mislead.
The slider needs a precise drag, but the win chance can also be typed into the chance input field or set with four presets (15 %, 30 %, 60 %, 90 %), so a fine-motor drag is not required.

The bet can be typed or set with five buttons (5, 10, 50, 100 add to the current bet; MAX sets 200). A round takes a single click on one of the two side buttons, with no timing pressure and no countdown.

The interface of this build is DOM text (not canvas), so it is at least present in the page structure. ARIA labels and reading order were not checked, so screen reader support is unconfirmed. The round outcome is not stated in text.

Each ladder tier pill always carries its printed multiplier text (e.g. 'X3.94') regardless of its background color (charcoal=unreached, green=passed/current, magenta=lost), so tier state is not color-only. However, on the two small corner-bracket cards shown for a single resolved pick, the WIN-vs-LOSS distinction (green bracket vs magenta bracket) IS color-only - a color-blind player must rely on the overall round outcome (CASHOUT state, balance change, bet-history row) rather than the bracket color to tell which hand won.

CASHOUT's active state (bright yellow fill, black text, printed dollar amount) versus its disabled state (flat dark charcoal, dimmed grey text, no amount) is conveyed by both fill color and the presence/absence of a printed amount.
A RANDOM button lets the player auto-pick a hand instead of choosing manually - a lower-effort alternative to the three hand buttons.

Autoplay offers a 'Hands' stepper (default 10) plus preset spin counts (5/10/15/20/25/50/75/100) and optional stop conditions ('stop if cash decreases by', 'stop if the coef exceeds'), reducing the number of individual clicks needed for a session.

All key numbers (BALANCE, LAST WIN, CASHOUT amount, BET, each ladder tier's multiplier) are rendered as on-canvas text with no DOM/ARIA text layer found for the ladder - a screen-reader user has no native access to this information without an accessible overlay, which this build does not appear to provide.

The 5 low-value gem letters (A/K/Q/J/10) are color-coded orange, red, lime-green, cyan and pink/magenta, but each is also uniquely shaped as its own letter or number glyph, so identity does not depend on color perception.

The 5 Hold & Spin rock colours (red, pink, gold, green, blue) are visually similar rounded-boulder shapes distinguished mainly by hue, but each rock always displays its dollar value as printed white text directly beneath it, so value is never color-only.

The BONUS rock's trigger state is signalled by a glow/halo shifting from white-to-blue to include hot pink/magenta plus an orange fire-like border on the reel strip, together with explicit 'GOOD LUCK!' on-screen text, not by color alone.

No audio-only information was observed; Ambient Music and Sound FX are decorative and independently toggleable in System Settings. All game state (win amounts, feature trigger confirmation, respin/feature text) is conveyed via on-screen text and imagery.

Win amounts are shown as large high-contrast yellow/gold digits on a dark background (WIN label in cyan), and the CONGRATULATIONS feature-won banner uses large gold/cream 3D lettering, both legible at low visual acuity.

Large circular touch targets throughout (SPIN, menu, sound, info, bet +/-, paytable navigation arrows). SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop the spin (holding SPACE triggers turbo), and Autoplay offers a configurable spin count plus a Skip Screens option to reduce required interactions.

Stable control layout across all base-game states: menu and sound icons bottom-left, info 'i' button beside them, CREDIT/BET text labels center-left, bet -/+ around the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY below/beside it. The rules booklet is a linear 7-page sequence with consistently-positioned previous/close/next icons and an explicit 'Page N/7' readout on every page.

5 monster symbols differ in body color AND shape: Pink Monster is chubby round with two horns; Orange Monster is spiky with single large central eye; Yellow Monster is squat smooth with wide grin; Green Monster is stout with triangular spikes; Blue Alien is slender with large head, antennae, thin limbs. Shape alone identifies each symbol.

4 gemstone symbols differ in cut shape as well as color: Blue Gemstone is round/oval; Pink Gemstone is triangular/rhombus angular; Orange Gemstone is small triangular/teardrop; Green Gemstone is larger oval/circular with emerald faceting.

WILD has a red framed border AND a distinctive flame/mask icon in orange/gold. ROCKET has a rocket ship shape with pointed top, cylindrical body, exhaust flames — cannot be confused with WILD or SCATTER. SCATTER has 'SCATTER' text printed directly on the symbol AND large planet/sphere shape.

Gamble wheel: WIN sector is green and LOSE sector is red, but both carry bold white text labels 'WIN' and 'LOSE' printed on the sectors. The WIN sector is physically larger. Flanking badges also read 'WIN' and 'LOSE' in white text. Text labels duplicate color coding. Multiplier shown as text badge (e.g., '3X') — the number itself carries the information, not color.
Confirm button in bonus buy dialog has a green background AND a white checkmark icon. Cancel button has a red background AND a white X icon. Shape/icon codes supplement color for both buttons.
Game delivers all information visually and via text. No audio-only information identified. Sound FX and ambient sound are toggleable in Settings. Game is fully playable without audio.

All key values are in text: win amounts, credit, bet, FREE SPINS LEFT counter, multiplier badge (e.g., '3X'), MEGAWAYS live counter, scatter count, gamble win probabilities. 'PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE' instruction is text. SCATTER symbol has 'SCATTER' text on the symbol face. Warning 'GAMBLING CAN RESULT IN NO FREE SPINS' is text.

SPACE and ENTER keys control spin. Autoplay up to 100 spins reduces repeated interactions. TURBO SPIN (hold SPACE) and SKIP SCREENS options allow faster progression through animations for users with limited fine motor control.

Individual reel symbols have no text labels — identification requires visual paytable reference. All win amounts, bet, credit, free spins count, and multiplier values are presented as text numbers. Key instructions and game state changes (e.g., 'FREE SPINS', 'PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE') are rendered as text.
OVER/UNDER active state is conveyed by both a colour change (white fill vs grey fill) and the button's fixed screen position/label text (OVER always top, UNDER always bottom) - never colour-only.

Winning history rows use a green pill for positive Profit values, but the value is always prefixed with a '+' sign and printed as text inside the pill, so win/loss meaning does not rely on green being distinguishable.

The Risk screen's red background is purely decorative; all actionable data (TAKE amount, YOU CAN WIN amount, die values) is white/yellow text and numbered/pipped dice, independent of the red backdrop. Active bottom-row icons (RISK/TAKE/ROLL) are reinforced by icon fill state (outline vs solid) and their own pictogram plus text caption, not by hue alone.

Bet and threshold adjustment both offer a direct jump-to-extreme control (Min/Max for bet, up/down steppers auto-stop at the floor/ceiling for threshold) in addition to incremental +/- stepping, reducing clicks needed to reach an extreme value.

The dice cup itself is clickable as an alternate way to trigger Roll ('Click the Roll button or hit the cup to roll the dice'), offering a larger hit-target alternative to the small circular ROLL icon.

All game-critical numbers (threshold, multiplier, bet amount, balance, win amount, TAKE/YOU CAN WIN amounts) are rendered as on-screen text, not only as icon/graphic state, which favours text-to-speech/OCR-based tooling.

The threshold stepper and the OVER/UNDER toggle together fully define the bet before rolling; a screen-reader flow should announce both together with the resulting Multiplier value, since the multiplier is the direct consequence of the threshold+direction pair.

The Risk screen's core interaction (pick 3 of 6 numbers, then Roll) requires distinguishing 6 visually similar square die-face buttons that differ only by pip count; for non-visual access these should be exposed as labelled 'die 1' through 'die 6' controls rather than relying on pip-pattern recognition.

Bonus type is colour-coded by base-game rocket (red = Bonus Spins, green = Hold & Win Spins, purple = Jackpot Spins), but colour is never the only channel: each rocket art sits next to its bonus name in printed text, and the three volcano labels above the reels read 'BONUS SPINS' / 'HOLD & WIN' / 'JACKPOT SPINS' in words.

The word 'purple' is overloaded: it names a base-game trigger rocket that maps to the entire Jackpot Spins feature, AND, separately, the in-bonus jackpot-rocket colour used only for the MAJOR tier. The five jackpot tiers also use TWO DIFFERENT colour palettes for the same names: base-game meter text is MINI cyan / MINOR green / MAJOR purple / MEGA orange / MAX red, while inside Jackpot Spins the reward-revealing rockets are Mini blue / Minor green / Major purple / Mega yellow / Max red. Every instance is paired with its printed tier name, but a colour-blind user relying on a verbal colour description alone should be told explicitly which system and which 'purple' is meant.

No audio-only information identified; all game state (spins remaining, win amounts, jackpot progress, bonus type) is presented as on-screen text/numeric HUD fields. Music and Sound FX toggles in Settings are purely optional.

Large circular SPIN button at bottom-right of the base game; Autoplay panel offers fixed round counts (10 up to 1000, or infinite) to reduce repeated manual actions; a Turbo Spin toggle (off by default) shortens spin animation time.

Bonus-type identity and jackpot-tier identity are always paired with printed English words on screen, favourable for OCR/alt-text reliance. The jackpot ladder and the 'Total Bet' / 'Balance' / 'Total win' HUD fields keep stable positions across the base game and all bonus states.

The 25 payline-number tags use many different flat hues purely decoratively; the bold white number is the real identifying cue. Winning symbols are marked by a cyan glow outline plus a numeric value popup, not color alone. Sound/Quick Spin toggles are distinguished by physical left/right position and fill, not hue. Free-spins/bonus mode is signalled by both a background pattern/hue change and explicit banner text.

No information is conveyed by audio alone. The Settings panel exposes independent Sound - Ambient and Sound - Effects toggles that do not gate access to any game information; all state (bet, win, jackpot amounts, free-spins count) is shown as on-screen text.

All bottom-bar targets are large round buttons; SPIN/STOP is the largest. Space bar duplicates both spin-start and reel-stop. Auto Play offers 10 to 500 spins with configurable stop conditions (balance decrease, single-win threshold, feature-triggered), reducing manual clicks for extended play.

Bottom control bar is stable across every screen: info -> BET -> BET LEVEL -/+ -> BET MAX -> SPIN/STOP -> AUTO PLAY -> COIN -/+ -> BALANCE, always printed as plain text. The Help screen is real linear HTML text across 11 pages, unlike the canvas-rendered reels and paytable booklet.

Symbols are distinguished by unique pictographic shape (cart/helmet/lantern/pickaxe/gem cluster/diamond/portrait), not by card-frame color alone; multiplier tiles always show a printed 'xN' number rather than relying on the blue badge hue; win/no-win and feature states are always paired with explicit text (WIN $x, PLACE YOUR BETS!, FREE SPINS LEFT n, LAST FREE SPIN).

Residual risk: the five low-value gem symbols (red, purple, blue, green, white/grey) share the same generic crystal-cluster silhouette and are differentiated from each other mainly by hue; a strong color-vision-deficiency user may need the payout amount or paytable position as a secondary cue to tell the five gem tiers apart.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are decorative and independently toggleable in System Settings. All game state (wins, spins left, multipliers, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.
Win amounts, the max-win banner and the game wordmark are rendered as large high-contrast gold-on-dark 3D text; the volatility badge and all toggle states are text-labelled, not color-only.

Large round click targets; the central SPIN button is the largest interactive element. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop spins (keyboard-operable) and holding SPACE triggers Turbo Spin. Autoplay (up to 100 spins, with Turbo/Quick Spin/Skip Screens modifiers) reduces the number of required clicks for extended play.

Stable control layout across all base-game states: menu+sound buttons stacked far-left, info 'i' button just beside them, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, bet -/+ flanking the central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY beneath SPIN. The info booklet is a linear 7-page sequence with an explicit 'Page n/7' indicator; Buy Feature and Special Bets are reached via two labelled plaques that each state their option count ('3 OPTIONS' / '2 OPTIONS').

Royal-card symbols (A red, K orange, Q purple, J green, 10 blue) are additionally identified by their printed letter/number glyph and fixed payout rank, not by color alone. WILD and SCATTER also carry the words WILD/SCATTER printed on the symbol banner.
BIG WIN (blue banner) and MEGA WIN (purple banner) free-spins celebration tiers are distinguished by banner text as well as color.
ON/OFF toggles in Settings and Autoplay use a physical yellow-slider left/right knob position, not color alone, to indicate state.
The right-hand control rail (turbo, autoplay, SPIN, buy, menu) stays in the same fixed position and order on every screen, giving a consistent click target regardless of screen content.

Every symbol is distinguished by silhouette (coin, building, face, helmet, shield, bowl, or a distinct letterform/digit), so no information depends on color alone at symbol level. Jackpot tier and toggle states are also carried by text label / knob position, not color alone. The free-spins day/night background swap includes a large brightness change alongside the color change.

No unique game information is conveyed by sound alone; every state change also has a visual/text change. Separate Ambient and Effects sound toggles (both default on) plus a master volume slider let hard-of-hearing/deaf players mute all sound without losing functionality.

Winning symbols/lines are marked with a bright gold/white glow outline layered on the symbol frame, a brightness change large enough to notice with reduced acuity. Section headers on the Help screen use a lighter grey banner strip behind bold white text for contrast, and highlighted numeric values are always restated in plain white text nearby, not shown only in the smaller orange highlight color.

Primary actions (SPIN, BET MAX, AUTO PLAY) are large circular targets and are also keyboard-bindable: the space bar spins and stops the reels, reducing the need for precise mouse targeting. Bet/coin/level adjustment uses simple +/- steppers rather than sliders or drag gestures.

Every numeric game state (balance, bet, coin, level, line count, win, jackpot value, free-spins remaining) is rendered as on-screen text. Symbols are distinguishable by shape/silhouette alone (coin/building/face/helmet/shield/bowl/seven letterforms). The paytable and Help screen are both single continuous scrolling documents encountered in a fixed linear order.

Toggle switches (SYSTEM SETTINGS) show state by knob position, left=off/right=on, not color alone; checkboxes (AUTOPLAY) show state via a filled square plus explicit white checkmark glyph, not color alone
Spin button changes shape, not just color, between states: twin curved white arrows in base game vs. a pink/red-outlined square 'STOP' glyph during free spins

Free Spins feature is signalled by a full scene palette change (blue night sky base game to solid black with gold/white sparkles in feature) plus an explicit 'FREE SPINS LEFT' text counter, not by a color swap alone

Nurse card is red/crimson, Friar Lawrence card is orange/amber-gold; Romeo and Juliet Wild cards sit on a blue daytime sky-and-sea background (distinct from the night-sky theme used everywhere else) inside a gold frame with a small red rose medallion in each corner; the expanded WILD reel is a purple/violet starburst panel with the word WILD spelled vertically in gold letters

No audio-only information observed; sound (ambient music, sound effects) is decorative only and independently toggleable, all game state (win amounts, spins remaining, bet, credit) is conveyed as on-screen text

CREDIT and BET numeric labels rendered in high-contrast yellow/gold text on a dark background; all primary controls are large filled circles or full-width pill/rectangle buttons (SPIN, AUTOPLAY start, BET MAX)

SPACE key is an explicit turbo-hold shortcut shown live on every base-game frame ('HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN'); Autoplay supports up to 100 spins configured in one action, reducing required clicks for extended play

Control layout is stable across all screens: menu+sound stacked bottom-left, a separate 'i' info button beside them, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY beneath SPIN; the GAME RULES booklet is a strictly linear 6-page sequence navigated by left/right triangles with an explicit 'Page N/6' readout and a single close (X) reachable from any page

The recurring red (Ronny)/blue (Donny) corner coding is always reinforced by shape (different pig, different glove/short color, left/right position) and by text (character names, card titles), never by color alone.

In Final Showdown Stage 1 the Wild-counter tag is printed red on Donny (the blue corner) and the Multiplier-counter tag is printed blue on Ronny (the red corner) - a deliberately crossed pairing that stays readable only because each tag also carries the printed word WILD or MULTI.
Buy vs Activate purchase buttons in the bonus-buy dialog are distinguished by both color (gold vs green) and the printed word, not color alone.
Selected bet amount and toggle-ON state pair a color change with an additional cue (fill shape, black-vs-white text, handle position), so no control was found to rely on hue alone.

No feature outcome (free-spin trigger, multiplier reveal, purchase confirmation) is communicated by sound alone - all key numbers (win amounts, spins remaining, multiplier values, counter totals) are also printed as on-screen text.
Paytable and rules booklet use bold yellow payout numbers on a solid navy background, white/light-grey body text and white bold headings - high contrast throughout.

All interactive controls are large (roughly 65-95px) circular or pill touch targets; bet ladder buttons are full-width rows; no drag gestures required anywhere in the captured flow (spin, buy, settings, autoplay, bet selection are single clicks).
Royals are told apart by letter and number shapes as well as color (A red, K purple, Q pink, J green, 10 blue, 9 olive).
Character symbols differ by shape (rooster, hand, foot, boots), not by color alone. Wild carries a number badge and Scatter the printed word SCATTER.
Big Win (blue lettering) and Mega Win (purple lettering) banners are told apart by the printed words; Turbo state is shown by the word OFF plus a struck-through bolt.
All outcomes are shown visually: banners, counters and the remaining free spins number; no information is audio-only. Sound can be switched ON/OFF in the menu.
Winning symbols get a glowing yellow-white outline; the win multiplier is a very large orange x-number between the two roosters, a high-contrast element.

Bottom field boxes are dark brown-grey with pale cyan-white values; win belt banner is gold with dark red text; menu sheets are dark charcoal-blue with white text and orange-brown headings and buttons.

Space key starts and skips spins and holding Space keeps spinning; Auto Spin up to 1000; tapping the game area during a spin stops the reels. The Spin button is the largest control; Plus/Minus rings are mid-size.
The game is a canvas with no text alternative for reels; only win banners and bottom fields carry numbers. Paytable and Game Rules are text panels.

The four high-value element symbols (fire=orange/red, land=dark green, water=blue, air=purple/lavender) rely partly on hue but are reliably distinguished by icon shape (flame/leaf/water-drop/spiral). The low-value pale tier reuses the same four shapes as a muted brown outline on a sand-beige disc, distinguished from the high tier by brightness/saturation contrast rather than hue. Free-spin count, win amounts and multiplier values are shown as plain white/yellow numerals, not by color alone.

Settings expose separate 'Music' and 'Sound FX' toggles; no information is conveyed by audio alone. All state changes (wins, free-spin count, multiplier level, rotation) are also shown as on-screen text/numerals or animation.

Balance, total bet, win amounts, free-spin counter (N/5) and multiplier overlays (e.g. 'x2', 'x10') are rendered as large, high-contrast white/orange text against dark panels; Big Win and round Total Win amounts additionally print the equivalent 'Nx BET' multiplier as bold high-contrast text.

Bet +/- steppers are small targets but show a visibly disabled/enabled arrow glyph at the 0.10 FUN and 50.00 FUN limits. The round Spin icon and round Autoplay icon are comparatively large touch targets. Spacebar can trigger a spin as an alternative to clicking.

Bottom bar has stable positions: info(i) and settings icons far left, balance and total-bet fields center-left, autoplay(A) and spin icons far right. Paytable and rules are a single linear scrollable panel with a confirmed end. After a field rotation, all 25 grid cells are reassigned new symbol contents within the same 25 physical positions and along the same 25 named lines (Line 1-Line 25) - the lines/positions themselves do not move, but their contents change, so a screen reader should re-announce the full grid after each rotation event as a new outcome, not merely a repositioning.

Numerals are printed both on the wheel pockets (white numerals on coral red and dark navy pockets) and on the table cells, so a colour-blind player can read the numbers directly without relying on fill colour.
Outside zones are labelled with words: 1 TO 18, EVEN, ODD, 19 TO 36, 1ST 12, 2ND 12, 3RD 12, and the three column buttons are marked 2 : 1.

Red and black are told apart by colour only: the red and black outside bet zones are blank cells (coral red and dark navy) with no text, and the number cells carry no red or black marker other than their fill.
The zero pocket and the zero cell are told by emerald green fill alone; the numeral 0 is the only non-colour cue.
No colour-blind mode, high-contrast mode or text size setting exists: the menu offers only Sound and Music toggles.
History rows show a win as an amount or a dash; the green shield icons are not the only cue.
The result is stated in words: Result: N and You win: X $ appear in the wheel centre after each round, and placed chips show their value as a number at the corner of the cell.
The player's own row in the Bets list is outlined in green and carries text such as +2 $ after a win.
Sound is on by default; no audio-caption equivalent was captured.

Every zone that contains the winning number, together with the winning number cell, is lit by a lighter tint (pale pink or pale grey), so the result is shown by position and brightness, not by hue alone.
The result strip is made of small coloured pills (red, dark, green for zero) with tiny numerals, and the highlight tint of a winning cell differs only slightly in lightness from neutral cells.
The wheel is cut by the top edge of the window, so only part of it is visible at once (about 13 of 37 pockets).
The betting window is 20 seconds by measurement (the timer text states the seconds), a time pressure for players with motor or cognitive difficulties; there is no way to extend it.

Screen reader support is not established and is unlikely: the whole interface is drawn on a canvas (the DOM carries no controls at all - checked in the live session, 0 DOM controls against 66 interactive objects inside the engine scene tree), so an assistive reader has no text, labels or roles to announce. Nothing in the menu offers an accessible mode.

Key state is conveyed by text/numbers, not color alone: rocket durability values are printed as white numbers regardless of rocket color; chest multipliers show white 'xN' text; the scatter carries the printed word BONUS. The four rocket types (blue, green, purple, red) are distinguished mainly by hue, with a secondary emblem shape (circle/lightning-bolt/skull-like mark) and the printed durability number as backups for a user who cannot distinguish the hues.
No audio-only information was identified; independent Music and Sound toggles in the settings panel imply sound is decorative/optional, and all balance/win/bet state is shown as on-screen text.

Primary action targets (Spin, Buy Bonus, bet +/-) are large, high-contrast circular/rounded buttons. No keyboard-shortcut hints are printed on screen, aside from a togglable 'Space to spin & go' option in the burger menu whose captured default state is off.

Control positions are stable across screens: Settings gear bottom-left, Balance/Bet/WIN readouts bottom-center, Spin bottom-right-of-center, hamburger Menu top-right, Buy Bonus button left of the crate grid, logo top-left. The How-to-play booklet is a single continuous scroll with no on-screen page-number indicator.

Every symbol is identified by unique shape plus baked-in name text, not by color alone: Wild is a bold red numeral 7 with a gold outline and the word WILD; Scatter is a gold crown with a red inner lining and a pink/magenta gem with the word SCATTER; the six fruits are shape-distinct (Star = magenta faceted gem, Grape = purple grapes, Watermelon = green with pink/red wedge, Blueberry = dark blue round fruit, Orange = orange-red gradient fruit, Cherry = red pair).

The only color-only UI signal is the violet/purple highlight for the currently selected line count and for the CLICK TO START button. It is always paired with a non-color cue: the selected line button also has a distinct border/fill shape, and CLICK TO START is uniquely large, centered and labelled with text.
No audio-only information observed. Music and Sound FX are toggleable and purely decorative; all outcomes (wins, bet, balance, RTP, rules) are conveyed in on-screen text.

Balance, bet and win amounts are high-contrast white/cream/gold text on dark backgrounds throughout. Winning-payline diagrams in the info booklet use a single bright yellow/gold highlight against neutral gray, high contrast, legible even under full monochromacy.

Bet adjustment uses small up/down triangle arrows next to the Total Bet value (likely the smallest touch target in the UI). The five LINES buttons and the Spin/Autoplay buttons are large circular/rectangular targets. Spacebar can substitute for clicking Spin (enabled by default in Settings).

Stable control layout across all game states: Info(i) and Settings(gear) bottom-far-left, Balance/Total-bet/bet-adjust-arrows bottom-center-left, Autoplay(A) and Spin bottom-far-right. The info booklet (33 pages total) is reached via the 'i' button and internally split into a linear paytable/lines section (money-bag icon) and a linear rules/text section (question-mark icon); a third history icon is present but appears inert in this demo build.

Wild (purple card, princess in green dress with orange-red hair) and Scatter (dark card, amber eyes) rely partly on color to read at a glance, but both also carry a printed text ribbon ('WILD'/'SCATTER') as a non-color fallback.
The four low-value royal letters differ in both color and letterform: A is red, K is green, Q is blue, J is gold/yellow - shape/letter plus color, so they stay distinguishable without color vision.

No audio-only information observed: all round outcomes, feature triggers, counters and totals are presented as on-screen text/numbers. Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable and turning them off does not appear to hide any game-state information.
Winning cells get a bright gold glowing border/fire effect AND a floating large numeric win value - dual-coded, not a color-only cue.
Spin/Autoplay/Info/Settings controls are distinguished by icon glyph shape (arrows, circular refresh, letter 'A', letter 'i', gear), not by color alone.

Buy-bonus buttons are large road-sign shaped hit targets on the right edge of the base game screen, no small/fiddly targets observed. Spacebar can trigger a spin as an alternative to clicking. Autoplay offers up to 1000 rounds or unlimited, reducing repeated clicking.

Control layout is stable across the whole session: info(i) and settings(gear) bottom-left next to the balance label, bet stepper centered, autoplay(A) and spin bottom-right. Paytable/rules are reached via a 3-icon rail (paytable/history/rules) on the info dialog's left edge.
Wins are marked by a golden polyline across the reels, the number in the WIN bar and animation, not by colour alone; non-winning tiles are dimmed
Jackpot tiers are named MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, GRAND on every plate and coin; the colours green, blue, purple and red are only a second cue
Paytable symbols differ by shape and face; the character tile frames (green, purple, orange-gold, blue, pink-red, yellow) are a secondary cue
Extra Chance state is shown by the toggle knob position, the panel label and the changed bet label, plus a greyed brown BUY BONUS button
Exception: spins left in the Bonus Game are shown by three lamps below the reels that differ only by colour (green means a spin left, dark means used); there is no text counter
Gear popup has Music (off by default) and Sound (on by default) toggles; no visual substitute for sound is described
White text on dark charcoal panels, yellow labels on dark, bold red numbers on gold coins
Space bar spins (menu toggle, on by default); turbo needs a held press on the spin button; autoplay is a one-click toggle; bet changes with minus and plus or from a menu of 21 values
Screen-reader support is not printed in the game and was not tested

Symbols do not rely on card colour alone: each regular symbol has a distinct pictorial icon (jar/bottle/shrimp/salmon/rice/avocado) and the 4 card-suit fillers are differentiated by suit shape (spade/heart/clover/diamond) as well as colour. SCATTER/TAKE SUSHI/TAKE ALL each carry a printed text-name plaque under the portrait; WILD has the word 'WILD' printed on it. Settings toggles combine switch position (left/right) with colour (grey/green). Volatility relies partly on counting yellow lightning-bolt icons but is also backed by explicit 'High volatility' text.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable, and all game state (win amounts, spins left, meter values, feature names) is presented as on-screen text/graphics.

All primary controls are large, well-separated circular touch targets; SPIN is the largest target on screen. SPACE/ENTER keys start/stop a spin without the mouse, and holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin. Autoplay with an optional Skip Screens setting reduces manual actions needed through Free Spins.

Control layout is stable across all screens: menu (hamburger) and sound icons stacked far-left, a separate 'i' info button just beside them, bet -/+ flanking the large central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY pill below/right of SPIN. Info booklet is a fixed 7-page sequence navigated with left/right arrow icons and closed with a centre X; each page shows 'Page N/7'.

All 11 paying symbols uniquely shaped: 5 realistic animal portraits (elephant, rhino, cheetah, zebra, impala) + 6 distinct letter/numeral glyphs. Color is never the sole differentiator. Card royals each distinguished by letter or numeral character regardless of color. WILD (lion face portrait) unique in subject; BONUS (diamond circle) has white 'BONUS' text label for color-independent identification. Volatility badge uses filled vs unfilled bolt shape plus text. Settings toggles use position and fill in addition to color.

All essential game information conveyed visually via text and numeric displays. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles available in System Settings (both on by default). No audio-only game-critical information confirmed in captured frames.

SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts start and stop spin. Autoplay supports up to 100 auto-spins configurable via slider. SKIP SCREENS option auto-skips feature intro and end screens. TURBO SPIN checkbox reduces spin duration. Large circular spin button at right side of bottom HUD. Bet adjustable via on-screen +/- buttons or BET MENU with COINS PER LINE and COIN VALUE fields.

5x4 grid: reels 1-5 left to right, rows 1-4 top to bottom. WILD Lion never appears on reel 1; BONUS Diamond never appears on reels 2 or 4. WIN amount and FREE SPINS LEFT counter shown numerically in HUD. BET and CREDIT displayed numerically. Information panel shows 'Page N/7' text indicator with left/right navigation arrows.

WILD and SCATTER are each identified by a printed word ('WILD'/'SCATTER') plus a distinct pictogram shape (oval medallion vs. a pair of eyes), not colour alone. The A/K/Q/J card-rank symbols are legible as letterforms first, colour second. The day-to-night background swap during Free Games is accompanied by an explicit on-screen 'FREE GAMES LEFT' text banner, so colour is never the only cue for the feature being active.

Sound toggles for Ambient and Effects are independent and on by default; none of the game's feedback (wins, triggers, retriggers) is audio-exclusive, as every event is also shown as an on-screen text banner.

The Help screen is plain left-aligned high-contrast text (light text on a near-black background, orange highlights for key numbers), the most legible surface in the game; the stylised carved-wood paytable booklet pages are comparatively harder to read by contrast.

All bet adjustments use discrete plus/minus buttons over a small closed set of 5 bet levels and 11 coin denominations rather than a continuous slider, which suits imprecise pointer input. Buy Feature and Super Bet both require a confirmation dialog with a single clearly labelled action button, reducing the chance of an accidental high-value purchase from one misclick.

The Buy Feature and Super Bet badges become ghosted and stop responding to clicks once their price at the current bet exceeds roughly 210 currency units; this state is shown only by opacity, with no audio or text cue, so a screen-reader user has no way to detect that the action has become unavailable.

Animal symbols differ by picture, card ranks by letter; the card tiles differ mainly by colour (terracotta-brown A, purple K, teal-blue Q, sage-green J, pale grey-beige 10) but each carries its own letter.

Wild and Scatter carry the printed words WILD and SCATTER. The active multiplier (x1 x2 x3 x5) is shown by larger size and brighter red-orange glow, not by colour alone. Winning symbols are marked by an explosion animation.
The red GET STARTED button is identified by its label and position; the Start Auto Spin button is dimmed when disabled; selected Bet Options values are white, larger and in a highlighted band.
All state changes are shown visually (explosions, ways counter, ribbon texts, WILD and SCATTER words); no sound-only cues were observed.

Gold and orange numerals for multipliers, cyan blue in the wild pattern, terracotta red spin button and ribbon; menu panels are dark charcoal with salmon-pink text. Base scene is a bright blue day sky, free spins scene a red-orange sunset.
One-tap SPIN, Space key to spin, hold Space for continuous spins, Auto Spin 10/30/50/80/1000, Turbo; Quit, Sound, Paytable, Rules, History in one menu.
Canvas game with no accessible text; balance, bet, win, remaining free spins and the ways counter are drawn on the canvas.
Symbols are told apart by drawn subject (animals, objects) and by printed letters and numbers, not by colour alone.
A, K, Q, J, 10 and 9 are coloured red, orange-yellow, green, blue, violet and magenta pink, and also have different glyph shapes.
Jackpot tiers MEGA, MAJOR, MINOR and MINI carry printed names and descending plaque sizes in addition to colour.
Prizes held in place during Cash and Lock have a bright green rim and also stay still while other cells change, so position and motion carry the meaning.
The win-way help diagram marks a counted path with a green tick and an uncounted path with a red cross, two icons of different shape.
A speaker button toggles sound; no information is conveyed by sound alone, every event carries a text banner.
Panel headings and key figures (STAKE, CREDIT, PAID) are bright yellow on near-black; body text is white.
BIG WIN and CONGRATULATIONS banners use large glossy lettering; the amount is repeated in the PAID strip or the credit change.

Single-click spin with round buttons about 50 to 100 px across; autoplay offers 10, 25, 50, 75 or 100 spins; some modals need a click on a small close cross at the top-right; PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE screens accept a click anywhere.
The interface is drawn on a canvas; the Game Information panel text is plain text in the page DOM.
Royal symbols A (red), K (orange-gold), Q (green), J (blue) and 10 (purple) are told apart by the letter or number shape as well as colour.
The three jackpot plates are named in text and also differ by keg colour (bronze, gold, silver-blue) and position (left, centre, right).
Cash values are printed in red or purple digits, but the digits carry the value; colour is only an extra cue.
Winning lines are marked by a red line and bright frames around the winning cells, plus printed PAID and LINE n PAYS text.
The Express Bet switch uses a green check mark and an orange X, which differ in shape, and the stake label changes to the higher number.
Feature starts have printed intro cards and on-screen messages; nothing appears to be audio-only in the frames. A sound toggle exists at the bottom right; audio itself was not assessed.
UI text is bright yellow for headings and the STAKE, CREDIT and PAID labels, white for other text, on dark grey translucent panels.
Win banners print the amount in large gold digits; feature totals appear on a cream tag or in a red capsule.
The paytable prints exact values per symbol, so symbols can be read in order without relying on colour.

One large round spin button, a PRESS TO SPIN strip, spacebar spin depending on operator; autoplay offers 10, 25, 50, 75, 100 spins with a STOP button; feature intros continue on any click or tap; no countdowns.
All text is drawn on a canvas, not in a text layer; a screen reader cannot read it without the operator's own accessibility layer.
Every state has a printed message in the bottom strip: PRESS TO SPIN, PAID, LINE n PAYS, BONUS COMPLETE, N SPINS REMAINING; Hot Pursuit and Tipsy Turbo show N TILL GRAND as text.

State is conveyed mainly through text/numerals/icon shape/checkmarks, not color alone. Scatter's 'SCATTER' label is printed in turquoise/cyan brush text and Wild's 'WILD' label in mint-green brush text directly on the symbol art, so both remain identifiable by the printed word, not by hue. Win badges and the 'BIG WIN' banner use red for emphasis, but the amount and label text are always shown in plain high-contrast lettering alongside.

No audio-only information observed. Every outcome (spin result, win amount, autoplay stop condition) is shown as on-screen text/numbers; Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative.

Large circular touch targets for Spin and Autoplay. Stake is adjusted with small dedicated up/down triangle buttons rather than a slider, allowing precise single-step adjustment. Spacebar can trigger a spin as a keyboard alternative to clicking Spin.

Bottom control bar has stable, grouped positions: info + settings icons and balance readout at the far left; stake +/- controls center-left; autoplay and spin (largest, rightmost target) at the far right. The info modal is a two-tab structure -- paytable via the 'i' icon, rules via the '?' icon -- each independently scrollable, with a close 'X' at the top-right of the modal.

Royal letters A/K/Q/J/10 are colored gold/red/green/blue/purple but remain distinguishable by their letterform shape, not color alone. WILD tracker slots switch from grayscale to full color plus a glowing gold ring when collected. Confirm/cancel dialogs use a checkmark vs X icon shape in addition to green/red. Ante Bet on/off indicator carries explicit 'ON'/'OFF' text alongside its green/red arrow.

No audio-only information observed; ambient music and sound FX are decorative and independently toggleable in Settings. All game state (bet, credit, win amount, free spins left, WILD-tracker progress, RTP/rules text) is conveyed visually and textually.

Large round click targets throughout; the central spin button (mascot icon) is the largest target. SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spins. Autoplay slider (up to 100 spins) and a SKIP SCREENS option reduce the number of clicks needed to play through features.

Stable control layout on every screen: menu (hamburger) and sound icons stacked far left of the reels, a separate info ('i') button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central spin button, autoplay directly beneath spin. The paytable/rules booklet is a strict linear 7-page sequence with an explicit 'Page N/7' readout on every page.

Most state is redundant to color: mute icons change shape rather than just color, the selected autoplay count is a filled white pill rather than a color change, and every low-value symbol (A/K/Q/J) carries its printed letter glyph in addition to its tile color. Residual risk: the Scatter and Gamble Scatter share an identical mask silhouette differentiated mainly by a cyan-vs-magenta color shift, so a color-blind or low-vision user relies on the printed reel-1-vs-reel-5 landing rule rather than color to tell them apart.

All state changes (wins, multiplier level, Free Spins award, bonus-buy prices) are shown as on-screen text or numerals; no audio-only information was observed. The Settings panel allows muting All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music independently, each shown by icon shape rather than color.

The SPIN button is the largest touch target on screen, isolated at the bottom of the right-hand column. Autoplay presets (10 up to 1000 spins) and the Gamble Feature's simple COLLECT/GAMBLE two-button choice both reduce the number of discrete actions required to play.

Control layout is stable across screens: sound and menu icons top-right of the reels; a fixed right-hand column (star / autoplay-shortcut / decorative lantern / bet-stepper / spin) in the base game; a consistent bottom-nav 4-icon row (grid=paytable, question-mark=rules, gear=settings, shield=info) inside every info/paytable/rules/settings panel.

Royal symbols distinguished by unique letterforms (A K Q J 10 9), not color. Portrait symbols use distinct faces and clothing (dark dress, cream top, blue shirt, green scrubs). WILD has printed WILD text; SCATTER labeled SCATTER; SUPER SCATTER is position-locked to reel 6.

ANTE BET toggle uses red (OFF) vs green (ON) — potential red-green issue; position of slider (left=off, right=on) provides a non-color duplicate cue. BUY FEATURE buttons differentiated by text (FREE SPINS vs SUPER FREE SPINS) and price, not color alone.

Free Spins mode indicated by text badge FREE SPINS LEFT and spin counter, not just fire/warm color change. LAST FREE SPIN text badge on final spin. WILD RIOT multipliers shown as dripping text (e.g. 2X) on symbols.

All game states visually labeled: win amounts, feature names, spin counters, mode badges are text overlays. Settings menu allows toggling AMBIENT and SOUND FX independently. WILD RIOT multipliers displayed as large dripping text on symbols, not audio-only.

Background palette is cool desaturated blue-grey with near-black reel cells. During Free Spins outer edges fill with bright orange-yellow fire and dark smoke, strong contrast shift. Title sign is teal-green with white serif text SANATORIUM SECRETS.

WILD symbols glow bright lime-green (electric yellow-green), highly visible against dark cells. HOOK symbol uses warm brownish-red metal tones and chain texture on near-black background. SCATTER glows green; SUPER SCATTER uses orange-red tones.

Primary interaction is single SPIN button (SPACE or ENTER). Autoplay available up to 100 spins with TURBO SPIN and QUICK SPIN options to reduce wait time. Bet adjusted via +/- oval buttons, no dragging required.

BUY FEATURE is two-click: open sidebar button then select option. All dialogs have clear X close button or PRESS ANYWHERE to continue. AUTOPLAY dialog has large green START AUTOPLAY button spanning full dialog width.

Win amount shown as text WIN $X.XX after each spin. Feature triggers show full-screen CONGRATULATIONS overlay with YOU HAVE WON N FREE SPINS text. FREE SPINS LEFT badge shows spin count during feature. SPACE and ENTER start/stop spin.

PUZZLE FEATURE piece placements have no text announcement per piece — visual and audio cues only. RESPINS LEFT count displayed on badge. High-paying symbol targets shown as thumbnail row above puzzle board.

WILD, SCATTER and BONUS are distinguished by shape/iconography (Santa face vs Christmas tree vs gift box), not by frame color; toggle switches convey state by knob position (left=off, right=on) in addition to track color; checkboxes use a white check-mark glyph on a filled green square, not color alone; jackpot tier plaques are all the same green/gold color regardless of tier and must be read by name text (GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR/MINI).

No audio-only information observed; all game state (wins, jackpot amounts, bonus prize values) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals. Sound FX and ambient music are independently togglable and appear decorative.

Win, credit and bet amounts are large gold/yellow high-contrast text on a dark bottom bar; jackpot amounts and tier names are shown as text on plaques rather than color-coded, but since plaque color does not vary by tier the text itself must be legible/zoomable to tell tiers apart.

Large circular click targets for SPIN, MENU, SOUND and INFO; SPACE and ENTER keys can start and stop a spin; Autoplay (up to 100 spins, optional SKIP SCREENS) reduces the number of repeated manual actions.

Control layout is stable in the base game: menu and sound icons far-left, info button beside them, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, autoplay below/right of spin, credit/bet labels center-left. The rules/paytable booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence navigable with previous/next arrows and a dedicated close control.

The three lowest-tier ornaments (purple, teal, blue) share identical payouts and differ only by colour, so colour confusion between them has no gameplay effect; the pink candy and red stocking are disambiguated by shape (round twisted candy vs boot-shaped stocking) rather than colour; wild multiplier values are always shown as printed 'xN' digits, not colour-coded.

Sound Effects and Music can be muted independently in Settings; no feature information is conveyed by audio alone -- the Santa Feature, Jingle Drop and Free Spins triggers all have full on-screen text/visual confirmation.
Spin can be triggered by mouse/tap on the Spin button or by the keyboard space bar; Quick Play (skip animation) also responds to the space bar or a tap anywhere on screen.
All numeric information (bets, balance, win amounts, RTP, feature counters) is rendered as canvas text rather than real DOM text.
Low-value ornament symbols (pink/red/green/blue ball) each carry a card suit emblem — spade, heart, club, diamond respectively — providing shape-based redundancy independent of sphere color
Double Chance toggle uses gray=OFF/green=ON color AND thumb position left=OFF/right=ON as dual cue; BUY FREE SPINS button visually grays when disabled by Double Chance
Free spins mode shifts reel background from deep purple (base game) to warm red/amber (FS); supplemented by explicit left-panel text FREE SPINS, LEVEL X, multiplier range Xx-100x
Buy Free Spins cards color-coded (green L1, cobalt-blue L2, red L3, dark burgundy L4) but each card also shows Level number, dollar price, and multiplier range as readable text
SCATTER symbol identified by distinctive gold ornate decorative frame and SCATTER text label on red background at base — not relying on color alone

All feature events shown visually: BONUS ACTIVE banner, GOOD LUCK!, TUMBLE WIN $X, SENSATIONAL!, CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON; ambient music and sound FX each independently toggleable in system settings

Win amounts displayed as large on-screen overlays with explicit text (SENSATIONAL!, CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON, dollar amounts in high-contrast frames); rules panel uses white text on dark background
SPACE and ENTER keys start or stop spin; AUTOPLAY up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option auto-advancing celebration screens; large circular spin button is most prominent tap target

Complete mechanics in 8-page in-game rules panel (white text on dark background, OCR-readable); FS left-panel shows spins remaining and gifts-to-level-up as numerical countdown; SPACE/ENTER spin, left/right arrows for rules navigation

The three low-tier 'lucky 7' symbols are distinguished primarily by outline/background colour (green vs blue vs red-maroon), a risk for red-green and blue-yellow colour-blind players. Secondary non-colour cues exist: each has a distinct printed payout value (0.03/0.02/0.01) and a fixed position on the paytable page (green top-left, blue top-right, red/maroon centred below). The base-game vs Free Games state is distinguishable by scene content and lighting (neon exterior vs warm interior), not by colour alone. Settings toggle switches encode ON/OFF via both colour (orange/grey) AND knob position (right/left).
No mechanic in this game is conveyed by sound alone: Free Games triggers, retriggers, Train Multiplier reveals and Super Mega Win presentations all carry on-screen text/numeral confirmation.

Bet/Balance/Win readouts use large printed numerals in the bottom control bar and the win overlay is stamped in bold orange directly over the winning tiles. The Ways badge is a large gold numeral on a purple plaque to the left of the grid, and the Super Bet ante cost (when active) is shown in a separate red/gold badge above it.

All controls are large, well-separated pill/circular buttons in a single horizontal bar; the space bar can both spin and stop the reels, offering a keyboard alternative to precise mouse clicks. Auto Play with configurable stop conditions reduces the need for repetitive clicking.

Every screen shows large printed numerals for Bet/Bet Level/Coin/Balance/Win in the bottom control bar and a thin service strip below it. A screen-reader implementation should announce the Ways badge value and the Super Bet badge (when present) alongside the bet, since both silently change the cost and structure of the next spin.

WILD is a gold gift box labeled 'WILD' in text — identifiable by text label and shape, not by color alone. SCATTER shows 'SCATTER' in yellow-white text on dark banner. Royal symbols use standard card letters (A, K, Q, J).

EXTRA CHANCE OF SCATTERS toggle: ON state is green (right position) and OFF is gray (left position). Differentiated by both position and ON/OFF text label inside toggle — accessible without color vision.

Bonus Buy dialog: Cancel button is a red circle with white X on the left; Confirm is a green circle with white checkmark on the right. Both symbol shape and position (left=cancel, right=confirm) differentiate them without color vision.
Settings toggles: all have ON/OFF positional state (left=OFF, right=ON) plus color (gray=OFF, green=ON). Text label inside each toggle clarifies state independent of color.
Volatility indicator uses 5 lightning bolt shapes — shape-based count, not color-only. Payline directions are stated in text: 'All symbols pay from left to right'.

All core game information is visual — WIN amounts, FREE SPINS LEFT count, CONGRATULATIONS message all appear as on-screen text. Sound can be toggled off via sound button or Settings menu without affecting gameplay information.

Candy-cane reel dividers are red-and-white striped — high contrast pattern. Reel background is dark blue-purple against gold ornate frame. WIN amount shown in large bright gold text. FREE SPINS LEFT shown in large cyan text.

SPACE and ENTER keyboard keys start and stop the spin. SPIN button is the largest interactive element (central circular button). Autoplay supports up to 100 automatic spins, reducing repeated spin actions.

WILD and SCATTER symbols have explicit text labels printed on them. Free Spins trigger shows full text overlay: 'CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON 15 FREE SPINS!' with 'PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE'. WIN amounts are text labels (WIN $XX.XX). BET and CREDIT are text labels. Paytable navigation uses left/right arrow buttons with explicit symbols.
Jackpot tiers are distinguished by both colour and a printed text label on every badge/plaque: Mini blue, Minor green, Mega red/orange, Grand gold -- never colour alone.
Enhancer symbols: Multiplier tiles are pink/magenta with an x plus a number, Addition tiles are blue with a plus sign plus a number -- distinguished by both colour and by the plus-vs-x glyph.
Bonus Game spin-counter baubles: lit (spin available) versus unlit (spin used) is conveyed by a brightness/glow difference, not by a colour-hue change -- safe for all colour-blindness types.
Settings mute toggles use an icon-shape change (plain speaker versus speaker with a small x through it), not colour, to show muted state.

Base game (blue background) versus Bonus Game (red/maroon background) is a full scene change also confirmed by a different top strip (vault icon versus Enhancer Reel) and a different spin-counter element, so the state is identifiable without colour perception.

Every audio cue implied by game state (win, jackpot award, bonus trigger, big win) is paired with an on-screen text/graphic banner (WIN:, BIG WIN, CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON...), so the game is fully playable with sound off; the Settings panel additionally allows muting All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music separately.

Two clearly separated large circular controls (Spin at bottom-right, Autoplay above it) plus a single scrollable Bet Select list; no drag-only or timing-critical controls were observed on any captured screen.

All monetary values (bet, balance, win, jackpot ladder, Instant Prize tokens, collected totals) are printed as plain on-screen text/numerals at all times, not encoded only in imagery. The four special-mechanic symbols (Instant Prize, Jackpot, Collector, Dud) are also each a distinct shape (round coin token, poker-chip badge, square portrait medallion, plain diamond), so shape-based identification remains possible without colour vision.

All 4 ornament symbols (ranks 4-7) display card suit marks (spade, heart, club, diamond) on the ball face, enabling shape-based distinction regardless of color vision. High symbols Teddy Bear, Train, and Biplane are uniquely shaped characters requiring no color cues.

Spin feature markers are 5 snowflakes distinguished by color (blue/purple/yellow/red/green). When a feature triggers, its name appears as a text label in the win journal panel (REFRESH, WILD SANTA, BLOCKS, SUPERSIZE, LUCKY SANTA), providing a secondary non-color cue.

All game mechanics described in 8-page text information panel. Win journal provides a complete text log of wins and feature triggers with dollar amounts. No critical gameplay information is conveyed through audio only.

SPACE and ENTER both trigger spin (redundant keyboard controls). Autoplay supports up to 100 auto-spins with TURBO SPIN and SKIP SCREENS options to minimize required interactions during feature rounds.

Win journal panel on the left provides a running text log of each win event: cluster size, symbol, optional feature label, and dollar amount. Midnight Riches entry overlays display MIDNIGHT RICHES and LEVEL N as large centered text. WIN display shows round total at bottom.
The four low-value gem symbols (red/green/purple/blue) are differentiated only by hue on the same shape — a residual color-dependency risk for the lowest payout tier specifically.
Ante-bet and settings toggle switches signal on/off via color (red/grey=off, green=on) AND explicit text ('OFF'/'ON') AND switch position, not color alone.
Buy Free Spins confirm dialog differentiates confirm/cancel via color (green/red) AND distinct icon shapes (checkmark vs X), not color alone.
No audio-only information observed; Ambient Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable and decorative/atmospheric only, all game state is conveyed as on-screen text.

Free Spins entry is reinforced by a full background-scene change (outdoor snowy aurora-lit base game to an indoor purple/blue living room) plus explicit 'FREE SPINS LEFT' text and countdown number, not color alone.

Large circular touch/click target for the primary SPIN action; SPACE/ENTER keyboard shortcuts start/stop the spin, holding SPACE triggers Turbo Spin; Autoplay (up to 100 spins) with a Skip Screens option reduces required interactions.
Rules/paytable is a fixed linear 7-page booklet with explicit 'Page N/7' labelling, navigated via left-triangle/close/right-triangle controls, not an open-ended scroll panel.

Same-payout animal pairs are distinguished by shape and plaque background color, not by the payout number: Bear (red-orange plaque) vs Eagle (blue plaque); Wolf (purple/violet plaque) vs Deer (teal-green plaque).

Card royals Q, J, 10 and 9 share an identical 5/4/3 payout tier but each is a distinct color (Q blue/indigo, J purple/lavender, 10 teal/green, 9 dusty pink/rose) plus a distinct letter/number glyph, so identity does not depend on color alone.

Free Spins state is signalled by a full background palette change from the daytime orange desert (base game) to a night-time blue-purple starry canyon, plus an explicit 'Free spins: N/15' text counter, not by color alone.
No information is conveyed by sound alone; all wins, feature triggers and counters are shown as on-screen text/numbers. Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative.

Wild Multiplier (x2) and Free Spins Multiplier (x3) values are shown as large printed numerals on high-contrast backgrounds (e.g. a purple 'X2' tag, a 'Total win' / '90x Bet' overlay in white/gold on dark background), legible without fine color discrimination.

Spacebar can trigger a spin as a keyboard alternative to clicking the Spin button (toggle in Settings, default on). Autoplay offers 10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/unlimited round-count presets plus configurable stop conditions, reducing required manual actions.

Control layout is stable across screens: info/settings buttons bottom-left, Balance/Total bet center-left, Autoplay/Spin buttons bottom-right, Buy Bonus button fixed on the mid-left edge of the reel frame. Help and Payments booklets are each a single linear scroll sequence reached via a 3-icon rake (money-bag/clock/question-mark) behind the 'i' button.

Letter symbols A/K/Q/J/10/9 are differentiated primarily by glyph shape, not color, since several share near-identical card styling; Wild and Scatter are additionally labeled with printed 'WILD'/'SCATTER' text on their cards.

The Chance x2 toggle's on/off state is conveyed by icon shape (plain arrow = inactive vs five-point star = active) plus background highlight, not color alone. The Bet Ways valid/invalid diagram uses white checkmark vs white X glyphs as the primary cue, with yellow highlight tiles only as a secondary aid.

No audio-only information was observed on any captured screen; Music and Sound FX are decorative toggles in Settings. All game state (wins, bet, ways, spins remaining, multiplier, bonus active) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.

Bet +/- controls and the round spin button are large touch targets. Autoplay offers preset round counts (10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/infinity) to reduce clicks needed for extended play. Chance x2 surcharge and Buy Bonus purchase are both single-click/toggle actions.

The playing field has no fixed row count: every reel's visible height is re-randomized each spin (observed ways counters 1728/3000/2160/1620/3600/9600 across captures), which is a structural property of the field itself, not a cosmetic detail.

Control layout is stable across all base-game screens: info/settings buttons bottom-left, Balance/Total bet center-left, Autoplay/Spin bottom-right, Buy Bonus/Chance toggle in a fixed left-side panel. Paytable/rules is a single continuous scroll (4 paytable pages + 11 rules pages) with no page-jump control beyond the scrollbar.

All five high-paying animals are distinct species shapes (lion / giraffe / zebra / hyena / two meerkats) AND each has a distinct background neon glow color (orange-gold / teal / purple / green / blue) — double differentiation, color not required

WILD is a unique landscape scene (sunset with acacia tree), not an animal portrait — identifiable by shape alone. SCATTER is the only circular medallion shape in silver-blue; all other symbols are rectangular tiles

All six royals share the same warm orange-tan stone style; distinguished solely by letter or numeral character shape (A / K / Q / J / 10 / 9). SPECIAL LION is white-silver versus the orange-gold of regular Lion
Ambient music and sound FX toggleable independently in settings menu; battery saver mode reduces animation speed, suitable for motion-sensitive players

SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts start and stop the spin; autoplay available (up to 100 spins) with stop conditions for feature win, loss limit, and single win limit; turbo spin and quick spin modes selectable

SPECIAL LION tracker bar displays explicit text 'COLLECT N MORE [icon] TRANSFORM [animal icon] TO [Lion icon]' during Free Spins — milestone progress readable without color perception. Bet and credit labels are clickable to toggle between coins and cash view

Primary/active button (SPIN, confirm checkmark, selected bet/autospin tile) is set apart from inactive raspberry-pink buttons by a brightness jump to bright yellow AND an outline/fill or icon-glyph difference, not by hue alone.
WILD and SCATTER icons carry the words WILD/SCATTER baked into the art, so they remain identifiable in grayscale without color.

The three symbol-medallion glow colors (pink/gold/teal for old man/blonde woman/bulldog) are a secondary cue only; the character art itself (bald man vs blonde hair vs dog) is the primary, color-independent identifier.
Payline diagrams use filled white dots vs empty dark-maroon dots on a 5x3 grid, distinguished by brightness/fill, not hue.
Toggle switches (Game Settings, Autoplay Advanced Settings) show on/off state by the handle's left/right position in addition to yellow fill when on.

No audio-only information observed; all game state (win amounts, spins remaining, multiplier value, purchase cost, RTP/bet limits) is conveyed through on-screen numerals and text. Sound/Music are separate labelled toggles in Game Settings.
Win amounts and Free Spins counts are rendered as large chiseled silver-grey 3D numerals with a dark outline for maximum contrast against the bright magenta light-burst background.
The multiplier gauge always shows its value as printed text (1X, 2X ... NX) rather than by ring color alone.
Primary action targets (SPIN, the yellow Play splash button, yellow bet/autospin confirm controls) are large, high-contrast and consistently yellow, easing relocation without fine positioning.

Layout is stable across the base game and all panels: BUY FREE SPINS sign and biker character fixed on the far left, the right-hand toolbar always in the same 5-icon top-to-bottom order, and balance/win/bet readouts always in the same 'LABEL / FUN / amount' left/center/right pattern on the bottom bar.

The paytable+rules booklet and the autoplay/bet-selector panels are each a single continuous linear scroll (no page-jump tabs), all navigable top-to-bottom with a consistent close-X in the same top-right position.

The gold coin-medallion Scatter and the low-value Sun symbol are both a circular gold sun-face on a light card; they are told apart by the Scatter's ornate green filigree card background versus the Sun's plain cream card, not by hue alone. The five locations are told apart by distinct background art, and WILD/Train Scatter both print their name as text.

Independent Sound-Ambient and Sound-Effects toggles exist in the settings panel. Wins, free-games counts, jackpot values, feature triggers and location changes are all shown as on-screen text or numerals, not conveyed by sound alone.

Every numeric readout (BET, BET LEVEL, COIN, BALANCE, WIN) is paired with a printed text label beneath or beside it. Win amounts and free-games counts appear as large embossed cream/gold numerals against a dark background on win and feature screens.

Space bar spins and stops the reels as an alternative to the mouse-only SPIN button. BET MAX sets bet level to its maximum in one click, and bet/coin adjustment uses dedicated stepper buttons rather than dragging or sliders.

Only the Help screen (12 pages, plain scrollable text) is real accessible text; the reels, the 22-page paytable/rules booklet, settings, autoplay and win/feature splash screens are all rendered on a single canvas with no text equivalent.

The two WILD symbols are told apart by shape, not color: black flag-and-skull vs. pink octopus tentacles. The Rum scatter and the Compass trigger symbol are distinguished by shape and printed words ('RUM') rather than by color. All 8 Compass wheel outcomes are printed as text/numerals on their segments, so color is not required to read a result.

All observed game states (feature triggers, wheel results, jackpot tickers, win totals) are conveyed through on-screen text/graphics; the Sound - Ambient and Sound - Effects toggles can be muted with no loss of information.

Background is a bright turquoise/cyan sky and sea; the UI frame is warm golden-brown wood with beige rope and grey iron brackets; the reel panel is pale tan parchment; the jackpot ticker is a red banner with bold yellow/cream digits. Every payout and feature outcome is also printed as text/number on the same frame, not conveyed by color alone.

Core actions are available both via mouse/touch (the ship's-wheel SPIN button, +/- steppers) and via a single keyboard key (Space bar starts and stops the reels). Auto Play with configurable stop conditions (balance decrease, single-win threshold, feature trigger) reduces the number of repeated manual actions needed.

Every payout, jackpot value and feature outcome is duplicated as on-screen text/numerals next to its icon; the running BET/WIN/BALANCE values in the bottom status bar mirror the larger animated banners, giving a redundant text anchor for every state change.
Bonus Symbol (green gem) and Super Bonus Symbol (red/orange gem) are distinguished by a skull-and-crossbones motif on the Super Bonus badge as well as by colour, not colour alone.
Push Bet promotional callouts use explicit text ('INCREASE chance to win feature') alongside the magenta/purple colour scheme, not colour alone.
Selected items in the Bet Select and Autoplay lists are shown by white-fill versus dark-grey fill contrast, not by hue.
In Settings, the mute state of each sound toggle is shown by the icon glyph changing shape (speaker vs speaker-with-cross), not by colour alone.

No audio-only information is used -- spins remaining, win amounts, feature awards and multiplier values are all conveyed through on-screen text and iconography; Settings offers independent All Sounds / Sound Effects / Music mute toggles.
Instant Prize coins are differentiated primarily by a printed numeral rather than by the coin's metal tint (bronze/copper, pale blue-white or gold), which only loosely correlates with value tier.

SPIN is the single largest circular target on screen. Base Bet is chosen from a scrollable list of discrete preset values (0.10 to 100.00 fun) rather than a continuous slider; Autoplay offers fixed spin-count presets (10 to 1000) plus an explicit Off state.

Control layout is stable across base-game frames: sound and menu icons top-right, Push Bet / autoplay-style icon / Bonus Buy icon stacked top-to-bottom on the right rail, large round SPIN at the bottom of that rail; Balance is always bottom-left, Total Bet always bottom-right.

Green totem mask and WILD's green mask share a hue family but differ in shape/silhouette, and WILD also carries an explicit 'WILD' text label; purple totem mask and card Q (also purple/magenta) are similarly hue-shared but shape-differentiated. Feature-state shift (green base game vs red/maroon Free Spins) is reinforced by on-screen text, not color alone. Settings toggle switches show state via handle position (left=off/right=on) in addition to track color (grey/green).

No audio-only information observed; Sound FX and Ambient Music toggles are purely decorative/optional. All game state (wins, spins left, multiplier, bet, credit) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.

Win amounts, free-spin counts and Shape Wins multipliers (e.g. 'x2', 'X7') are shown as large, high-contrast gold/yellow numerals on dark backgrounds, legible without fine print or color discrimination.

Large round click targets with SPIN the largest and most central; SPACE/ENTER are keyboard-operable spin triggers; Autoplay supports at least 100 automatic spins reducing required clicks; Buy Free Spins lets a player skip needing to land a natural 3+ scatter combination.

Stable control layout across all base-game screens: menu and sound stacked far left, info 'i' button just to their right, bet -/+ flank the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY sits directly below SPIN. Win amounts, remaining free-spin counts, multiplier values and matched-symbol tallies are all shown as legible numerals in addition to colour. Paytable and Rules panels use white body text on a dark charcoal panel with gold headings and a gold X close icon — high contrast rather than colour-dependent.

Bottom control bar (TURBO / minus / SPIN / plus / AUTO / menu) keeps a stable left-to-right order in the base game; Paytable and Rules are linear, page-numbered, top-to-bottom scrollable documents reached from the same menu and each closable with a single X control.

The four jackpot plaques (GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR/MINI) differ by color (maroon/green/blue/magenta) but each also carries its own printed tier name and fixed top-to-bottom rank order, so identity does not depend on color alone.

Balance/win/bet readout and paytable/RTP/limits figures are high-contrast white or gold text on a dark aubergine background, legible without relying on icon size or bar length alone.

Button and toggle state changes by fill or shape, not hue alone; win-tier labels and all monetary values are always printed as text or numerals rather than color-only signals. Space key starts a spin, holding Space repeats spins, Space during a spin skips the reel animation. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80, 1000 spins and a Turbo button is present.
