Jackpot tiers MEGA, MAJOR, MINOR, MINI are told apart by printed labels and by position top to bottom, not only by plaque colour (red, purple, blue, green).
Animal symbols differ by shape; tile border colours are additional cues: gold wolf, rust-red eagle, purple cougar, green bear.
Card symbols are letters and a numeral, so green Q and turquoise J are separable by glyph.
Cash orbs are blue glowing moons carrying a printed value; the free games banner is blue and the Cash Feature banner is orange-red, and both carry printed titles.
No sound captions were observed; all feature states and wins are also shown as text on screen.
Headings, STAKE, CREDIT and PAID labels are yellow on near-black panels; body text is white; the message strip shows white text over a dark translucent bar.
Wins are announced in text (PAID, LINE n PAYS, SCATTER PAYS, NICE WIN) in addition to a blue glow on winning tiles.
All required inputs are single clicks; the Spacebar may also start a spin depending on jurisdiction and operator configuration; the bonus banners need a click on CONTINUE.
Game state is mostly text on the bottom message bar; a DOM strip below the canvas shows the game name and a clock. No other text alternatives were observed.
Character symbols differ by drawn shape (horns, fox ears, beak, lantern eye, clawed hand, hairdo), so red demon and green imp are not confused by red-green colour blindness.
Royals are identified by letter or number shape; colours are secondary: yellow-green A, pink-red K, purple Q, blue J, green 10, brown-mauve 9.
Wild and Scatter print the words WILD and SCATTER; Mystery has a unique white swirl on a dark-crimson tile.
The active multiplier lantern is lit bright yellow with a light trail and printed x digits; the others are dimmer orange-beige.
Win state: white-blue glow outline on tiles, printed WIN amount and ways counter text. Free spins: printed REMAINING FREE SPIN number plus a shift from violet night to coral-red sunset.
Win information is printed (WIN banner, win plaque, TOTAL WIN screen) and the free spin count is a large number. A Sound toggle exists in the menu; sound-only cues cannot be judged from stills.
Black info plaques with pale cyan-blue numbers; lantern captions bold lantern yellow; TOTAL WIN digits large gold on glowing orange; Collect plaque is dark red with gold text.

Large round bronze spin button; Auto Spin 10, 30, 50, 80, 1000; Turbo; keyboard Space starts, holds, skips animation or activates a lone button. Bet by plus and minus or scroll wheels with Max Bet and Confirm. Controls fade during spin resolution.
Paytable and rules are real text in scrolling panels; the reel area is a canvas without text. Reading order: lanterns, roof banner, ways counter, reels left to right, balance, bet, win, controls.

Every wheel cell is labelled with its multiplier in text, so a filled segment is never told by colour alone; the three special cells are additionally distinguished by shape - square, triangle and circle. The cash-out amount is printed as a number on the button.

A near-black background patterned with faint circle, triangle and square outlines; the wheel sits in the middle as concentric dark rings with pale grey multiplier labels, and filled segments light up in saturated colour. The action button is a large green circle, and the cash-out buttons turn solid yellow with the amount in dark text.
Every action is a single click on a large target, and the space bar spins as well, which the menu states outright. Nothing needs holding or timing.

The interface is real DOM, but the autoplay control has no accessible name anywhere on the page - it carries no text and no label, and is only identifiable by its element class. Multiplier labels on the wheel are rotated text.

Feature Pots (magenta Boost, red Jackpot, orange Min Coin) and Jackpot tier badges (green/teal Mini, blue/purple Minor, red Major, rainbow Grand) are color-coded but each also carries a printed name and numeric value, so identity does not depend on color alone.

Special-symbol overlays are color-coded (purple/magenta Boost, green/blue/red/rainbow Jackpot by tier, orange/gold Min Coin) but show a printed x-value or clover shape too; the one brief exception is a Jackpot coin flying onto the grid before its tier-name banner resolves.

All game-state information (wins, respins remaining, feature levels, RTP, prices) is conveyed as on-screen text/numbers; sound is limited to Music and Sound FX toggles with no audio-only information identified.
Checkbox state in Settings (Quick spin, Spacebar to spin, Music, Sound FX) is shown by fill color together with a checkmark glyph, not by hue alone.

Primary actions (Spin, Buy Features, Autoplay) are large clickable icons; the bet can be set via a dropdown list or +/- stepper without dragging a slider; Spacebar can trigger Spin as an alternative to clicking.

Control layout is stable: info/settings icons far left of the bottom bar, balance and bet center-left, message ticker center, autoplay and spin far right; the 3 Feature Pots and 4 Jackpot badges stay in fixed top/left positions and always carry both a text label and a printed numeric value.

A cleared rung and the current undecided rung render in the SAME gold, so cell colour cannot separate them. What does carry the state is the label in the left-hand column turning solid, the climber's position on the ladder and the live cash-out figure - worth knowing, because the obvious cue is the unreliable one here.
Sound is a toggle in the burger menu and every outcome is printed on screen, so no result is carried by audio alone.
Every rung prints its multiplier in a dedicated left-hand column at a constant position rather than inside the cells, so the ladder can be read without tracking the character.
The round is turn-based and waits for a step or a cash-out; Auto Pick removes the need for precise repeated presses once a round is running.
The control bar is real DOM with named elements, but the ladder and the climber are drawn on canvas, so progress is not exposed as text.

All 4 character symbols differ by gender and armor/helmet appearance beyond hex border color. 4 glyph symbols have unique shapes (trefoil, inverted-triangle, star-burst, trident) independent of color. Royals identified by letter (A/K/Q/J). Base-to-FS mode shift: background changes from amber/orange to deep navy; reinforced by FREE SPINS LEFT text counter badge.

All game events conveyed visually via text overlays and on-screen numerals. Separate AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles in settings. Feature win announced via full-screen congratulations overlay with win amount. No audio-exclusive game information identified.

Hex cell borders glow in distinct colors (red, purple, green, blue) for symbol grouping. WILD gemstone is a multicolor jewel with large gold WILD label text. Scatter emits ultra-bright white-green radiant glow — highest luminosity symbol on the grid. WIN amounts displayed in large prominent numerals.

Large circular spin button in center-right of bottom bar. Large persistent Buy Free Spins banner on left side of screen. Autoplay up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option. Keyboard: hold SPACE for turbo spin. Bet adjustable in both main toolbar and settings panel.

Grid: 6 reels left to right, 4 hex rows per reel; wins on left-to-right adjacent reels from reel 1. Win amounts shown as dollar text. Feature triggers use full-screen text overlays. FS countdown shown as X FREE SPINS LEFT badge. BET and CREDIT shown as labeled text numerals.

Locked WILD state during the Respin Feature is marked with a padlock icon and a glowing cyan/white edge outline, not color alone; the stacking re-hit multiplier is printed as white/gold number text ('x2'/'x3'/'x4') on the tile, independent of color

Green is reused for paytable navigation arrows and for ON/active toggle states, but each instance also carries a distinguishing shape (left/right triangle, checkmark) or explicit text label, so it is not a color-only cue

No audio-only information was observed on any captured screen; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative — all game state (win amounts, line-pays, credit/bet, feature progress) is conveyed through on-screen text and iconography
Win amounts, line-pays text, and CREDIT/BET values are rendered as high-contrast yellow/cyan text on a dark navy background throughout every screen

SPIN is the largest click target on screen; SPACE/ENTER also start and stop a spin, giving a keyboard-only path; Autoplay with an adjustable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option reduces the number of required manual actions for extended play

Stable control layout across all screens: menu and sound buttons stacked far left, 'i' info button immediately to their right, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, bet +/- buttons flanking the large central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY just below/right of SPIN; the rules/paytable booklet is a strictly linear 6-page sequence navigated with prev/next arrows and closed with a center X, in the same position on every page
Most controls are non-color glyph/icon based (menu lines, speaker, info 'i', +/-, checkmark/X); toggle state is shown by handle position, not track color alone.
Volatility rating is shown as a literal count of filled gold lightning-bolt icons (5 of 5), not a color scale.

The four multiplier hearts (green, blue, pink/magenta, orange/gold) share the same shape and differ mainly by hue, but each hit heart also prints its actual multiplier value as text (e.g. '2x', '3x'), the non-color-dependent cue.
Paytable/rules navigation arrows and close button are green but differentiated by shape (left triangle / cross / right triangle), not color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and decorative. Win amounts, free-spins-left, total multiplier, retrigger/trigger events and round completion are all shown as on-screen text/numerals.
Win amounts, FREE SPINS LEFT counter and TOTAL MULTIPLIER badge are printed as large, high-contrast gold/white numerals on dark backgrounds.

Large round click targets; central SPIN is the largest. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop the spin (keyboard-operable). Autoplay (adjustable spin count + SKIP SCREENS option) reduces the number of required manual clicks.

Stable control layout across base-game screens: menu (hamburger) and sound stacked far-left, separate 'i' info button beside them, bet +/- flanking the large central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. Info booklet is a linear 7-page sequence navigable with prev/next arrows and closable via a dedicated X.
toggle switches (e.g. Double Chance ON/OFF) encode state by BOTH handle position (left=off/right=on) and text label, not color alone; checkboxes use a checkmark glyph, not color fill
volatility rating is shown as a COUNT of lightning-bolt icons (5 of 5 filled) rather than a single hue, legible by counting

the 9 regular pay symbols are differentiated mainly by shape/icon (sun/heart/moon/star badges vs faceted gem shapes), not color alone; symbol colors in words: sun-badge gold on red/orange, heart-crown pink/magenta with gold crown, moon-badge gold on deep purple, star-badge gold on blue-purple in teal frame, red heart-gem ruby-red, blue gem sapphire-blue, green gem emerald-green, teal gem teal/cyan, yellow gem amber/yellow

no audio-only information observed; all game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, total multiplier, bet, credit, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals; music and sound effects are decorative and toggleable

all primary controls are large circular touch targets, SPIN being the largest element on screen; SPACE/ENTER keys also spin, holding SPACE engages turbo without opening a menu; Autoplay with adjustable count and a Skip Screens option reduces clicks needed for extended play

control positions are stable across all base-game states (menu+sound icons far-left, info button next to them, bet -/+ flanking the central spin button, autoplay beneath spin); the 7-page rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence with an explicit 'Page N/7' counter on every page

Five low-value gem symbols share the same faceted-gemstone design but are distinguished by CUT/SHAPE as well as color: red heart-cut, blue pentagon/shield-cut, green rhombus/kite-cut, teal rounded-octagon-cut, yellow hexagon-cut.

Base game background is a bright blue daytime sky; Free Spins mode swaps to a deep purple/violet starry night sky with magenta nebula clouds -- mode is also confirmed by on-screen 'FREE SPINS LEFT n' and 'TOTAL MULTIPLIER' text, not by color alone.

The four MULTIPLIER heart symbols (green, blue, pink/magenta, orange/gold) are distinguished ONLY by color with no shape or text difference between variants; however the actual multiplier numeric value is always printed on/near the symbol, so the value remains readable without color discrimination.
Toggle switches (Ante Bet, Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen) show state by handle POSITION (left=off/right=on) in addition to green-when-on color.
Navigation arrows in the paytable/info booklet are shape-coded (triangle/cross/triangle for prev/close/next), not color-coded alone.

No audio-only information observed; Ambient Music and Sound FX are separately toggleable decorative audio, while all game state (wins, free spins remaining, total multiplier, tumble results, bonus-buy price) is conveyed redundantly in on-screen text and numerals.
CREDIT, BET and WIN readouts are large high-contrast yellow-on-dark text; award amounts on the Congratulations plaque are large gold digits on a blue rounded plaque for legibility.

The central SPIN button is the largest click target; SPACE/ENTER also start/stop the spin and holding SPACE gives turbo spin; Autoplay (adjustable spin count plus Skip Screens) reduces required clicks for extended play.

Bottom bar layout is stable and predictable: menu and sound icons far-left, 'i' info button next to them, bet +/- flank the central SPIN button, Autoplay directly below SPIN; the info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with prev/next navigation and a center close button.

The five low-value gem symbols are distinguished not only by color but by cut/shape: red heart-cut, green diamond/rhombus-cut, blue kite/shield-cut, gold hexagon-cut, teal round-cut; their payouts also differ, so color alone is never required to identify them.
The four high-value medallions differ by the icon inside the badge (star / heart+crown / sun / crescent moon), not by badge color alone.

Feature/background transitions (base game sky-blue vs Free Spins pink palace vs Super Free Spins deep-space starfield) are paired with explicit on-screen text (FREE SPINS LEFT, X/12 SCATTERS, ALL WINS ARE MULTIPLIED BY XN), so no state relies on color alone.
Settings menu on/off toggle state is shown by BOTH knob position (left=off, right=on) AND track color (dark=off, green=on); position is the non-color-dependent cue.

No audio-only information was observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles; all game state (wins, spins left, multiplier, scatter-collection progress, feature transitions) is conveyed via on-screen text and banners.
CREDIT and BET balance labels are yellow/gold text on a dark background for high contrast; primary action controls (SPIN, START AUTOPLAY) are large circular/rectangular high-contrast targets.
SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spins in addition to pointer clicks; AUTOPLAY (with SKIP SCREENS enabled by default) reduces the number of manual interactions needed across the long feature chain.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across all base-game states (menu+sound icons far left, info button next, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, SPIN with bet +/- centered-right, AUTOPLAY below SPIN, BUY FEATURE mid-left of the reel frame); the 8-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigable with left/right arrows and closed with a central X.

Every symbol has a unique shape: round medallion (Sun), round disc with wings (Pink Heart Medallion), orb with candles (Moon Candelabra), spiky starburst frame (Blue Star Badge), faceted heart (Red Heart Gem), rhombus-cut gem (Blue Sapphire), square-cut gem (Green Emerald), smooth round disc (Teal Circle Gem), hexagonal gem (Yellow Hexagon Gem), human figure (SCATTER princess). Shape alone distinguishes all 9 regular symbols without relying on color.

Blue Sapphire Diamond (cobalt blue, angular gear frame) and Teal Circle Gem (aquamarine, smooth round border) differ in both shape and surface: one is sharp-faceted rhombus, the other is smooth round disc. Distinguishable without color perception.

Sun Medallion (red background) vs Green Emerald Diamond (emerald green) may appear similar to red-green colorblind users. Sun Medallion has a round medallion shape with golden flanges and a sunburst motif; Green Emerald is a square-cut flat gem — distinctly different shapes.

Regular Free Spins (dark blue/near-black background) vs Super Free Spins (vivid magenta/purple background) may appear as two dark or similar tones for tritanopes. The header text above the grid provides a text-based distinction: 'WIN UP TO 50000X BET' in regular FS vs 'HIT [heart icon] TO MULTIPLY TUMBLE WIN' in Super Free Spins.

Multiplier Hearts exist in four colors (green, blue, pink, orange) but all four are functionally identical. The numeric multiplier value (e.g. '140x') is always displayed on or near the symbol. No gameplay decision requires distinguishing heart color.

SCATTER (princess, human figure with red hair and gold wand) vs SUPER SCATTER (glowing golden starburst orb) differ in shape and subject. The princess is the only humanoid figure on the grid. Both carry text labels ('SCATTER' / 'SUPER SCATTER') enabling text-based identification.
Ante Bet 'DOUBLE CHANCE TO WIN FEATURE' toggle uses green for ON state and dark/grey for OFF, supplemented by 'OFF'/'ON' text label — readable without color perception.

All win amounts, bonus triggers, and feature events are shown as on-screen text overlays: CONGRATULATIONS modal, SENSATIONAL! full-screen win celebration, WIN $X in bottom bar. No audio-only feedback detected.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX can be toggled independently in SYSTEM SETTINGS. Game is fully playable without audio. Regular Free Spins vs Super Free Spins are distinguished visually by background color and header text — no audio cue exclusively indicates which mode is active.

Symbol colors in order of payout rank: (1) Sun Medallion — red and gold; (2) Pink Heart Medallion — hot-pink disc, gold border; (3) Moon Candelabra — silver-grey-purple frame, gold crescent, white candles; (4) Blue Star Badge — blue disc and icy-blue frame, gold star center; (5) Red Heart Gem — deep crimson faceted heart; (6) Blue Sapphire Diamond — cobalt blue faceted rhombus; (7) Green Emerald Diamond — emerald green faceted square; (8) Teal Circle Gem — aquamarine smooth round disc; (9) Yellow Hexagon Gem — warm golden-yellow hexagonal cube.

SCATTER princess: red hair, blue-white magical-girl outfit, golden star-tipped wand, surrounded by golden sparkles, 'SCATTER' in large gold block letters beneath. SUPER SCATTER: bright gold/yellow glowing starburst orb, 'SUPER SCATTER' label visible in rules.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop the spin. HOLD SPACE activates Turbo Spin. Bet adjustable via on-screen minus/plus buttons. Autoplay available: up to 100 auto-spins, with SKIP SCREENS option to auto-dismiss bonus intro and end screens, reducing repeated interactions.
SPIN button is a large circular button centered in the bottom bar, easy pointer target. QUICK SPIN and TURBO SPIN modes reduce animation time and waiting between spins.

All critical numeric values are displayed as text: CREDIT, BET, WIN, FREE SPINS LEFT, TOTAL MULTIPLIER. Win modals show full text ('CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON $X IN 15 FREE SPINS'). Payout rules are in 8 pages of structured text with clear section headers (GAME RULES, TUMBLE FEATURE, SUPER SCATTER, FREE SPINS, MAX WIN, ANTE BET, BUY FREE SPINS, HOW TO PLAY, SETTINGS MENU, BET MENU, AUTOPLAY).

The scatter-pays mechanic is described in plain text on game rules page 1: 'Symbols pay anywhere on the screen. The total number of the same symbol on the screen at the end of a spin determines the value of the win.' No paylines to memorize.

Volatility indicator uses five filled flame icons (all five filled = High). The word 'High' is not shown next to the icons in the indicator itself; the verbal description is provided on rules page 5 of 8: 'High volatility games pay out less often on average but the chance to hit big wins in a short time span is higher.'

WILD (pink star) and SCATTER (fairy portrait) identified by distinct icon art plus explicit 'WILD' text label, not color alone; multiplier values are printed as numerals; toggle switches use handle position plus green/grey fill.
Free Spins mode is signaled by a background palette shift (cooler blue sky vs warmer base-game sky) AND an explicit 'FREE SPINS LEFT' text counter, not color alone.
Volatility rating on the splash screen is conveyed by both the word 'VOLATILITY' and a count of 5 lit gold lightning-bolt icons (position/count-based), not hue alone.
Ways-to-win diagram uses a green checkmark vs a red X, also distinguished by shape (check-mark vs cross), not color alone.

One color-reliant cue: the 'gold symbol' cell-background tint (warm gold/orange vs default pale pink) is not dual-coded with shape/text, though it is restricted to known reel positions (2/3/4 in base game, always reel 3 in Free Spins).

No audio-only information observed; SOUND and Battery Saver toggles are purely comfort settings. All game state (wins, spins remaining, multiplier tier, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.
Max-win callout, win-tier label ('MEGA'), and awarded free-spins counts are printed as large high-contrast gold/white numerals and text rather than relying on subtle color/shading alone.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, Info and Menu; Autoplay reduces required manual actions (default 100 spins, adjustable via slider); SPIN button shows 'HOLD FOR TURBO SPIN' wraparound text implying a press-and-hold gesture; no separate keyboard-shortcut hint observed.

Control layout is stable across states: isolated SOUND icon at far bottom-left; main row Info(i) -> History -> Speed-cycle -> Bet-menu -> Hamburger-menu directly above CREDIT/BET labels; SPIN button flanked by -/+ bet adjusters. The rules/info panel is one continuous scrolling document (drag + 'X' to close), not discrete numbered pages, so it should be treated as a single linear document.

Jackpot tiers are distinguished by printed names (MINI/MAJOR/MEGA JACKPOT) and screen position, not color alone, though MINI's name text is green and MAJOR's is pale blue on matching blue banners with gold values.
WILD and SCATTER symbols print the words WILD/SCATTER directly on the card art in addition to distinct artwork (Mount Rushmore mountainside vs Statue of Liberty bust).
The Free Spins wild multiplier is a printed number (x2/x3/x5) on each Wild card and a printed running total (e.g. x8) on the accumulator shield, not conveyed by color alone.
The four low-value letter symbols (A, K, Q, J) are distinguished from each other by their letter glyph, not by their thin outline color (cyan, purple/magenta, purple, purple respectively).
Coin symbol values are printed as gold numerals directly on the coin face once it lands, readable independent of color.

Music and Sound FX are independently toggled in Settings; feature outcomes (jackpot/free-spins triggers, wins) are always confirmed by on-screen text and numerals ('FREE SPINS', 'HOLD & WIN', win amounts), not conveyed by audio cues alone.

Win amounts and awarded spin/respin counts are shown as large printed numerals (e.g. free spin count '15', respin count '3'); bet-multiplier equivalents ('101x BET', '55x BET') give a secondary numeric confirmation of win size.
Disabled options (Quick spin, 'Don't stop the game on pop-ups') are shown with grayed-out text and an unfilled checkbox, a low-vision-readable state cue beyond color alone.

Bet is adjusted via a +/- stepper or a scrollable dropdown list of discrete denominations (0.10 to 50.00 FUN); autoplay round counts are chosen via preset buttons (10/25/50/100/250/500/750/1000/infinity) rather than precise numeric entry.
Spin can be triggered via the Spacebar as an alternative to clicking the spin button (toggle in Settings, on by default).

In the Buy Bonus dialog, the real purchase price (200.00 FUN, centered) is distinguished from two illustrative example numbers (X10 under Free Spins, 400.00 under Hold & Win) only by larger size and position, with no distinguishing text label -- a potential gap for screen-reader users relying on structure rather than visual size.

Green Atom vs Golden Atom: identical orbital-ring shape, distinguished only by hue (lime-green vs amber-gold). Deuteranopia may confuse these. Pink Atom vs Hot-Pink Gem: both have pink/magenta tones but atom has ring structure vs solid faceted gem. Settings toggles ON=green OFF=grey; slider position (left/right) duplicates the color cue.

Win indicators: expanded WILD reels are flanked by bright pink/magenta vertical neon light beams (shape/position cue) AND 'WIN $XX.XX' text at bottom (text cue, not color-dependent). WILD symbol always bears 'WILD' text label. BONUS bears 'BONUS' text label.

Win amount shown as 'WIN $XX.XX' text on screen. Megaways counter updates each spin. All rules readable in the 6-page info panel without audio. Settings: AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles in System Settings.

Symbols are distinct in form: round gem (teal), diamond (purple), angular gem (pink), rectangular flat gem (cyan), teardrop gem (rose), planet with rings (orange), atom rings (pink/green/golden), small planet no rings (red-orange), starburst (WILD), fireball (BONUS). Neon-outlined cosmic aesthetic on dark indigo/navy background.

Spin via SPACE or ENTER keyboard shortcut. Autoplay up to 100 spins with large START AUTOPLAY button. SKIP SCREENS option enabled by default. Bet adjustment requires repeated +/- clicks. Autospins slider may need drag interaction with no visible +/- buttons.

Paytable read order (top to bottom): Teal Gem 6/5/4/3-match = 2.5x/1.5x/0.75x/0.5x; Purple Diamond = 1.0x/0.75x/0.6x/0.4x; Hot-Pink Gem = 0.75x/0.6x/0.5x/0.3x; Cyan Flat Gem = 0.6x/0.5x/0.4x/0.25x; Rose Teardrop Gem = 0.6x/0.5x/0.4x/0.25x.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX independently toggleable in SYSTEM SETTINGS. All win amounts, payline results, free spins remaining, and feature states (FREE SPINS COMPLETED, etc.) displayed as on-screen text. No audio-only information.

High symbols are large detailed objects on parchment-cream reel background. Royals use distinct letter/numeral shapes (A/K/Q/J/10). Bottom bar shows win amounts in white/cyan text on dark background. Volatility indicated by 5 lightning bolt count icons plus an explanatory text paragraph. GOLDEN TICKET panel shows numeric count (0/3) in addition to filled/empty slot visuals.

SPACE and ENTER keys spin/stop the reels. Hold SPACE activates Turbo Spin. Autoplay supports up to 100+ spins with TURBO, QUICK, and SKIP SCREENS options. Bet adjustment uses simple +/- buttons without precision dragging.

No information is conveyed by sound alone; all game state (wins, ball counts, RTP, jackpot values, feature triggers) is presented as on-screen text or numerals. Sound toggles (Ambient/Effects) are purely optional per the settings panel.

All primary controls are large, well-separated circular or square brass buttons; the Space bar can start and stop spins, reducing the need for precise pointer clicks. Autoplay with configurable stop conditions further reduces required interactions for repeated play.

Control positions are stable across the base-game session: info/paytable button and BET readout at the far left, BET LEVEL stepper, BET MAX, central SPIN (doubles as stop/skip), AUTO PLAY, COIN stepper, BALANCE at the far right. All 6 fruit symbols identifiable by shape alone: strawberry (heart-shaped with leafy crown), plum (round with stem), watermelon (triangular slice with rind and seeds), orange (round with leaf), grapes (cluster of small spheres with vine), cherries (pair on Y-shaped stem). Royal symbols A, K, Q, J are labeled with their letters and have distinct gradient colors (blue, orange, pink/magenta, bright green respectively) — readable by letter alone without color.

WILD identified by golden honeycomb texture and large W letter — not color-dependent. SUPER WILD identified by bee silhouette with wings and antennae. BONUS identified by BONUS text label and floral border.

Marked positions shown as honeycomb-textured circular discs with darker border — distinguishable from normal cells by texture, not color alone. In Free Spins, sticky activated positions have a bright blue/cyan energy ring border, additionally distinct by shape.

Buy Free Spins confirm/cancel buttons: red square with white X (cancel) vs green square with white checkmark (confirm) — distinguished by both color AND icon, accessible to red-green colorblind users.
Settings toggles show state by both color (grey=off, green=on) AND slider position (left=off, right=on). Autoplay checkboxes use checkmark presence in addition to fill color.

All game states communicated via on-screen text: PLACE YOUR BETS (idle), GOOD LUCK (spin in progress), CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON N FREE SPINS PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE (FS trigger), FREE SPINS LEFT N and WIN $X.XX (during FS), SUPERB! and win amount (win screen). No critical information conveyed by sound alone.

Win amount displayed in large bright gold text on dark stone tablet. CREDIT and BET labels prominent in golden-yellow text. Win celebration label (SUPERB!) rendered in very large chunky letters. FREE SPINS LEFT counter shown both as rotating drum visual and as plain text in bottom bar.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop the spin (keyboard accessible). Bet changes via minus/plus circle buttons. Autoplay supports up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option to auto-dismiss feature intro and end screens.

Grid is 7x7 = 49 positions. Bottom bar left-to-right: settings gear, sound toggle, info button; then CREDIT and BET display; then center status text (PLACE YOUR BETS / GOOD LUCK / WIN amount); then minus, spin, plus, AUTOPLAY buttons. Left panel: game logo top, BUY FREE SPINS mid, wooden chest bottom.

All interactive controls use labeled icons: gear = settings, speaker = sound, circle-i = info, refresh arrow = spin. Win celebration shown as on-screen text (SUPERB! etc.) and numeric dollar amount on stone tablet.

Nav arrows are triangle/cross shapes, not color-only; toggle switches show state by handle position (left=off/right=on) as well as color; checkboxes carry a white checkmark glyph; EXIT board cells are labelled with the literal word 'Exit'; the 3 buy tiers are labelled '3/4/5 SCATTERS' text plus an accent color; the 4 low gem symbols are distinguished by card-suit shape (spade/heart/club/diamond) as well as color; the 3 high-value drinks are distinguished by container shape (martini/wine/tall mojito glass) as well as liquid color; the Multiplier pip counter changes ring shade (light vs gold) alongside the numeric readout.

No audio-only information observed; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles. All game state (win amounts, feature trigger, multiplier value, total win, EXIT signs) is conveyed through on-screen text and numbers.

Win amounts, feature banners (CONGRATULATIONS!/Mega!) and RTP/max-win/bet-limit text are shown as large high-contrast text on dark or colored pill backgrounds, legible independent of fine color discrimination.

Large round click targets; the SPIN button is the largest element on the bar. SPACE/ENTER also start/stop the spin. The BUY BONUS RESPINS sign gives one-click access to the feature (with a confirm step), and Autoplay (with a numeric slider) reduces the clicks needed for base-game play.

Stable control layout: hamburger menu + sound stacked at the far left of the bottom bar, 'i' info button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. The info booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence (left/right triangle to change page, X to close) with a persistent 'Page N/7' readout.

The three heroes are distinguished by more than color: Red Braid wears a red bodysuit and wristbands with bare muscular arms, a spiky blond mohawk and a small round amulet pendant at the neck; Mr. Blue Hands is bare-chested with large boxing-glove-style gauntlets covering both forearms, buzz-cut blond hair and a brown beard; Tommy Sun has distinctly warmer golden-yellow skin (vs the other two heroes' tan-orange skin), a tall spiked mohawk with dark stripe accents, a grey chevron marking across the chest and a sun-shaped round belt buckle. Each hero's name is also printed as a text plate under the portrait.

Hero accent colors (red/blue/yellow) on the volatility readout are always paired with the plain word LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH and the exact FUN max-win number in text, so no information is color-only. Hero selection state uses a white glow/border (shape-based), not a color swap. The currently selected bet value in the bet-ladder overlay is distinguished by brightness (dim grey vs white text), not hue. One minor gap: in the Autoplay panel, the selected option pill is shown only via orange-vs-grey fill with no checkmark/icon, so the 'currently active' cue relies on hue+saturation alone (the option's own text label is still legible either way).

All observed game feedback (win amount, hero selection, bet changes) is delivered visually with on-screen text; no sound-only information was identified. A speaker/mute icon is present, implying an optional audio layer, but no essential game state appeared to depend on sound.

The entire core loop requires exactly one button (Power) per round, plus optional Autoplay to remove repeated clicking altogether; bet adjustment offers both fine-grained chevron stepping and a single-tap full-grid picker for reaching extreme (min/max) values quickly.

Every numeric state (bet amount, max win, balance, last win) is always paired with a plain-text 'FUN' currency label and a caption ('Bet amount', 'Max Win', 'Balance', 'BET Amount'), so values are text-derivable, not encoded only in a graphic. Hero identity is always confirmed by a printed name plate/label in addition to the character artwork.

Most affordances are non-colour-coded: button glyph shapes (menu lines, speaker, 'i', +/-, spin arrows), toggle-switch knob position (not just track colour), checkbox check-marks, numeric free-spin counts printed on every driver option, and a 'Page n/8' text counter.

Volatility meter (lightning bolts) relies on lit/unlit colour to convey level, but the COUNT of lit bolts is also a usable non-colour cue; the four neon low-value suit symbols are distinguished primarily by card-suit SHAPE (heart/club/diamond/spade), not colour.
Low-value suit colours: Heart cyan/blue, Club green, Diamond purple/magenta, Spade gold/orange - each on a differently coloured tile as well as a distinct shape.

WILD symbol is chrome pistons + cyan speedometer with red-orange 'WILD' text on a violet halo; FREE SPINS symbol is a chrome medallion with checkered racing flags - both distinguished by shape/text, not colour alone.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are decorative and independently toggle-able in Settings. All game state (win amounts, free spins left, LAPS level, collection-meter progress, driver names) is conveyed through on-screen text and icon states.
Win amounts and free-spin counts are shown as large high-contrast gold numerals on dark steel plaques; CREDIT/BET labels are gold/yellow text on a dark background for contrast.

Large round click targets; the central SPIN button is the largest interactive element. SPACE and ENTER both start/stop the spin; holding SPACE performs a turbo spin. AUTOPLAY (configurable spin count, SKIP SCREENS option) reduces required interactions for extended play.

Stable control positions across all base-game screens: menu+sound bottom-left, 'i' info button beside them, bet +/- flanking the round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY below SPIN. Info booklet is a strictly linear 8-page sequence navigated with prev/close/next controls, with an explicit 'Page n/8' text readout on every page.

Settings toggle switches convey on/off via knob position (left=off, right=on) in addition to green (on) versus grey (off) track color. Win confirmation uses explicit text ('WIN $24.00', 'LINE 2 PAYS $24.00') and miniature symbol icons in addition to the purple win-line drawn across the winning row.

Booklet navigation arrows are distinguished by triangle-vs-X shape, not color alone (green left/right triangles for prev/next, green X to close). Volatility is shown as both a 5-of-5 filled lightning-bolt icon count and explicit descriptive text, not color-dependent.

No information is conveyed by audio only; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC toggles in Settings are purely decorative. All game state (balance, bet, win amount, paying line) is shown as on-screen text and graphics.

Large circular touch targets, especially the central SPIN button (the largest control on screen). SPACE and ENTER keys can start/stop a spin without mouse precision. Autoplay (adjustable spin count, up to at least 100) reduces the number of repeated clicks needed.

Control layout is stable and predictable: menu/sound/info icons stacked bottom-left, balance labels center-left, spin button flanked by bet +/- center-right, autoplay below spin, provider branding bottom-left. The rules/paytable booklet is a linear 5-page sequence navigated with left/right triangle arrows and closed with a center X, with consistent icon positions across all pages.

A lost or pending row in My Bets keeps literal dash placeholders in its multiplier and cash-out columns, while a won row replaces them with real numbers - the outcome is legible from the text, not only from the row tint.
The green shield mark on every My Bets row is NOT a win indicator - it appears on losing rows too and marks fairness verification. Reading it as a result would be a mistake.
MAKE BET, CANCEL and CASHOUT share a similar warm palette and are told apart mainly by their text label, which makes the button state the one place where colour alone is not enough.
Sound, music and animation are separate toggles in the menu, and every result is printed on screen or in My Bets, so nothing is carried by audio alone.
Manual cash-out is time-critical, but Autocashout commits the exit coefficient before the round starts and autoplay runs whole series unattended, so the timing requirement can be removed entirely.

Three gummy bears (red/cherry red, purple/violet, amber orange/golden orange) share identical gummy bear silhouette; color is the sole differentiator between them. Non-color cues: paytable position (ranks 5, 6, 7 left to right) and payout magnitude (red > purple > orange).

Game modes distinguished primarily by background color: base game has pale lavender/blue grid interior and blue sky; Free Spins shifts to deep purple/violet background; Super Free Spins uses hot pink/magenta background. Non-color cues: FREE SPINS LEFT counter panel appears on the left (buy buttons disappear); Super label shown above the counter in Super FS; all 49 grid cells covered with golden multiplier tile markers at start of Super FS round.

Multiplier spot markers shown as golden/amber tile backgrounds vs plain uncolored tiles. High luminance contrast between marked and unmarked cells; marked tiles also have a distinct texture pattern providing a non-color visual cue.
Settings panel toggle states use green (ON) vs gray (OFF) fill color. Non-color positional cue: toggle thumb is on the right side when ON, left side when OFF.

SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are independently toggleable in settings. Win amounts shown visually: gold text in bottom bar during play and full-screen CONGRATULATIONS overlay with win amount at round end. FREE SPINS trigger visible via SCATTER symbol count on grid, intro overlay screen, and FREE SPINS LEFT counter panel appearance; no audio dependency for feature awareness.

Autoplay supports up to 100 consecutive spins, minimizing required input. TURBO SPIN and QUICK SPIN options reduce animation duration per spin. SKIP SCREENS auto-dismisses feature intro and end overlays after a short delay. Keyboard SPACE and ENTER start and stop the spin (verbatim from rules).

All interactive controls (spin button, bet up/down, buy FS buttons, autoplay, settings, info) are canvas-rendered, not DOM elements. Screen readers cannot interact with canvas natively. All actions require coordinate-based click or tap input; no accessible ARIA labels on canvas controls.

Three gummy-bear symbols (red, purple/violet, orange-gold) share an identical silhouette and are distinguished mainly by hue -- a genuine residual risk for red-green colour-blind players. The other four paying symbols (green star, orange heart, purple bean, pink lollipop) are also distinguished by shape, not colour alone.

No audio-only information observed on any captured screen; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles in System Settings. All game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, multiplier values, feature triggers) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals, not sound alone.

State cues use large high-contrast text/numerals rather than small print: paytable navigation arrows (shape+position), toggle switches (handle position), checkboxes (checkmark presence), multiplier tags and free-spins counters are all plain legible numerals/glyphs.

Large round click/touch targets throughout; SPACE and ENTER both start/stop the spin (keyboard-operable, no mouse required for core play); Autoplay with adjustable spin count and a SKIP SCREENS option substantially reduces the number of required interactions for extended play.

CREDIT balance does not update spin-by-spin during Free Spins -- it stays frozen at the post-purchase amount through every gameplay frame and only jumps to the new total on the round-ending win screen; a screen reader polling only the CREDIT field would perceive no change until the round completes.

Win counters animate (count up from zero to the final amount) rather than snapping instantly; a screen reader polling the win field mid-animation would read an unstable intermediate value, not the settled win -- reliable only once the animation completes or on the Free Spins round-total screen.

Multiplier values are printed as literal 'x<number>' text on every marked grid cell rather than conveyed by color/tier alone; the escalating tier color-coding (orange/red/magenta/purple/blue) supplements but is not required to read the value.

The three gummy-bear symbols (red / purple / orange-gold) share an identical teddy-bear shape and differ mainly by color; shape alone is not sufficient to distinguish their rank (noted residual risk). The other four candies (pink/magenta lollipop, orange/amber heart, magenta/pink jelly bean, green star) are distinguishable by shape alone.

VOLATILITY is shown as a count of filled vs. unfilled yellow lightning-bolt icons (5 of 5) plus the text 'High', not by hue alone. Settings toggle switches (Battery Saver/Ambient Music/Sound FX/Intro Screen) show state by both knob position (left=off, right=on) and track color (grey/green).

No information is conveyed by audio alone; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles in Settings. All game state (win amounts, spins remaining, multiplier values, feature triggers) is duplicated in on-screen text.

Large circular touch targets (SPIN is the largest). SPACE/ENTER also spin from the keyboard, and holding SPACE engages turbo spin. AUTOPLAY (up to 100 configurable spins) and SKIP SCREENS reduce the number of clicks/keypresses required for extended play.

Bottom-bar control positions are stable across screens: hamburger-menu + speaker stacked far bottom-left, 'i' info button beside them, CREDIT/BET center-left, bet -/SPIN/+ and AUTOPLAY center-right; BUY FEATURE and SPECIAL BETS are always the same two stacked left-edge buttons (with REBUY FREE SPINS appearing beneath BUY FEATURE after a purchased round). The info booklet is a fixed 8-page linear sequence, navigated by left/right triangle icons and a center X, with an explicit 'Page n/8' readout.

The three low-value gummy bears (red, purple, orange-gold) share an identical silhouette and are told apart mainly by color; the four higher symbols (candy ball, heart, crescent, star) are also distinguished by shape.
Free Spins switches from the pale daytime-blue base game sky to a deep purple/navy night sky with stars and snow - a brightness/texture shift, not hue alone.
Multiplier-marked grid cells are outlined with a gold rectangle AND show printed multiplier text (e.g. 'X2', 'X4'), not color alone.
No audio-only information; Sound FX and Ambient Music are decorative toggles. Win amounts, free spins remaining, and multiplier value are always shown as on-screen text.
CREDIT/BET/WIN readouts and free-spins/win-total counters use large, bold, high-contrast gold/cream text on dark backgrounds.
Large circular click targets; SPIN is also triggerable via SPACE or ENTER without pointing. Autoplay and Skip Screens reduce required interactions during repeated play.
Rules/paytable booklet is a strictly linear, explicitly numbered 7-page sequence ('Page N/7') navigated via left-arrow/X-close/right-arrow controls.

The active/selected bet or autoplay-round pill is distinguished from unselected pills by fill color (yellow vs dark purple) PLUS a bold black numeral, so the number is a non-color fallback. A third hover/last-touched state uses white fill; three-way color coding without a shape/icon differentiator could be ambiguous for colorblind users relying on color alone, but toggle switches (Spacebar to spin, Welcome Screen) use both knob position and color, which is accessible by position alone.

The 8 regular symbols are each visually distinct by shape/icon (numeral 7, grape cluster, watermelon wedge, bell, round gem, orange, lemon, cherry pair), so colorblind players can distinguish them by silhouette; the two scatters (Diamond vs Star) are also shape-distinct (teardrop gem vs five-point star).
Sound and Music are separately toggleable in Game Settings; no mechanic depends on audio alone -- win/loss and feature states are all shown as on-screen text/banners.
All numeric HUD values (BALANCE/WIN/BET) are rendered in bold high-contrast yellow-on-dark-purple; payout table figures use the same yellow-on-dark scheme with white row labels for symbol counts.

No accessibility gap noted for motion/photosensitivity control: the Gamble Feature screen uses a bright full-screen blue starburst flash and the Huge Win overlay a radial light-burst animation, both a possible photosensitivity concern -- no in-game setting was found to reduce flashing/motion effects (only Sound/Music toggles exist).
DOUBLE CHANCE toggle uses green (ON) and red (OFF) but also displays text ON/OFF — color not required to read state.
Settings toggles (BATTERY SAVER, AMBIENT MUSIC, SOUND FX, INTRO SCREEN) use green/grey, supplemented by toggle position (left=off, right=on) and text labels.
Buy Free Spins confirm/cancel buttons differ in shape (checkmark vs X), not color alone — usable by all color-blind types.

Ball symbols 7 (purple/violet), 8 (dark blue), 9 (green) may be confused by deuteranopes, but all carry printed numerals as the primary identifier. Their payouts are identical so misidentification does not affect payout understanding.

Weight boxes show yellow numerals on red squares. Contrast is reduced for red-green dichromats but the numbers remain legible. WILD symbol carries text WILD on the symbol itself. SCATTER carries text SCATTER.

Sumo portrait symbols are differentiated by expression and body features (angry brow/tattoos/bead necklace/round face/slim build/younger look), not color alone. Low symbols carry printed digits 6-10 for reliable identification.
AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separate toggles in settings. All game state (win amounts, free spins count, target weight) is shown visually as text numbers. No game state is audio-only.

TARGET WEIGHT shown in large bright yellow digits on amber/orange badge to the right of reels, labeled TARGET WEIGHT in yellow text. WIN amounts in large gold/yellow text centered below reels. MEGAWAYS counter in bright yellow top-left. FREE SPINS LEFT badge is purple with large yellow countdown digit.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spin. Large circular Spin button in bottom bar. Autoplay with configurable spin count (up to 100) via slider. SKIP SCREENS option reduces required interactions. Hold SPACE activates Turbo Spin. BUY FREE SPINS requires a two-step confirmation preventing accidental activation.
All game state values (FREE SPINS LEFT, WIN amount, TARGET WEIGHT, MEGAWAYS count, CREDIT, BET) are displayed as on-screen numeric text. No information is conveyed through animation or audio alone.

WILD/SCATTER/MULTIPLIER SCATTER are identified by shape and printed text ('WILD'), not color alone; the ways-to-win diagram pairs green checkmark vs red X with distinct check/cross shapes, so this is low risk.

Silver and gold multiplier badges share overlapping printed values (x2/x3/x5/x8/x10) but follow different math: SILVER badges add together, GOLD badges multiply the silver total. For those shared values, badge tint (silver vs gold) and position on the knob row is the only in-round cue distinguishing them - a genuine color-dependent barrier.

System Settings on/off toggles (BATTERY SAVER/AMBIENT MUSIC/SOUND FX/INTRO SCREEN) show state via BOTH handle position (left=off, right=on) AND a small icon inside the handle, in addition to green-when-on color.

No audio-only information is used; ambient music and sound effects are purely decorative and independently toggleable (AMBIENT MUSIC / SOUND FX). All game state (win amounts, spins remaining, multiplier values, bet/credit) is conveyed via on-screen text and numerals.

All control icons are white glyphs on dark circles with large round hit targets; CREDIT/BET labels are orange-yellow and WIN amounts are bright yellow/gold, both shown on dark backgrounds for contrast.

SPIN is operable via SPACE or ENTER (holding SPACE triggers turbo spin); all primary controls are large round buttons; AUTOPLAY (up to 100 spins) with a SKIP SCREENS option reduces the number of required clicks per session.

MENU/SOUND/INFO icons sit in a stable stack at the bottom-left corner; bet +/- flank the central round SPIN button with AUTOPLAY directly below; the rules booklet is a strictly linear 8-page sequence with an explicit 'Page N/8' readout.

Green is used for both navigation controls and 'on/confirm' UI states, but always paired with a distinct shape or glyph (left/right triangle arrows, X close, checkmark) or explicit text, so meaning never relies on color alone.

Settings toggle switches (Battery Saver/Ambient Music/Sound FX) show on/off state via BOTH knob position (left=off, right=on) AND track color (gray=off, green=on) — position is the non-color-dependent cue.
The 5 payline diagrams use filled-white vs filled-gray grid cells (shape/position-based), not hue, to show each line's path.

No information is conveyed by audio alone. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative; all game-state information (credit, bet, win amount, per-line payout, autoplay count, settings state) is presented as on-screen text/graphics.
Win amount, per-line payout text, and promo banner messages are shown as large, high-contrast yellow/white text on a dark background, legible without color discrimination.

All primary controls are large rounded buttons; the central SPIN button is the largest single target on screen. SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop a spin, giving a keyboard-only path. Autoplay with a configurable spin count and a 'Skip Screens' option reduces the number of repeated manual actions needed.

Control layout is stable across every screen (menu+sound bottom-left, info button beside them, credit/bet center-left, bet -/+ flanking SPIN, autoplay below SPIN). The info booklet is a strictly linear 5-page sequence navigated with prev/next/close and an explicit 'Page N/5' counter on every page.
Multiplier coins are colour-coded (green X2, blue X3, purple X5, red X7) but each also carries its printed number, so colour is never the only cue.
Settings toggles and autoplay checkboxes show state by both colour (green versus grey) and shape or position (knob right versus left, check mark versus empty box).

On bonus wheels, money wedges are plain coloured wedges with values like 10x; multiplier wedges are glossy pointed jewel shapes with an X prefix (X2 green, X3 blue, X5 purple, X7 red, X10 and X27 white-silver). Shape and prefix tell them apart.
Seven and BAR symbols are distinct by form; the plain seven versus seven on BAR differ only by a small BAR glyph at the seven's foot.

Every outcome has a visual form: win amount text, line number text, bonus trigger highlight, win banners. No sound-only cue is documented. Sound has a speaker button and AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles in settings.

Spin button, plus/minus and balance texts are large and high contrast (gold or white on dark). Win amounts and the winning line number are printed as text. Spin button is about 130 px, plus/minus about 55 px.

SPACE and ENTER start and stop the spin; holding Space gives turbo spin. Autoplay with a slider up to 100 spins, TURBO SPIN, QUICK SPIN and SKIP SCREENS options, and a speed-cycle button. Intro screen and promo badges can be switched off in settings. PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE makes the whole screen a click target.
No screen-reader hooks are visible; all information is drawn on canvas.
Symbols differ by shape, letter or picture, not only colour: A, K, Q, J, 10 are glyphs (pink-red, orange, lime-green, blue, teal-green); picture symbols differ by object.
Mystery symbol is a dark red silhouette with an orange glow when active; framed symbols carry a red frame with club-shaped feet in addition to the shape.
Active tab and selected values in menus are light green; the selected autoplay value is also shown by a lighter fill.
Win amounts, multiplier x-N, remaining free spins and banners such as 'One more scatter!', 'LAST FREE SPIN' and 'TOTAL WIN' are printed as text, so nothing is sound-only.
Wild and Scatter are gold with the words WILD and SCATTER lettered on them; TOTAL WIN is gold lettering on a pink-red banner; the multiplier is a large red x-N number.
Large round spin button, minus and plus bet buttons, Space key shortcut, autoplay of 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins, Turbo Spin option.
Paytable and Rules panels are real DOM text and readable; the reels are a canvas without text labels.

Jackpot tiers (MEGA gold/orange-pink outline, MAJOR white/purple outline, MINOR light-blue/blue outline, MINI yellow-green/green outline) are each labeled with their tier name and dollar value in text, not color alone.
Dialog confirm/cancel controls use color plus glyph: green circle with white checkmark = confirm, red circle with white X = cancel.
Settings toggle switches show on/off by handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to green-when-on coloring.
No audio-only information observed; sound is decorative (Ambient Music / Sound FX toggles). Respins left, collected value, jackpot tier and win amount are all conveyed visually and via text.
Win amounts, jackpot values and respin counters are rendered as large high-contrast white/yellow text on a dark plaque.
Central SPIN button is the largest on-screen control; SPACE/ENTER keys also start and stop spins; Autoplay and the two feature buy-buttons reduce clicks needed to reach paid features.

Control layout is stable across screens: menu+sound bottom-left, info button beside them, bet +/- around the central spin button, autoplay below spin, both buy-feature buttons fixed left, jackpot ladder fixed right; the info booklet is a linear 8-page sequence with a 'Page N/8' indicator.
Triple BAR (green), Double BAR (purple), Single BAR (blue) identified by bar count (3/2/1) independent of color. All colorblind types can distinguish by counting bars alone.

JOKER WILD identified by unique jester portrait shape (face + tri-pointed hat with gold bells), not color alone. Volatility badge includes authoritative text label 'Medium volatility' alongside lightning bolt icons.
All win amounts, feature states, and settings communicated visually. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX independently toggleable in settings. No essential information conveyed by audio only.
SPACE and ENTER keyboard shortcuts start and stop spins. Up to 100 autoplay spins with SKIP SCREENS option to bypass feature animations. Normal, Quick Spin, and Turbo Spin speed modes available.

All 9 symbols have unique non-color shapes. WIN amounts shown as dollar values in large gold text with 'WINNER' text label. Payline diagrams on rules page 3/6 are small visual grids that may require alt-text.

WILD-triggered modifier jars (EXPAND=blue, CASH=green, COLLECT=orange/pink) carry fixed text labels and switch from intact to a visibly SHATTERED jar with rising smoke plus a gauge needle in the danger zone when armed — shape/text based, not color alone.
Low-value card-rank symbols (A, K, Q, J, 10, 9) share identical blue neon styling on a dark circuit-board background and are distinguished only by letter/number shape and payout tier, never by color.

No information is conveyed through audio alone; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative, and all wins, spin counters, modifier states and feature outcomes are shown as on-screen text or numerals.
Card-rank glyphs (9 / 0 / 10 shapes) are moderately similar at small in-reel size, a legibility risk independent of color vision.

All primary controls are large circular targets; SPACE/ENTER give full keyboard control of spinning, holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin, and Autoplay with an adjustable spin-count slider reduces the number of required interactions.

Control layout is fixed: menu+speaker bottom-left, info 'i' beside them, CREDIT/BET center-left, bet +/- flanking SPIN, AUTOPLAY below SPIN, BUY BONUS (or its replacements) at a fixed far-left slot, GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR panel fixed far right.

WILD (red-orange tiki mask, green leaf crown) vs WILD MULTIPLIER (blue and gold tiki mask, blue flame crown): distinguished by both color and crown shape (leaves vs flames). Paytable payouts (50x vs 2000x) further differentiate them.

MONEY (torch: vertical stick with flame at top) vs COLLECT (campfire: horizontal log base with flame above): both fire-themed but clearly different silhouettes — shape alone distinguishes them without relying on color.

Jackpot tiers MEGA (warm red-orange label), MAJOR (magenta-pink label), MINOR (cyan-light blue label), MINI (bright green label): each tier has a distinct text name and monetary value alongside its label color — no color-only dependency.

Bonus buy dialog: Cancel button is a red circle with white X glyph; Confirm button is a green circle with white checkmark glyph. Icon shape (X vs checkmark) distinguishes function without relying on red-green color differentiation.
Autoplay checkboxes: checked state shows a green box with a white checkmark glyph; unchecked state shows an empty square outline. Checkmark shape identifies checked state independently of color.

All game states have visual text indicators: Respins Feature active shown by neon blue grid border and RESPINS LEFT numeric counter; '3 SPINS AWARDED' shown as overlay text; WIN amount shown in bottom bar and on win screen. Sound FX and Ambient toggles available in Settings independently.

Paytable payouts are white text on a dark background across 7 pages navigable with arrow buttons. Jackpot values are white text on black pill-shaped backgrounds on the right panel. Bottom bar labels CREDIT and BET are in yellow-gold text; values in white. All key info is in text numerals, not color-coded exclusively.

All controls are large circular click targets on the game canvas; no drag interactions required. SPACE or ENTER keys trigger spin. Autoplay configurable up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option to reduce mid-bonus interaction. Bet changed via plus and minus buttons.

Screen reader must announce full symbol names: 'WILD' (red-orange mask) and 'WILD MULTIPLIER' (blue-gold mask) are visually similar tiki mask shapes and require explicit name announcement on every landing. MONEY (torch) and COLLECT (campfire) must be announced by name and position (reel number).

Respins Feature state changes require announcement: feature trigger, current respin counter value after each respin, '3 SPINS AWARDED' transition, and final win amount on win screen. Jackpot tier hits (MEGA/MAJOR/MINOR/MINI) must announce tier name and value.

Winning lines are marked by a green glow, a numbered payline badge and a printed value overlay together, not color alone. The Free Spins feature is signalled by a full scene change (day farm to night barn interior) and explicit text counters as well as a color shift. Toggle switches show handle position besides fill color. Residual risk: the BARN and TWISTER tiles are both gold-bordered and distinguished mainly by their pictogram and printed name.

No information is conveyed only through audio; the Sound-Ambient and Sound-Effects toggles are decorative/optional. Bet, balance, win amounts, the Free Spins counter and jackpot values are always presented as on-screen text and numerals.

All primary actions use large circular buttons; the space bar is a full keyboard alternative for spin/stop. Auto Play with a stop-on-feature-trigger toggle reduces the number of required manual actions. BET MAX only raises BET LEVEL — reaching the true maximum bet needs COIN raised separately too.

Control layout is stable throughout the session: info/paytable far left, bet controls flanking the central spin button, auto play immediately to its right, balance at far right. The Help screen and Pay Table booklet are both linear scrolling text documents reachable from fixed entry points.

Win highlighting does not rely on colour alone: winning symbols stay bright while the rest are dimmed, a glowing line is drawn through them, the amount is printed as a number and the ribbon spells WIN with the amount.
Royal symbols differ by letter or number shape as well as colour: A gold-tan, K pink, Q green, J cyan-teal, 10 lilac-purple.

Turbo state is shown by a diagonal slash on the lightning-bolt icon; the selected autoplay pill is filled and its number changes colour. Paytable counts are white and payouts light blue, in the same 5, 4, 3 order for every symbol.

Multiplier wheel values are printed on every segment; segment colours (blue, yellow, red) do not map to fixed values. The Scatter is identified by the printed word SCATTER and a crown shape, the Wild by its emblem shape.

Space starts a spin, holding it repeats spins, pressing it during a spin skips the animation and it activates the only available on-screen button; tapping the game area stops the reels. Toggle switches (Ante Bet, settings) convey state by BOTH handle position (left=off/right=on) and fill color (grey=off/green=on); checkboxes add an explicit white checkmark glyph rather than relying on green fill alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; Ambient Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative, while all wins, spin counts, multiplier values and feature states are shown as on-screen text/numbers.

Splash-screen max-win text ('WIN UP TO 25,000X BET') and the volatility badge are large, high-contrast and paired with explicit numbers/words, not relying on subtle color alone; primary controls (SPIN, bet +/-, buy-feature buttons, dialog YES/NO) are all large touch targets.

SPACE and ENTER start/stop a spin; holding SPACE activates Turbo Spin, reducing the need for precise repeated pointer clicks. Autoplay offers a slider-selected spin count (default 100) with Turbo/Quick/Skip-Screens checkboxes to further cut down on manual interaction.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are purely decorative toggles. All game state (win amounts, spins left, multiplier values, feature triggers) is conveyed visually via on-screen text.

Large round touch targets; SPIN is the largest control. SPACE and ENTER also start/stop a spin. Autoplay with a configurable spin count and a skip-screens toggle reduces the number of required clicks.

Stable control layout: menu+sound far-left, 'i' info button beside them, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN, AUTOPLAY below/beside SPIN. The rules booklet is a strictly linear 7-page sequence with a 'Page n/7' indicator on every page.

The nine paying symbols are distinguished by shape (heart, square, pentagon, oval, and distinct fruit silhouettes) as well as color; paytable navigation arrows are triangle-shaped (not color-only); toggle switches use both track color (green=on/grey=off) and handle position (left=off, right=on).
The MULTIPLIER bomb symbol (free spins only) always shows its value as printed gold text/number rather than relying on color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone: bet, credit, win amounts, free spins remaining, multiplier values and tumble wins are all shown as on-screen text/numbers; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are decorative toggles only.

SPIN is the largest touch target on screen; SPACE and ENTER keys also start/stop a spin; holding SPACE triggers turbo spin; Autoplay (up to 100 spins with a SKIP SCREENS option) reduces the number of required discrete actions.

Bottom bar layout is stable across states: menu/sound/info icons far left, CREDIT/BET labels left-of-center, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN. The six paying symbols differ by shape as well as colour: heart, rounded square, oval, peach with stem and leaf, grape bunch, curved banana. The three prize plaques above the grid (lime green SNAP on the left, pink-red BURST with three gold stars on each side in the centre and widest, bright blue SPARK on the right) are told apart by printed labels, position and size, not only by colour.

Settings toggles show state by knob position (left off, right on) as well as grey versus green track; the autoplay checkbox shows its on state with a white check mark as well as green fill. No sound-only information: win amounts, spin counters and results are all printed. A speaker toggle sits outside the game strip at the lower left; SOUND is also a toggle in SYSTEM SETTINGS.

White text on near-black semi-transparent panels is high contrast; headings are orange-gold. The base-game message and win text sit over pink cotton-candy art, which lowers contrast. CREDIT and BET labels are gold-yellow with white amounts.

The build is PORTRAIT: the playable game is a narrow vertical strip in the centre of the window (about x 444 to 836 at 1280x800), with decorative non-interactive candy-landscape background on both sides, so text and symbols are small.
Multiplier values appear in large gold figures with a dark outline on a round candy ball; the remaining free spins count is shown as a very large number above the words FREE SPINS LEFT.

Main targets: the large round spin button (about 75 px across), minus and plus beside it (about 36 px) and bottom buttons (about 60 by 35 px), inside a narrow strip. Free spins and result screens advance by PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE; Autoplay offers SKIP SCREENS to avoid that tap.

The information panel needs a drag or wheel gesture to scroll. HOLD FOR TURBO SPIN is printed on the spin button while a menu is open, which implies a press-and-hold gesture. Autoplay has Turbo Spin and Quick Spin checkboxes, and Battery Saver reduces animation speed.

Everything is drawn on a canvas; no DOM text is exposed. Key facts are the CREDIT and BET amounts at the bottom and the message above the spin button (PLACE YOUR BETS!, WIN $x.xx, nX [symbol] PAYS $x.xx, n FREE SPINS LEFT).
Candies differentiated by shape: heart (red), rounded square (purple), pentagon (green), oval (blue). Fruits by silhouette: round apple, round plum, elongated watermelon, grape cluster, banana bunch.
SUPER SCATTER has a gold ring frame and red banner reading 'SUPER SCATTER' — text label identifies it independently of color. MULTIPLIER BOMB shows its numeric value prominently on the ball face.
NO/YES buttons in buy-confirm dialogs are red/green and also carry text labels. DOUBLE CHANCE toggle shows 'OFF' or 'ON' text regardless of color state.
SPACE and ENTER trigger or stop spin. Hold SPACE for Turbo Spin; TURBO SPIN checkbox in autoplay enables it without sustained hold. Up to 100 auto-spins; SKIP SCREENS auto-dismisses bonus overlays.
Win amounts shown as text in bottom bar ('WIN $X.XX'). Audio cues present for wins; sound is toggleable in settings. FREE SPINS LEFT counter displayed in large text on left side during FS.

4 candy symbols distinct by shape: heart (pointed bottom/rounded lobes), rounded square, pentagon gem (flat facets), rectangle. 5 fruits: apple (stem+leaf), round plum, lime oval, grape cluster, banana curve. Scatter: round swirl spiral. Bomb: round with fuse top. Shape is primary differentiator.

Free Spins state is dual-cued: background darkens to deep blue-purple AND 'FREE SPINS LEFT N' text counter appears. Settings toggles dual-cued by position (left=off, right=on) and color (grey/green). YES/NO bonus buy dialog buttons are text-labeled with spatial separation (left/right).

No audio-only game information. All wins, free spins triggers, multiplier values, and results conveyed visually as text overlays. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX can be independently disabled in SYSTEM SETTINGS. BATTERY SAVER reduces animations without affecting gameplay information.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spin. Full autoplay with configurable count and SKIP SCREENS option reduces repeated interactions. SPIN button is the largest bottom-bar element. 'PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE' on trigger/win overlays means any click or tap advances. BUY FEATURE and ANTE BET are wide panel targets.

Stable control positions every screen: menu+sound at far left, i-info button, CREDIT/BET center-left, SPIN with +/- bet in center, AUTOPLAY at far right. Left panel: BUY FEATURE top, ANTE BET toggle bottom. All win amounts, bets, credit, RTP values displayed as explicit text.

7-page Game Rules booklet via i-button; navigate with arrow buttons, X to close. Win events use explicit text: 'CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON $X IN 10 FREE SPINS'. Bonus buy dialog shows full sentence with cost amount. 'PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE' on all overlay screens.

Paying symbols are distinguished by shape as well as color: star=yellow/gold, kiwi=bright green with yellow-green starburst, strawberry=red with green leafy cap, orange=orange/amber wedge, raspberry=magenta/pink beads, blueberry=deep blue/indigo sphere.

Free Spins state is signalled redundantly by a palette shift (dark indigo reel background vs pale lavender base game) plus explicit on-screen text ('FREE SPINS LEFT n', 'TUMBLE WIN'), not by color alone; button icons are white glyph shapes on identical dark pills, and bet-menu +/- steppers are also distinguished by their +/- glyph, not just color.

No audio-only information observed; sound/music is decorative and can be muted via the speaker icon or the SOUND toggle in System Settings. All game state (wins, spins remaining, multiplier totals, bet values) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals.
Playable game area is a narrow vertical portrait strip centered in the capture (about 392px wide, full height); left/right thirds are blurred zoomed-in background filler with no interactive content.

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, bet +/- and the four bottom-bar buttons. SPIN can be held down for turbo instead of repeated tapping. Autoplay offers an adjustable spin count and a 'Skip Screens' option that auto-skips feature intro/end animations, reducing required interactions.

Stable bottom control row order: info (i) - autoplay - spin-speed cycle - bet menu (coin stack) - system settings (hamburger). Info/rules content is a single scrollable panel (1 paytable page + 9 rules pages) with a consistently-positioned close 'X' top-right; left/right letterbox filler columns carry no content and can be skipped.

High-tier symbols distinguished by shape: Cookie (round bumpy dome), Chocolate Bar (rectangle), Pink Donut (toroidal ring with center hole), Twisted Candy (elongated twist cylinder), Macaron (flat disc with two-tone halves and horizontal seam). Low-tier: Red Heart (heart silhouette), Yellow Square (square with swirl pattern), Green Square (plain square), Blue Jelly Bean (curved bean/teardrop). Yellow and Green Squares share square shape; Yellow has warm amber tone and decorative swirl vs Green plain cooler hue.

WILD has gold WILD text label as non-color identifier; distinctive blobby amoeba shape with protruding orbs. MONEY is a glowing orb with internal swirl — unlike all candy food symbols.

All significant events communicated via on-screen text: CONGRATULATIONS and YOU HAVE WON N FREE SPINS on FS trigger; WINNER text overlay during active cluster wins; FS completion screen shows exact dollar total; PRESS ANYWHERE TO CONTINUE on win screens. No audio-only information detected.

Winning clusters highlighted with dashed colored borders around the cluster boundary. FREE SPINS LEFT counter displayed in a blue rounded rectangle with large numeral. WIN accumulation updated numerically in the bottom bar. Mode transitions use full-screen text overlays in large bubble lettering. MONEY tracking panel shows count and accumulated dollar value as text.

Keyboard shortcuts: SPACE or ENTER to spin. All primary controls in bottom bar. Autoplay available (up to 100 spins, configurable loss and win limits). Win screens auto-advance or respond to any click or tap anywhere on screen.

7x7 grid (49 positions), cluster pays. Left panel top-to-bottom: BUY FEATURE button (2 options), SPECIAL BETS button with ON/OFF toggle. Bottom bar L-R: Settings (hamburger icon), Info (i), Credit and Bet display, turbo hint text, Bet-minus, Spin, Bet-plus, Autoplay. Keyboard: SPACE or ENTER to spin. During FS: FREE SPINS LEFT counter and MONEY panel with numerical dollar value.

Settings toggles show handle position in addition to green/grey track color; autoplay checkboxes use a checkmark glyph; Buy Bonus confirm/cancel use X vs checkmark glyphs in addition to red/green circles.
Winning clusters get a pink/magenta glow outline paired with an explicit on-screen dollar-amount callout, so identification does not depend on color alone.

No audio-only information observed; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative. Game state (win amounts, free spins left, bonus active, lives, multipliers) is always shown as on-screen text/icons.
Free spins count, max-win callout ('WIN UP TO 10,000 X BET') and win-summary amounts are large, high-contrast text on light plaques, legible without fine detail vision.

Large round SPIN button is the largest interactive element; SPACE and ENTER also start/stop the spin, holding SPACE engages turbo spin; Autoplay supports a configurable spin count (up to at least 100) reducing required clicks.

Stable control layout: menu+sound bottom-far-left, 'i' info button beside them, CREDIT/BET center-left, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY beneath SPIN; paytable/rules is a fixed 7-page sequence with arrow nav and a close X.

Symbols are told apart by distinct silhouettes (captain, parrot, monkey, octopus, crossed swords, skull, anchor, wheel, hook, bottle), not by colour alone. Multiplier values are printed as numbers. Winning symbols get a yellow outline frame.
Super Scatter differs from the plain gold scatter by a red ribbon banner with the word SUPER across the coin.
No information is conveyed by sound alone. Sound FX and Ambient Music have separate toggles in settings.

Bright saturated palette: deep purple, candy pink, turquoise blue, sunny yellow-gold, orange and green. Base game is a sunny beach with a blue sky; free spins are set in a blue underwater-style cave. Multiplier numbers are gold on purple pennants above reels 2-5.
Autoplay with a slider (100 spins shown), plus Skip Screens, Quick Spin and Turbo Spin options, reduce repeated input. Holding SPACE gives a turbo spin.
Rules text, bet readouts and the win line (for example 12X octopus PAYS $2.00) are on-screen text. Spin and autoplay are large round buttons. Keyboard: SPACE and ENTER start and stop the spin.

Ante Bet toggle changes position (left/right) AND icon glyph (checkmark vs right-arrow) AND text label (OFF/ON), not color alone; disabled Buy Free Spins panel is desaturated in tone rather than recolored, with unchanged text; scatter-progress meter shows both individual scatter icons (shape/count) and a printed number; active multiplier-reel cell is marked with a green box outline plus a printed numeral; symbol identity within a cluster reinforced by distinct icon shape (jelly dome vs flower vs octagon vs stacked pastry) and by letterform for royals A/K/Q/J, not hue alone

No audio-only information identified; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are decorative toggles in Settings; all game state (win amounts, free-spins-left counter, scatter progress, multiplier values, bet amounts, RTP/volatility/bet-limit info) is conveyed through on-screen text and numerals

High-contrast large text used throughout for critical numbers (win amounts, credit, bet, RTP, max win, free-spins-left counter), gold/yellow or white text on dark backgrounds; multiplier ladder, scatter meter and Ante Bet toggle pair color with shape/position/text redundantly; the rules/paytable booklet uses a single large, high-contrast font size per page rather than dense small print

Large circular touch targets with SPIN being the largest; SPACE and ENTER keys can start/stop a spin (keyboard-operable, no mouse required for core play); Autoplay with configurable spin count and optional Skip Screens reduces required clicks for repeated play

Stable control positions across all screens: hamburger menu and sound icons at far left of bottom bar, info 'i' icon just to their right, CREDIT/BET readout center-left, bet +/- flanking the large central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN; the in-game rules/paytable booklet is a linear 7-page sequence with explicit 'Page N/7' counter, making position always announceable

Settings/autoplay toggle state is shown by left/right switch position as well as colour (green=on); autoplay checkboxes use a white checkmark glyph, not colour alone; multiplier values are always printed as 'xN' text on the tile, never colour-coded; feature-state changes (base game to Free Spins to Super Free Spins) are shown by a full background and frame-colour change plus explicit on-screen text, not colour alone.
