The 4 BOMB symbol variants are mainly distinguished by gem color (red, teal, green, magenta); only the magenta variant has a distinct star-shaped outline as a secondary non-color cue, so red-green colorblind players may not reliably tell the other three apart by color alone.

No audio-only information is present; ambient music and sound FX are separately toggleable and purely supplementary; all feature states and win amounts are conveyed through on-screen text and graphics.

Win amounts, spins-left counters and multiplier values are printed as large plain white/gold text rather than conveyed by color alone; SCATTER symbols that trigger Free Spins are marked with a glowing gold outline (brightness), not color alone.

The central SPIN button is the largest click target on screen; SPACE and ENTER keys are documented alternatives to start/stop a spin; Autoplay supports up to 100 spins with a Skip Screens option enabled by default, reducing required interactions.

No information is conveyed by audio only; ambient music and sound FX are separately toggleable and purely decorative; all game state is shown as on-screen text/imagery.

Control layout is stable across screens: menu/sound bottom-left, info button next to them, CREDIT/BET center-left (doubles as coins/cash toggle), SPIN center-right, AUTOPLAY below SPIN; the rules booklet is a linear 6-page sequence with 'Page n/6' always shown.

The three jackpots (Minor, Major, Grand) are distinguished by text label and by layout position (left, center, right; Grand is the largest and centered), not by banner colour alone. Sound and Music have independent mute sliders in the Settings menu. The primary numeric readouts (Balance, Last Win, Bet Amount, jackpot values) use large, bold, high-contrast text: dark navy or brown on cream for the balance bar, and white or gold on saturated colour fills for the jackpot banners and win banners. The core interaction offers two redundant inputs: tapping the pinata directly, or clicking the separate, fixed-position round green button (taught explicitly in onboarding as 'Tap Pinata / or Button'). The Bet Amount decrease control locking at maximum heat is signalled by both an icon change (padlock) and a text label change ('Unlock'), not by greying out alone.

All numeric information (Balance, Last Win, Bet Amount, the three jackpot values, the spins-remaining and multiplier tickets, the Total Win banner) is rendered as on-canvas bitmap text rather than selectable DOM text in the base-game view, so a screen-reader user would need a purpose-built audio or text-alternative layer for this canvas UI.

The four Cascade Feature categories are colour-coded (pink=Extra Wilds, blue/purple=Extra Hot Zones, orange/red=Free Spins Trigger, green=Win Multiplier) but each card also carries a distinct icon (gold W-bones, pink grid/lattice, flame cauldron, skull-and-crossbones) and a printed numeric value, so no category depends on colour alone.

The four low-value rune gem symbols share one payout table and are differentiated mainly by border colour (red/purple/green/blue), but each also has a differently shaped glowing rune engraved on its face (S-curl / J-shape / C-or-L shape / lower-case e), giving a non-colour identification cue.
The Push Bet toggle uses a grey track with the switch on the left when off and a green track with the switch on the right when on; switch position is a redundant non-colour cue.
Every base-game and free-spins control icon (menu, sound, autoplay, bonus-buy, bet, spin) is a white line-art glyph on a dark circular button, shape-based rather than colour-coded.

No game information is conveyed by audio alone - wins, spins remaining, multipliers and feature results are all shown as on-screen text/graphics. The Settings panel exposes independent mute toggles for All Sounds, Sound Effects and Music.
WIN, EPIC WIN and CONGRATULATIONS banners use large gold bevelled 3D text with a dark outline against a warm orange glow, high-contrast against the dark background.

The SPIN button is the largest interactive target on the base and free-spins screens; the SPACE bar can trigger a spin as a keyboard alternative to clicking; Autoplay offers 8 preset spin counts (Off, 10, 20, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000) to reduce the number of manual clicks needed.

The game is canvas-rendered, so no text is natively exposed to a screen reader unless a separate accessible layer is added; the bottom navigation bar (grid/Paytable, ?/Rules, gear/Settings, shield/Know the Game) and the right-hand control column (Bonus Buy, Autoplay, Bet, Spin) keep a fixed, consistent order across every screen.
Winning lines are marked by a pink outline plus a printed amount label per line, and the PAID box prints the total, so colour is not needed.
Reel letters are told apart by shape (A, K, Q, J) as well as colour: A yellow-orange, K purple, Q green, J blue.
COLLECT (red octagon, left) and GAMBLE (green octagon, right) both carry their words in white-gold lettering and differ by position.

Bar Crawl board squares carry text or pictures (multipliers x2 to x10, BEER, ARRESTED, GIRLS, PIZZA HOUSE, MINGS TAKEAWAY), not colour alone.
All outcomes are shown visually through text banners, amounts, pink line outlines and per-line amount labels; no audio cue was seen to be required.
Bottom information bar is near-black with white labels BALANCE, BET and PAID and large white numbers; the top strip is black with a white clock and white text.

All controls are large tap targets and the spin button is a big round button; bonus intro screens accept a tap anywhere. After a win, a spin click is swallowed for about 8 seconds while the win presentation plays.

Large circular Spin button at bottom-right of the screen; Spacebar-to-spin is enabled by default as a keyboard alternative to clicking, and Autoplay with configurable stop conditions reduces the number of required interactions.

Symbols differ by shape and character (eagle beak, wolf ears, bear nose, owl eyes) as well as by hue; the Wild is marked by the word WILD on a blue tile.
Multiplier values are printed as numbers; paylines are numbered 01-10; line diagrams use light blue cells against grey cells; win lines are thin cyan paths numbered at the reel edge.
No sound-only information observed; sound can be toggled in the menu.
Dark navy translucent panels with light-blue headings and white or light-blue text; orange WILD lettering and win amounts; golden-yellow title; light-blue Confirm button.
Large central Spin button; Space key spins on PC and held Space spins continuously; tapping during a spin stops the reels; Turbo Spin shortens animation; Auto Spin 10/30/50/80/1000.
Paytable and Rules panels are real DOM text; wins are printed as text in the balance, bet and win pills.
Symbols are told apart by shape and silhouette (person badge, helmet, ball, shoe, cone, tickets, fluffy balls, whistle), not by colour.

Paytable: counts in white and payouts in gold sit in two fixed columns, distinguished by position as well as colour.

Space key spins and activates a lone on-screen button, holding Space repeats spins; Turbo Spin is available; Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 and 1000 spins.
The play field is a canvas, but paytable and rules are real page text with all numbers, so payouts and rules are readable; reel results and the multiplier step exist only as images.

Hold & Spin locked MONEY coins vs. empty cells are distinguished by content and shape (numbered gold coin vs. small green diamond outline), not color alone; toggle switches in settings show state by both position (left/right) and fill color.

Win amounts, the RESPIN LEFT counter, CREDIT and BET values are shown as large high-contrast gold/yellow numerals on a dark red banner; splash logo and 'WIN UP TO 5000X' promo text use large 3D outlined lettering.
Large circular touch targets for SPIN, BET MAX and START AUTOPLAY buttons; configurable autoplay spin count (default 100) reduces the number of required manual interactions.

Control layout is stable across all screens: INFO button and MENU button bracket the bottom row, bet -/+ sit either side of the central SPIN button, CREDIT/BET labels are centered above the spin bar; the rules/info booklet is one continuous scrollable document (drag up/down, X closes) rather than paged left/right arrows.

Cell outcome is carried by shape, not colour: a safe cell shows a faceted gem, a losing cell shows a padlock with a keyhole. The ladder rows are labelled 'hit 1' to 'hit 10' with the multiplier printed under each.

A flat dark-navy dashboard with three panels side by side: bet controls on the left, the multiplier ladder in the middle, the ten-row board on the right. The action button is a wide bright green BET; the current rung is outlined in blue.

Card royals A/K/Q/J are distinguished by letter shape, not only color (A red, K green, Q pink/magenta, J blue, each with gold bevel and small blue gem).
System-settings toggles show switch handle position (left=off, right=on) in addition to fill color; autoplay checkboxes show an explicit white checkmark glyph rather than relying on green fill alone.
Hold & Spin MONEY token dollar values and column multiplier tags are printed as plain text/numbers on each token, readable regardless of the teal token color or dark-blue multiplier pill color.

No audio-only information is conveyed; music and sound effects are decorative and independently toggleable (Ambient Music, Sound FX); all game state (wins, bet, credit, respins remaining, multipliers) is shown as on-screen text/numbers.

Win amounts and CREDIT/BET values are shown in large bold high-contrast orange/gold text on dark backgrounds; navigation and control icons are white glyphs on dark circular buttons, not thin low-contrast marks.

Large round click targets for SPIN, bet +/-, menu, sound and info; SPACE/ENTER keys also start/stop a spin, and holding SPACE engages Turbo Spin; Autoplay (adjustable spin count, Skip Screens option) reduces required clicks for extended sessions.

Bottom-bar controls hold stable positions across all base-game screens: menu+sound stacked bottom-left, info 'i' button beside them, CREDIT/BET labels left-of-center, bet -/+ flanking the central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY below/right of SPIN; the 6-page rules booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigated with consistent left/right-triangle icons and a center 'X' close.

Outcomes are told apart by SHAPE, not only colour: a safe block carries a check mark, an unsafe one a cross. The main button changes its WORD (Start Game / Cancel / Cash Out) rather than only its colour.
Sound is decorative and switchable in the settings menu; no information is audio-only.
The whole interface is real DOM text (the game draws no canvas), so browser zoom and text scaling work. Bet, balance, multiplier ladder and the difficulty name are numeric or worded text, not gauges.
No timed reaction is required: the tower waits for the player between rows, and autoplay removes repetitive clicking.
Controls are DOM elements with visible text labels and the round state is carried by the button text; nothing has to be inferred from an animation.
WILD and SCATTER badges are distinguished by printed text labels and distinct pictograms (gunslinger head vs steam-locomotive), not colour alone.
Bronze, silver and gold Coin tiers are identified by the printed multiplier number on each tile, not by metal colour alone.

ACTIVATE (ante toggles) vs BUY (one-shot purchases) buttons in the purchase dialog carry different button text, not just different button colour.

The reel background tint change (near-black base game vs dark maroon-red Free Spins) is reinforced by an explicit 'Free spins: N/M' text counter, so feature state stays readable without colour vision.

No audio-only information was observed; Sound FX and Music are separately toggleable sliders in Settings, and all game state (wins, spins remaining, multipliers, feature names) is conveyed as on-screen text/graphics.

Large circular spin button and large rectangular Buy/Activate/START buttons; bet is adjustable via a coarse 16-stop dropdown ladder or fine +/- steppers; Spacebar-to-spin is enabled by default, reducing required precision clicks.

Bottom bar layout is stable across base game and feature play: info/settings icons far-left, balance/bet readouts centre-left, contextual hint/win text centre, autoplay/spin far-right; the Buy Features cart icon and active-ante/Rebuy Bonus badges sit in fixed top-left/top-right positions.

CANCEL (red) / BUY (green) dialog buttons and CANCEL (red) / BUY BONUS (red launcher) are labelled with text and separated left/right, not distinguished by hue alone.
Disabled bet-ladder up/down stepper arrows differ in opacity/interactivity, not only color, at the 0.10 FUN minimum and the 24.00 FUN maximum.
Which payline paid is spelled out as text ('Line N pays') at the bottom bar in addition to any in-reel highlight.

No game state is conveyed by sound alone — balance, bet, wins, Bonus Game multiplier and autoplay count are all shown as on-screen text/numerals; Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative.
Win amounts and the Bonus Game multiplier/'TOTAL WIN' readout are large high-contrast gold/white numerals on dark backgrounds, legible without color discrimination.

Bet adjustment and autoplay round-count selection use discrete stepper/preset-button targets rather than fine drag gestures; Spacebar can trigger a spin as an alternative to clicking the spin button; Quick Spin is an optional speed-up, off by default.

jackpot tiers (green Mini / cyan Major / magenta Mega) are also distinguished by text labels, not color alone

control positions are stable across screens: info+settings bottom-left, bet display centered, autoplay+spin bottom-right

18 paylines shown as numbered grid diagrams with highlighted cells — position-based, accessible without color.

Mini-paytable panel persistent on left side of screen throughout gameplay showing all symbol payouts. Win amounts in large bold numerals. 'NICE WIN' / win amount displayed simultaneously in bottom bar and center overlay.

All win amounts displayed as dollar numerals (e.g., '$7.19'). Win tier labeled in text ('NICE WIN'). CREDIT and BET values shown as text labels in bottom bar.
