Jackpot tiers dual-coded: red GRAND, pink/magenta MAJOR, green MINOR, blue MINI plaques each also carry the printed tier name; toggle switches use color AND left/right handle position; multiplier bubbles use color AND printed 'xN' text.

Card suits (green Clubs, purple/magenta Spades, red/pink Hearts, light-blue Diamonds) are distinguished by both hue and distinct gem shape, not color alone; nav arrows use triangle/cross shapes, not color.

No information conveyed by audio alone; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative; win amounts, spins remaining and feature status are always shown as on-screen text.

Bright cyan/turquoise underwater scene with white stone ruin columns and coral; orange-red octopus, orange-shelled sea turtle, coral-red starfish; pink and gold pearl-in-shell MONEY symbols; gold-framed jackpot ladder in red, pink, green and blue.

Large round click targets for SPIN and bet +/-; BET MAX button jumps straight to the maximum bet; Autoplay slider up to 100 spins; SPACE/ENTER keyboard alternatives to clicking SPIN, holding SPACE engages turbo spin.

Stable control layout: MENU and INFO icons top-left of reel frame, bet +/- flanking the central round SPIN button bottom-right, AUTOPLAY below/right of SPIN; 8-page rules booklet navigated with left/right triangle icons and closed with a central X.

All five high-value symbols distinguished by shape alone: beer mug (glass with foam), harp (instrument), horseshoe (U-shape with clover), pipe (curved tube), mushroom (spotted caps). Card suits are four distinct shapes: spade (pointed), heart, clubs (three-lobed trefoil), diamond (rhombus). No color-only differentiation required.
Jackpot tiers MEGA/MAJOR/MINI use text labels on each sign board. Tier is always readable from the text label alone, without needing to perceive background color (red/blue/green respectively).
Settings toggles use position (right = on) and interior icon as shape-based cues in addition to color (green = on, grey = off). DOUBLE CHANCE button uses text 'OFF'/'ON' plus an arrow icon.
Winning cells highlighted with golden shimmer/glow animation; win amount text is always shown in the WIN bar simultaneously. Win event readable without color perception via text amount alone.

All game information presented visually. Win events and feature entries (Free Spins) are signaled by on-screen text and animation: FREE SPINS LEFT counter, clover-burst full-screen transition, CONGRATULATIONS screen, WIN amount in bottom bar. No audio-only cues. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX toggles in settings are independent.

Jackpot signs on left panel are large, clearly labeled boards. WIN amount shown in large yellow text. HUGE WIN overlay uses oversized 3D gold text. SPIN button is largest control on screen. CREDIT and BET labels use high-contrast white/yellow text. CONGRATULATIONS screen shows win amount in large yellow text inside a centered golden frame against dark red background.

SPACE and ENTER keyboard keys start and stop the spin, enabling play without a mouse. AUTOPLAY allows continuous hands-free play up to 100 spins. SKIP SCREENS option in autoplay reduces required interactions during feature entry/exit transitions.

All win amounts displayed as text in the bottom WIN bar and as large overlay text on win events (USD with dollar sign). Jackpot panel on the left shows MEGA/MAJOR/MINI labels with current cash values. GOOD LUCK! text signals active Money Collect. FREE SPINS LEFT N counter indicates FS mode and remaining spins.

All interactive buttons have icon and/or text labels: SPIN, AUTOPLAY, START AUTOPLAY (N), SYSTEM SETTINGS (hamburger), sound, info (i), minus, plus. WILD and BONUS symbols carry their names as text within the symbol graphic.

Jackpot plaques (MAXI/MEGA/MINOR/MINI) are distinguished by label text and vertical order — color (red/purple/teal/dark green) is supplementary. All payout values are numeric text. Royal symbols identified by letter character, not color alone.

Settings toggle state indicated by position (left=off, right=on) as primary cue; color (grey=off, green=on) is secondary. Confirm/Cancel buttons use X shape (stop) and checkmark shape (approve) — color (red/green) is secondary.
Gamble wheel win sector is visually much larger than lose sector — size is the primary distinguisher. Text labels 'WIN' and 'COLLECT' on buttons convey outcome without relying on color.
Free Spins mode distinguished from base game by the 'FREE SPINS LEFT X' text counter at bottom (non-color cue) in addition to the warm rose-pink/magenta background shift.

All game results (wins, free spin count, money collect awards) shown as on-screen text overlays and bottom bar values. No audio-only cues for game outcomes. Congratulations screen displays win amount in text.

Keyboard: SPACE and ENTER start/stop spin. All major controls (Spin, +/-, Autoplay) accessible via mouse clicks. Autoplay supports up to 100 auto-spins to reduce repetitive input. SKIP SCREENS checkbox available to skip intro/end screens.

All key data is text-labeled: MEGAWAYS counter is a live numeric value, WIN and CREDIT amounts in bottom bar, FREE SPINS LEFT countdown, jackpot tiers labeled MAXI/MEGA/MINOR/MINI. Paytable data is numeric. Gamble wheel probabilities listed in rules page 3 as text.

Base game background is a bright green Irish meadow with a multicolour rainbow (red/orange/yellow/green/blue/purple bands); reel frame is light wood with green vine and four-leaf-clover corner decorations.

Jackpot ladder panel: six pill labels distinguished by BOTH printed tier name/number and border color - EMERALD/MAX WIN (green pill, gold border), GRAND/1000X (dark teal pill, magenta border), MEGA/100X (dark teal pill, red border), MAJOR/50X (brown pill, purple border), MINOR/25X (brown pill, blue border), MINI/10X (brown pill, orange border).
WILD multiplier is printed as a legible numeral ('1X'/'2X') on a bright lime-green badge rather than relying on color alone.

Free-spins gamble wheel distinguishes win (green) and lose (dark red) zones by proportional wedge SIZE as well as color; the award ladder's current-amount rung is marked by position and printed number, not color alone.

MONEY symbol is a golden pot of gold with a green clover emblem; BONUS symbol is a golden four-leaf clover with a red/orange glow halo; Toadstool mushroom symbol is red-capped with white spots; Leprechaun boots are green leather with gold trim.
Settings toggles show on/off by BOTH handle position (left=off/grey, right=on/green) and a small icon on the active side; checkboxes use a white check-mark glyph, not color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are decorative toggles. All game state (win amounts, spins left, collected total, multipliers, mode active/inactive) is shown as on-screen text/numerals.

Large circular touch targets for MENU, SOUND, INFO, SPIN, bet +/- and AUTOPLAY. SPACE/ENTER provide keyboard-only spin control. Autoplay offers adjustable spin count and a Skip Screens option to reduce required interactions.

Control positions are stable across screens: menu+sound stacked far-left, info button beside them, bet +/- flank the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY sits directly beneath SPIN. The info booklet is a strict linear 8-page sequence with consistent left-triangle/right-triangle/X navigation.

Paying symbols are identified primarily by artwork/animal silhouette, not color alone: Wildebeest is dark purple with a purple glow and gold frame, Elephant's frame is green, Rhino's is orange/amber, Zebra's is blue, Antelope's is pink/magenta; SCATTER is a blue drum badge; WILD is a dark red plaque with gold lettering; SUPER WILDEBEEST is a gold wildebeest head on black.

Toggle switches (Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen) show on/off via BOTH handle position (left=off, right=on) and track color (grey=off, green=on); the Skip Screens checkbox uses a white checkmark glyph, not color alone.
Free Spins state is signalled by both a background palette shift (daytime blue/gold to dusk orange/purple) and on-screen text ('FREE SPINS LEFT n' / 'LAST FREE SPIN'), not color alone.

No information is conveyed by audio alone; Ambient Music and Sound FX are independently toggleable in System Settings, and all game state (win amounts, spins remaining, meter values, feature triggers) is presented as on-screen text/graphics.
CREDIT/BET labels are rendered in yellow high-contrast text on a dark bottom bar; win text ('WIN $X.XX') is bold white/cream lettering with a dark outline, centered at the bottom of the play area.

Large round click targets, SPIN being the largest bottom-bar element. SPACE and ENTER both start/stop a spin; holding SPACE performs a turbo spin, reducing repeated precise clicks. Autoplay offers an adjustable spin-count slider (default 100).

Control positions are stable across screens: menu/sound stacked bottom-left, separate 'i' info button beside them, bet -/+ flanking the central round SPIN button, AUTOPLAY below/right of SPIN. The rules booklet is a strictly linear 6-page sequence with left-triangle/X/right-triangle navigation and a 'Page N/6' readout.
Royal symbols A (pink/purple) and Q (lime green) have distinct letter shapes ensuring disambiguation without color. K (orange/golden) and J (orange-red) differ only in letter shape.
WILD is the only landscape-rectangle symbol; all others are square or portrait. WILD also has explicit 'W' letter. SCATTER is the only flat square tile with printed text label 'Scatter'.
Wild Respin locked Wilds show a bright neon glow border (visible in greyscale as brightness rim). Multiplier values are numeric badges (2x, 3x, 5x, 10x) — not color-only.
Free Spins mode changes background from street-scene to bubblegum-pink horizontal stripes — distinguishable by pattern change, not color alone. 'FREE SPINS LEFT N' counter shown on chalkboard.
Bonus Buy dialog action buttons: red cancel button shows white X symbol; green confirm button shows white checkmark — both color and icon symbol differ, fully redundant.
Settings/autoplay toggles: ON state is bright green pill shifted right; OFF state is grey pill shifted left. Position alone distinguishes state without relying on color.

All game outcomes conveyed visually: WIN amounts as text, feature mode via background pattern change and 'FREE SPINS LEFT' counter, respin state via SPIN button icon change. No game-critical audio-only information.
High-contrast yellow WIN text on dark bottom bar. Bold white text on dark overlay panels. Symbols use strong 3-D silhouettes: dome (jelly), hook (candy cane), rectangle (Wild), flat tile (Scatter).

Full keyboard support: SPACE and ENTER start/stop spin; hold SPACE for Turbo Spin. Autoplay up to 100 spins. Quick Spin and Turbo Spin options reduce session duration. Skip Screens reduces waiting time.
All win amounts, credit balance, total bet, free spins remaining, and multiplier values appear as on-screen numeric text. Seven-page info screen contains full textual rules for all features.
Picture symbols differ by animal shape (rooster, crab, prawn, carp) and object (coin, gourd); tile color (ivory, royal blue, emerald green, red) is a redundant cue.

Letter symbols A (coral red), K (green), Q (light blue) and J (pale cream-beige) share a white tile and differ by letter shape. Red A and green K could look alike for red-green colorblind players, but the letters are clear.

Winning tiles are marked by brightness: they glow white while all other tiles dim to dark grey. Win level is spelled in words: WIN, TOTAL WIN, BIG WIN; the TOTAL WIN ribbon is red with cream and gold text.

All outcomes are shown visually: win amount ribbon, multiplier number, glowing winning tiles and the BIG WIN overlay. Whether the Free Spins trigger and lives are announced visually is unknown, as the feature was never seen.
The J symbol is pale cream-beige on a white tile and is hard to see. Paytable and rules panels use small grey-white text on a near-black charcoal background; payout numbers are gold-yellow.

Wild appears as a large overlapping cluster of golden dice spanning several cells, visibly bigger than normal tiles. Cascade multiplier is a large red-orange number in an open white porcelain bowl at the top.
Large central round spin button with Turbo and Auto buttons at the sides. Tapping the button or game area during a spin stops the reels; on PC the Space key spins, hold Space keeps spinning.

During a spin the plus, minus and AUTO buttons are dimmed. Autoplay takes two steps: pick 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins, then press Start Auto Spin. The menu button sits at the far right edge and is partly cut off in the portrait window.
The game is drawn on a canvas; no readable text layer for the reels was confirmed. Paytable and rules panels are real text.
Selected values in Bet Options and Auto Spin are neon green but also marked by a centred highlighted band or filled pill and by text, not colour alone.

Winning lines are shown by vivid winning symbols against faded pale non-winning ones, a small win value on the line and a glowing yellow-white line number at both reel edges, so red/green deficiency does not hide them.
Paytable line diagrams use bright green lit cells on grey cells; only colour separates lit from unlit, but each diagram carries a printed line number.
No audio content could be documented from stills. Visual cues carry the main events: line glow, multiplier badge, Remaining Free Spin counter. A Sound toggle exists in the bottom menu.

Base game is a bright daylight waterfall scene; free spins switch to a golden sunset with orange, pink and gold haze and a rainbow arch. UI panels are dark charcoal-grey with white text, neon green for selected values, balance, Confirm and Start buttons.
Line-number markers at the reel edges are faint and translucent until a line wins. Win digits are decorative gold numerals.

All controls are single taps with no hold gestures. On PC Space starts a spin, hold Space for continuous spins, Space during a spin skips the animation. Bet wheels need a swipe, but Max Bet and Plus/Minus give tap-only alternatives. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins.

Win amount is repeated three ways: green ribbon text 'Win', the centre WIN pill and a value on the winning line. Balance, WIN and bet sit in the info bar above the controls. Remaining Free Spin counter and multiplier badge under reel 2 are visual-only cues.

Each of the 9 regular symbols has a distinct shape/motif: Athena Coin (face portrait on coin), Spartan Helmet (helmet with plume), Golden Vase (handled urn), Scroll (rolled parchment), Red Helmet (same helmet shape as rank-2, only sphere color differs — colorblind users should note both helmet symbols share the same icon), Owl (bird silhouette), Crossed Swords (X-blade pattern), Shield (round shield), Catapult (machine with wheel). Symbol identity can be distinguished by icon shape alone.

Multiplier gems share the same golden winged-frame shape but differ in gem color (blue sapphire, green emerald, pink/fuchsia, red ruby, purple amethyst). All gem variants are functionally identical — they all add their displayed numeric multiplier value. The numeric value (e.g. '12x') is displayed directly on the gem symbol, so function is readable without color.

Scatter (Athena Portrait) is a rectangular framed card — visually distinct from all other symbols which use circular spherical orbs. 'SCATTER' text label appears on the frame. No color dependency for identification.

Bonus buy cancel vs confirm buttons differentiated by icon shape (X vs checkmark) in addition to color (red vs green). Shape alone is sufficient. Autoplay SKIP SCREENS checkbox: checked state shown by green fill with white tick mark; unchecked is empty white-bordered square. Shape (filled vs empty) provides state indication.
Winning symbols during tumble sequences are marked with a large white X overlay, providing a shape-based (not color-only) indicator of which symbols are cleared.

All game outcomes, win amounts, feature triggers and states are communicated visually. Sound settings (AMBIENT, SOUND FX) can be toggled off independently without affecting gameplay outcome visibility. Win amounts, multiplier values, spin counts and feature announcements are all text-based.

Critical values displayed in large bold text with high contrast: CREDIT and BET in gold on dark background; WIN amounts in large gold text at bottom center; TOTAL MULTIPLIER in large gold text on dark mahogany panel with gold border; FREE SPINS LEFT in large white text on purple panel. The win amount on the Mega Win overlay appears on a purple pill-shaped banner in large gold text.

Locked row positions above the reel grid each display a gold numeral (1, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15) indicating the cumulative tumble threshold to unlock. Numbers are rendered in gold on a sandy/tan stone-frieze background.

SPACE and ENTER keys can start and stop the spin. Holding SPACE activates Turbo Spin (indicated by in-game hint). Spin speed also adjustable via spin-speed cycle button (Normal/Quick Spin/Turbo Spin). Autoplay available via AUTOPLAY button; AUTOPLAY SETTINGS dialog allows setting number of auto-spins via slider and enables SKIP SCREENS. Bet adjustable with on-screen +/- buttons or via Bet Menu.

Main game elements top-to-bottom left-to-right: game logo top-right; BUY FREE SPINS button (price shown) top-left panel; ANTE BET toggle (bet amount and ON/OFF state) left panel; locked row with 6 tumble-unlock indicators (1,3,6,9,12,15) above reel grid; 6x5 reel grid center; Athena character illustration right; CREDIT and BET displays bottom-left; HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN hint bottom-center; settings/info buttons bottom-left; minus/spin/plus/AUTOPLAY buttons bottom-right.

All game outcomes and win amounts are communicated visually as on-screen text. Feature triggers shown via full-screen text overlay with CONGRATULATIONS and spin count. Tumble wins shown in TUMBLE WIN counter box. Free spins completion shown with WIN amount and FREE SPINS COMPLETED label. No information conveyed through audio alone.
Toggle switches (Battery Saver, Ambient Music, Sound FX, Intro Screen, Ante Bet, Super Spin) show state via thumb position (left=off, right=on) in addition to track colour.

ANTE BET / SUPER SPIN active state is shown via the literal word 'ACTIVE' plus a white checkmark glyph, not colour alone; free-spins-left, tumble-win and total-multiplier values always appear as explicit white/gold numeric text on dark plaques rather than relying on colour.

Locked-row unlock state is shown by carved gold numerals (1/3/6/9/12/15) and by carved-stone-vs-live-symbol imagery (shape), not colour alone. Residual risk: the CONFIRM BUY dialog differentiates CANCEL (red) from YES (green) primarily by colour, though the words 'CANCEL' and 'YES' are also printed as a text fallback.

No audio-only information was observed; Ambient Music and Sound FX are purely decorative toggles in Settings. All game-state information (wins, free spins remaining, multipliers, purchase confirmations) is presented as on-screen text/numerals.

Balance and counter values (CREDIT, BET, WIN, FREE SPINS LEFT, TOTAL MULTIPLIER, TUMBLE WIN) are shown in large high-contrast white or gold text on dark maroon/teal plaques; the paytable/rules booklet uses large green triangle nav controls plus a text 'Page N/8' indicator rather than a bare scrollbar.

All primary actions are large circular touch targets (SPIN, MENU, INFO, AUTOPLAY); SPACE and ENTER both start/stop a spin, reducing the need for precise pointer clicks. Autoplay (slider observed to at least 100 spins) reduces total required interactions. Buy-feature and special-bet purchases both require a two-step confirm (select tile -> CONFIRM BUY -> YES), guarding against accidental large-stake purchases.

Control layout is stable across all captured states (hamburger menu + info top-left; CREDIT/BET left-of-centre; SPIN centre-right flanked by -/+ steppers; AUTOPLAY below SPIN), but the two quick-buy/special-bet plaques change their own label text (BUY FEATURE <-> REBUY FREE SPINS / REBUY SUPER FREE SPINS) depending on purchase history, so a screen reader would need to re-announce them on every state change. The 8-page rules/paytable booklet is a linear sequence navigated with '<' / 'X' (close) / '>' and a 'Page N/8' indicator.

Multiplier token diamond colors (blue/green/magenta/red) do not encode value — always paired with a printed number (2x-500x); Free Spins state is signalled by a full background color shift (warm orange day vs cool navy night) plus explicit text labels, not color alone; toggle switches and checkboxes also change position/glyph, not just color.

No game state is conveyed by audio alone — wins, spins remaining, multiplier totals and feature triggers are all shown as on-screen text/imagery; Ambient Music and Sound FX can be toggled independently without losing any information.
CREDIT/BET, running win totals and multiplier values are shown as large high-contrast yellow/gold text on dark backgrounds; SPIN and bet +/- buttons are the largest on-screen touch targets.

SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop the spin, so the game is fully keyboard-operable; Autoplay offers a configurable spin count plus a Skip Screens option, reducing the number of required manual interactions.

Control layout is stable across screens: menu/sound icons far left, a separate info 'i' icon beside them, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY directly beneath it; the rules booklet is a fixed linear 8-page sequence with a consistent Page N/8 indicator and left/close/right navigation icons.

WILD identified by golden heart shape AND bold 'WILD' text label — not color alone. BONUS identified by orb shape AND 'BONUS' text label. Royal symbols A/K/Q/J distinguished by both distinct letter shape and color (crimson/blue-purple/teal/magenta). BUY FREE SPINS button is bright green; Ante Bet OFF state is crimson — red-green colorblind users rely on the 'OFF' word label since toggle states differ only by color.

AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are separate toggles in settings — both can be disabled independently. All game events (wins, multiplier increases, free spins trigger) communicated visually: text overlays, glowing effects, cauldron animation for multiplier increase, flashing symbol outlines on wins.

Megaways counter top-right shows live ways count in large digits. Free Spins left panel has large FREE SPINS LEFT counter (bright yellow-green digits) and MULTIPLIER counter (large golden digits on dark background). Win amounts shown in large golden bold text bottom-center. Small descriptive text under settings toggle labels (white on dark) may be difficult at reduced size.

SPACE and ENTER keys start and stop spin (confirmed in rules). Hold SPACE for Turbo Spin. Autoplay available with configurable count (observed 100), QUICK and TURBO SPIN modes, and SKIP SCREENS option for reduced interaction.

12 distinct symbol types: Witch, Owl, Cat (high), Candle, Cauldron, Green Potion (mid), A/K/Q/J (low royals), WILD, BONUS. Dynamic Megaways counter changes every spin (critical for understanding current ways-to-win). During Free Spins: two live counters — FREE SPINS LEFT and MULTIPLIER — both key state indicators. Win amount shown at bottom-center and reflected in CREDIT display.
Jackpot tiers carry word labels on the plates above the reels and on the discs, so hue is redundant; the four rims are magenta-purple, deep blue, green and red-orange
Power Play levels differ by title word, by one, two or three stacked wolves and by price, not only by orange versus red
Fire Spins has an orange-red sky and Blitz Spins a pink-magenta sky; both rounds also have a text panel with a 1-2-3 counter
Collected values are shown in red digits with a dark outline, plain cash values in gold digits; the outline differs besides the hue
Selected stake in the stake window is a white-filled button with dark text, not a hue change
No caption for sound cues was seen; all feature states and wins are shown as text on screen. Sound can be muted with the speaker button
Headings are yellow on a dark background, body text is white; payline diagrams are yellow cells on dark cells, so line shape is carried by position

Spin by button (spacebar may also work depending on jurisdiction and operator), autoplay of 10, 25, 50, 75 or 100 spins with a stop button, speed button; no hold-to-spin. Spin button about 130 px across, small buttons about 50 px

State is also written as text: message bar (PRESS TO SPIN, GOOD LUCK, PAID with amount), line wins announced as LINE N PAYS amount, TOTAL WIN plate, banner words NICE WIN, BIG WIN, HUGE WIN, panels FIRE SPINS and BLITZ SPINS with a counter. Bottom strip with clock and session result is real page text

MOON (cool blue-white disc) and GOLD MOON (warm amber-gold disc) are distinguished primarily by color. GOLD MOON name is distinct in paytable text; its landing triggers a visible chain-removal animation providing a non-color cue for the matrix unlock event.

Jackpot tiers GRAND/MAJOR/MINOR/MIDI/MINI each show name text and dollar amount on sidebar panels; panel color (deep purple/medium purple/blue/grey-blue/bright green) is a redundant third channel only.

Royal symbols A/K/Q/J distinguished by letter shape regardless of color (A=hot pink, K=red-orange, Q=golden-amber, J=sapphire blue). SCATTER canyon tile carries yellow 'SCATTER' text label as a non-color identifier.
All game outcomes, win amounts, and jackpot awards appear as on-screen text. SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC independently toggleable in System Settings. No critical audio reliance for game outcomes.

HOLD SPACE keyboard shortcut for turbo spin. Autoplay with configurable spin count (slider to 100 spins), QUICK SPIN, TURBO SPIN, and SKIP SCREENS options reduce required motor input significantly. Plus/minus bet buttons in bottom bar for bet adjustment.

All 12 symbols named in paytable: Bison/Eagle/Horse/Puma/A/K/Q/J/WILD/SCATTER/MOON/GOLD MOON. RESPINS LEFT counter shown as numeric text. Win amounts stated as dollar text (e.g. 'YOU HAVE WON $140.00'). CREDIT and BET always visible as labeled text in bottom bar.
Jackpot tiers MINI/MAJOR/MEGA each have distinct text labels and different dollar amounts — color alone does not distinguish them
Win highlighted by golden glow overlay AND 'WINNER' text plus 'WIN $X.XX' label — shape and text redundant with color
High-value symbols depict distinct animals with different silhouettes (bison/eagle/horse/puma); royals use distinct letterforms A/K/Q/J with different color schemes
Money Respin coins display numeric values in large bold text; MINI JACKPOT and MAJOR JACKPOT coins carry their own text labels — not color-only identification
All critical game information conveyed visually with text labels; feature completions confirmed by on-screen text (WIN $X FREE SPINS COMPLETED); sound is supplementary only
SPACE/ENTER keyboard shortcuts start/stop spin; SPIN button is the largest UI element; AUTOPLAY (up to 100 spins) reduces per-spin interactions; HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN hint always visible
Key on-screen texts: WOLF GOLD, MINI/MAJOR/MEGA, jackpot dollar amounts, CREDIT $X.XX, BET $X.XX, WIN $X.XX, WINNER, N RESPINS LEFT, FREE SPINS COMPLETED, AUTO SPINS LEFT N, Page N/7

Money Bubble cells are circular orbs with dollar amount text — distinguishable by shape and text, not color alone. FREE PLAY cells have a wolf face portrait and bold white 'FREE PLAY' text — distinct by shape and label. Winning cells gain a gold glow border AND share the same text value, confirming match without relying on color.

Game fully playable with all sound off. No audio-only information. Wins indicated visually by gold cell border highlight and WIN/TOTAL WIN text in bottom bar. Audio toggles (AMBIENT, SOUND FX) available in settings.

Large high-contrast text throughout: white and golden-yellow on dark backgrounds. The '3' in 'MATCH 3 TO WIN!' is displayed extra large for emphasis. Prize amounts shown in large bold golden text on orb cells. Bottom bar uses bold white text for CREDIT, TOTAL WIN, WIN labels.

Minimal interaction: select purchase quantity (radio button), click BUY NOW, then SCRATCH! or AUTOPLAY. AUTOPLAY eliminates per-card clicking. STOP halts autoplay. No time pressure, no rapid input required.

All game state readable as text: CREDIT balance, TICKETS LEFT count, persistent 'MATCH 3 TO WIN!' instruction, WIN and TOTAL WIN amounts after each card, button labels (SCRATCH!, PLAY NEXT, STOP, BUY MORE TICKETS, BUY NOW). Paytable is a plain text table with 10 tiers. Symbol identity given by dollar amount text or 'FREE PLAY' text — no image-only identification needed.
Jackpot tiers MINI/MINOR/MAJOR/GRAND distinguished by text label AND left-to-right position (ascending value) in addition to capsule color — tier readable without color.
Bonus buy dialog cancel (X icon) vs confirm (checkmark icon) use both shape and color — distinguishable without color perception.
Ante Bet toggle shows 'ON'/'OFF' text label in addition to green/grey color change. Autoplay SKIP SCREENS checkbox uses checkmark shape vs empty box.

Settings toggles (BATTERY SAVER, AMBIENT MUSIC, SOUND FX, INTRO SCREEN) differentiate state by green vs grey color only — no explicit ON/OFF text visible in settings panel. Potential accessibility gap.
SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC toggle off independently in Settings. All game information is visual; no story content dependent on audio.

Bison symbol: warm amber-orange card with golden border and red corner gems. Eagle: white head feathers on dark body, golden border. Horse: brown/chestnut with dark green mane. Puma: tawny gold fur on purple-violet background. WILD wolf: face split blue-white left / orange-gold right with purple glow border. MONEY: light blue/cyan glowing moon disc with golden numerals on face.
Low royal symbols: A is magenta/hot pink, K is golden yellow/orange, Q is golden yellow, J is cobalt blue/royal blue. All have distinctive serif letterforms with crown accents.

SPACEBAR triggers spin without mouse click. AUTOPLAY with SKIP SCREENS option minimizes per-spin interaction. SPIN and AUTOPLAY buttons are large circular targets in bottom bar. Bet adjustable via plus/minus buttons in bottom bar or from Settings overlay.
SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spin. CREDIT and BET values are text labels clickable to toggle coins/cash view. Paytable is text-based with named symbols and payout values.

Four masks are square tiles with faces: red-brown jaguar-like, violet fanged, emerald-green human, deep-blue bird. Five gems are non-square shapes: red hexagon, golden-yellow triangle, purple heptagon, green circle, blue diamond. Same-colour pairs (red mask and red hexagon, purple mask and purple heptagon, green mask and green circle) differ by shape, so colour is never the only cue.

Each gem also carries a distinct carved motif: dancing figures on the hexagon, coiled serpent on the triangle, calendar-like emblem on the heptagon, spiral ring on the circle, square pattern on the diamond.
SCATTER and SUPER SCATTER medallions carry the written words. The two bomb suns differ only by brightness and gem-tipped rays (green, blue, red), which is a weak cue.
Win feedback is also visual: glowing winning symbols, tumble animation, win-tier banners such as SUPERB and CONGRATULATIONS screens. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX can be switched off in SYSTEM SETTINGS.

Multiplier digits above the reels are gold with a red outline on dark brown stone recesses; free spins multipliers are gold on dark stone, high contrast. Balance, bet and win values are white on dark panels with orange-gold labels.
The BUY FEATURE label is muted bronze on brown when the feature is unavailable, which is low contrast. Winning symbols glow cyan during tumbles.

Large circular spin button; SPACE or ENTER starts and stops the spin, hold SPACE for turbo spin. Autoplay with a slider up to 100 spins, plus TURBO SPIN, QUICK SPIN and SKIP SCREENS options. BATTERY SAVER reduces animation.
All gameplay is on a canvas; DOM labels were not checked. Wins, balance, free spins left and multipliers appear as on-screen text only.

The four low-value kanji symbols (Zhong/Ren/Ji/Dao) are distinguished primarily by different glyph shapes, with color only a secondary cue; the four high-value icons (Boss, mask, knife, sake) are likewise shape-distinct, not color-coded.

Reel multiplier values are printed numerals inside gold boxes ('x1' .. 'x18'), not conveyed by color intensity; win and spin-count readouts ('WIN', 'Total Win', 'Remaining Free Spin: N') are always numeric text, never color-only.

Residual risk: base game vs Free Spins state is signalled mainly by a brown-vs-red/maroon background tint, though this is reinforced by the 'Remaining Free Spin' counter text that only appears during the feature.
No information is conveyed by audio alone: wins, remaining spins, multipliers and bet are always shown as on-screen numerals/text, and a dedicated Sound on/off toggle exists in the rules menu.
Win banners ('Total Win', free-spins summary) use large high-contrast gold script on a dark red/brown background, legible without fine color discrimination.

The central SPIN button is the largest on-screen target. PC users can hold Space to auto-repeat spins, press Space mid-spin to skip the reveal animation, and Space also activates the sole on-screen button when only one is available. Auto Spin presets (10/30/50/80/1000) reduce the number of manual actions needed.

Bottom control bar has a stable left-to-right order: Turbo Spin - Minus - SPIN (largest, centered) - Plus - Auto Spin, with a separate status row above showing profile/balance, provider badge, current bet and a Bet Options button.

WILD is identified by its circular medallion shape and 'WILD' wordmark, not color alone. The coin-pair and lantern-pair symbols differ by object shape (round coins vs hanging lanterns), not just color. Card symbols A/K/Q/J/10 are distinguished by glyph shape since their fill colors (gold/red/green/teal/pink) can be hard to tell apart under color-vision deficiency, particularly red K vs green Q.

The bonus trigger and the ordinary win highlight must be told apart by SCOPE, not hue: an ordinary win highlight tints only the reels on a winning payline (e.g. 3 of 5 reels turn cyan), while the bonus trigger requires ALL FIVE reels turning the identical color (green, blue or red) simultaneously.

Card royal symbols A/K/Q/J use letter shapes as primary differentiator alongside color (pink/green/purple/ice-blue). Q (purple) and J (ice-blue) may be difficult to distinguish for tritanopes. Ice Pick uses axe shape to differentiate from card royals.

Settings toggles use green (ON) vs gray (OFF) color with no visible text state label — concern for green-gray colorblind users. Bonus Buy dialog cancel (red X) vs confirm (green checkmark) are differentiated by X vs checkmark symbol shapes — adequate for red-green colorblind users.

Multiplier badges are blue rounded rectangles with white bold x-value text (x2, x5, x10, x20) overlaid on symbol lower edge. Badge presence/absence is shape-based, not color-only. Free Spins mode indicated by purple reel cell backgrounds AND FREE SPINS LEFT text badge.

No audio-only game state information identified. Win amounts and Free Spins counts are displayed as on-screen text. Feature start/end has visual overlays with text (CONGRATULATIONS, YOU HAVE WON, FREE SPINS LEFT). SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC toggles available in Settings.

WILD displays WILD text banner in yellow on dark background. SCATTER displays SCATTER text banner. Free Spins active state shown via FREE SPINS LEFT counter badge with large white text and number. Multiplier badge values shown as bold white x-value text on blue background overlaid on each symbol.

SPACE and ENTER keys trigger spin; holding SPACE activates Turbo Spin. Autoplay available via AUTOPLAY button with slider-configurable spin count and SKIP SCREENS option to reduce interruptions. Primary on-screen spin button embedded in decorative yeti character art at right-center (approx. x=1042 y=482 in 1280x800) — may be hard to locate precisely for motor-impaired users.

5 reels x 4 rows, 20 fixed paylines left-to-right; minimum 3-of-a-kind on adjacent reels from reel 1. SCATTER (icy mountain peak, SCATTER text banner): 3/4/5 anywhere = 10/15/20 Free Spins. WILD (yeti face, WILD text banner): substitutes all except SCATTER. Primary spin button is embedded inside yeti mascot illustration on right side of screen — keyboard SPACE or ENTER is the accessible alternative.
Royal letters A/K/Q/J/10 share one orange-to-yellow gradient color scheme but are differentiated by glyph shape only, not by color -- color-blind-safe by design.
Free Spins counter (n/15), Moon Multiplier value (x1/x3/x6) and each sticky Wild's bonus tag (+2/+3/+5/+10) are shown as printed numbers, not conveyed by color alone.
The bonus signpost switches between the words 'BUY BONUS', 'BONUS ACTIVE' and 'CHANCE x2 ACTIVE', not only by a color change.
Settings toggles (Quick spin, Spacebar to spin) show state via fill color AND an explicit checkmark glyph plus handle position, not color alone.
Winning cells on a base-game win are marked by a white outline and dimming of the rest of the grid (position/contrast-based), not by color alone.

No audio-only information observed; Sound FX and Music are separate adjustable/mutable sliders, and all game state (wins, spin counts, multipliers, feature status) is conveyed redundantly via on-screen text.
Win banners and the 'TOTAL WIN' summary use large high-contrast digits (red/gold on cream, white on dark translucent bar), legible without fine color discrimination.
The 'MAX WIN 8000x' callout and 'CLICK TO START' on the splash screens are large high-contrast text on a light background.
Large circular Spin button is the primary target; Spacebar-to-spin is enabled by default as a keyboard alternative to clicking.
Autoplay offers configurable stop conditions (on any win, bonus won, single win exceeds, balance change) reducing repeated manual spin clicks.
Bet ladder is a scrollable dropdown list (verified boundaries 0.20 FUN and 32.00 FUN) rather than requiring many individual +/- taps.
Bottom bar controls have stable positions: info(i)+settings(gear) far left, Total bet stepper center-left, status/win text center, autoplay(A)+Spin far right.
The Information panel (paytable + rules) is one continuous scroll reachable via chevrons/icon rail, not discretely numbered pages -- should be read as one linear document.

Symbol identity relies primarily on distinct SHAPES (star, heart, donut ring, square, triangle, spiral, gradient ball) even though adjacent hues (red/orange/pink) exist; shape remains the reliable cue for color-blind users.

Yommi Boost state is reinforced with text ('DISABLE Yommi Boost') and an icon change (white star on the SPIN button), not color alone; Free Spins state is signalled by a full scene/background change plus explicit 'Free spins: n/12' text.

No audio-only information was observed; all outcomes (wins, spins remaining, multipliers, feature triggers) are conveyed through on-screen text/numerals; Music/Sound FX are separately toggleable and default on.
Win-tier names ('HUGE WIN' vs 'TOTAL WIN' vs 'AWESOME') and win amounts are large high-contrast white numerals on a bright green disc, legible without color discrimination.
Bet adjustment uses small up/down triangle buttons (a finer target than a typical +/- pair), a minor motor-accessibility friction point; autoplay presets (10-1000 rounds) reduce manual spin clicks.

Bottom bar controls have stable positions (info/settings far-left, balance/bet centre, autoplay+spin far-right); the paytable/rules booklet has only 2 switchable sections (money-bag=Paytable, question-mark=Rules), navigated by scrolling rather than page arrows.

State is conveyed redundantly: toggle switches by handle position plus text label ('OFF'), checkboxes by checkmark glyph, cancel/confirm buttons by X-vs-checkmark glyph, feature state by explicit text ('FEATURE ACTIVE', 'FREE SPINS LEFT n') as well as by color glow, and every payout/value is printed as text on its tile rather than color-coded. The five royal card symbols (A yellow/gold, K red, Q lime-green, J light-blue, 10 pink/magenta) are distinguished primarily by their printed letter/number glyph, with color only a secondary cue. Sub-round outcome (PIGS continue vs POLICE end) is conveyed by the symbol image itself, not by color coding.

No information is conveyed by audio alone in the captured frames; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently toggleable and purely decorative/reinforcing. All wins, feature triggers, spin counts and totals are shown as on-screen text.

All interactive targets are large filled circles or wide pill/rectangle buttons. SPACE and ENTER can start/stop spins without pointer use. Autoplay (up to a slider-selected count, default 100) and a dedicated Turbo/Quick spin-speed cycle reduce the number of required clicks. The bet menu offers coarse -/+ stepping plus a one-click 'BET MAX' shortcut.

Control positions are stable across all game states: hamburger-menu and sound stacked bottom-left, information 'i' just to their right, bet -/+ flanking the large central SPIN button, autoplay pill directly below SPIN. The 7-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigated with left/right triangle buttons and a numeric 'Page n/7' readout, closed with a dedicated X.

White Glazed Donut and Chocolate Donut share identical ring shape — distinguished by color only (white/cream glaze vs dark brown glaze with sprinkles); no in-game text label differentiates them; risk for protanopia/deuteranopia users

WILD symbol (combo meal plate) identified by neon yellow-green glow border and multi-item composition (burger, fries box, drink can, sauce cups) — distinguishable from single-food paying symbols by shape complexity beyond color
Win multiplier shown as text 'BIG SALE x[N]' on a parchment-tan scroll at lower-left — not color-coded; value readable without color perception

Free Spins mode uses multiple redundant non-color cues: 'FREE SPINS LEFT [N]' text counter, pennant bunting decoration above grid, multiplier text starting at x3, and purple reel borders alongside background sunset hue change
AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX independently toggled off in SYSTEM SETTINGS; BATTERY SAVER reduces animation speed; game fully playable with all audio disabled
SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spin — full keyboard alternative to mouse; hold SPACE triggers turbo spin
Low symbols A/K/Q/J are each a different colour (green/red/purple/blue) but also a distinct letter shape, so colour is not required to tell them apart
Money Re-Spin board: filled cells show a blue disc with a printed currency number, empty cells show a plain grey disc with no number — distinguished by content and colour together
Settings toggles (Sound - Ambient, Sound - Effects, Quick Spin) show on/off by both colour (orange vs grey) and handle position (right vs left)
All numeric information (bet, payouts, spins remaining, RTP, prices) is shown as plain readable numerals rather than colour-only cues

Switching into Free Games swaps the reel background from a bright daytime pastel sky to a darker night-blue sky with lightning streaks — a brightness/composition change, not just a colour change, signalling the mode switch
SPACE bar both starts and stops a spin, reducing reliance on precise mouse clicks on the small round SPIN button
Auto Play supports stop conditions (feature triggered, balance loss threshold, single-win threshold) that reduce the need for repeated manual intervention
The Help overlay is real HTML text and reads correctly via a DOM text probe; the in-game paginated booklet is rendered on canvas and is not separately accessible as text without OCR

Mode choice (Olympus vs Hades) is doubly redundant: text label ('PLAY IN OLYMPUS'/'PLAY IN HADES') plus distinct character art plus distinct icon shape (blue lightning bolt vs red bull horns), not color alone.
Royal letters A/K/Q/J/10 share one design differentiated by the letter glyph itself (purple/red-orange/gold-orange/blue/green color is secondary, not load-bearing).

Buy Feature button re-skins orange (Hades) or blue (Olympus) and Special Bets stays purple in both modes, but all three controls are also uniquely positioned (Buy Feature bottom-left, Special Bets top-right) and fully text-labelled.

Expanding WILD multiplier value is always printed as text ('WILD Nx') on the character, not conveyed by glow color alone; Zeus (white/silver, cool glow) and Hades (fire crown, warm glow) appearances are also distinguished by shape, independent of active mode.

Settings toggle state (Battery Saver/Ambient Music/Sound FX) is shown by BOTH switch handle position (left=off, right=on) AND fill color (gray=off, green=on) AND an explicit pause/bars icon on the on-state handle.
Autoplay checkboxes (Turbo Spin/Quick Spin/Skip Screens) show state with an explicit white checkmark glyph, not fill color alone.

No information is conveyed through audio only; AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independently togglable and purely decorative. All game state (win amounts, free spins remaining, multiplier values, RTP, bet limits) is presented as on-screen text/numbers.

Disabled bet +/- controls (at min/max bet) are rendered flat gray versus the green/white active-state buttons - a shape/contrast cue in addition to color, visible at the bet-menu ceiling ($250.00 total bet).

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, bet +/-, and menu icons. SPACE/ENTER start and stop a spin (keyboard-operable); HOLD SPACE triggers turbo spin. Autoplay (adjustable spin count, SKIP SCREENS on by default) minimizes required clicks for extended play.

Stable control layout across both modes: hamburger/speaker/info icons stacked bottom-left; CREDIT/BET labels center-left; bet -/+ around the central SPIN button; AUTOPLAY directly below SPIN; Buy Feature always bottom-left of the reel frame; Special Bets always top-right; Choose Volatility ribbon always far-left edge. The 8-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence navigable with only prev/close/next controls.

Mode selection conveyed by position (left/right), icon shape (lightning bolt vs bull-horn/altar) and explicit volatility word ('HIGH'/'VERY HIGH'), not by hue; toggle switches use left/right position plus grey/green fill; win amounts and spin counts always printed as explicit text.

Symbol colors: royals are purple/magenta (A), red/orange (K), gold/yellow (Q), blue (J), green (10). Olympus theme is cool sky-blue/cyan with gold accents; Hades theme is dark red/orange fire with a grey/gunmetal frame - modes are further distinguished by scene content (columns/blue sky vs stairs/fire), independent of hue.
No information is audio-only; SOUND FX and AMBIENT MUSIC are purely decorative toggles in Settings. All game state (wins, free-spins-left, multipliers, prices) is conveyed as on-screen text.

Win amounts rendered as large high-contrast text: gold on dark-blue plaque (Olympus) or gold on dark-red plaque (Hades); checkbox state uses a check-mark glyph (shape) not color alone; large circular touch targets throughout.

SPIN is the largest touch target on screen; SPACE/ENTER keys also start/stop a spin (keyboard-operable). AUTOPLAY slider up to 100 spins and SKIP SCREENS checkbox reduce required repeated clicks by auto-advancing feature intro/end screens.

Control layout is stable and identical across both modes: hamburger-menu + sound icons bottom-left, info ('i') button nearby, CREDIT/BET labels center-left, bet +/- around the central circular SPIN button, AUTOPLAY beneath SPIN. The 7-page info booklet is a strictly linear sequence with explicit 'Page N/7' text and consistent prev/close/next controls at a fixed position.

Zeus-side (blue) vs Typhon-side (red) distinction reinforced by LEFT/RIGHT text labels on paytable, 'ZEUS WIN' and 'TYPHON WIN' text bars, character position (Zeus left of grid / Typhon right), and contrasting subjects (white eagle vs red phoenix, white horse vs dark horse, silver lyre vs gold lyre).

GOD MULTIPLIER values displayed as numerals (2x/3x/5x/7x/10x/20x) inside coins positioned at screen corners. Combined multiplier shown as large numeral overlay at grid center. Not color-only communication.

Settings toggle states use position (left=off, right=on) in addition to grey (off) vs green (on) color. BUY FEATURE panel (gold color) and SPECIAL BETS panel (purple color) each carry descriptive text labels, not color alone.

Ambient Music and Sound FX independently togglable in System Settings. Battery Saver mode reduces animation speed (benefits motion-sensitive users). All feature triggers and win amounts shown via on-screen text overlays.
HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN keyboard shortcut available. Autoplay supports up to 100 spins with configurable stop conditions. Quick Spin and Turbo Spin checkboxes available in autoplay settings.

Win amounts displayed simultaneously in ZEUS WIN bar, TYPHON WIN bar, and main WIN display at bottom bar. FREE SPINS LEFT N counter uses numeric text with purple badge styling. Credit and BET shown as labeled gold text.

Each lane's chance gauge is a red-to-yellow-to-green gradient bar with a pointer, but the exact 'CHANCE: N%' value is always printed in text underneath, so the gauge color never has to be read to know the odds.

The bottom-left run-history strip marks a lost pick with a dark maroon/brownish-red filled pill and an older cashed win with a green filled pill; the win/loss distinction is partly carried by shape too (a plain grey text badge with no background marks an earlier successful-but-uncashed pick), but the green-vs-maroon pair relies on hue/lightness contrast between two filled pills, which may be harder to tell apart for some color-vision deficiencies.
Pay symbols differ by shape and glyph, not only by colour: A, K, Q, J and 10 are distinct pixel letters and numbers; heroine, zombie, pistol and knife are distinct silhouettes.
The scatter carries the printed word SCATTER (pink lettering with cyan edge on a gold chest). Multiplier tickets carry the printed value (x2, x5 and so on).
Weak spot: the red spin button versus the lime-green Start and Collect buttons rely on colour, but each also has a text label or an arrow icon.
Sound toggle in the menu. Wins and features are also shown visually (WIN counter, FREE SPINS WON banner, TOTAL WIN screen), so no information is audio-only.
Winning symbols are shown by a yellow glow and an explosion animation plus the WIN counter, not by colour only.
Panel text is light grey on dark charcoal (lower contrast); payout numbers are hot pink on dark. Accent colours: hot pink, lime green, golden yellow, cyan, red.
Strong flashes and glow animations on wins, wheel spins and explosions; no reduced-motion setting was seen.
Large red spin button at the bottom centre; autoplay (10 / 30 / 50 / 80 / 1000 spins) avoids repeated taps. A spin can be stopped by tapping the button or the game area.
PC keyboard: Space starts a spin; holding Space continues spins; pressing Space during spinning skips the reel animation; when only one button is available, Space activates it.
Symbols identified by character/letter shape, not color alone. High symbols: 4 unique zombie portrait faces. Low symbols: A/K/Q/J letter shapes are primary identifier; color is supplementary.
SCATTER: 'SCATTER' text label plus unique brain shape. WILD: 'WILD' text plus numeric multiplier (x2, x3) in text. MYSTERY: '?' printed on gift box face. All identifiable without color perception.

Settings toggles: knob position indicates state (left=OFF, right=ON) independent of grey/green color. Buy dialog: X icon=cancel, checkmark icon=confirm. Paytable valid/invalid ways diagram uses checkmark/X shapes.

Free Spins trigger indicated visually: reel frame changes to red-and-green carnival style, background shifts to indoor tent, confetti appears, FREE SPINS LEFT side counter shows. MEGA WIN shown as full-screen text overlay with amount.

Yellow/gold text on dark backgrounds for credit, bet, win amounts, FS counter. Large text for MEGA WIN amount, BUY FREE SPINS $160, and FREE SPINS COMPLETED label. Symbol cells approximately 143x150px at 1280x800.
SPACE and ENTER keys start/stop spins (shown as on-screen hint). Autoplay configurable up to 100 spins with SKIP SCREENS option to reduce interaction. Turbo and quick spin modes reduce wait time.

Key info as text: max win 5000x (preview screen), RTP 96.50%, bet $0.20-$100.00 (rules), BUY FREE SPINS $160, FREE SPINS LEFT counter updates each spin, WIN amount and FREE SPINS COMPLETED label on completion.
Payout lists use a white count and a lime-green value, and all multipliers and win amounts are printed as numbers (x25, 0.54), so they do not rely on colour.
The six royals A, K, Q, J, 10, 9 are stone-grey letters each with its own muted tint (dusty rose, tan, lavender, slate blue, muted green, steel blue-grey) and also differ by glyph.
Wild is a tall expanded column with the word WILD in glowing green; Scatter carries the word SCATTER in orange on a green emblem, so both are identifiable by text and shape.
Winning symbols glow green only: during a cascade the highlight colour alone marks winners, shape and position do not.
The selected Auto Spin choice is shown by dark-green fill with lime text and by position, among grey unselected round options.
A Sound toggle exists in the menu. Results are shown visibly through the WIN text in the marquee band; no sound-only cues were observed.

Dim, murky olive-green and teal laboratory background with high contrast; reel cells are dark near-black green panels. Key text is lime green (balance, bet, Confirm, Start), orange (SCATTER, ZOMBIE) and teal cyan (banner band, 1600 WAYS plaque).
Expanded Wild multiplier numbers are large green digits prefixed with x on dark ground; the marquee band under the reels is partly cut off while scrolling.

Large round Spin button centred at the bottom; Space starts a spin, hold repeats, Space skips the reel animation. Auto Spin offers 10, 30, 50, 80 or 1000 spins. Turbo, minus, plus and auto buttons are small.
The game is drawn on a canvas; the Paytable and Rules panels are real DOM text and readable, but the reel field has no text alternative.

Settings toggles, autoplay checkboxes, and buy-feature confirm/cancel dialogs pair color with shape (handle position, checkmark glyph, X icon), so state is never color-only; WILD (blood bag with gold 'WILD' text) and SCATTER (yellow bus with red text) are identified by shape and text, not hue

Base game vs free spins is signalled by a full background scene change (teal school corridor vs rainy amber street) plus persistent text labels ('FREE SPINS LEFT', 'MULTIPLIER'); win-tier celebrations 'SENSATIONAL!' (orange glow) vs 'MEGA!' (blue glow) are distinguished by different words as well as color

No audio-exclusive information observed; all game state (win amounts, spins remaining, multiplier value, feature name, RTP/rules text) is conveyed through on-screen text and iconography. AMBIENT MUSIC and SOUND FX are independent, clearly-labelled toggles in System Settings so audio can be fully disabled without losing information
CREDIT/BET balance labels are rendered in yellow-on-dark high-contrast text; primary controls (SPIN, MENU, sound, info) are large circular high-contrast white-glyph-on-dark-circle icons

Large circular touch targets for SPIN, MENU, sound and info; SPACE/ENTER keyboard shortcuts start/stop spins without needing to target the on-screen button. Autoplay (adjustable spin count plus a Skip Screens option shortening forced-wait intro/outro screens) reduces repeated clicks needed to play many rounds

Controls are stable and consistently positioned: hamburger MENU + sound speaker bottom-left, 'i' info icon beside them, bet +/- flanking the central SPIN button, AUTOPLAY below SPIN. The rules booklet is a strict linear 7-page sequence navigated by prev/next arrows with a persistent 'Page N/7' indicator; a single X closes it from any page. Both Buy-Feature entries are fixed left-edge signs with explicit text price/description, not icon-only
